papers.title: KPolaris: GPU-accelerated Polarized Radiative Transfer in General Relativity
papers.abstract: Polarized black-hole images carry information about both the magnetized plasma and the curved spacetime through which the radiation propagates. We present KPolaris, an open-source GPU-accelerated general-relativistic polarized radiative-transfer code built on the Kokkos framework. It supports analytic plasma models and GRMHD simulation data, with both fast-light and slow-light radiative transfer. The code also provides diagnostics that connect image structure to the emitting plasma and to propagation effects along the rays. These include emissivity-weighted plasma maps, emission contributions from selected regions, selected-ray histories, and sensitivities of the Stokes parameters to plasma parameters. Numerical convergence tests and comparisons with an independent radiative-transfer code assess the accuracy of the calculations. GPU acceleration reduces the computational cost of image generation, facilitating multi-frequency and time-dependent studies of polarized black-hole images.

classification.title_zh: KPolaris：广义相对论中GPU加速的偏振辐射转移
classification.abstract_zh: 偏振黑洞图像携带了磁化等离子体和辐射传播所经过弯曲时空的信息。我们提出 KPolaris，一个基于 Kokkos 框架构建的开源 GPU 加速广义相对论偏振辐射转移代码。它支持解析等离子体模型和 GRMHD 模拟数据，并支持快光和慢光辐射转移。该代码还提供诊断工具，将图像结构与发射等离子体及沿射线的传播效应联系起来。这些诊断包括发射率加权的等离子体图、选定区域的发射贡献、选定射线历史，以及 Stokes 参数对等离子体参数的敏感性。数值收敛测试以及与独立辐射转移代码的比较评估了计算的准确性。GPU 加速降低了图像生成的计算成本，促进了偏振黑洞图像的多频和时间依赖研究。
classification.one_liner: KPolaris 是一个基于 Kokkos 的 GPU 加速广义相对论偏振辐射转移开源代码，用于生成和分析黑洞偏振图像。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接对应重点标签‘经典引力/广义相对论’，属于广义相对论黑洞成像与辐射转移计算，但不涉及全息或量子引力理论。

papers.title: Stochastic motion of massless particles near event horizons in Schwarzschild and Reissner-Nordstr\"om spacetimes
papers.abstract: In classical general relativity, it is well known that radially moving massless particles in the exterior region take infinite coordinate time to reach the event horizon in black hole spacetimes. In this short paper, we use two stochastic versions of ingoing radial null geodesic equation to study the stochastic radial motion of massless particles in Schwarzschild and Reissner-Nordstr\"om spacetimes. We show that the probability that a radially moving massless particle enters the black hole in finite coordinate time remains zero. This indicates the stochastic perturbations of quantum effects preserve certain properties of classical black holes.

classification.title_zh: Schwarzschild 和 Reissner-Nordström 时空中事件视界附近无质量粒子的随机运动
classification.abstract_zh: 在经典广义相对论中，众所周知，在黑洞时空的外围区域，径向运动的无质量粒子需要无限坐标时间才能到达事件视界。在这篇短文中，我们使用入射径向零测地线方程的两个随机版本，研究无质量粒子在 Schwarzschild 和 Reissner-Nordström 时空中的随机径向运动。我们表明，径向运动的无质量粒子在有限坐标时间内进入黑洞的概率仍然为零。这表明量子效应的随机扰动保持了经典黑洞的某些性质。
classification.one_liner: 用随机径向零测地线方程研究 Schwarzschild 与 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞事件视界附近的无质量粒子，发现有限坐标时间落入黑洞的概率仍为零。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，直接讨论黑洞事件视界附近经典零测地线及其随机扰动；不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶。

papers.title: Gravitational Imprints of Dark Energy in Neutron Stars
papers.abstract: We investigate, for the first time, the non-radial $f$-mode oscillations of neutron stars (NSs) with a dark energy (DE) core utilising a fully general relativistic treatment. We construct the stellar profile by considering a relativistic mean field model for nuclear matter and a modified Chaplygin fluid like prescription for DE. We compute the stellar structure, $f$-mode oscillations, tidal deformability, and gravitational wave (GW) energy and strain of the NS with DE core by varying the DE equation of state (EoS) parameters. Our study reveals that the inclusion of DE softens EoS and reduces the maximum mass compared to the pure neutron star. The obtained mass-radius values are consistent with observational constraints from massive pulsars such as PSR J0030+0451 and PSR J0740+6620. We find that the extent of the DE core, determined by the transition density, plays a crucial role in modifying the stellar structure and oscillation properties, with lower transition densities producing appreciable changes over a wider mass range. The $f$-mode frequencies and damping times exhibit systematic modifications, for higher mass configurations, while the correlation between the $f$-mode frequency and tidal deformability remains consistent with observational constraints from GW170817 and GW190814. Further, the normalised oscillation energy distribution remains nearly universal, with only minimal deviations for the higher mass configurations. Finally, we estimate the characteristic GW strain associated with the $f$-mode oscillations and find that the predicted signals lie within the sensitivity band of future third generation GW detectors.

classification.title_zh: 中子星中暗能量的引力印记
classification.abstract_zh: 我们首次采用完全广义相对论处理，研究了具有暗能量（DE）核心的中子星（NS）的非径向 f 模振荡。我们通过核物质的相对论平均场模型和暗能量的修正 Chaplygin 流体型方案构建星体轮廓。通过改变暗能量状态方程（EoS）参数，我们计算了含 DE 核心 NS 的星体结构、f 模振荡、潮汐形变以及引力波（GW）能量和应变。我们的研究表明，引入 DE 会软化 EoS，并相对于纯中子星降低最大质量。所得的质量-半径值与 PSR J0030+0451 和 PSR J0740+6620 等大质量脉冲星观测约束一致。我们发现，由转变密度决定的 DE 核心范围在修改星体结构和振荡性质方面起关键作用，较低的转变密度会在更宽的质量范围内产生显著变化。对于较高质量构型，f 模频率和阻尼时间表现出系统性修正，而 f 模频率与潮汐形变之间的关联仍与 GW170817 和 GW190814 的观测约束一致。此外，归一化振荡能量分布几乎保持普适，仅对较高质量构型有极小偏离。最后，我们估算了与 f 模振荡相关的特征 GW 应变，并发现预测信号位于未来第三代 GW 探测器的灵敏度波段内。
classification.one_liner: 完全广义相对论下含暗能量核心中子星的 f 模振荡、潮汐形变与引力波信号研究，属经典引力/相对论天体物理。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/广义相对论与引力波天体物理，符合重点标签之一，但不涉及全息、AdS/CFT 或量子引力主线。

papers.title: Thermodynamics of arbitrary spherical surfaces in FLRW spacetimes
papers.abstract: In this work, we investigate the thermodynamics of arbitrary spherically symmetric surfaces in non-flat FLRW spacetimes within general relativity. Adopting the gravity-to-thermodynamics perspective, the Clausius relation and the unified first law follow directly from the gravitational field equations and matter dynamics, with a central role played by the matter-flux measure derived from energy-momentum conservation. The cosmological apparent-horizon and event-horizon thermodynamics are both recovered as special cases. In particular, the event-horizon temperatures derived from the gravitational dynamics satisfy both thermodynamic relations without introducing phenomenological modifications, and the corresponding temperature reduces to the Gibbons-Hawking temperature in the de Sitter limit. We further show that previous inconsistencies originate from incompatible temperature prescriptions rather than from any intrinsic deficiency in the thermodynamics of the cosmological event horizon. These results demonstrate that the gravity-thermodynamics correspondence is a generic feature of gravitational dynamics rather than a property unique to causal horizons.

secondary_topics: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: FLRW 时空中任意球对称面的热力学
classification.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们在广义相对论框架下研究非平坦 FLRW 时空中任意球对称面的热力学。采用引力到热力学的视角，Clausius 关系与统一第一定律直接由引力场方程和物质动力学推出，其中由能量-动量守恒得到的物质通量测度起核心作用。宇宙学视界与事件视界热力学均作为特例被恢复。特别地，由引力动力学得到的事件视界温度无需引入现象学修正即可满足这两个热力学关系，并且在 de Sitter 极限下相应温度约化为 Gibbons-Hawking 温度。我们进一步表明，先前的不一致源于不相容的温度约定，而非宇宙学事件视界热力学本身存在内在缺陷。这些结果表明，引力-热力学对应是引力动力学的一般特征，而不是因果视界独有的性质。
classification.one_liner: 在非平坦 FLRW 时空中，任意球对称面的 Clausius 关系与统一第一定律可由引力场方程直接导出，事件视界温度在 de Sitter 极限回到 Gibbons-Hawking 温度。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力与视界热力学，不直接涉及 AdS/CFT 全息，但涉及引力-热力学对应和宇宙学视界，可作为经典引力支线参考。

papers.title: Lensing Signatures of a Primary Hair Black Hole Solution
papers.abstract: We investigate the weak and strong field gravitational lensing of light by a primary hair black hole (BH) solution obtained within the framework of the gravitational decoupling (GD) approach. In this method, the BH solution is constructed by introducing geometric deformations to a known seed spacetime, which, in the present case, is the Schwarzschild geometry. The deformation functions are determined by imposing the dominant energy condition, leading to the emergence of two characteristic parameters, the primary hair $Q$ and the coupling constant $\alpha$, both of which deform the Schwarzschild spacetime. To explore the lensing properties of this BH, we employ the Gibbons-Werner approach in the weak field regime and Bozza's formalism in the strong field regime. In the weak field limit, we derive the deflection angle up to second-order corrections and find that the coupling parameter $\alpha$ contributes more significantly to the leading-order deflection than the primary hair parameter $Q$. The primary hair is also found to exhibit an effectively repulsive gravitational behavior. In the strong field regime, we compute the deflection angle of photons propagating near the photon sphere, where the deflection diverges logarithmically, allowing photons to complete multiple loops around the BH and form relativistic images. Using the supermassive BH Sgr A* as the astrophysical lens, we further investigate the strong lensing observables, namely the asymptotic angular position $\vartheta_{\infty}$, the angular separation $s$, and the relative magnitude $r_{\mathrm{mag}}$. We also constrain the primary hair parameter $Q$ for different values of the coupling constant $\alpha$ using the shadow observations of Sgr A* reported by the Event Horizon Telescope (EHT) Collaboration.

classification.title_zh: 初级毛发黑洞解的引力透镜特征
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在引力解耦（GD）框架下研究了由初级毛发黑洞解引起的弱场和强场引力透镜效应。该方法通过向已知种子时空（此处为 Schwarzschild 几何）引入几何形变来构造黑洞解。形变函数由主导能量条件确定，导致出现两个特征参数：初级毛发 Q 和耦合常数 α，二者都会使 Schwarzschild 时空发生形变。为探索该黑洞的透镜性质，我们在弱场区采用 Gibbons-Werner 方法，在强场区采用 Bozza 形式。在弱场极限下，我们将偏折角推导到二阶修正，发现耦合参数 α 对领头阶偏折的贡献比初级毛发参数 Q 更显著；初级毛发也表现出有效排斥的引力行为。在强场区，我们计算了光子在光子球附近传播的偏折角，其中偏折呈对数发散，使光子可绕黑洞多圈并形成相对论像。以超大质量黑洞 Sgr A* 作为天体物理透镜，我们进一步研究了强透镜观测量，即渐近角位置 ϑ∞、角分离 s 和相对星等 r_mag。我们还利用事件视界望远镜（EHT）合作组报道的 Sgr A* 阴影观测，对不同耦合常数 α 下的初级毛发参数 Q 进行了限制。
classification.one_liner: 在引力解耦框架下研究初级毛发黑洞的弱/强场透镜偏折、相对论像及 EHT 对 Sgr A* 阴影的限制。

papers.title: Axial Perturbations of Charged Kiselev Black Holes in Rastall Gravity: Matter Response and Quasinormal Modes
papers.abstract: We investigate axial gravitoelectromagnetic quasinormal modes of a charged black hole surrounded by dust-like Kiselev-type anisotropic matter in Rastall gravity. Under a closure prescription that neglects perturbations of the anisotropy direction, the system reduces to two coupled Schr\"odinger-type equations. These equations admit an $r$-independent algebraic decoupling in the Reissner--Nordstr\"om and general-relativistic dust-like limits, but such a decoupling is generically obstructed when both the Rastall modification and the surrounding-matter contribution are present. For comparison, we introduce an auxiliary frozen-source truncation, whose potential matrix differs from the matter-response matrix in only two entries. For the axial dipole, the matter-response system has one-way coupling, whereas the truncated reference system has two-way coupling. Nevertheless, representative fundamental frequencies of the matter-response system and the reference system differ only at the sub-percent level. A Chebyshev pseudospectral calculation, validated through the Reissner--Nordstr\"om limit and spectral-convergence tests, shows that increasing the dimensionless Rastall coupling $\gamma$ lowers both the oscillation frequency and the damping rate in the small-$\gamma$ region. In the large-$\gamma$ region, the oscillation frequency rises, whereas the damping rate varies nonmonotonically. A larger black-hole charge generally raises the oscillation frequency, whereas stronger surrounding-matter contributions tend to produce longer-lived modes. All surveyed fundamental axial modes satisfy $\operatorname{Im}\omega<0$.

classification.title_zh: Rastall 引力中带电 Kiselev 黑洞的轴向微扰：物质响应与准正规模
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了 Rastall 引力中被类尘埃 Kiselev 型各向异性物质包围的带电黑洞的轴向引力电磁准正规模。在忽略各向异性方向微扰的闭合方案下，系统约化为两个耦合的薛定谔型方程。这些方程在 Reissner–Nordström 与广义相对论类尘埃极限下允许 r 无关的代数解耦，但当 Rastall 修正与周围物质贡献同时存在时，这种解耦通常被阻碍。为比较，我们引入一个辅助的冻结源截断，其势矩阵与物质响应矩阵仅有两个矩阵元不同。对于轴向偶极，物质响应系统具有单向耦合，而截断参考系统具有双向耦合。尽管如此，物质响应系统与参考系统的代表性基频仅在亚百分之一的水平上不同。通过 Reissner–Nordström 极限和谱收敛测试验证的 Chebyshev 伪谱计算表明，增大无量纲 Rastall 耦合 γ 会在小 γ 区域降低振荡频率与阻尼率。在大 γ 区域，振荡频率上升，而阻尼率非单调变化。较大的黑洞电荷通常会提高振荡频率，而更强的周围物质贡献倾向于产生寿命更长的模式。所有考察的基本轴向模式满足 Im ω < 0。
classification.one_liner: 研究了 Rastall 引力中带电 Kiselev 黑洞的轴向准正规模，比较物质响应与冻结源截断，并给出 Rastall 耦合、黑洞电荷及环境物质对频率和阻尼的影响。

papers.title: Quadratic Gravitational-Wave Scattering by Kerr Black Holes
papers.abstract: Second-order black-hole perturbation theory will be an important component of precision gravitational-wave modeling and tests of strong-field gravity with next-generation detectors. Beyond quasinormal modes (QNMs), whose quadratic interactions have been the focus of recent work in black-hole spectroscopy, a generic retarded solution consists of a continuum of real-frequency scattering states whose nonlinear interactions in Kerr remain comparatively less explored. We use numerical relativity to study the quadratic response of Kerr black holes to nearly monochromatic $(\ell,m)=(2,\pm2)$ incident gravitational waves, measuring the complex self-coupling to the outgoing $(\ell,m)=(4,4)$ daughter at twice the parent frequency for black-hole spins up to $a=0.95$. At low frequencies, the coupling is strongly suppressed and exhibits opposite spin dependence for prograde and retrograde scattering. At higher prograde frequencies, we identify a daughter-mode resonance whose frequency and width extracted from the nonlinear response track the fundamental $(\ell,m,n)=(4,4,0)$ QNM. Near the fundamental $(2,2,0)$ QNM frequency, the in-mode coupling grows with spin, in contrast to the decreasing quadratic QNM coupling, demonstrating that the nonlinear response depends on the full parent scattering state rather than on its frequency alone. A complementary semi-analytic second-order Teukolsky calculation reproduces the nonlinear response from our numerical relativity simulations. Our numerical-relativity results and their semi-analytic extension provide a basis for generic homogeneous radiative perturbations of Kerr at second order, with applications to dynamical tides, near-extremal dynamics, and second-order gravitational self-force theory.

classification.title_zh: Kerr黑洞的二次引力波散射
classification.abstract_zh: 二阶黑洞微扰理论将成为精密引力波建模以及用下一代探测器检验强场引力的重要组成部分。除准正规模（QNM）之外——其二次相互作用是近来黑洞谱学研究的焦点——一般的推迟解还包含一个实频散射态连续谱，而它们在Kerr情形下的非线性相互作用仍相对较少被探索。我们使用数值相对论研究Kerr黑洞对近单色 $(\ell,m)=(2,\pm2)$ 入射引力波的二次响应，测量其与频率为母模两倍的出射 $(\ell,m)=(4,4)$ 子模的复自耦合，直到自旋 $a=0.95$。在低频下，耦合被强烈压低，并且对于顺行和逆行散射表现出相反的自旋依赖。在较高的顺行频率下，我们识别出一个子模共振，其从非线性响应中提取的频率和宽度与基频 $(\ell,m,n)=(4,4,0)$ QNM一致。在基频 $(2,2,0)$ QNM频率附近，入射模耦合随自旋增大，这与减小的二次QNM耦合相反，表明非线性响应依赖于完整的母散射态而不只是其频率。一个互补的半解析二阶Teukolsky计算再现了我们数值相对论模拟得到的非线性响应。我们的数值相对论结果及其半解析推广为Kerr在二阶下的通用齐次辐射微扰提供了基础，并可用于动力学潮汐、近极端动力学以及二阶引力自力理论。
classification.one_liner: 用数值相对论和半解析二阶Teukolsky计算研究Kerr黑洞对近单色引力波的非线性散射，提取(4,4)子模耦合及QNM共振。

papers.title: Analytical and spectral characterization of floral patterns in higher-order polynomial pp-waves
papers.abstract: We investigate analytically and numerically the floral deformation of particle rings induced by higher-order polynomial modes of pp-waves. The transverse tidal eigendirections determine $m$ interlaced sectors of radial stretching and compression, while a weak-pulse solution provides the complete first-order response of the ring. Direct geodesic integration for $m=2,3,4$ confirms the predicted orientation and discrete symmetry. A Fourier analysis shows that the response remains overwhelmingly dominated by the angular mode $n=m$; in particular, the loops found for $m=4$ arise from geometrical folding of the fundamental mode rather than strong harmonic mixing. The temporal moments of the pulse further distinguish displacement from velocity memory without changing this angular signature.

classification.title_zh: 高阶多项式pp波中花形图案的解析与谱表征
classification.abstract_zh: 我们通过解析和数值方法研究了pp波高阶多项式模式诱导的粒子环花形形变。横向潮汐本征方向确定了m个交错的径向拉伸与压缩扇区，而弱脉冲解给出了环的完整一阶响应。对m=2,3,4的直接测地线积分证实了预测的取向和离散对称性。傅里叶分析表明，响应仍以角模式n=m占绝对主导；特别地，m=4时发现的环来自基频模式的几何折叠，而非强谐波混合。脉冲的时间矩进一步区分了位移记忆与速度记忆，但不改变该角特征。
classification.one_liner: pp波高阶多项式模诱导粒子环花形形变，测地线与傅里叶分析显示响应以角模式n=m主导，并可区分位移与速度记忆。

papers.title: A Systematic Study of Resonance-Driven Flux Modifications in Extreme-Mass-Ratio Inspirals
papers.abstract: Transient orbital resonances can introduce phase-dependent corrections to the evolution of extreme-mass-ratio inspirals (EMRIs), potentially altering their long-term dynamics and emitted gravitational-wave signals. In this work, we quantify the resonance-induced modifications to the energy, axial angular momentum, and Carter constant fluxes and compute the corresponding resonance coefficients across a broad region of the orbital parameter space. Using the publicly available \texttt{pybhpt} code, we solve the Teukolsky equation in the frequency domain to coherently combine the degenerate radial and polar harmonics that arise at resonance. We analytically derive a selection rule governing the relative radial-polar phase dependence of the resonant flux modifications. We argue that the relative strengths of different resonances reflect a balance between symmetry-induced cancellations and the degree to which the resonant orbit samples the underlying two-dimensional orbital phase space. For the dynamically important $3{:}2$ and $2{:}1$ resonances, we also characterize how the resonance coefficients vary with the primary black-hole spin, orbital eccentricity and inclination. Our results constitute the largest set of Teukolsky-based resonance coefficients calculated to date and provide essential input for future studies of transient orbital resonances in EMRIs.

classification.title_zh: 极端质量比旋进中共振驱动通量修正的系统研究
classification.abstract_zh: 瞬态轨道共振可以给极端质量比旋进（EMRI）的演化引入相位依赖的修正，可能改变其长期动力学和发射的引力波信号。在本工作中，我们量化了共振引起的对能量、轴向角动量和Carter常数通量的修正，并在广泛的轨道参数区域内计算了相应的共振系数。利用公开可用的pybhpt代码，我们在频域中求解Teukolsky方程，以相干地组合共振时出现的简并径向和极角谐波。我们解析推导了一个选择定则，支配着共振通量修正的相对径向-极角相位依赖。我们认为，不同共振的相对强度反映了对称性导致的抵消与共振轨道对底层二维轨道相空间的采样程度之间的平衡。对于动力学上重要的3:2和2:1共振，我们还刻画了共振系数如何随主黑洞自旋、轨道偏心率和倾角变化。我们的结果构成了迄今为止计算的最大一组基于Teukolsky的共振系数，并为未来EMRI中瞬态轨道共振的研究提供了必要的输入。
classification.one_liner: 系统计算了EMRI中瞬态轨道共振对能量、角动量和Carter常数通量的修正，给出了迄今最大的Teukolsky共振系数集。

papers.title: Thin-Shell Black Bounce
papers.abstract: A recently proposed class of black-bounce solutions sourced by anisotropic fluids, whose exterior reproduces the Reissner-Nordstr\"om geometry all the way down to a minimal-area bounce, was put forward by Lessa and Olmo. In this work, we show that this solution conceals a thin-shell structure precisely at the bounce. Motivated by this observation, we construct a new class of black-bounce solutions with static, spherical symmetry featuring the emergence of a minimal-area bounce supported by a thin shell. This nontrivial topological structure is shown to arise from the degeneracy of the metric at the bounce, where the inverse metric becomes ill-defined, leading to curvature tensors with distributional discontinuities precisely at that point. As a consequence, a delta-function thin shell of energy-condition-violating matter is necessarily present at the bounce. To generate such solutions, we draw on proposals from quantum gravity that predict the existence of a fundamental minimum length scale, employing energy density profiles that encode these quantum-gravitational effects in an effective manner, replacing the point-like description of matter at minimal-length scales with a smeared one. We consider two well-motivated profiles, of Lorentzian and Gaussian type, to generate a novel class of solutions exhibiting the features of either regular black holes or wormholes, whose center conceals a thin-shell bounce. In addition, we investigate the thermodynamics of these compact objects.

classification.title_zh: 薄壳黑洞反弹
classification.abstract_zh: 最近，Lessa 和 Olmo 提出了一类由各向异性流体提供源的黑洞反弹解，其外部一直再现 Reissner-Nordström 几何，直到一个最小面积的反弹处。在本工作中，我们表明该解恰好在反弹处隐藏了一个薄壳结构。受此观察启发，我们构建了一类新的具有静态球对称性的黑洞反弹解，其特征是由一个薄壳支撑的最小面积反弹的出现。我们证明这种非平凡拓扑结构源于反弹处度量的简并，在那里逆度量变得不良定义，导致曲率张量恰好在该点出现分布性不连续性。因此，在反弹处必然存在一个由违反能量条件的物质构成的 delta 函数薄壳。为了生成此类解，我们借鉴量子引力中预测存在基本最小长度尺度的提议，采用以有效方式编码这些量子引力效应的能量密度分布，将最小长度尺度下的点状物质描述替换为弥散描述。我们考虑两种有充分动机的分布，即 Lorentzian 型和 Gaussian 型，来生成一类新的解，这些解表现出正则黑洞或虫洞的特征，其中心隐藏着一个薄壳反弹。此外，我们研究了这些致密天体的热力学。
classification.one_liner: 通过引入最小长度尺度的弥散能密分布，构建了在反弹处隐藏薄壳的静态球对称黑洞反弹解，并研究其热力学。

papers.title: Gravitational wave signatures of subsolar neutron star formation in collapsar disks
papers.abstract: Standard models for stellar core collapse predict the birth of neutron stars with masses exceeding a solar mass. In the collapsar model, a rapidly rotating massive star collapses to a black hole surrounded by a dense, neutrino-cooled accretion disk, whose outer regions may in some cases fragment into neutron-rich clumps that collapse to form subsolar-mass neutron stars. These disk-formed objects can then merge either with one another or, following possibly hierarchical evolution, with the central black hole. In this work, we characterize the gravitational-wave signatures of these binaries, focusing on distinctive features of the collapsar environment: Doppler and other phase modulations from orbital motion about the central black hole, gas-driven migration in the disk, and tidal interactions during inspiral. We show that the combination of anomalously low component masses with these environmental imprints produces unique waveform signatures that can distinguish the collapsar channel from other subsolar merger scenarios. Current and next-generation detectors have good prospects for identifying the intrinsic properties of such objects and, if subsolar mergers are discovered, for testing and constraining the collapsar formation pathway.

classification.title_zh: 塌缩星盘中亚太阳质量中子星形成的引力波特征
classification.abstract_zh: 标准恒星核塌缩模型预言诞生质量超过一个太阳质量的中子星。在塌缩星模型中，快速旋转的大质量恒星塌缩为一个黑洞，周围环绕着一个致密、经中微子冷却的吸积盘，其外部区域在某些情况下可能碎裂成富中子团块，并塌缩形成亚太阳质量中子星。这些由盘形成的天体随后可以彼此并合，或者经过可能的分级演化后与中心黑洞并合。在本工作中，我们刻画这些双星系统的引力波特征，重点关注塌缩星环境的独有特征：围绕中心黑洞轨道运动导致的多普勒及其他相位调制、盘中的气体驱动迁移，以及旋近过程中的潮汐相互作用。我们表明，异常低的分量质量与这些环境印记相结合，会产生独特的波形特征，从而能够将塌缩星通道与其他亚太阳质量并合场景区分开。当前和下一代探测器有很大希望识别这类天体的内禀性质，并且如果发现亚太阳质量并合，则有望检验和限制塌缩星形成路径。
classification.one_liner: 塌缩星吸积盘可形成亚太阳质量中子星，其双星并合引力波带有轨道多普勒调制、气体迁移和潮汐等独特环境印记。

papers.title: Generalized Regular Black Holes with Tunable Cores and Geodesic Properties
papers.abstract: We introduce a family of static and spherically symmetric regular black-hole geometries characterized by a discrete core index $n$, a regularization scale $a$, and a dimensionless deformation parameter $\eta$. The construction starts from a positive, normalized effective density profile with a tunable central behavior. The lowest member contains the Bardeen geometry as a limiting case, whereas a nonzero deformation parameter generates a Reissner--Nordstr\"om-like asymptotic correction. The parameter $n$ controls the order of central depletion: the lowest member possesses a de Sitter-type core, whereas higher members approach a Minkowski-like center with vanishing density and curvature. We determine the horizon structure, extremality condition, Hawking temperature, entropy, and the horizon thermodynamic identity implied by the radial Einstein equation. Null geodesics are analyzed to obtain the photon sphere, critical impact parameter, and shadow radius, including analytic weak-deformation approximations, the exact Schwarzschild and Bardeen limits, and comparison with the leading Reissner--Nordstr\"om-like behavior. The photon-orbit angular frequency and Lyapunov exponent are then used to separate orbital and instability timescales; their ratio provides information not already contained in the shadow radius. Weak gravitational lensing and magnification are discussed through a controlled sector-isolated expansion of the asymptotic metric. We further study timelike geodesics, circular motion, the marginally bound orbit, and the innermost stable circular orbit, deriving exact implicit relations and perturbative expressions. The model provides a unified framework for investigating how a tunable regular core and an RN-like exterior deformation affect the thermodynamic and geodesic properties of regular black holes.

classification.title_zh: 具有可调核心与测地线性质的广义正则黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 我们引入一类静态球对称正则黑洞几何，由离散核心指标 n、正则化尺度 a 和量纲一形变参数 η 刻画。构造从一个正的、归一化的有效密度剖面出发，其中心行为可调。最低阶成员以 Bardeen 几何作为极限情形，而非零形变参数产生类 Reissner-Nordström 的渐近修正。参数 n 控制中心耗竭的阶数：最低阶成员具有 de Sitter 型核心，而更高阶成员趋近于密度与曲率消失的 Minkowski 型中心。我们确定视界结构、极端性条件、Hawking 温度、熵，以及径向 Einstein 方程隐含的视界热力学恒等式。分析零测地线以获得光子球、临界碰撞参数和阴影半径，包括弱形变解析近似、精确的 Schwarzschild 与 Bardeen 极限，以及与领头 Reissner-Nordström 类行为的比较。随后用光子轨道角频率与 Lyapunov 指数区分轨道时标与不稳定性时标；其比值提供了阴影半径未包含的信息。通过渐近度规的受控分部门隔离展开，讨论弱引力透镜与放大率。我们进一步研究类时测地线、圆周运动、边缘束缚轨道和最内稳定圆轨道，导出精确隐式关系与微扰表达式。该模型为研究可调正则核心和 RN 类外部形变如何影响正则黑洞的热力学与测地线性质提供了一个统一框架。

papers.title: A Primer on Spacetime Singularities II: Spatially Homogeneous Cosmologies
papers.abstract: This article is the second part of a review devoted to spacetime singularities in classical General Relativity. While Primer I developed the mathematical framework for defining, classifying, and proving the existence of singularities, the present work examines their concrete realization in spatially homogeneous cosmological models. After reviewing the geometrical foundations of homogeneity and the Bianchi classification, we derive the field equations for orthogonal and tilted perfect fluid cosmologies and use the Kasner and Bianchi I solutions as elementary prototypes of anisotropic singular behaviour. Raychaudhuri focusing provides general conditions under which the homogeneous Cauchy development reaches a finite proper time boundary. We then distinguish matter singularities, characterized by divergent density and Ricci curvature, from more subtle non-scalar or whimper singularities associated with Cauchy horizons and extreme fluid tilt. The classical Ellis-King analysis is reconsidered in the light of later developments, including rigorous curvature-blow-up results for Bianchi VIII and IX models, kinematic singularities in geodesically complete tilted spacetimes, and the recent reappearance of whimper behaviour in dipole cosmology. The resulting picture shows that even spatially homogeneous cosmologies exhibit a remarkably rich hierarchy of singular boundaries. The detailed dynamical approach to these boundaries - Hamiltonian cosmology, Kasner transitions, Mixmaster dynamics and the BKL conjecture - is reserved for Primer III.

classification.title_zh: 时空奇点入门 II：空间均匀宇宙学
classification.abstract_zh: 本文是关于经典广义相对论中时空奇点的综述的第二部分。Primer I 建立了定义、分类和证明奇点存在的数学框架，而本工作考察其在空间均匀宇宙学模型中的具体实现。在回顾均匀性的几何基础和 Bianchi 分类之后，我们推导正交和倾斜理想流体宇宙学的场方程，并以 Kasner 和 Bianchi I 解作为各向异性奇点行为的基本原型。Raychaudhuri 聚焦给出了一般条件，使均匀 Cauchy 发展到达有限固有时边界。随后我们区分物质奇点（以密度和 Ricci 曲率发散为特征）与更微妙的非标量或 whimper 奇点（与 Cauchy 视界和极端流体倾斜相关）。我们在后续发展的背景下重新审视经典 Ellis-King 分析，包括 Bianchi VIII 和 IX 模型的严格曲率爆破结果、测地完备倾斜时空中的运动学奇点，以及 whimper 行为最近在偶极宇宙学中的重现。由此得到的图景表明，即使空间均匀宇宙学也展现出异常丰富的奇点边界层级。对这些边界的详细动力学方法——哈密顿宇宙学、Kasner 跃迁、Mixmaster 动力学和 BKL 猜想——留待 Primer III。

papers.title: Testing Van der Waals black holes using black hole photon rings
papers.abstract: The Van der Waals black hole (BH) is a non-Kerr model in Anti-de Sitter (AdS) spacetime that exhibits characteristic thermodynamic phase transitions. Whether the physical validity of parameters such as the BH molecular volume $b$ and pressure $P$ is feasible still requires observational verification. As a sensitive probe of strong gravitational fields, the BH photon ring directly carries spacetime geometric information, making it an ideal object for model testing. In accordance with the spacetime metric associated with this BH, this study obtains the null geodesic equations for photons and conserved quantities, determines the photon sphere conditions and radii via effective potential analysis, investigates the photon ring classification and radiative properties, and employs measurements from the Event Horizon Telescope (EHT) to place constraints on parameters and simulate the optical appearance. The results show that the molecular volume parameter $b$ significantly regulates the radius of the photon sphere radius, photon ring structure, and the luminosity. Within a specific interval, the model exhibits a high degree of agreement with the EHT measurements for M87* and Sgr A*. This interval not only satisfies the energy conditions (weak, strong, and dominant) but also corresponds to a stable Van der Waals-type phase transition region. Furthermore, the photon ring can distinguish between the Van der Waals BH and the Schwarzschild BH: due to the small-black-hole-large-black-hole (SBH-LBH) phase transition and microstructural discontinuities, the photon ring of the Van der Waals BH is particularly sensitive to the parameter $b$, whereas the Schwarzschild BH lacks these features. This work uses the photon ring to probe BH molecular models, linking its microstructure, spacetime geometry and observational signatures, and provides a new way to derive BH microphysics from observations.

classification.title_zh: 利用黑洞光子环检验范德瓦尔斯黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 范德瓦尔斯黑洞（BH）是反德西特（AdS）时空中的一种非Kerr模型，表现出特征性的热力学相变。黑洞分子体积 b 和压强 P 等参数的物理有效性是否可行，仍需观测验证。作为强引力场的敏感探针，黑洞光子环直接携带时空几何信息，使其成为检验模型的理想对象。根据与该黑洞相关的时空度规，本研究获得光子的零测地线方程与守恒量，通过有效势分析确定光子球条件与半径，研究光子环分类和辐射性质，并利用事件视界望远镜（EHT）的测量对参数施加限制并模拟光学外观。结果表明，分子体积参数 b 显著调节光子球半径、光子环结构和光度。在特定区间内，该模型与 M87* 和 Sgr A* 的 EHT 测量高度一致。该区间不仅满足能量条件（弱、强、主导），还对应稳定的范德瓦尔斯型相变区域。此外，光子环可以区分范德瓦尔斯黑洞与史瓦西黑洞：由于小黑洞-大黑洞（SBH-LBH）相变和微观结构不连续性，范德瓦尔斯黑洞的光子环对参数 b 特别敏感，而史瓦西黑洞缺乏这些特征。这项工作利用光子环探测黑洞分子模型，将其微观结构、时空几何和观测特征联系起来，并提供了一种从观测推导黑洞微观物理的新途径。
classification.one_liner: 利用光子环与EHT观测约束AdS范德瓦尔斯黑洞的分子体积参数，并联系其相变、时空几何与光学外观。
classification.relevance_reason: 主要属于经典引力/广义相对论中的黑洞光子环研究，并涉及AdS黑洞热力学相变，直接匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”和“相变与气泡成核”重点支线；但摘要未涉及AdS/CFT对偶或全息方法。

papers.title: Gravitational Waves from Long Strings and Loops
papers.abstract: We compute the gravitational wave spectrum produced by a global cosmic string network in the scaling regime. The spectrum naturally divides at the string correlation length into infrared and ultraviolet parts. In the infrared, we derive the spectrum analytically from the unequal-time correlator of the string stress-energy tensor within the unconnected segment model, which we generalize for the first time to string loops. The loop contribution can be comparable to that of long strings, depending on the loop evolution parameters. In the ultraviolet, where structure below the correlation length dominates the source, we develop a data-driven method that connects this correlator formalism to the instantaneous radiation power spectrum measured in existing lattice simulations. The predicted spectrum rises with frequency as $\Omega_{\rm GW}\propto k$ and $k^{3}$ in the infrared, and flattens into a plateau with a mild logarithmic tilt in the ultraviolet. The turnover frequency between the two is set by the mass of the Goldstone boson, the axion. Confronting the predicted spectrum with current data and projected sensitivities, we map out current constraints and future probes in the plane of the symmetry-breaking scale~$f_a$ and the axion mass~$m_a$.

classification.title_zh: 长弦与弦环产生的引力波
classification.abstract_zh: 我们计算了处于标度区间的整体宇宙弦网络产生的引力波谱。该谱在弦关联长度处自然分为红外和紫外两部分。在红外部分，我们在非连通段模型中，由弦应力-能量张量的非等时关联函数解析地推导出该谱，并首次将该模型推广至弦环。弦环贡献可与长弦贡献相当，具体取决于弦环演化参数。在紫外部分，关联长度以下的结构主导源，我们发展了一种数据驱动方法，将这种关联函数形式与现有格点模拟中测得的瞬时辐射功率谱联系起来。预测的谱在红外部分随频率按 Ω_GW ∝ k 和 k^3 上升，在紫外部分则变平为一个带有轻微对数倾斜的平台。两者之间的转折频率由 Goldstone 玻色子即轴子的质量决定。将预测谱与当前数据和预期灵敏度进行对比，我们在对称性破缺能标 f_a 与轴子质量 m_a 的平面上给出了当前限制和未来探测前景。
classification.one_liner: 在标度区间计算整体宇宙弦网络的引力波谱，区分长弦与弦环贡献，并给出轴子参数空间的限制与探测前景。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于宇宙弦引力波与宇宙学/经典引力方向，不是 AdS/CFT 或全息研究；但与用户列出的经典引力支线相关。

papers.title: Holography for bulk-boundary local topological order
papers.abstract: In our previous article [arXiv:2307.12552], we introduced local topological order (LTO) axioms for quantum spin systems which allowed us to define a physical boundary (associated to a cut of the lattice) manifested by a net of boundary algebras in one dimension lower. This gives a formal setting for topological holography, where the braided tensor category of DHR bimodules of the physical boundary algebra captures the bulk topological order. In this article, we extend the LTO axioms to quantum spin systems equipped with a topological boundary (domain wall with the trivial phase), again producing a physical boundary algebra for the bulk-boundary system, whose category of (topological) boundary DHR bimodules recovers the topological boundary order. We perform this analysis in explicit detail for Levin-Wen and Walker-Wang bulk-boundary systems. Along the way, we introduce a 2D braided categorical net of algebras built from a unitary braided fusion category (UBFC). Such nets arise as boundary algebras of Walker-Wang models. We consider the canonical state on this braided categorical net corresponding to the standard topological boundary for the Walker-Wang model. Interestingly, in this state, the cone von Neumann algebras are type I with finite dimensional centers, in contrast with the type II and III cone von Neumann algebras from the Levin-Wen models studied in [arXiv:2307.12552]. The superselection sectors recover the underlying unitary category of our UBFC, and it was recently proven in [arXiv:2609.20725] that the superselection category also captures the fusion and braiding.

classification.title_zh: 体-边界局域拓扑序的全息
classification.abstract_zh: 在我们之前的文章 [arXiv:2307.12552] 中，我们为量子自旋系统引入了局域拓扑序（LTO）公理，使我们能够定义一个物理边界（与格点切割相关），它由低一维的边界代数网来体现。这为拓扑全息提供了一个形式化框架，其中物理边界代数的 DHR 双模的编织张量范畴捕获了体拓扑序。在本文中，我们将 LTO 公理推广到配备拓扑边界（与平凡相的畴壁）的量子自旋系统，再次为体-边界系统产生一个物理边界代数，其（拓扑）边界 DHR 双模范畴恢复拓扑边界序。我们对 Levin-Wen 和 Walker-Wang 体-边界系统进行了显式详细分析。在此过程中，我们引入了一个由幺正编织融合范畴（UBFC）构造的二维编织范畴代数网。这类网作为 Walker-Wang 模型的边界代数出现。我们考虑该编织范畴代数网上对应于 Walker-Wang 模型标准拓扑边界的正则态。有趣的是，在此态中，锥 von Neumann 代数是 I 型且具有有限维中心，这与 [arXiv:2307.12552] 中研究的 Levin-Wen 模型的 II 型和 III 型锥 von Neumann 代数形成对比。超选择扇区恢复了我们 UBFC 的底层幺正范畴，并且最近在 [arXiv:2609.20725] 中证明，超选择范畴也捕获了融合与编织。
classification.one_liner: 将局域拓扑序公理推广到带拓扑边界的量子自旋系统，为 Levin-Wen/Walker-Wang 体-边界系统建立拓扑全息框架。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于拓扑全息与量子自旋/拓扑序方向，涉及畴壁（拓扑边界）；但不涉及 AdS/CFT、经典引力或用户列出的全息引力重点支线，因此相关度中等。

papers.title: Holomorphic Conformal Cartan Geometry: Conformal Gravity, Twistors, and Ambitwistors
papers.abstract: Four-dimensional conformal gravity, twistor theory, and ambitwistor theory are reviewed within the unified framework of holomorphic conformal Cartan geometry. Starting from the spinorial representation of the geometry, the normal $\mathfrak{sl}(4,\mathbb{C})$-valued Cartan connection, its curvature $2$-form, and the associated tractor bundles are systematically formulated. Evaluated on the real Lorentzian slice, the quadratic curvature action is shown to reproduce four-dimensional Weyl--Bach conformal gravity upon fixing a Weyl gauge. Local twistor and dual twistor bundles are constructed as associated spin tractor bundles, illustrating how parallel transport yields the classical incidence relations in flat space and chiral integrability constraints in curved backgrounds: anti-self-duality for $\alpha$-surfaces and self-duality for $\beta$-surfaces. Furthermore, by pairing local twistors and dual twistors via an invariant canonical pairing, ambitwistor space is shown to parameterize complex null geodesics and symmetrically accommodate both left- and right-handed Weyl curvatures. This framework establishes a direct gauge-theoretic bridge linking conformal Cartan geometry to twistor and ambitwistor theories.

classification.title_zh: 全纯共形嘉当几何：共形引力、扭量理论与双扭量理论
classification.abstract_zh: 本文在全纯共形嘉当几何的统一框架下回顾四维共形引力、扭量理论与双扭量理论。从该几何的旋量表示出发，系统表述了取值于 sl(4,C) 的正规嘉当联络、其曲率 2-形式以及相关的 tractor 丛。在实 Lorentzian 切片上，取定 Weyl 规范后，二次曲率作用量可重现四维 Weyl--Bach 共形引力。局域扭量丛与对偶扭量丛被构造为相关的旋量 tractor 丛，说明平行输运如何给出平直空间中的经典关联关系，以及弯曲背景中的手征可积性约束：α-曲面的反自对偶性与 β-曲面的自对偶性。进一步，通过不变正则配对将局域扭量与对偶扭量配对，双扭量空间被表明可参数化复零测地线，并对称地容纳左手与右手 Weyl 曲率。该框架建立了直接连接共形嘉当几何与扭量、双扭量理论的规范论桥梁。
classification.one_liner: 在全纯共形嘉当几何框架下，统一构造四维共形引力、扭量丛与双扭量空间，并连接 Weyl--Bach 作用量与手征可积性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文聚焦经典共形引力与扭量/双扭量几何，不涉及 AdS/CFT、全息或量子引力；但属于经典引力/广义相对论相关的数学物理。

papers.title: Dual modes in Kerr spacetimes and the Whiting transform: Mode stability revisited
papers.abstract: The purpose of the paper is to place Whiting's classical growing mode stability argument, extended to real frequencies by Shlapentokh-Rothman for the scalar wave equation and by Andersson, Ma, Paganini and Whiting in general, in the framework of classical PDE theory. The key steps are: a description of the dual or adjoint modes, a singular phase space pairing argument which is technically executed via the Fourier transform, followed by a standard unique continuation result. One part of our description of the dual modes connects them directly to the standard mode solutions which are smooth over the event horizon. In the zero spin case, there is a geometric interpretation of this: quasinormal modes (for non-zero real frequencies) which are smooth across the future event horizon can be extended as distributional QNM solutions by 0 through the past event horizon. We also describe the behavior of mode solutions at the bifurcate sphere.

classification.title_zh: Kerr 时空中的对偶模与 Whiting 变换：模式稳定性再探讨
classification.abstract_zh: 本文旨在将 Whiting 经典的增长模稳定性论证——由 Shlapentokh-Rothman 对标量波动方程推广到实频率，并由 Andersson、Ma、Paganini 和 Whiting 作一般化推广——置于经典 PDE 理论框架中。关键步骤包括：描述对偶模或伴随模，通过 Fourier 变换技术上执行一个奇异相空间配对论证，随后使用标准的唯一延拓结果。我们对对偶模描述的一部分将它们直接联系到在事件视界上光滑的标准模解。在零自旋情形，这有一个几何解释：跨未来事件视界光滑的准正规模（对非零实频率）可以通过在过去事件视界上置零而延拓为分布意义下的 QNM 解。我们还描述了模解在分叉球面上的行为。
classification.one_liner: 用经典 PDE 框架重新表述 Kerr 时空中的 Whiting 模式稳定性论证，并刻画对偶模及其与视界光滑模、QNM 分布延拓和分叉球面行为的关系。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文直接研究 Kerr 时空中的模式稳定性与准正规模，属于经典引力/广义相对论及 QNM 支线，与用户重点标签高度相关。

papers.title: Effective description of lensed gravitational waves diffracted by stellar fields
papers.abstract: As natural telescopes, Gravitational lenses enable the observation of sources that would otherwise be too distant and faint. Stellar-mass objects, or microlenses, act as impurities in the lens, producing subtle distortions of the source. These effects are necessary to correctly interpret observations, and may in some cases be themselves evidence of gravitational magnification. Gravitational waves (GWs) observed by ground detectors and magnified by galaxies and clusters will undergo microlensing by fields of stars and remnants: describing these systems requires not only considering a large number of small-scale lenses (microlenses), but also including wave-optics effects, leading to frequency-dependent modulations of the signal. Here we present novel models for Reduced-Order Stochastic Diffraction (ROSD), which overcome these challenges in the search for GW lensing signatures: an effective description is synthesized from numerical simulations of wave-optics lensing by stellar fields via a singular value decomposition. The procedure yields an optimized orthonormal basis to describe microlensing distortions -- capturing the dominant "tones" of the stellar field, or stellar timbre -- and a probability density function for the coefficients, which can be used as priors or to verify the consistency with stellar-field lensing. We present SVD-stellar-I5-aLIGO as an example of this model category, discuss the role of truncation order and demonstrate how it can be applied to GW data via injection and recovery in Bayesian parameter estimation. ROSD can be tailored to account for detector sensitivity and the type of source under analysis, and extended to different microlens populations and external potentials. ROSD models open a new window to probe small-scale objects (stars, remnants and potentially dark matter) and facilitate the discovery of the most distant compact binary mergers.

classification.title_zh: 被星场衍射的透镜化引力波的有效描述
classification.abstract_zh: 作为天然望远镜，引力透镜使得观测原本过于遥远和暗淡的源成为可能。恒星质量天体，或微透镜，作为透镜中的杂质，对源产生细微畸变。这些效应对于正确解释观测是必要的，并且在某些情况下本身可能是引力放大效应的证据。地面探测器观测到的、被星系和星系团放大的引力波将经历恒星和遗迹场造成的微透镜效应：描述这些系统不仅需要考虑大量小尺度透镜（微透镜），还需要包括波动光学效应，从而导致信号随频率变化的调制。在这里，我们提出了用于约化阶随机衍射（ROSD）的新模型，这些模型在寻找引力波透镜特征时克服了这些挑战：通过奇异值分解，从星场波动光学透镜的数值模拟中合成一种有效描述。该过程产生一个优化的正交归一基来描述微透镜畸变——捕捉星场的主导“音调”，或恒星音色——以及系数的概率密度函数，可用作先验或验证与星场透镜的一致性。我们提出 SVD-stellar-I5-aLIGO 作为此类模型的一个例子，讨论截断阶数的角色，并展示如何通过注入和恢复在贝叶斯参数估计中将其应用于引力波数据。ROSD 可以针对探测器灵敏度和所分析源的类型进行定制，并可扩展到不同的微透镜族群和外部势。ROSD 模型为探测小尺度天体（恒星、遗迹，以及可能暗物质）开辟新窗口，并促进发现最遥远的致密双星并合。
classification.one_liner: 提出基于SVD的约化阶随机衍射有效模型，用于描述星场微透镜对引力波的波动光学畸变，并应用于贝叶斯参数估计。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究广义相对论框架下的引力波引力透镜与星场微透镜波动光学效应，直接属于经典引力/广义相对论支线。

papers.title: Cavity Multimodes as an Array for High-Frequency Gravitational Waves
papers.abstract: Microwave cavities operated in the presence of a background magnetic field provide a promising avenue for detecting high-frequency gravitational waves (HFGWs). We demonstrate for the first time that the distinct antenna patterns of multiple electromagnetic modes within a single cavity enable localization and reconstruction of key properties of an incoming HFGW signal, including its polarization ratio and frequency drift rate. Using a 9-cell cavity commonly employed in particle accelerators as a representative example, we analyze the time-domain response of 18 nearly degenerate modes, which can be sequentially excited by a frequency-drifting signal. The sensitivity is further enhanced by the number of available modes, in close analogy to the scaling achieved by a network of independent detectors, enabling sensitivity to astrophysically plausible binary sources.

classification.title_zh: 腔多模作为高频引力波探测的阵列
classification.abstract_zh: 在存在背景磁场的条件下运行的微波腔，为探测高频引力波（HFGWs）提供了一条有前景的途径。我们首次证明，单个腔中多个电磁模式各自不同的天线方向图能够定位并重建入射 HFGW 信号的关键性质，包括其极化比和频率漂移率。以粒子加速器中常用的 9-cell 腔作为代表性例子，我们分析了 18 个近简并模式的时域响应；这些模式可被一个频率漂移的信号依次激发。灵敏度还会因可用模式数目的增加而增强，这与独立探测器网络所实现的标度十分类似，从而能够对天体物理上合理的双星源达到灵敏度。
classification.one_liner: 单腔中的多个电磁模式可像阵列一样定位并重建高频引力波信号，模式数增加还能提升灵敏度。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于高频引力波的微波腔探测方案，涉及经典引力/引力波探测，但不涉及全息、量子引力或 AdS/CFT，因此与全息主线相关性有限；因用户包含经典引力重点标签，整体相关性中等。

papers.title: GW231109_235456: A Sub-threshold Binary Neutron Star Merger in the LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA O4a Observing Run?
papers.abstract: We present a sub-threshold search for gravitational-wave inspirals from binary neutron stars using data from the first part of the fourth LIGO--Virgo--KAGRA observing run. To enhance sensitivity to this targeted population, we adopt a population prior informed by the Galactic double neutron star population observed via radio pulsar surveys and by the confirmed GW170817 event. The search, with a sensitivity ~60% higher than standard GWTC-4.0 searches, recovers the previously sub-threshold candidate GW231109_235456 (reported in GWTC-4.0) with a network signal-to-noise ratio of 9.7 and an improved false-alarm rate of 1 per 60 years. Accounting for a trials factor of five, arising from the four previous searches and this new search, the false-alarm rate of the candidate is approximately 1 per 12 years. If the event is of astrophysical origin, the inferred source properties indicate component masses of 1.40 to 2.24 solar masses for the primary and 0.97 to 1.49 solar masses for the secondary, yielding a total mass of 2.95 solar masses with an uncertainty of plus 0.38 and minus 0.07 solar masses. The event is localized to a region of 430 square degrees (90% probability) at a luminosity distance of 165 megaparsecs with an uncertainty of plus 70 and minus 69 megaparsecs. Assuming the signal arises from a binary neutron star merger, this event would contribute a local merger rate of 53 to 342 per cubic gigaparsec per year (90% credible interval).

classification.title_zh: GW231109_235456：LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA O4a 观测运行中的一个亚阈值双中子星并合？
classification.abstract_zh: 我们利用第四次 LIGO--Virgo--KAGRA 观测运行第一阶段的数据，对双中子星引力波旋近信号进行了亚阈值搜索。为增强对该目标群体的灵敏度，我们采用了由射电脉冲星巡天观测到的银河系双中子星群体以及已确认的 GW170817 事件所给出的群体先验。该搜索的灵敏度比标准 GWTC-4.0 搜索高约 60%，重新发现了此前在 GWTC-4.0 中报告为亚阈值的候选事件 GW231109_235456，其网络信噪比为 9.7，误报率改善为每 60 年一次。考虑来自此前四次搜索和本次新搜索的五重试验因子后，该候选事件的误报率约为每 12 年一次。如果该事件源自天体物理，推断的源性质表明主星质量为 1.40 至 2.24 太阳质量，次星质量为 0.97 至 1.49 太阳质量，总质量为 2.95 太阳质量，不确定度为 +0.38 和 -0.07 太阳质量。事件定位到 430 平方度（90% 概率）的区域，光度距离为 165 兆秒差距，不确定度为 +70 和 -69 兆秒差距。假设该信号来自双中子星并合，该事件将贡献的局部并合率为每年每立方吉秒差距 53 至 342 次（90% 可信区间）。
classification.one_liner: 利用 O4a 数据对双中子星进行亚阈值搜索，重新发现候选事件 GW231109_235456 并给出其质量、距离与并合率推断。

papers.title: GW-YOLO: Multi-transient segmentation in LIGO using computer vision
papers.abstract: Time series data and their time-frequency representations from gravitational-wave interferometers present opportunities for artificial intelligence methods in signal and image processing, particularly for low-latency analysis. In this work, we introduce GW-YOLO, a signal and noise identification tool based on the YOLO (You Only Look Once) object detection framework. GW-YOLO identifies whether an observed transient contains noise, an astrophysical signal, or both, while providing time-frequency coordinates of detected objects through pixel-level segmentation masks. Our approach achieves a 53% detection efficiency for binary black hole signals in the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) 12--15 range when they overlap with transient noise, increasing to more than 75% at SNR 15--18. For binary neutron star signals overlapping with transient noise, the detection efficiency reaches 57% at SNR 30--33 and 87% at SNR 39--42. To our knowledge, this is the first quantitative assessment of the ability to detect astrophysical signals overlapping with realistic instrumental noise in gravitational-wave interferometers. We also present a fully automated, low-latency pipeline that produces pixel-level segmentation masks for individual noise transients and astrophysical signals, enabling further automation of event validation and downstream noise-mitigation procedures.

classification.title_zh: GW-YOLO：利用计算机视觉在 LIGO 中进行多暂现源分割
classification.abstract_zh: 来自引力波干涉仪的时间序列数据及其时频表示，为人工智能方法在信号与图像处理中提供了机会，尤其是在低延迟分析方面。在这项工作中，我们介绍 GW-YOLO，一种基于 YOLO（You Only Look Once）目标检测框架的信号与噪声识别工具。GW-YOLO 识别观测到的暂现源包含噪声、天体物理信号还是两者，并通过像素级分割掩膜提供检测对象的时频坐标。我们的方法在信噪比（SNR）12--15 范围内、且与瞬态噪声重叠时，对双黑洞信号的检测效率达到 53%，在 SNR 15--18 时提高到 75% 以上。对于与瞬态噪声重叠的双中子星信号，检测效率在 SNR 30--33 时达到 57%，在 SNR 39--42 时达到 87%。据我们所知，这是首次对引力波干涉仪中与真实仪器噪声重叠的天体物理信号检测能力进行定量评估。我们还提出了一条全自动、低延迟的流水线，可为单个噪声暂现源和天体物理信号生成像素级分割掩膜，从而进一步自动化事件验证和下游降噪流程。
classification.one_liner: 基于 YOLO 的 LIGO 时频图多暂现源分割工具，可区分噪声与天体物理信号并给出像素级掩膜。

papers.title: The Mass-Angular Momentum Inequality for Multiple Black Holes
papers.abstract: This is the second in a series of two papers to settle the conjectured mass-angular momentum inequality for multiple black holes. More precisely, we show that for a complete, simply connected, maximal initial data set for the Einstein equations with multiple ends that are either asymptotically flat or asymptotically cylindrical, the ADM mass of any asymptotically flat end admits a lower bound given by the square root of total angular momentum, under the assumption of nonnegative energy density and axisymmetry. Moreover, equality is achieved in this mass lower bound only for a constant time slice of an extreme Kerr spacetime. The proof is based on a novel flow of singular harmonic maps with hyperbolic plane target, under which the renormalized harmonic map energy is monotonically nonincreasing. Relevant properties of the flow are achieved through a refined asymptotic analysis of solutions to the harmonic map equations and their linearization.

classification.title_zh: 多黑洞的质量-角动量不等式
classification.abstract_zh: 这是两篇论文中的第二篇，旨在解决多黑洞的质量-角动量不等式猜想。更精确地说，我们证明：对于 Einstein 方程的一个完备、单连通、极大初始数据集，其具有多个端，且这些端要么渐近平坦要么渐近柱状，在非负能量密度和轴对称假设下，任意渐近平坦端的 ADM 质量都有一个由总角动量的平方根给出的下界。此外，该质量下界中的等号仅由极端 Kerr 时空的常时切片取得。证明基于一类以双曲平面为目标的新型奇异调和映射流，在此流下重正化调和映射能量单调不增。该流的相关性质通过调和映射方程及其线性化解的精细渐近分析获得。
classification.one_liner: 证明多端 Einstein 初始数据中 ADM 质量以总角动量的平方根为下界，等号仅由极端 Kerr 时空的常时切片取得。

papers.title: Complex frequency evolution of direct waves from binary black hole mergers
papers.abstract: While no signal originating at a black hole's event horizon can reach future null infinity, information about the horizon and its immediate vicinity can be encoded in asymptotic properties of waves emitted by matter or field perturbations falling toward a growing/forming horizon. Within a response-filtered framework, "direct wave" denotes source-sensitive plunge and remnant-formation information revealed by filtering the black-hole response. Unlike a stationary damped sinusoid with a fixed complex frequency, the direct wave follows the evolving source and has an evolving instantaneous complex frequency tied at late times to the remnant horizon angular velocity $\Omega_H$ and surface gravity $\kappa_H$. Using rational filters, we remove quasinormal modes from numerical-relativity waveforms to study this evolution. Before numerical contamination, trajectories depend on remnant spin: the real frequency evolves toward $2\Omega_H$ from above for lower spins ($\chi_f\lesssim0.7$) and from below for higher spins ($\chi_f\gtrsim0.7$), while the instantaneous decay rate increases, with best-resolved cases approaching the expected value of $3\kappa_H$. As in particle-plunge results, the horizon-controlled value is approached only at late times, as frame dragging controls near-horizon motion. For $\chi_f\sim0.7$ remnants of non-precessing, comparable-mass binaries, the early-time real frequency is close to $2\Omega_H$ because the binary orbital frequency transitions smoothly to the remnant horizon frequency. Finite-time deviations therefore carry information about merger/collapse dynamics rather than undermining the horizon connection. Full direct-wave evolution requires numerical-relativity calibration. We further show that approximate pole-zero pairing in the Kerr response motivates a minimal filter set that suppresses quasinormal-mode features while revealing source-trajectory information.

classification.title_zh: 双黑洞并合直接波的复频率演化
classification.abstract_zh: 虽然任何起源于黑洞事件视界的信号都无法到达未来零无穷，但关于视界及其紧邻区域的信息可以编码在落入增长/形成中的视界的物质或场扰动所发射的波的渐近性质中。在响应滤波框架内，“直接波”指通过滤波黑洞响应而揭示的对源敏感的俯冲与残余形成信息。与具有固定复频率的稳态阻尼正弦不同，直接波跟随演化的源，并具有演化的瞬时复频率，在晚期与残余视界角速度 Ω_H 和表面引力 κ_H 相关。使用有理滤波器，我们从数值相对论波形中移除准正规模以研究这一演化。在数值污染之前，轨迹依赖于残余自旋：实频率对较低自旋（χ_f≲0.7）从上方趋向 2Ω_H，对较高自旋（χ_f≳0.7）从下方趋向 2Ω_H，而瞬时衰减率增加，最佳分辨情形接近预期的 3κ_H。如同粒子俯冲结果，只有在晚期才接近由视界控制的值，因为参考系拖曳控制近视界运动。对于非进动、可比质量双星的 χ_f~0.7 残余黑洞，早期实频率接近 2Ω_H，因为双星轨道频率平滑过渡到残余视界频率。因此有限时间偏差携带的是并合/坍缩动力学信息，而不是破坏视界联系。完整的直接波演化需要数值相对论校准。我们进一步表明，Kerr 响应中的近似极点-零点配对促成一个最小滤波器集，它抑制准正规模特征，同时揭示源轨迹信息。
classification.one_liner: 利用有理滤波从数值相对论波形中提取双黑洞并合直接波，揭示其瞬时复频率在晚期趋向残余视界的 Ω_H 与 κ_H。

papers.title: Action-level characterization of gravitational-wave propagation in dynamical Barbero--Immirzi gravity
papers.abstract: We investigate which operators in first-order dynamical Barbero--Immirzi (BI) gravity control cosmological tensor propagation at the action level. Within a bosonic, two-derivative, curvature-linear Einstein--Cartan class, eliminating the algebraic Lorentz connection reveals a separation between the scalar sector and the tensor kinetic normalization. In particular, the Holst-to-Palatini ratio determines the scalar kinetic structure, whereas the transverse-traceless tensor mode is normalized by the parity-even Hilbert--Palatini coefficient. As a consequence, a minimal dynamical Holst sector with fixed parity-even normalization remains exactly on the general-relativistic tensor-propagation surface and does not generate anomalous gravitational-wave friction. We then construct a regular nonminimal parity-even realization in which the tensor normalization evolves cosmologically, derive the corresponding standard-siren observable, and apply current GWTC-3, GWTC-4.0, and GWTC-5.0 information as an observational test of this action-level tensor sector. The resulting constraints should therefore be interpreted as limits on the evolution of the tensor kinetic normalization rather than direct constraints on minimal BI torsion dynamics.

classification.title_zh: 动态 Barbero–Immirzi 引力中引力波传播的作用量层面刻画
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究一阶动态 Barbero–Immirzi (BI) 引力中哪些算符在作用量层面控制宇宙张量传播。在玻色、两导数、曲率线性的 Einstein–Cartan 类中，消去代数洛伦兹联络后，标量部门与张量动能归一化之间出现分离。特别地，Holst 与 Palatini 之比决定标量动能结构，而横向无迹张量模式由宇称偶的 Hilbert–Palatini 系数归一化。因此，具有固定宇称偶归一化的最小动态 Holst 部门恰好保持在广义相对论张量传播面上，不会产生异常引力波摩擦。然后我们构造一个正则非最小宇称偶实现，其中张量归一化随宇宙学演化，推导相应的标准汽笛观测量，并利用当前 GWTC-3、GWTC-4.0 和 GWTC-5.0 信息作为对该作用量层面张量部门的观测检验。所得约束应被解释为对张量动能归一化演化的限制，而非对最小 BI 挠率动力学的直接约束。
classification.one_liner: 在一阶动态 Barbero–Immirzi 引力中，张量传播的归一化由宇称偶 Hilbert–Palatini 系数控制，最小 Holst 项不产生异常引力波摩擦，并用 GWTC 数据约束张量动能归一化的宇宙学演化。

papers.title: On the Tidal and Frame-Drag Fields in General Relativity
papers.abstract: It is known that in vacuum, two infinitesimally separated timelike observers under free fall notice a relative acceleration due to the tidal field (or the `electric' part of the Weyl tensor), and if they are carrying inertial guidance gyroscopes, they notice relative precession between these gyroscopes due to the frame-drag field (or the `magnetic' part of the Weyl tensor). The frame-drag field thus has no Newtonian analog. In this paper, for a family of timelike observers carrying inertial gyroscopes and forming a congruence, we define these fields as constraint equations in the presence of matter using (1+3) covariant splitting of spacetime. Unlike Newtonian gravity, the relative velocities of the observers around a closed contour formed by their spatial separations (and a temporal vector that closes this contour if the congruence is not hypersurface orthogonal) do not add up to zero due to the frame-drag field and momentum density of the fluid. Moreover, the relative orientations of the gyroscope spins around the same contour do not generally cancel out due to the tidal field, the fluid variables (anisotropic pressure and energy density), and the spatial cross-product of relative velocities associated with the separation vectors that form the contour. Additionally, it is shown that even in the absence of the frame-drag field, neighboring observers see relative precession between their gyroscopes when their relative velocity and acceleration are non-parallel due to differential Thomas precession.

classification.title_zh: 广义相对论中的潮汐场与框架拖曳场
classification.abstract_zh: 众所周知，在真空中，两个无限接近的、自由下落的类时观测者会因潮汐场（即 Weyl 张量的“电”部分）而感受到相对加速度；若它们携带惯性导引陀螺仪，则会因框架拖曳场（即 Weyl 张量的“磁”部分）而感受到陀螺仪之间的相对进动。因此框架拖曳场没有牛顿对应。本文针对一族携带惯性陀螺仪并构成同余的类时观测者，利用时空的 (1+3) 协变分解，在存在物质时将这两个场定义为约束方程。与牛顿引力不同，观测者围绕由其空间间隔（以及若同余非超曲面正交时闭合该回路的类时矢量）形成的闭合回路的相对速度，由于框架拖曳场和流体的动量密度而不会加和为零。此外，陀螺仪自旋围绕同一回路的相对取向一般也不会相互抵消，其原因包括潮汐场、流体变量（各向异性压强和能量密度），以及与构成回路的间隔矢量相关的相对速度的空间叉积。文中还表明，即使没有框架拖曳场，当相邻观测者的相对速度和加速度不平行时，由于微分 Thomas 进动，他们也会看到陀螺仪之间的相对进动。
classification.one_liner: 用 (1+3) 协变分解将潮汐场与框架拖曳场表述为含物质约束方程，并讨论陀螺仪沿闭合回路的非牛顿行为与 Thomas 进动。

papers.title: Investigation of Circular Photon Orbits in Naked Singularity Spacetimes from a Geometric Method
papers.abstract: Circular photon orbits play a pivotal role in both gravitational theories and astronomical observations. However, the properties of circular photon orbits in naked singularity spacetimes remain insufficiently explored and deserve in-depth investigation. The present work is dedicated to a comprehensive study of the features of circular photon orbits in naked singularity spacetimes. Notably, a geometric approach is employed to investigate these orbits, in which the framework of optical geometry together with its intrinsic curvatures plays a crucial role. We analyze the existence of circular photon orbits through the intrinsic geodesic curvature, and then examine the numbers of stable and unstable circular orbits, as well as the topological invariant associated with circular photon orbits. By examining various classes of naked singularity spacetimes, we obtain a general conclusion regarding circular photon orbits that holds for the most of spherically symmetric naked singularity spacetimes: the total number of circular photon orbits is an even integer ($\textit{N} = \text{2}\textit{k}$), consisting of $\textit{k}$ stable orbits and $\textit{k}$ unstable orbits in equal proportion. A mathematical proof of this conclusion is also provided in the present work. Furthermore, a comparison with other categories of spacetimes reveals that the conclusions regarding the number of circular photon orbits in naked singularity spacetimes agree with those obtained for compact object spacetimes without naked singularities, indicating that the number of circular photon orbits is primarily governed by the presence of event horizons rather than spacetime singularities. Keywords: Circular Photon Orbit, Naked Singularity Spacetime, Optical Geometry, Geometric Curvatures

classification.title_zh: 几何方法研究裸奇点时空中的圆光子轨道
classification.abstract_zh: 圆光子轨道在引力理论和天文观测中都起着关键作用。然而，裸奇点时空中的圆光子轨道性质仍研究不足，值得深入探讨。本文全面研究裸奇点时空中圆光子轨道的特征。特别地，采用几何方法，其中光学几何框架及其内蕴曲率起重要作用。我们通过内蕴测地曲率分析圆光子轨道的存在性，然后考察稳定和不稳定圆轨道的数量，以及与圆光子轨道相关的拓扑不变量。通过考察多类裸奇点时空，我们得到一个对大多数球对称裸奇点时空成立的普遍结论：圆光子轨道总数为偶数（N=2k），由k条稳定轨道和k条不稳定轨道等比例组成。本文还给出了该结论的数学证明。此外，与其他类型时空的比较表明，裸奇点时空中圆光子轨道数量的结论与无裸奇点致密天体时空所得结论一致，表明圆光子轨道数量主要由事件视界的存在决定，而非时空奇点。关键词：圆光子轨道，裸奇点时空，光学几何，几何曲率。
classification.one_liner: 用光学几何与内蕴曲率证明多数球对称裸奇点时空中圆光子轨道总数为偶数且稳定/不稳定各半，并指出其数量主要由视界而非奇点决定。
