papers.title: The Ringdown and the Tide: Fingerprints of Dark Matter Halo Profiles
papers.abstract: Astrophysical black holes (BH) are not isolated, but embedded in matter supplied by their host galaxies. We study how the shape of a surrounding dark matter (DM) halo modifies the ringdown and tidal response of an asymptotically flat, static, spherically symmetric BH. The halo is modelled as an anisotropic Einstein cluster with vanishing radial pressure and a generalized $(\alpha,\beta,\gamma)$ density profile, supplemented by an inner cut-off near the BH and, where required, an outer tidal truncation. We derive the axial gravitational perturbation equation and compute the quasinormal mode (QNM) spectrum using sixth-order Wentzel-Kramers-Brillouin (WKB) methods and time-domain evolutions. The halo redshifts both the oscillation frequency and the damping rate, by an amount set not only by the halo compactness but also by the profile parameters: the inner slope $\gamma$ dominates for centrally concentrated halos, while $\alpha$ and $\beta$ give subleading but profile-dependent corrections. In the eikonal limit, the shift is governed by a single redshift integral encoding the halo mass distribution outside the light ring, explaining the close correspondence between the QNM frequencies, the light ring frequency, and the Lyapunov exponent. We also show that different combinations of compactness and profile shape can yield nearly degenerate ringdown spectra. Time-domain evolutions confirm the WKB frequencies and display the expected late-time Price law decay, with an intermediate tail controlled by the outer density falloff for slowly decaying profiles. Finally, we compute the static axial tidal Love number and show that it probes the halo with a radial weighting different from the ringdown sector. The combined ringdown and tidal response therefore provides a possible way to distinguish environmental effects from genuine deviations of the vacuum BH geometry.

classification.title_zh: 环铃与潮汐：暗物质晕剖面的指纹
classification.abstract_zh: 天体物理黑洞并非孤立，而是嵌于宿主星系提供物质的环境中。我们研究周围暗物质晕的形状如何改变渐近平直、静态、球对称黑洞的环铃和潮汐响应。晕被建模为各向异性 Einstein cluster，径向压强为零，并采用广义 (α,β,γ) 密度剖面，在黑洞附近加入内截断，并在需要时加入外部潮汐截断。我们推导轴向引力扰动方程，并使用六阶 WKB 方法和时域演化计算 QNM 谱。晕使振荡频率和阻尼率红移，其量不仅由晕致密性决定，也由剖面参数决定：对于中心集中晕，内斜率 γ 主导，而 α 和 β 给出次领头但依赖剖面的修正。在 eikonal 极限，移动由单个红移积分控制，该积分编码光环绕外的晕质量分布，解释了 QNM 频率、光环绕频率和 Lyapunov 指数之间的密切对应。我们还表明，致密性和剖面形状的不同组合可给出几乎简并的环铃谱。时域演化证实 WKB 频率，并显示预期的晚期 Price 律衰减，其中间尾由外密度衰减控制（对缓慢衰减剖面）。最后，我们计算静态轴向潮汐 Love 数，并表明它探测晕的径向权重不同于环铃部分。因此，联合环铃和潮汐响应提供了一种可能区分环境效应与真空黑洞几何真实偏离的方法。
classification.one_liner: 研究暗物质晕剖面如何通过黑洞环铃 QNM 与潮汐 Love 数留下可观测指纹，以区分环境效应与真空黑洞几何偏离。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究经典广义相对论中的黑洞扰动、QNM 与潮汐响应，并涉及暗物质晕环境，属于用户重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”和“QNM与非线性演化”的核心主题；不涉及全息对偶。

papers.title: Discovery of Interpretable Surrogates via Agentic AI: Application to Gravitational Waves
papers.abstract: Fast surrogate models for expensive simulations are now essential across the sciences, yet they typically operate as black boxes. We present \texttt{GWAgent}, a large language model (LLM)-based workflow that constructs interpretable analytic surrogates directly from simulation data. Surrogate modeling is well suited to agentic workflows because candidate models can be quantitatively validated against ground-truth simulations at each iteration. As a demonstration, we build a surrogate for gravitational waveforms from eccentric binary black hole mergers. We show that providing the agent with a physics-informed domain ansatz substantially improves output model accuracy. The resulting analytic surrogate attains a median Advanced LIGO mismatch of $6.9\times10^{-4}$ together with an $\sim 8.4\times$ speedup in waveform evaluation, surpassing both symbolic regression and conventional machine learning baselines. Beyond producing an accurate model, the workflow identifies compact physical structure from the learned representation. As an astrophysical application, we use \texttt{GWAgent} to analyze the eccentricity of GW200129 and infer $e_{20\mathrm{Hz}}=0.099^{+0.063}_{-0.044}$. These results show that validation-constrained agentic workflows can produce accurate, fast, and interpretable surrogates for scientific simulations and inference.

classification.title_zh: 通过代理式AI发现可解释替代模型：应用于引力波
classification.abstract_zh: 昂贵的科学模拟现在需要快速替代模型，但它们通常表现为黑箱。我们提出 GWAgent，一个基于大语言模型的工作流程，可直接从模拟数据构建可解释的解析替代模型。替代建模非常适合智能体工作流，因为候选模型可在每次迭代中针对真实模拟进行定量验证。作为演示，我们为偏心双黑洞并合的引力波波形构建替代模型。我们表明，向智能体提供物理信息领域拟设可显著提高输出模型的精度。所得解析替代模型在 Advanced LIGO 上达到中位失配 6.9×10^-4，并将波形评估加速约 8.4 倍，超过符号回归和传统机器学习基线。除了产生准确模型外，该工作流还从学到的表示中识别出紧凑的物理结构。作为天体物理应用，我们使用 GWAgent 分析 GW200129 的偏心率，并推断 e_{20Hz}=0.099^{+0.063}_{-0.044}。这些结果表明，受验证约束的智能体工作流可为科学模拟和推断产生准确、快速且可解释的替代模型。
classification.one_liner: GWAgent 用 LLM 智能体从模拟数据构建可解释引力波波形替代模型，并用于偏心双黑洞与 GW200129 偏心率推断。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接属于经典引力/引力波方向，涉及偏心双黑洞并合波形与 GW200129 偏心率推断；但核心是代理式 AI 构建可解释替代模型的方法学，对经典引力理论本身贡献有限。

papers.title: gwBenchmarks: Stress-Testing LLM Agents on High-Precision Gravitational Wave Astronomy
papers.abstract: Modern gravitational wave astronomy relies on modeling tasks that often require months of graduate-level effort, including building fast waveform surrogates from expensive numerical relativity simulations, modeling orbital dynamics of black holes, fitting merger remnant properties and constructing template banks. These problems demand extreme precision to support detection and parameter inference, with state-of-the-art models achieving $\lesssim 10^{-4}$ relative error. We study whether state-of-the-art LLM coding agents can perform such end-to-end scientific modeling, where success requires constructing models with stringent accuracy criteria and reasoning about physical systems. We introduce gwBenchmarks, a suite of eight tasks grounded in gravitational wave analytic calculations and numerical simulations collectively representing over $10^8$ core-hours of compute. The tasks span interpolation, regression, and high-dimensional time-series modeling, requiring a combination of numerical methods, machine learning, and physics-informed approaches. In preliminary experiments, agents frequently relied on proxy metrics, partial evaluation, or fabricated results to spuriously complete tasks. We therefore implement an external pre-defined framework to gauge agent progress. Evaluating twelve coding agents, we find no consistent winner. On the easiest task, multiple agents converge to the same cubic spline solution, with one rediscovering a coordinate transformation widely used in the literature. On harder tasks like analytic waveform modeling, all agents fall 1-2 orders of magnitude short of domain requirements and exhibit systematic failures, including metric misuse, constraint violations, and result fabrication. Our code, data, and website are publicly available.

classification.title_zh: gwBenchmarks：在高精度引力波天文学中压力测试 LLM 智能体
classification.abstract_zh: 现代引力波天文学依赖的建模任务通常需要数月研究生级别的工作，包括从昂贵的数值相对论模拟中构建快速波形代理模型、对黑洞轨道动力学建模、拟合并合余晖性质以及构建模板库。这些问题要求极高精度以支持探测和参数推断，最先进模型的相对误差达到 ≲10^-4。我们研究最先进的 LLM 编码智能体是否能够执行此类端到端科学建模，其中成功需要构建满足严格精度标准的模型并对物理系统进行推理。我们提出 gwBenchmarks，一套八个基于引力波解析计算和数值模拟的任务，合计代表超过 10^8 核心小时的计算量。这些任务涵盖插值、回归和高维时间序列建模，需要数值方法、机器学习和物理信息方法的结合。在初步实验中，智能体经常依赖代理指标、部分评估或编造结果来虚假完成任务。因此，我们实现了一个外部预定义框架来衡量智能体进展。评估十二个编码智能体，我们发现没有一致赢家。在最简单的任务上，多个智能体收敛到相同的三次样条解，其中一个重新发现了文献中广泛使用的坐标变换。在诸如解析波形建模等更难任务上，所有智能体都比领域要求差 1-2 个数量级，并表现出系统性失败，包括指标误用、约束违反和结果编造。我们的代码、数据和网站公开可用。
classification.one_liner: 引入 gwBenchmarks，评估十二个 LLM 编码智能体在八项高精度引力波建模任务上的端到端科学建模能力，发现其远未达到领域精度要求。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文围绕引力波波形建模与数值相对论任务，属于经典引力/引力波支线，但核心是 LLM 智能体基准测试，不含新的引力理论或全息对偶结果。

papers.title: Probing Kerr symmetry breaking with LISA extreme-mass-ratio inspirals
papers.abstract: [abridged] Extreme-mass-ratio inspirals (EMRIs) are one of the main sources of gravitational waves (GWs) for LISA. The large number of GW cycles in the EMRI signal makes them very precise probes of the local spacetime geometry that are highly sensitive to deviations from the Kerr metric. Here, we investigate EMRIs around generic, non-Kerr compact objects characterized by a rich multipolar structure. At leading post-Newtonian and linear mass-ratio orders, we incorporate in the waveform model both the axisymmetric and nonaxisymmetric components of the mass quadrupole and octupole moments, parametrizing in this way the breaking of two fundamental symmetries of the Kerr metric. We study the impact of these modifications on the waveform in the philosophy of the EMRI \emph{analytic kludge} models. In our case, the orbital evolution follows from a Lagrangian that contains of the multipolar structure of the primary, including for the first time the nonaxisymmetric multipole moments that break axial symmetry. Then, we assess the capability of LISA to constrain deviations of the multipole moments from their Kerr values and detecting symmetry-breaking effects. In this way, we analyze how effectively LISA will be able to probe models that predict horizon-scale modifications, such as the fuzzball model. Our results show that future LISA observations of EMRIs will provide unprecedented tests of the black hole structure and the underlying theory of gravity. In particular, with one year of LISA data from the inspiral of a $10\,M_{\odot}$ compact object into a rotating supermassive black hole of $10^{6}\,M_{\odot}$ and signal-to-noise ratio of 30, it will be possible to place tight bounds on deviations from the two fundamental symmetries of the Kerr metric, constraining equatorial symmetry breaking in the mass multipole sector to the $10^{-1}$ level and axial symmetry breaking to the $10^{-2}$ level.
authors: Pablo F. Muguruza (Institute of Space Sciences
Institute of Space Studies of Catalonia
Carlos F. Sopuerta (Institute of Space Sciences
Institute of Space Studies of Catalonia)

classification.title_zh: 利用 LISA 极端质量比旋进探测 Kerr 对称性破缺
classification.abstract_zh: 极端质量比旋进（EMRI）是 LISA 的主要引力波源之一。EMRI 信号中大量的引力波周期使其成为局部时空几何的精密探针，并对 Kerr 度规偏离高度敏感。本文研究围绕具有丰富多极结构的广义非 Kerr 致密天体的 EMRI。在领头后牛顿阶和线性质量比阶，我们在波形模型中同时纳入质量四极矩和八极矩的轴对称与非轴对称分量，以此参数化 Kerr 度规两个基本对称性的破缺。我们按 EMRI analytic kludge 模型的思想研究这些修改对波形的影响。在我们的情形中，轨道演化来自包含主天体多极结构的拉格朗日量，并首次纳入破坏轴对称性的非轴对称多极矩。随后，我们评估 LISA 约束多极矩偏离 Kerr 值以及探测对称性破缺效应的能力。由此，我们分析 LISA 能多有效地检验预测视界尺度修改的模型，例如 fuzzball 模型。结果表明，未来 LISA 对 EMRI 的观测将为黑洞结构和基础引力理论提供前所未有的检验。特别地，对于一颗 10 太阳质量致密天体旋进到 10^6 太阳质量旋转超大质量黑洞、信噪比为 30 的一年 LISA 数据，将可能对 Kerr 度规两个基本对称性的偏离给出严格限制：将质量多极矩扇区的赤道对称性破缺限制到 10^-1 水平，将轴对称性破缺限制到 10^-2 水平。
classification.one_liner: LISA EMRI 波形纳入非 Kerr 多极结构，可对 Kerr 赤道与轴对称性破缺给出严格限制。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究 LISA 极端质量比旋进对 Kerr 黑洞时空对称性破缺的探测，属于经典引力/广义相对论与引力波检验。

papers.title: Testing the strong equivalence principle with multimessenger binary neutron star mergers
papers.abstract: The constancy of the gravitational constant $G$ is a cornerstone of the strong equivalence principle and of general relativity, yet its possible temporal variation remains a key target in tests of fundamental physics. Gravitational-wave (GW) astronomy, especially when combined with electromagnetic observations, provides an unprecedented new opportunity to probe this principle in the strong-field and dynamical regime. In this work, we develop a GW waveform model with a slowly varying gravitational constant, incorporating its effects both on compact binary dynamics and GW propagation in an expanding universe. Applying this framework to the binary neutron star merger GW170817, together with independent electromagnetic constraints on the luminosity distance, sky localization and binary inclination from GRB 170817A, we perform a joint Bayesian analysis that disentangles varying-$G$ effects from astrophysical degeneracies. We find no evidence for a temporal variation of the gravitational constant, and constrain its fractional time derivative to $\dot{G}/G \in [-3.36 \times 10^{-9}, 5.34\times10^{-10}]~{\rm yr^{-1}}$, representing the most stringent bounds obtained to date from real GW observations. Our results demonstrate the power of multi-messenger astronomy as a precision probe of the strong equivalence principle in the relativistic regime.

classification.title_zh: 用多信使双中子星并合检验强等效原理
classification.abstract_zh: 引力常数 G 的恒定性是强等效原理和广义相对论的基石，但其可能的时间变化仍是基础物理检验的关键目标。引力波天文学，尤其是与电磁观测相结合，为在强场和动态区域探测这一原理提供了前所未有的新机遇。在本工作中，我们建立了一个具有缓慢变化引力常数的引力波波形模型，将其效应同时纳入致密双星动力学和膨胀宇宙中的引力波传播。将这一框架应用于双中子星并合 GW170817，并结合来自 GRB 170817A 对光度距离、天区定位和双星倾角的独立电磁约束，我们进行联合贝叶斯分析，将变化 G 效应与天体物理简并分离开来。我们发现没有引力常数随时间变化的证据，并将其分数时间导数限制在 \dot{G}/G ∈ [-3.36 × 10^{-9}, 5.34 × 10^{-10}] yr^{-1}，这是迄今从真实引力波观测得到的最严格限制。我们的结果展示了多信使天文学作为相对论区域强等效原理精密探针的能力。
classification.one_liner: 利用 GW170817/GRB 170817A 多信使观测对变化引力常数 G 进行贝叶斯限制，未发现强等效原理破缺证据。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究广义相对论与经典引力框架下的强等效原理检验，并使用引力波与电磁多信使观测限制引力常数变化，直接匹配用户重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”。

papers.title: Misinterpreting spin precession as orbital eccentricity in gravitational-wave signals
papers.abstract: The increasing scope and breadth of gravitational wave detectors is providing the opportunity to explore new parameters in gravitational-wave astronomy. Eccentricity and spin-precession are two key observables to infer the origin of a gravitational wave (GW) source. The interpretation of GW source parameters can be plagued by degeneracy, such as the well-known degeneracy between mass and spin. As the field has explored new parameters, questions have been raised about possible degeneracies between eccentricity and spin-precession. Although some state-of-the-art models now include these effects individually, models that incorporate spin-precession and eccentricity are only in their infancy. Until models faithfully cover the complete parameter space of compact binary coalescence, our ability to correctly measure the source parameters and infer the formation of the binary is compromised. Here, we present a study of the distinguishability of these two key parameters in heavy binary black hole systems. We study merger-ringdown dominated systems with detector-frame total masses ranging between $200-300M_{\odot}$ and mass ratio ranging between $1-3$. Our work finds that there is indeed a degeneracy between eccentricity and spin-precession; however, it is a highly localized effect. We find that the misidentified eccentricity estimates get worse as the detector-frame total mass increases from $200M_{\odot}$ to $300M_{\odot}$, corresponding to progressively shorter signals in the detector band. Additionally, this misidentification is highly sensitive to the inclination angle of the source system. We provide quantifiable estimates of the potency of this degeneracy in addition to identifying some of the regions of parameter space where this degeneracy exists.

classification.title_zh: 将自旋进动误判为引力波信号中的轨道偏心率
classification.abstract_zh: 引力波探测器范围和广度的不断增加，为探索引力波天文学中的新参数提供了机会。偏心率和自旋进动是推断引力波源起源的两个关键观测量。引力波源参数的解读可能受到简并的困扰，例如众所周知的质量-自旋简并。随着该领域探索新参数，人们提出了关于偏心率和自旋进动之间可能简并的疑问。尽管一些最先进模型现在已分别包含这些效应，但同时包含自旋进动和偏心率的模型仍处于起步阶段。在模型忠实覆盖致密双星并合的完整参数空间之前，我们正确测量源参数并推断双星形成的能力会受到损害。在这里，我们研究重双黑洞系统中这两个关键参数的可区分性。我们研究并合-铃宕主导的系统，探测器系总质量范围在 200-300 M⊙，质量比范围在 1-3。我们的工作发现，偏心率和自旋进动之间确实存在简并；然而，这是一种高度局域化的效应。我们发现，随着探测器系总质量从 200 M⊙ 增加到 300 M⊙，误判的偏心率估计会变得更差，这对应于探测器频带中逐渐变短的信号。此外，这种误判对源系统的倾角高度敏感。我们提供了这种简并强度的可量化估计，并确定了这种简并存在的一些参数空间区域。
classification.one_liner: 研究发现重双黑洞引力波信号中自旋进动与轨道偏心率存在局域简并，误判随总质量增大而加剧且依赖倾角。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/广义相对论与引力波方向，涉及双黑洞参数估计；不涉及全息对偶、量子引力或量子信息。

papers.title: Covariant Two-Field Perturbations Through a Curvature-Driven Bounce in Closed FRW Cosmology
papers.abstract: We study perturbations through a locally non-singular bounce in a closed ($K=+1$) FRW universe with a regularised two-field sigma model. Positive curvature drives the bounce in General Relativity without NEC violation; the expanding branch approaches Starobinsky inflation and yields the standard leading slow-roll observables at $N=60$. In the exact fiducial reduced-scalar calculation, kinetic and gradient coefficients remain positive on the declared harmonic-time grid and tensor characteristics are luminal; a wall-free homogeneous-shear scan establishes only sampled robustness. We integrate the scalar sector in two field-space representations of the comoving curvature perturbation, both in Newtonian gauge, with an algebraic Gordon-Wands projection as a third reconstruction: across 64 turning cells the maximum cross-representation residual is $5.6\times10^{-10}$, and across $H=0$ the Einstein-constraint, tolerance-refinement and DOP853-Radau diagnostics stay at the $10^{-8}$-$10^{-12}$ level. On the fiducial no-turn trajectory we derive and integrate the exact finite-harmonic closed-$S^3$ reduced scalar action, propagating two canonically normalised finite-time states without claiming a unique asymptotic vacuum. This gives an early-plateau tensor-to-scalar ratio $r_{\ell=60}=1.73\times10^{-6}$ (state range $[1.62,1.73]\times10^{-6}$), distinct from the observable-pivot prediction $r\simeq3.1\times10^{-3}$, and an entropy-to-curvature power ratio $0.983$ at $\ell=60$ (state range $[0.896,0.983]$), which is spectator power rather than a transfer coefficient or an isocurvature fraction. At the lowest harmonics the two states span $n_s^{\rm curv}\in[0.86,4.17]$; state sensitivity and cosmic variance preclude a likelihood claim. The work establishes a fully specified finite-grid perturbative continuation through a curvature-driven bounce, not a proof of past geodesic completeness.

classification.title_zh: 闭FRW宇宙学中曲率驱动反弹下的协变双场扰动
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究在闭合（K=+1）FRW宇宙中，通过局部非奇异反弹的扰动，采用正则化双场sigma模型。正曲率在不违反NEC的情况下驱动广义相对论中的反弹；膨胀分支趋近Starobinsky暴胀，并在N=60给出标准领先慢滚观测量。在精确基准约化标量计算中，动能和梯度系数在声明的谐波时间网格上保持为正，张量特征为光速；无墙均匀剪切扫描仅确立了采样稳健性。我们在牛顿规范中，用共动曲率扰动的两种场空间表示积分标量扇区，并以代数Gordon-Wands投影作为第三种重构：在64个转向单元中，跨表示最大残差为5.6×10^-10，跨越H=0时Einstein约束、容差细化和DOP853-Radau诊断保持在10^-8至10^-12水平。在基准无转向轨迹上，我们推导并积分精确有限谐波闭S^3约化标量作用量，传播两个正则归一化有限时状态，但不声称唯一渐近真空。这给出早期平台张量标量比r_{ℓ=60}=1.73×10^-6（状态范围[1.62,1.73]×10^-6），区别于可观测枢轴预测r≃3.1×10^-3，以及ℓ=60处熵曲率功率比0.983（状态范围[0.896,0.983]），这是spectator功率而非转移系数或等曲率分数。在最低谐波，两个状态跨越n_s^curv∈[0.86,4.17]；状态敏感性和宇宙方差阻止似然声明。该工作建立了一个完全指定的有限网格微扰延拓穿越曲率驱动反弹，而非过去测地完备性的证明。
classification.one_liner: 在闭FRW宇宙中，用双场sigma模型研究曲率驱动非奇异反弹下的协变宇宙学扰动演化及早期平台观测量。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典广义相对论与宇宙学扰动/反弹暴胀方向，匹配用户重点标签中的经典引力/广义相对论支线；但并非AdS/CFT或其他全息对偶研究。

papers.title: Universal relations for fast rotating neutron stars without parametrisation bias
papers.abstract: We provide a summary of several parametrisations for the nuclear equation of state that have been proposed over the past decades and list viable ranges for their parameters. Based on these parametrisations, we construct a large database of rotating neutron star models using the \textsc{rns} code, which are arranged in sequences of constant central energy density. After filtering these sequences with respect to generous astrophysical constraints, we discover tight universal relations for various bulk quantities of uniformly rotating neutron stars of arbitrary rotation rates. These universal relations allow bulk quantities of uniformly rotating neutron stars to be estimated at minimal computational cost, approximately three orders of magnitude faster than solving the full stellar equilibrium equations, employing only mass, radius, and moment of inertia of associated non-rotating neutron stars. Calibrated on a large, model-agnostic dataset, the relations are robust and remain accurate when tested against realistic equations of state and outperform previously published ones. For most quantities the 99th percentile of the relative residuals lies below 1.6\%; the moment of inertia (2.8\%) and T/W (4.6\%) carry the largest uncertainties. Such relations are important for future, high-precision measurements coming from electromagnetic and gravitational wave observations and may be used in equation of state inference codes or gravitational wave modeling among others.

classification.title_zh: 无参数化偏置的快速旋转中子星普适关系
classification.abstract_zh: 我们总结了过去几十年提出的若干核状态方程参数化方案，并列出了其参数的可行范围。基于这些参数化，我们使用 RNS 代码构建了一个庞大的旋转中子星模型数据库，这些模型按恒定中心能量密度序列排列。在根据宽松的天体物理约束过滤这些序列后，我们发现了任意转速的均匀旋转中子星多种体量的紧密普适关系。这些普适关系允许以极低计算成本估算均匀旋转中子星的体量，比求解完整恒星平衡方程快约三个数量级，且仅需使用相关非旋转中子星的质量、半径和转动惯量。由于在一个大型、模型无关的数据集上校准，这些关系具有鲁棒性，并在用现实状态方程测试时保持准确，且优于此前发表的关系。对大多数量而言，相对残差的第99百分位低于1.6%；转动惯量（2.8%）和 T/W（4.6%）的不确定度最大。此类关系对于未来来自电磁和引力波观测的高精度测量很重要，并可用于状态方程推断代码或引力波建模等。
classification.one_liner: 基于大规模旋转中子星模型数据库，给出无参数化偏置的普适关系，可快速准确估算任意转速均匀旋转中子星的体量。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/相对论天体物理，涉及中子星旋转、状态方程与引力波建模，匹配经典引力/广义相对论重点标签，但不涉及全息或量子引力。

papers.title: Reconciling Inflation with Anisotropies at Small Scales
papers.abstract: There have been persistent suggestions, based on several diverse data sets, that some aspects of our Universe were or are not isotropic. It is not easy to develop a coherent theoretical account of such a ``statistical anisotropy'', for, in standard General Relativity, intuition suggests that it contradicts the predictions of the very successful Inflationary hypothesis. We put this intuition on a firm basis, by proving that if we [a] make use of an Inflationary theory in which Inflation isotropises spatial geometry ---$\,$ this, of course, includes the great majority of such theories ---$\,$ and if [b] we insist on assuming that spacetime has a strictly metric geometry (one in which the geometry is completely determined by a metric tensor), then indeed all aspects of the ``Hubble field'' must be isotropic. Conversely, should a statistical anisotropy be confirmed, then either we must contrive to build anisotropy into Inflation from the outset, or we will have to accept that spacetime geometry is not strictly metric. We argue that the second option, implemented by allowing spacetime \emph{torsion} to be non-zero, would be by far the most natural way to accommodate \emph{some} such observations. Such theories can reconcile a non-isotropic Hubble field at the end of Inflation with a perfectly isotropic spatial geometry, and thus are able to reconcile Inflation with certain kinds of possibly observable anisotropies at relatively small cosmic scales (though by no means with all).

classification.title_zh: 将暴胀与小尺度各向异性相协调
classification.abstract_zh: 基于若干不同数据集，一直有迹象表明我们宇宙的某些方面过去或现在并非各向同性。要为这种“统计各向异性”建立自洽的理论解释并不容易，因为在标准广义相对论中，直觉上它与非常成功的暴胀假说的预言相矛盾。我们为这一直觉提供了坚实基础，证明：若我们（a）采用一种暴胀理论，其中暴胀使空间几何各向同性化（当然包括绝大多数此类理论），并且（b）坚持假定时空具有严格度规几何（即几何完全由度规张量决定），那么“哈勃场”的所有方面都必须各向同性。反过来说，若统计各向异性得到证实，那么要么必须从一开始就把各向异性构造进暴胀，要么必须接受时空几何不是严格度规的。我们认为，通过允许时空挠率非零来实现的第二种选择，将是远为自然地容纳其中某些观测的方式。此类理论能够把暴胀结束时非各向同性的哈勃场与完全各向同性的空间几何协调起来，从而能够将暴胀与相对小宇宙尺度上某些可能可观测的各向异性相协调（尽管绝非所有）。
classification.one_liner: 证明在严格度规广义相对论和使空间各向同性化的暴胀下哈勃场必须各向同性；若观测到统计各向异性，则需引入挠率等非严格度规几何。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文讨论暴胀宇宙学、广义相对论与时空几何/挠率，不属于AdS/CFT或全息对偶研究，与全息理论无直接关联。

papers.title: Charged particle interference in Kerr-Newman spacetime based on teleparallel gravity
papers.abstract: The quantum interference of charged particles in Kerr-Newman spacetime is studied based on teleparallel gravity. We calculate the gravitational phase difference, electromagnetic phase difference, and fringe shifts. We find that the gravitational phase difference contains three parts, respectively corresponding to the result in Kerr spacetime, the effect of Kerr-Newman black hole's charge on spacetime, and a mixed contribution from gravity and electromagnetic interaction. As for the electromagnetic phase difference, it contains two parts, respectively representing a pure electromagnetic contribution and a contribution in which electromagnetism mixes with gravitation. We compare the magnitudes of these phase differences. Afterwards, we extend the results to the case of dyonic Kerr-Newman spacetime. We discuss the effects of the black hole's magnetic charge and rotation, and propose two gedanken experiments to test the Dirac quantization condition. We also study the case that the universality of gravity breaks down, and show that the deviation from the weak equivalence principle can be determined from the fringe shifts. Additionally, we compare the results in teleparallel gravity with those in general relativity. For a generic weak gravitational field, we show that the gravitational phases in these two theories are consistent at the first order of the gravitational gauge potential but differ at higher orders.

classification.title_zh: 基于远平行引力的Kerr-Newman时空中带电粒子干涉
classification.abstract_zh: 本文基于远平行引力研究Kerr-Newman时空中带电粒子的量子干涉。我们计算了引力相位差、电磁相位差和条纹移动，发现引力相位差包含三部分：分别对应Kerr时空的结果、Kerr-Newman黑洞电荷对时空的效应，以及引力与电磁相互作用的混合贡献；电磁相位差包含两部分：纯电磁贡献以及电磁与引力的混合贡献。随后将结果推广到dyonic Kerr-Newman时空，讨论黑洞磁荷与转动效应，并提出两个思想实验检验Dirac量子化条件。还研究了引力普适性破缺的情形，表明可从条纹移动确定对弱等效原理的偏离。最后比较远平行引力与广义相对论的结果：对于一般弱引力场，两种理论的引力相位在引力规范势一阶一致，但在高阶不同。
classification.one_liner: 在Kerr-Newman及时空中计算带电粒子干涉的引力与电磁相位差，并比较远平行引力与广义相对论。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，研究Kerr-Newman黑洞时空中的相位干涉、Dirac量子化条件与弱等效原理检验；不涉及AdS/CFT全息。

papers.title: Real-Time Doppler-Frequency Measurement and Frequency-Pulling Suppression in Arm-locking
papers.abstract: Arm-locking is an important technique for suppressing laser frequency noise in space-based gravitational-wave detection. However, stronger noise suppression inevitably increases the magnitude of frequency pulling, thereby prolonging the lock-acquisition time and increasing the risk of system instability. To address this issue, this paper proposes a real-time Doppler-frequency measurement and frequency-pulling suppression method based on a linear-quadratic-gaussian controller. To achieve a balance between noise suppression and pulling suppression, a time-varying control strategy is adopted. At the initial stage of the time-varying control process, the primary objective is to rapidly limit frequency pulling. Subsequently, the level of pulling suppression is gradually relaxed while the capability for laser frequency-noise suppression is progressively enhanced, so that the residual frequency noise satisfies the time-delay interferometry (TDI) requirement by the end of the transition. Comprehensive performance simulations are conducted for several arm-locking configurations. The results show that the proposed suppressor can reduce frequency pulling within approximately 1000 s while limiting its magnitude to below 100 MHz, thereby eliminating the need for the conventional Doppler frequency pre-estimation stage. When a Fabry-Perot laser is used, the amplitude spectral density (ASD) of the closed-loop laser frequency noise meets the requirements of second-generation and first-generation TDI after 2000 s and 9200 s of closed-loop operation, respectively. These results demonstrate that the proposed suppressor provides both rapid frequency-pulling suppression and a high level of laser frequency-noise suppression. This new method provide a feasible way for rapid acquisition and locking of arm-locking.

classification.title_zh: 臂锁定中的实时多普勒频率测量与频率牵引抑制
classification.abstract_zh: 臂锁定是空间引力波探测中抑制激光频率噪声的一项重要技术。然而，更强的噪声抑制不可避免地会增大频率牵引的幅度，从而延长锁定捕获时间并增加系统不稳定性风险。针对这一问题，本文提出一种基于线性二次高斯控制器的实时多普勒频率测量与频率牵引抑制方法。为在噪声抑制与牵引抑制之间取得平衡，采用了时变控制策略。在时变控制过程的初始阶段，主要目标是快速限制频率牵引。随后，逐步放宽牵引抑制水平，同时逐步增强激光频率噪声抑制能力，使残余频率噪声在过渡结束时满足时间延迟干涉（TDI）要求。针对若干臂锁定配置进行了全面的性能仿真。结果表明，所提出的抑制器可在约1000秒内减小频率牵引，同时将其幅度限制在100 MHz以下，从而无需传统的多普勒频率预估计阶段。当使用Fabry-Perot激光器时，闭环激光频率噪声的幅度谱密度（ASD）在闭环运行2000秒和9200秒后分别满足第二代和第一代TDI的要求。这些结果表明，所提出的抑制器同时提供了快速的频率牵引抑制和高水平的激光频率噪声抑制。这种新方法为臂锁定的快速捕获与锁定提供了一条可行途径。
classification.one_liner: 提出基于LQG的实时多普勒频率测量与时变控制策略，在臂锁定中快速抑制频率牵引并满足TDI激光噪声要求。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于空间引力波探测中的激光频率噪声控制与臂锁定技术，未涉及AdS/CFT、全息对偶、量子引力或量子信息，因此与全息理论物理重点无关；仅在广义引力波探测语境下可关联经典引力/广义相对论，但不是理论引力或全息研究。

papers.title: Biases from Astrophysical Environmental Effects in Standard-Siren Cosmology
papers.abstract: Next-generation ground based gravitational wave detectors will enable precision standard-siren cosmology, making systematics increasingly important. We investigate how line-of-sight acceleration, as may arise for compact binaries in dense astrophysical environments, biases measurements of the Hubble constant $H_0$. We simulate a catalogue of 50 binary neutron star bright sirens with known host redshifts, assuming the signals have been impacted by line-of-sight acceleration and analysing them with vacuum waveforms. Unmodelled line-of-sight acceleration biases the inferred luminosity distances and shifts the individual $H_0$ posteriors systematically towards lower values. Consequently, combining events narrows the posterior around a biased value rather than averaging away the systematic, even when the acceleration signs are assigned randomly. For our 50-event catalogues, affected fractions of approximately $10\%$ at $|a_\parallel|/c=10^{-6}\,\mathrm{s^{-1}}$, or $30\%$ at $|a_\parallel|/c=10^{-7}\,\mathrm{s^{-1}}$, produce offsets exceeding three posterior standard deviations in at least one quarter of the realisations. Considering larger catalogues further increases the significance of the effect. Our results indicate that environmental effects may constitute an important systematic for precision standard-siren cosmology and should be incorporated into future population analyses.

classification.title_zh: 标准汽笛宇宙学中天体物理环境效应导致的偏差
classification.abstract_zh: 下一代地基引力波探测器将实现精密标准汽笛宇宙学，使系统误差日益重要。我们研究视线加速度——致密双星在稠密天体物理环境中可能产生——如何偏置哈勃常数 H0 的测量。我们模拟了一个包含 50 个已知宿主红移的双中子星亮汽笛的目录，假设信号受到视线加速度影响，并用真空波形分析它们。未建模的视线加速度会偏置推断的光度距离，并将单个 H0 后验系统性移向较低值。因此，合并事件会使后验在偏置值附近变窄，而不是平均掉系统误差，即使加速度符号随机分配。对于我们的 50 事件目录，在 |a∥|/c=10^{-6} s^{-1} 时约 10% 受影响，或在 |a∥|/c=10^{-7} s^{-1} 时约 30% 受影响，会在至少四分之一实现中产生超过三个后验标准差的偏移。考虑更大目录会进一步提高该效应的显著性。我们的结果表明，环境效应可能成为精密标准汽笛宇宙学的重要系统误差，并应纳入未来族群分析。
classification.one_liner: 未建模的视线加速度会系统性偏低地偏置标准汽笛哈勃常数测量，且多事件合并不消除该偏差。
classification.relevance_reason: 研究经典引力波标准汽笛宇宙学及其系统误差，与“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签相关；但不涉及全息、AdS/CFT 或量子引力。

papers.title: On rigidity of stationary black holes under a nontrapping assumption
papers.abstract: We prove that a smooth, regular, asymptotically flat stationary vacuum black hole has a nonextremal Kerr exterior if no null geodesic orthogonal to its stationary Killing field is trapped. We extend the local rotational symmetry by choosing successive domains whose limiting boundary in the ergoregion, if nonempty, is locally a timelike photon surface for the stationary quotient metric. To obtain this geometry without an initial regularity assumption on the boundary, we derive uniform estimates along complete rotational orbits from nontrapping and use convexity along short null segments to control the boundary. Its null geodesics lift to spacetime null geodesics orthogonal to the stationary field. Circularity allows us to continue them through ergosurface contact with stationary projection confined to a compact set, contradicting nontrapping and giving global axisymmetry.

classification.title_zh: 关于非捕获假设下稳态黑洞的刚性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们证明：若不存在与其稳态 Killing 场正交的被困零测地线，则一个光滑、正则、渐近平坦的稳态真空黑洞外部必为非极端 Kerr 外部。我们通过选取一系列区域来延拓局部旋转对称性；其在能层中的极限边界若非空，则是稳态商度量的局部类时光子面。为了在边界无初始正则性假设下得到该几何，我们由非捕获性沿完备旋转轨道导出均匀估计，并利用短零线段上的凸性控制边界。该边界的零测地线可提升为与稳态场正交的时空零测地线。圆性允许它们穿越能层面接触继续延拓，同时稳态投影限制在紧集内，与非捕获性矛盾，从而得到全局轴对称性。
classification.one_liner: 在非捕获条件下证明稳态真空黑洞外部必为非极端 Kerr 外部。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究经典广义相对论中的稳态黑洞刚性与 Kerr 唯一性，直接属于用户重点标签中的“经典引力/广义相对论”支线。

papers.title: Stereoscopic gravitational-wave probe: Gravitational lensing of a binary merger in active galactic nuclei
papers.abstract: Recent work has shown that, if a large fraction of the LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA compact binary coalescences (CBCs) occur in accretion disks around active galactic nuclei (AGNs), many such AGN-CBC systems will likely experience lensing and produce multiple gravitational-wave (GW) "images" of the CBCs that will become detectable with current or future GW detectors. However, the waveforms produced by such lensed "images" will differ from those produced by other lensing systems because the binary source is orbiting the AGN's central supermassive black hole at a close distance. Here, we show that these systems produce 2 snapshots of the same binary source from 2 different viewing angles. These differences in the effective viewing angle between the images are encoded in the GWs they emit, such that GW detectors can effectively analyse the waveforms from 2 viewpoints. Beyond such "multi-view lensing", the GW images may also differ by their Doppler shift due to the expected relativistic orbital motion of the source around the AGN, an effect which is further amplified by the proximity to the lens. If the AGN's own angular momentum can be related to the binary's orbital angular momentum, we can describe the entire AGN-CBC system using only one additional free parameter compared with a typical point-mass lens system, or with 3 additional parameters when we do not make such an assumption. In this work, we establish a framework of transformation rules that describe both the angles in the 2 points of view, and the Doppler effect that comes from the source's motion around the lens. We also provide the framework to produce consistent AGN-lensed waveforms from any currently available GW waveform. These AGN-CBC systems give 2 unique points of view on a binary merger thus opening up a new window into the merger's properties unlike any other lens system.

classification.title_zh: 立体引力波探针：活动星系核中双星合并的引力透镜效应
classification.abstract_zh: 近期工作表明，如果 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 探测到的致密双星并合中有很大一部分发生在活动星系核（AGN）周围的吸积盘中，那么许多这类 AGN-CBC 系统很可能经历引力透镜，并产生多个引力波“像”，这些像将可被当前或未来引力波探测器探测到。然而，这类透镜“像”产生的波形与其他透镜系统不同，因为双星源在很近的距离上绕 AGN 中心超大质量黑洞运动。本文表明，这些系统会从两个不同视角给出同一双星源的快照。像之间有效视角的差异被编码在它们发射的引力波中，因此引力波探测器可以有效地分析来自两个视角的波形。除了这种“多视角透镜”之外，引力波像还可能因源绕透镜的相对论性轨道运动而产生多普勒频移差异，而靠近透镜会进一步放大该效应。若 AGN 自身角动量可与双星轨道角动量相关联，则整个 AGN-CBC 系统相比典型点质量透镜系统只需增加一个自由参数即可描述；若不采用该假设，则需增加三个自由参数。本文建立了一套变换规则框架，用以描述两个视角中的角度，以及源绕透镜运动产生的多普勒效应。我们还提供了从任何当前可用引力波波形生成自洽 AGN 透镜化波形的框架。这些 AGN-CBC 系统为双星并合提供了两个独特视角，从而打开了不同于任何其他透镜系统的、探究并合性质的新窗口。
classification.one_liner: AGN 中的双星并合经引力透镜可产生同一双星的两个视角，并可用统一波形变换框架生成自洽的透镜化引力波。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论与引力波透镜方向，使用广义相对论框架分析活动星系核中致密双星并合的透镜化波形；与全息对偶无直接关系，但直接对应“经典引力/广义相对论”重点支线。

papers.title: Analytical estimates of core optics stray light noise and design requirements for ground based gravitational wave detectors
papers.abstract: We present an analytical framework to translate detector sensitivity into stray light requirements for the core optics region of ground based gravitational wave interferometers. We derive analytical estimates for several relevant scattering regimes, extend the treatment to collections of planar baffles, and obtain an analogous requirement for deterministic ghost beams intercepted by beam dumps. The framework is intended to provide conservative design requirements before a complete optical layout is available. We apply it to Cosmic Explorer to show how these estimates can be used to derive requirements for next generation detectors. The resulting expressions provide a compact set of tools for stray light budgeting and early design studies in current and future gravitational wave detectors.

classification.title_zh: 地面引力波探测器核心光学杂散光噪声的解析估计与设计要求
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个解析框架，将探测器灵敏度转化为地面引力波干涉仪核心光学区域的杂散光要求。我们推导了几个相关散射情形的解析估计，将处理推广到平面挡板集合，并得到被光束收集器拦截的确定性鬼光束的类似要求。该框架旨在在完整光学布局可用之前提供保守的设计要求。我们将其应用于 Cosmic Explorer，展示如何用这些估计推导下一代探测器的要求。所得表达式为当前和未来引力波探测器的杂散光预算和早期设计研究提供了一套紧凑工具。
classification.one_liner: 为地面引力波干涉仪核心光学区建立杂散光解析估计，并据此给出下一代探测器的设计要求。
classification.relevance_reason: 涉及地面引力波探测器的核心光学杂散光噪声与设计要求，属于经典引力/引力波探测相关；但不是全息对偶、量子引力或理论经典引力研究。

papers.title: Boson Star Factory: Past, Present, and Future
papers.abstract: Boson stars are self-gravitating solitons of the Einstein-Klein-Gordon equations for a massive complex scalar field, and arguably the simplest horizonless compact objects arising in General Relativity. Beyond spherical symmetry, their construction requires solving a system of nonlinear elliptic partial differential equations, a difficult task per se and that each group has traditionally addressed with its own numerical implementation. A systematic comparison of different methods applied to the same physical model has so far been lacking. In this work, we carry out such a comparison for the two simplest non-spherical configurations: rotating boson stars and static dipolar boson stars. We employ three independent codes, based respectively on finite differences (FIDISOL/CADSOL), finite elements (FreeFem), and spectral methods (Kadath), and assess their accuracy through different diagnostics. The three solvers agree on the global observables to typically eight significant digits. We further compare the runtime of each code on identical hardware and provide precise benchmark values of the relevant physical quantities, intended to serve as reference data for future numerical studies of boson stars. As a further proof of concept, we also present the use of physics-informed neural networks to construct a rotating Q-ball solution.

classification.title_zh: 玻色星工厂：过去、现在与未来
classification.abstract_zh: 玻色星是带质量复标量场在 Einstein-Klein-Gordon 方程中的自引力孤子，可以说是广义相对论中出现的最简单的无事件视界致密天体。超越球对称时，其构造需要求解非线性椭圆偏微分方程组；这本身很困难，且各研究组传统上使用各自的数值实现。对不同方法应用于同一物理模型的系统性比较此前一直缺乏。本文对两种最简单的非球对称位形——旋转玻色星和静态偶极玻色星——进行这种比较。我们采用三个独立代码，分别基于有限差分（FIDISOL/CADSOL）、有限元（FreeFem）和谱方法（Kadath），并通过不同诊断量评估其精度。三个求解器在全局可观测量上通常一致到八位有效数字。我们进一步在相同硬件上比较各代码的运行时间，并给出相关物理量的精确基准值，旨在为未来玻色星数值研究提供参考数据。作为进一步的概念验证，我们还展示了使用物理信息神经网络构造旋转 Q-ball 解。
classification.one_liner: 比较有限差分、有限元和谱方法求解旋转与偶极玻色星，并提供基准数据，另用物理信息神经网络构造旋转 Q-ball。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究广义相对论中的自引力孤子/玻色星及其数值构造，直接匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签，也涉及“畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀”方向；但不涉及全息对偶。

papers.title: Constraining the geometry of rotating black holes with eikonal QNMs
papers.abstract: Quasinormal modes of black holes provide a central avenue for confronting general relativity with gravitational-wave observations from the ringdown stage of compact binary coalescence. However, inferring black-hole properties or the background spacetime requires theory-dependent input. In this work, we connect a calibrated eikonal method, which relates quasinormal mode shifts to local metric properties near the light ring, with the underlying rotating black hole metric. Using Bayesian inference, we compare a metric-specific model based on the global Konoplya-Rezzolla-Zhidenko parametrization with a metric-agnostic approach based on local values and radial derivatives of the metric functions at the light ring. For each model, we perform both one-parameter and simultaneous multi-parameter analyses and quantify how their priors map onto the same local quantities. We find that uniform priors on the metric-specific coefficients can induce strongly nonuniform and skewed priors on these local metric quantities. For an injection compatible with general relativity, both models remain consistent with Kerr and yield similar posteriors for the orbital frequency and Lyapunov exponent despite their different induced priors. For injections representing deviations from general relativity, one-parameter analyses can fail to recover the injected local deviations and, in the metric-specific case, can bias the global metric reconstruction. The multi-parameter analyses of both models yield consistent constraints, suggesting sufficient robustness. However, they introduce substantial degeneracies and differences in marginalized parameters, demonstrating practical limitations when considering more flexible models. Finally, we apply the framework to approximate posterior information from the ringdown analysis of GW250114 and find that both models are consistent with the Kerr metric in general relativity.

classification.title_zh: 用 eikonal QNM 约束旋转黑洞的几何
classification.abstract_zh: 黑洞准正规模是将广义相对论与致密双星并合铃宕阶段引力波观测相对照的核心途径。然而，推断黑洞性质或背景时空需要依赖理论的输入。本文把一种校准的 eikonal 方法（将准正规模频移与光环形附近局部度规性质联系起来）与旋转黑洞度规相连接。利用贝叶斯推断，我们比较了基于全局 Konoplya-Rezzolla-Zhidenko 参数化的度规特定模型，与基于光环形处度规函数局部值及径向导数的度规无关方法。对每个模型，我们进行单参数和多参数同时分析，并量化其先验如何映射到相同的局部量。我们发现，度规特定系数上的均匀先验可对这些局部度规量诱导出强烈非均匀且偏斜的先验。对于与广义相对论一致的注入，两个模型都与 Kerr 一致，并给出相似的轨道频率和 Lyapunov 指数后验，尽管其诱导先验不同。对于代表偏离广义相对论的注入，单参数分析可能无法恢复注入的局部偏离，且在度规特定情形下可能使全局度规重构产生偏差。两个模型的多参数分析给出了一致的约束，表明具有足够稳健性。然而，它们引入显著简并及边缘化参数差异，展示了考虑更灵活模型时的实际局限。最后，我们将该框架应用于 GW250114 铃宕分析的近似后验信息，发现两个模型一般都与广义相对论中的 Kerr 度规一致。
classification.one_liner: 用 eikonal 准正规模结合贝叶斯推断，比较度规特定与度规无关模型对旋转黑洞几何和广义相对论偏离的约束。

papers.title: Do gravitational waves assist the genuine tripartite entanglement harvesting?
papers.abstract: We investigate the harvesting of genuine tripartite entanglement by three linearly arranged Unruh-DeWitt detectors locally coupled to a massless scalar field in a gravitational wave background. We show that gravitational waves play a dual role in entanglement harvesting, either enhancing or suppressing the harvested entanglement depending on the system parameters. In particular, genuine tripartite entanglement exhibits a pronounced nonmonotonic response to the gravitational wave frequency, characterized by successive suppression, enhancement resembling resonance, and renewed suppression, while approaching its corresponding value in Minkowski spacetime in the regime of high frequencies. Its dependence on the detector separation is also nonmonotonic, displaying local enhancement peaks that are absent in the corresponding bipartite entanglement behavior. Compared with bipartite entanglement, genuine tripartite entanglement therefore exhibits a higher sensitivity to gravitational wave perturbations in both the frequency and spatial domains. These results suggest that genuine tripartite entanglement may provide a sensitive quantum probe of spacetime perturbations induced by gravitational waves.

classification.title_zh: 引力波是否有助于真三体纠缠的采集？
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了三个线性排列的 Unruh-DeWitt 探测器与引力波背景中无质量标量场局域耦合时，对真三体纠缠的采集。我们表明，引力波在纠缠采集中扮演双重角色：根据系统参数不同，既可以增强也可以抑制采集到的纠缠。特别地，真三体纠缠对引力波频率表现出显著的非单调响应，其特征为相继抑制、类似共振的增强以及再次抑制，并在高频区域趋近其在 Minkowski 时空中的对应值。它对探测器间距的依赖也是非单调的，表现出对应两体纠缠行为中不存在的局部增强峰。因此，与两体纠缠相比，真三体纠缠在频率和空间域中对引力波扰动都表现出更高的敏感性。这些结果暗示，真三体纠缠可能为引力波诱导的时空扰动提供一种敏感的量子探针。
classification.one_liner: 三个 Unruh-DeWitt 探测器在引力波背景中的真三体纠缠采集对引力波频率和探测器间距呈非单调响应，并比两体纠缠更敏感。
classification.relevance_reason: 研究引力波背景对 Unruh-DeWitt 探测器真三体纠缠采集的影响，属于相对论量子信息/弯曲时空量子场论；与“经典引力/广义相对论”中的引力波背景有交叉，但不涉及全息、AdS/CFT、凝聚态或 QCD 等重点支线。

papers.title: Joule Thomson expansion of symmergent black holes in extended phase space
papers.abstract: We investigate the Joule Thomson expansion of a symmergent black hole within an extended phase-space formalism in which the thermodynamic pressure is introduced as an independent variable. The symmergent entropy contains the parameter alpha-hat, which modifies the enthalpy and thermodynamic volume relative to their standard forms. We show that the Joule Thomson coefficient depends only on the combination 8piP*r_+^2, leading to an inversion curve P_i = (pi/2) * I_i^2 that is independent of alpha-hat. The isenthalpic curves, however, retain a parametric dependence on alpha-hat, indicating that the symmergent sector affects the thermodynamic trajectories but not the inversion boundary itself. The inversion pressure and temperature are derived explicitly, and the cooling regime P > P_i is distinguished from the heating regime P < P_i. Since the effective geometry is asymptotically AdS-like for positive pressure, the results also admit a holographic reading, in which the Joule Thomson expansion corresponds to an isenthalpic process in the dual field theory. The results provide a consistent thermodynamic framework for symmergent black holes and clarify the role of the symmergent parameters in the Joule Thomson process.

classification.primary_topic: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 扩展相空间中的 Symmergent 黑洞 Joule-Thomson 膨胀
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在扩展相空间形式中研究 Symmergent 黑洞的 Joule-Thomson 膨胀，其中热力学压强被作为独立变量引入。Symmergent 熵包含参数 \hat{\alpha}，它相对于标准形式修改了焓和热力学体积。我们表明，Joule-Thomson 系数仅依赖于组合 8πP r_+^2，导致反转曲线 P_i = (π/2) I_i^2 与 \hat{\alpha} 无关。然而，等焓曲线仍保留对 \hat{\alpha} 的参数依赖，表明 Symmergent 部分影响热力学轨迹但不影响反转边界本身。我们显式推导了反转压强和温度，并将冷却区 P > P_i 与加热区 P < P_i 区分开来。由于正压时有效几何渐近 AdS 型，结果也允许一种全息解读，其中 Joule-Thomson 膨胀对应于对偶场论中的等焓过程。这些结果为 Symmergent 黑洞提供了一个一致的热力学框架，并阐明了 Symmergent 参数在 Joule-Thomson 过程中的作用。
classification.one_liner: 研究扩展相空间中 Symmergent 黑洞的 Joule-Thomson 膨胀，发现反转曲线不依赖 Symmergent 参数，而等焓轨迹仍依赖该参数。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要属于经典黑洞热力学与扩展相空间 Joule-Thomson 膨胀，契合‘经典引力/广义相对论’重点；但全息仅为 AdS 型几何下的解读，未展开 AdS/CFT 计算，因此全息相关度有限。

papers.title: A novel phenomenological parametrization of dynamical dark energy via matter-gravity coupling
papers.abstract: We develop a new parametrization for generic departures from the $\Lambda$CDM model based on the Markov-Mukhanov action with non-minimal matter-gravity coupling. In this approach the cosmological constant $\Lambda$ and the gravitational coupling $G$ become dynamical with their values determined by the explicit form of the matter-gravity coupling. We use the framework to build a simple phenomenological model where dynamical dark energy is naturally obtained as a consequence of the departure of the theory from classical General Relativity at low densities. We show how the model's free parameters can be constrained from observational data and interpret the tentative observations of `phantom crossing' by the DESI collaboration in view of the proposed formalism.

classification.title_zh: 通过物质-引力耦合的动态暗能量的一种新颖唯象参数化
classification.abstract_zh: 我们基于带有非最小物质-引力耦合的 Markov-Mukhanov 作用量，为偏离 ΛCDM 模型的一般情形发展了一种新的参数化。在此方法中，宇宙学常数 Λ 和引力耦合 G 变为动力学量，其取值由物质-引力耦合的显式形式决定。我们利用该框架构建了一个简单的唯象模型，其中动态暗能量自然地作为理论在低密度下偏离经典广义相对论的结果而出现。我们展示了如何从观测数据约束该模型的自由参数，并在所提议的形式体系下解释 DESI 合作组的暂定‘phantom crossing’观测。
classification.one_liner: 基于 Markov-Mukhanov 非最小物质-引力耦合，提出动态暗能量的唯象参数化，并讨论观测约束与 DESI phantom crossing 解释。

papers.title: Signatures of Novikov-Thorne accretion disks around rotating black holes in semiclassical gravity with trace anomaly
papers.abstract: Semiclassical gravity provides a promising framework to address the black hole singularity problem through quantum backreaction characterized by a coupling parameter, making it essential to thoroughly explore the accretion properties around such objects. In this paper, within the framework of semiclassical gravity with type-A trace anomaly, we investigate the thermal radiative signatures of Novikov-Thorne accretion disks around rotating black holes across diverse parameter spaces, focusing on the energy flux density, temperature profile, and thermal luminosity. Our findings demonstrate that the introduction of the coupling parameter suppresses disk emission, leading to lower peak values of both energy flux density and temperature, as well as lower peak values and corresponding peak frequencies in thermal luminosity compared to their Kerr counterparts in general relativity. In particular, this discrepancy becomes remarkably pronounced when the black hole possesses a high spin. Mechanistically, increasing the coupling parameter reinforces the effective gravitational field strength of the central compact object, which pushes the equatorial stable circular orbits outward and increases the specific energy of the orbiting matter, thereby reducing the radiative efficiency and weakening the overall disk emission. This suppression mechanism offers a practical astrophysical window to distinguish semiclassical gravity from general relativity and to place observational constraints on the coupling parameter via thermal disk spectra.

classification.title_zh: 半经典引力中带迹反常的旋转黑洞周围 Novikov-Thorne 吸积盘的特征
classification.abstract_zh: 半经典引力通过由耦合参数刻画的量子反作用，为解决黑洞奇点问题提供了一个有前景的框架，因此彻底探索此类天体周围的吸积性质至关重要。本文在具有 A 型迹反常的半经典引力框架下，研究了旋转黑洞周围 Novikov-Thorne 吸积盘在不同参数空间中的热辐射特征，重点关注能流密度、温度分布和热光度。结果表明，耦合参数的引入会抑制盘辐射，导致能流密度和温度的峰值都比广义相对论中的 Kerr 对应体更低，热光度的峰值及相应峰值频率也更低。特别地，当黑洞具有高自旋时，这种差异变得非常显著。机制上，增大耦合参数会增强中心致密天体的有效引力场强，使赤道面上的稳定圆轨道向外移动，并增加轨道物质比能，从而降低辐射效率并削弱整体盘辐射。这种抑制机制提供了一个实用的天体物理窗口，可用于区分半经典引力与广义相对论，并通过热盘谱对耦合参数施加观测约束。
classification.one_liner: 在半经典引力 A 型迹反常框架下，旋转黑洞的 Novikov-Thorne 吸积盘辐射被耦合参数抑制，高自旋时与 Kerr 差异显著，可作为区分半经典引力与广义相对论的观测窗口。
classification.relevance_reason: 与用户关注的全息各支线无直接关系；但涉及旋转黑洞、相对论吸积盘和半经典修正，可归入经典引力/广义相对论重点标签。

papers.title: Signatures in the local interstellar medium of electromagnetic radiation produced by neutron star gravitational waves
papers.abstract: The Voyager spacecraft have been detecting plasma oscillations of a few kHz for over 40 years. However, there is still no widely accepted hypothesis for the astrophysical source of the oscillations. Having entered the local interstellar medium, these detections have persisted, adding to the challenge of identifying the astrophysical source. Neutron stars were one of the earliest hypothesized candidates of the electromagnetic radiation responsible for the detected plasma oscillations, but no theoretical mechanism could be identified to explain the frequency of the oscillations. We explore the recently developed theory of co-production of electromagnetic radiation in gravitational wave backgrounds as a possible source of these low-frequency oscillations and investigate whether neutron stars could be the astrophysical source.

classification.title_zh: 局地星际介质中由中子星引力波产生的电磁辐射的特征
classification.abstract_zh: 旅行者号航天器40多年来一直探测到几千赫兹的等离子体振荡。然而，对于这些振荡的天体物理来源，仍没有广泛接受的假说。进入局地星际介质后，这些探测持续存在，增加了识别天体物理来源的挑战。中子星是最早被假设为导致所探测等离子体振荡的电磁辐射候选源之一，但未能找到理论机制来解释振荡频率。我们探索近期发展的引力波背景中电磁辐射协同产生理论，作为这些低频振荡的可能来源，并研究中子星是否可能为天体物理源。
classification.one_liner: 探讨中子星引力波背景中协同产生的电磁辐射能否解释旅行者号探测到的千赫兹等离子体振荡。

papers.title: Optimal all-angle reconstruction of the Hellings-Downs curve
papers.abstract: Pulsar timing arrays (PTAs) detect nanohertz gravitational waves through spatial correlations between the timing residuals of different pulsars. For an isotropic, unpolarized stochastic background in general relativity, the ensemble-mean correlation follows the Hellings--Downs (HD) curve; measuring this angular pattern tests the gravitational-wave origin of the signal. Standard bin-by-bin reconstructions optimize the weights within each angular bin separately. We reconstruct the curve jointly using the full pulsar-pair covariance, retaining a free amplitude in every bin. The resulting all-angle best linear unbiased estimator minimizes the variance of every bin value and every linear combination of bins. Applied to the public NANOGrav 15 yr data products, our method reduces the bin standard deviations by up to 12.9\%, with a median reduction of 9.5\%. For a future Square Kilometre Array Observatory (SKAO)-like PTA, the predicted reduction reaches 36.4\%, with a median of 29.6\%, enabling significantly more precise measurements of the gravitational-wave background.

classification.title_zh: Hellings-Downs 曲线的最优全角度重建
classification.abstract_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列（PTAs）通过不同脉冲星计时残差之间的空间相关性探测纳赫兹引力波。在广义相对论中，对于各向同性、非偏振的随机背景，系综平均相关性遵循 Hellings--Downs (HD) 曲线；测量该角度图样可检验信号的引力波起源。标准的逐 bin 重建分别优化每个角度 bin 内的权重。我们利用完整的脉冲星对协方差联合重建该曲线，在每个 bin 中保留一个自由振幅。由此得到的全角度最佳线性无偏估计量使每个 bin 值以及每个 bin 线性组合的方差最小。应用于公开的 NANOGrav 15 年数据产品，我们的方法将 bin 标准差最多降低 12.9%，中位降低 9.5%。对于未来类似平方公里阵列天文台（SKAO）的 PTA，预计降低可达 36.4%，中位为 29.6%，从而能够显著更精确地测量引力波背景。
classification.one_liner: 提出利用完整脉冲星对协方差的全角度联合重建方法，更精确测量 Hellings-Downs 曲线。

papers.title: Null Geodesics in the Reissner-Nordstr\"om Black Hole Spacetime Pierced by a Cosmic String
papers.abstract: In this paper, we investigate null geodesics in the spacetime of a Reissner-Nordstr\"om black hole pierced by a cosmic string. Analysis of the equations of motion reveals that null geodesics in this conical spacetime can be classified into three main categories, with the classification entirely determined by the ratio $|Q|/M$ (where $Q$ and $M$ denote the black hole charge and mass, respectively). Analytical solutions to the null geodesic equations are obtained for each category. Based on these solutions, we numerically simulate light trajectories and analyze in detail the effects of the black hole charge $Q$ and the cosmic string parameter $\alpha$. It is found that the cosmic string parameter $\alpha$ enhances the winding behavior of null geodesics across all three main categories. Finally, we consider light deflection in the equatorial plane and derive an expression for the deflection angle, revealing that the charge $Q$ decreases the deflection angle, whereas the cosmic string parameter $\alpha$ increases it.

classification.title_zh: 被宇宙弦穿过的 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞时空中的零测地线
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究了被宇宙弦穿过的 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞时空中的零测地线。运动方程分析表明，该圆锥时空中的零测地线可分为三大类，分类完全由比值 |Q|/M 决定，其中 Q 和 M 分别表示黑洞电荷和质量。文章给出了每一类零测地线方程的解析解。基于这些解，作者数值模拟了光线轨迹，并详细分析了黑洞电荷 Q 和宇宙弦参数 α 的影响。结果发现，宇宙弦参数 α 会增强所有三大类零测地线的缠绕行为。最后，文章考虑了赤道面上的光线偏折，并推导了偏折角表达式，表明电荷 Q 会减小偏折角，而宇宙弦参数 α 会增大偏折角。
classification.one_liner: 研究被宇宙弦穿过的 RN 黑洞时空中零测地线的分类、解析解与光偏折，发现电荷减小偏折角而弦参数增大偏折角。

papers.title: Energy-momentum-squared gravity: charged quark star solutions with unified interacting matter
papers.abstract: We investigate the equilibrium structure of electrically charged quark stars within the framework of energy-momentum-squared gravity (EMSG), adopting a unified interacting quark-matter equation of state that incorporates perturbative QCD corrections, color superconductivity, and finite-strange-quark-mass effects. By solving the modified Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff equations over a broad range of EMSG coupling strengths and interaction parameters, we show that the inclusion of electric charge substantially increases both the maximum mass and radius compared with neutral configurations. For strong negative couplings and pronounced interaction strengths, the resulting stellar models reach masses close to $3,M_{\odot}$ with compactness ratios of order $0.34$, placing them within the mass range inferred for the secondary component of GW190814, whose nature remains observationally undetermined. The presence of charge reduces the central density at maximum mass by approximately $10$--$15\%$ while maintaining full compliance with causality requirements. Furthermore, comparisons with observational constraints from PSR J1614$-$2230, J0348$+$0432, J0740$+$6620, J0952$-$0607, and recent NICER radius measurements indicate that charged EMSG configurations remain consistent with current astrophysical bounds over a wide parameter space. These results demonstrate that a moderate electric charge, when combined with nonlinear matter-geometry coupling, can support quark stars that are significantly more massive than those predicted in general relativity, underscoring the potential observational relevance of charged compact objects in modified gravity and multimessenger astrophysics.

classification.title_zh: 能量-动量平方引力：带统一相互作用物质的带电夸克星解
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在能量-动量平方引力（EMSG）框架下研究带电夸克星的平衡结构，采用统一相互作用夸克物质状态方程，并纳入微扰QCD修正、色超导和有限奇异夸克质量效应。通过在大范围EMSG耦合强度和相互作用参数下求解修改后的Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff方程，我们发现引入电荷会显著提高最大质量和半径。对于强负耦合和显著相互作用强度，星体模型质量可接近3倍太阳质量，紧致度约为0.34，落在GW190814次天体推断质量范围内。电荷使最大质量处的中心密度降低约10%–15%，同时满足因果性要求。与PSR J1614-2230、J0348+0432、J0740+6620、J0952-0607以及近期NICER半径测量等观测约束比较后，带电EMSG位形在广泛参数空间内仍与当前天体物理界限一致。这些结果表明，适度的电荷与非线性物质-几何耦合结合，可以支持比广义相对论预言显著更重的夸克星，凸显了修改引力中带电致密天体的潜在观测意义。
classification.one_liner: 在能量-动量平方引力下，带电夸克星可通过非线性物质-几何耦合获得接近3倍太阳质量并满足当前观测约束。

papers.title: Quasinormal modes in the field of a dyon-like dilatonic black hole corresponding to $A_1 + A_1$ Toda chain
papers.abstract: We explore the quasinormal modes of a massless test scalar field in the gravitational background of a non-extremal dilatonic dyonic black hole. The dyon-like black hole solution is considered within a four-dimensional gravitational model that includes two scalar fields and two 2-forms. It is governed by two dilatonic coupling vectors $\vec{\lambda}_s$ (with $s=1,2$) that satisfy $\vec{\lambda}_1 = \vec{\lambda}_2 = \vec{\lambda}$ and $\vec{\lambda}^2 = 1/2$. We derive and examine the quasinormal modes of a massless scalar test field in the eikonal limit. These modes are governed by the solution parameters $\mu > 0$, $P_1 > 0$, and $P_2 > 0$. In the two limiting scenarios -- namely $P_1 = P_2 = 0$ and $P_1 = P_2 = P > 0$ -- our results reduce exactly to the known (eikonal) quasinormal spectra for the Schwarzschild and Reissner-Nordstr\"om black holes, respectively. Numerical higher-order WKB analysis of quasinormal frequencies for two lower levels (for various values of parameters) is also presented.

classification.title_zh: 对应于 A_1 + A_1 Toda 链的类双荷膨胀黑洞场中的准正规模
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了非极端膨胀双荷黑洞引力背景中无质量试探标量场的准正规模。该双荷型黑洞解是在一个包含两个标量场和两个 2-形式的四维引力模型中考虑的。它由两个膨胀耦合矢量 \vec{\lambda}_s（s=1,2）支配，二者满足 \vec{\lambda}_1 = \vec{\lambda}_2 = \vec{\lambda} 且 \vec{\lambda}^2 = 1/2。我们推导并考察了无质量标量试探场在 eikonal 极限下的准正规模。这些模式由解参数 \mu > 0、P_1 > 0 和 P_2 > 0 控制。在两个极限情形——即 P_1 = P_2 = 0 和 P_1 = P_2 = P > 0——我们的结果分别精确回到已知的 Schwarzschild 和 Reissner-Nordstr\"om 黑洞（eikonal）准正频谱。我们还给出了两个低阶模式（对不同参数取值）的准正频率的高阶 WKB 数值分析。
classification.one_liner: 在含两个标量场与两个 2-形式的膨胀双荷黑洞背景中，计算无质量试探标量场的 eikonal 准正规模并给出高阶 WKB 数值结果。

papers.title: An exact Kerr-like rotating Morris--Thorne wormhole: throat, ergoregion and equatorial shadow slice
papers.abstract: We construct an exact Kerr-like rotating extension of the zero-redshift Morris--Thorne wormhole in a Teo-type stationary, axisymmetric ansatz. The Einstein equations for an anisotropic source comoving with zero angular momentum observers fix $\mathcal{K}(r)=r^2+a^2$ and reduce frame dragging to a radial quadrature. For $b(r)=r_0^2/r$, this is evaluated using incomplete elliptic integrals and normalised by the ADM angular momentum. The spacetime is asymptotically flat with zero ADM mass, so $a=J_{\rm ADM}/M_{\rm ADM}$ does not apply. The oblateness length $a$ and angular momentum $J_{\rm ADM}$ remain independent, yielding a family $(r_0,a,J_{\rm ADM})$. The choice $J_{\rm ADM}=ar_0$ selects only a one-parameter slice for numerical ergoregion and equatorial-capture illustrations; it is not a field-equation constraint. We find $r_{\rm th}=\sqrt{r_0^2-a^2}$, with reality bound $|a|\leq r_0$ and regular range $0\leq |a|<r_0$. In the canonical stationary foliation, the throat is defined quasi-locally as the unique closed surface $S_0$ in the family $S_\ell$ with zero mean curvature and positive area second variation. Moreover, $r=r_{\rm th}$ and $\ell=0$ are coordinate representations. A signed throat-adapted coordinate reveals two asymptotically flat ends, excludes closed timelike curves, and establishes that the throat is timelike, not a horizon. These conclusions hold independently of $J_{\rm ADM}=ar_0$. The supporting stress tensor, reconstructed from the Einstein tensor, is an effective phenomenological source. We do not claim any microscopic matter Lagrangian or realistic equation of state. We also determine the ergoregion onset. Since the full Hamilton--Jacobi equation is nonseparable, we limit ourselves to derive the optical result for a one-dimensional equatorial capture interval.

classification.title_zh: 精确类 Kerr 旋转 Morris-Thorne 虫洞：喉部、能层与赤道阴影切片
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在 Teo 型稳态轴对称拟设中构造了零红移 Morris-Thorne 虫洞的精确类 Kerr 旋转扩展。与零角动量观察者共动的各向异性源对应的 Einstein 方程固定了 K(r)=r^2+a^2，并将参考系拖曳约化为一个径向积分。对于 b(r)=r_0^2/r，该积分用不完全椭圆积分计算，并用 ADM 角动量归一化。时空渐近平直且 ADM 质量为零，因此 a=J_ADM/M_ADM 不适用。扁率长度 a 与角动量 J_ADM 保持独立，给出一个 (r_0,a,J_ADM) 族。选择 J_ADM=a r_0 只选出一个单参数切片，用于数值能层和赤道捕获图示；它不是场方程约束。我们发现 r_th=sqrt(r_0^2-a^2)，实在性界为 |a|≤r_0，正则范围为 0≤|a|<r_0。在规范稳态叶状结构中，喉部被准局域地定义为族 S_l 中唯一具有零平均曲率和正面积二阶变分的闭合曲面 S_0。此外，r=r_th 和 l=0 是坐标表示。一个带符号的喉部适应坐标揭示出两个渐近平直端，排除了闭合类时曲线，并确立喉部是类时的，而不是视界。这些结论独立于 J_ADM=a r_0。从 Einstein 张量重建的支撑应力张量是有效唯象源。我们不声称任何微观物质拉格朗日量或现实状态方程。我们还确定了能层起始。由于完整的 Hamilton-Jacobi 方程不可分离，我们只推导一维赤道捕获区间的光学结果。
classification.one_liner: 构造了精确类 Kerr 旋转 Morris-Thorne 虫洞，并分析其喉部、能层与赤道阴影光学切片。

papers.title: Horizon--orbit scale competition underlying chaos bound violation for spinning particles
papers.abstract: In this paper, we investigate the chaos bound through the local radial instability of charged spinning test particles on unstable circular orbits in the black-bounce--Kerr--Newman spacetime. Our results show that violation of the bound is governed by the competition between the local orbital-instability scale and the surface gravity scale, with variations of the black hole background and the particle dynamics providing two complementary routes to the same threshold crossing. Background variations affect both scales and can drive the system into the bound-violating regime when the surface gravity is suppressed more strongly than the orbital instability. At fixed background, by contrast, the surface gravity remains unchanged, and the transition across the threshold is driven by changes in the unstable orbit dynamics induced by the particle parameters. The background-controlled and probe-dynamics-controlled routes therefore represent two realizations of a unified horizon--orbit scale competition rather than independent mechanisms.

classification.title_zh: 自旋粒子混沌界违背背后的视界—轨道尺度竞争
classification.abstract_zh: 本文通过 black-bounce-Kerr-Newman 时空中带电自旋测试粒子在不稳定圆轨道上的局部径向不稳定性来研究混沌界。结果表明，混沌界的违背由局部轨道不稳定尺度与表面引力尺度之间的竞争所支配；黑洞背景的变化和粒子动力学的变化提供了通向同一阈值跨越的两条互补路径。背景变化会同时影响这两个尺度，并且当表面引力比轨道不稳定性受到更强压制时，可驱动系统进入违背混沌界的区域。相反，在固定背景下，表面引力保持不变，跨越阈值由粒子参数引起的不稳定轨道动力学变化所驱动。因此，背景控制的路径与探针动力学控制的路径代表统一视界—轨道尺度竞争的两种实现，而非相互独立的机制。
classification.one_liner: 在 black-bounce-Kerr-Newman 时空中，带电自旋测试粒子的混沌界违背由视界表面引力与轨道不稳定性两种尺度的竞争统一决定。

papers.title: Effective Field Theory of Gravity in Relativistic Media
papers.abstract: We develop an effective field theory of gravity in relativistic media. Integrating out the medium leaves vacuum gravity with updated Feynman rules: a graviton propagator dressed by the stress-energy two-point function of the environment, medium-induced bulk graviton vertices from higher correlators, and generalized worldline couplings encoded in matched Wilson coefficients. The diagram topologies are unchanged from vacuum, so different media (perfect fluids, collisionless matter, coherent scalar fields such as wave dark matter) are not different theories but different correlators inserted into the same diagrams. We derive the in-medium rules for a relativistic fluid and obtain the full 1PN Einstein-Infeld-Hoffmann potential, the 1PN Stokes drag, the gravitational self-energy and a generalized Christodoulou memory whose new tensor structure records the orientation of the medium's anisotropy, turning the permanent strain into an $\textit{astrophysical weathervane}$. The same rules activate phenomena forbidden in vacuum: the sound pole converts the symmetry-protected, non-running black-hole Love number into a resonant, running one, and graviton splitting $h\to hh$ is open into the longitudinal branch of the dressed propagator, and gives the transverse graviton a width, $\Gamma=G_N\omega^3(1-c_s^2)^2/120c_s^3$, a $\textit{gravitational opacity}$ set by the sound speed. The same vertex makes a graviton suffer dynamical friction. We assess observational prospects, from dephasing and tidal resonances within reach of the Einstein Telescope and LISA to proof-of-principle memory and opacity signatures.

classification.title_zh: 相对论性介质中引力的有效场论
classification.abstract_zh: 我们发展了相对论性介质中引力的有效场论。将介质积分掉后，真空引力获得更新的费曼规则：一个被环境应力-能量两点函数修饰的引力子传播子，由更高关联函数产生的介质诱导体引力子顶点，以及编码在匹配威尔逊系数中的广义世界线耦合。图拓扑与真空中相同，因此不同介质（完美流体、无碰撞物质、相干标量场如波暗物质）不是不同理论，而是插入同一批图中的不同关联函数。我们推导了相对论性流体的介质内规则，并得到完整的 1PN Einstein-Infeld-Hoffmann 势、1PN Stokes 阻力、引力自能，以及一个广义 Christodoulou 记忆，其新的张量结构记录了介质各向异性的取向，将永久应变变成“天体物理风向标”。同一套规则激活了真空中被禁戒的现象：声极点将对称性保护的非跑动黑洞 Love 数转化为共振的、跑动的 Love 数；引力子分裂 h→hh 打开到修饰传播子的纵向支，并给横向引力子一个宽度，Γ=G_Nω^3(1-c_s^2)^2/120c_s^3，一种由声速设定的“引力不透明度”。同一顶点使引力子遭受动力学摩擦。我们评估观测前景，从 Einstein Telescope 和 LISA 可及的退相位和潮汐共振，到原理验证性的记忆和不透明度信号。
classification.one_liner: 将介质积分掉得到相对论性介质中的引力 EFT 费曼规则，并导出 1PN 势、广义 Christodoulou 记忆、黑洞 Love 数共振修正、引力子分裂/不透明度与动力学摩擦等效应。

papers.title: Gauge versus (hidden) physical symmetries of FLRW cosmologies
papers.abstract: In generally covariant theories, evolution in coordinate time is a gauge transformation, so that a symmetry made manifest in a gauge-fixed description need not be a symmetry of the physical dynamics. At the same time, deparametrisation removes gauge redundancies but may hide physical symmetries, in particular those that depend on the chosen physical clock. We investigate the relation between gauge and hidden physical symmetries in flat FLRW geometry coupled to an arbitrary number $n$ of free massless scalar fields. We show that conformal Killing vectors of the minisuperspace metric generate conserved charges that are Dirac observables and hence gauge-invariant. Their Poisson algebra realises the maximal conformal algebra $\mathfrak{conf}(n,1)\simeq\mathfrak{so}(n+1,2)$, extending previous single-field results to arbitrary $n$. We then revisit the Eisenhart--Duval lift in a family of gauges and show that the resulting symmetry algebra is gauge dependent. Only in the harmonic gauge does the algebra enlarge to the Schr\"odinger algebra, which is thus not a physical symmetry. Finally, we show that deparametrisation maps the lifted charges to gauge-invariant Dirac observables, which always realise a subalgebra of $\mathfrak{conf}(n,1)$, recovering it in full in the harmonic gauge. Our results provide a systematic framework for disentangling gauge from physical symmetries in minisuperspace models, recovering charges to which reduced phase-space descriptions are structurally blind, and extending naturally to models with potentials.

classification.title_zh: FLRW 宇宙学的规范对称性与（隐藏）物理对称性
classification.abstract_zh: 在广义协变理论中，坐标时间的演化是规范变换，因此在固定规范描述中显现的对称性未必是物理动力学的对称性；同时，去参数化虽消除规范冗余，却可能隐藏物理对称性，尤其是依赖所选物理时钟的对称性。我们研究平坦 FLRW 几何耦合任意 n 个自由无质量标量场时规范对称性与隐藏物理对称性的关系。证明 minisuperspace 度规的共形 Killing 矢量生成守恒荷，这些荷是 Dirac 可观测量因而规范不变；其 Poisson 代数实现最大共形代数 conf(n,1)≃so(n+1,2)，将先前单场结果推广到任意 n。随后在一族规范中重新审视 Eisenhart–Duval 提升，表明所得对称代数依赖规范；只有在谐振规范下代数才扩大为 Schrödinger 代数，因此后者不是物理对称性。最后，去参数化把提升荷映射为规范不变的 Dirac 可观测量，它们总是实现 conf(n,1) 的子代数，并在谐振规范下完整恢复该代数。我们的结果为在 minisuperspace 模型中区分规范与物理对称性提供了系统框架，找回约化相空间描述在结构上无法看到的荷，并可自然推广到带势模型。
classification.one_liner: 研究平坦 FLRW minisuperspace 中规范对称性与隐藏物理对称性的关系，并证明物理守恒荷实现最大共形代数 conf(n,1)。

papers.abstract: The equilibrium thermodynamics of boosted Schwarzschild black holes is worked out in a concise way and shown to agree with expectations from relativistic thermodynamics.

papers.title: de Sitter Scalar Discrete Series: Gupta-Bleuler Structure and Holography
papers.abstract: We show that scalar discrete-series unitary irreducible representations (UIRs) $\Pi_{p,0}$ ($p=1,2,\cdots$) of the de Sitter (dS) group $\mathrm{SO}_0(1,4)$ admit a dS-covariant Krein realization on the dS hyperboloid, endowed with a dS-invariant non-degenerate Klein-Gordon (KG) sesquilinear form, in which the group action is indecomposable and organizes naturally into a Gupta-Bleuler triplet. The positive- and negative-norm sectors are already present in the underlying Krein space, whereas a null sector emerges only at an intermediate stage, where the induced KG form becomes degenerate and its radical leads canonically to the physical quotient carrying the UIR $\Pi_{p,0}$. We further show that suitable limits of the bulk theory at the ``future'' and ``past'' conformal boundaries ${\mathcal{I}}^\pm$ give rise to dS-invariant boundary realizations endowed with induced kernel inner products. While the bulk negative-norm sector admits no independent boundary counterpart, the boundary realization retains the physical and gauge structures inherited from the bulk. The resulting boundary module nevertheless remains indecomposable, with its physical quotient carrying the discrete-series representation $\Pi_{p,0}$. The antipodal symmetry provides a natural relation between the realizations on ${\mathcal{I}}^+$ and ${\mathcal{I}}^-$, ensuring the consistency of the boundary construction and its geometric interpretation. At the heart of the analysis lies a Fourier-type bulk-boundary transform that provides a dS-covariant identification of the bulk and boundary physical sectors, establishing a one-to-one intertwining correspondence between the bulk and boundary realizations of $\Pi_{p,0}$ while preserving reflection positivity.

classification.title_zh: de Sitter 标量离散系列：Gupta-Bleuler 结构与全息
classification.abstract_zh: 我们证明 de Sitter（dS）群 SO_0(1,4) 的标量离散系列幺正不可约表示（UIR）Π_{p,0}（p=1,2,...）在 dS 双曲面上允许一个 dS 协变的 Krein 实现，并赋予 dS 不变的非退化 Klein-Gordon（KG）半双线性形式；其中群作用是不可分解的，并自然组织为 Gupta-Bleuler 三重态。正模与负模部分已存在于底层 Krein 空间，而零模部分仅出现在中间阶段：此时诱导 KG 形式退化，其根基（radical）典型地给出携带 UIR Π_{p,0} 的物理商。我们进一步表明，体理论在“未来”和“过去”共形边界 I^± 的适当极限会产生具有诱导核内积的 dS 不变边界实现。虽然体负模部分没有独立的边界对应，但边界实现保留了从体继承的物理与规范结构。所得边界模仍不可分解，其物理商携带离散系列表示 Π_{p,0}。对跖对称性为 I^+ 与 I^- 上的实现提供自然关系，确保边界构造及其几何解释的一致性。分析核心是一个傅里叶型体-边界变换，它提供体与边界物理扇区的 dS 协变识别，在保持反射正性的同时，建立 Π_{p,0} 的体与边界实现之间的一一交织对应。
classification.one_liner: 本文给出 dS 标量离散系列 UIR 的 Krein/Gupta-Bleuler 体实现，并通过体-边界变换构造其 dS 协变边界实现，证明二者物理扇区一一对应且保持反射正性。
