papers.title: Charge-dependent scalarization of Einstein- Euler-Heisenberg black holes
papers.abstract: Charge-dependent scalarization of the Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg (EEH) black hole is carried out in the EEH-scalar theory by introducing an exponential scalar coupling with coupling constant $\alpha$ to the Maxwell and nonlinear electrodynamic terms. The bald black hole (EEHBH) is described by mass $M$ and arbitrary magnetic charge $q$ and has a single horizon when choosing the action parameter $\mu=0.3$. Here, we find the critical onset charge $q_c=r_+^2/\sqrt{2\mu}$ with $r_+(M,q_c)$ the outer horizon radius from the resonance condition. The spontaneous scalarization ($\alpha^+$) of this black hole is available for charge $0<q< q_c=1.115$ for $M=1$ and $\mu=0.3$, with positive $\alpha$, whereas its new scalarization ($\alpha^-$) occurs for $q> q_c$ and negative $\alpha$. The former case of $q=0.5$ implies infinite branches of scalarized EEHBHs but its fundamental branch ($n=0$) is stable against the $l=0$ modes considered here, while for $q=2$ and $q=20$, one stable scalarized branch is found for each charge within the explored parameter ranges.

classification.title_zh: Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg 黑洞的电荷依赖性标量化
classification.abstract_zh: 通过在 Maxwell 项和非线性电动力学项中引入具有耦合常数 α 的指数标量耦合，在 EEH-标量理论中研究了 Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg (EEH) 黑洞的电荷依赖性标量化。光头黑洞（EEHBH）由质量 M 和任意磁荷 q 描述，并且当选取作用量参数 μ=0.3 时具有单一视界。这里，我们从共振条件发现临界起始电荷 q_c = r_+^2/√(2μ)，其中 r_+(M,q_c) 是外视界半径。该黑洞的自发标量化（α^+）在 M=1、μ=0.3 时对于电荷 0<q<q_c=1.115 可用，且 α 为正；而其新的标量化（α^-）发生在 q>q_c 且 α 为负时。前一种情形 q=0.5 意味着无穷多个标量化 EEHBH 分支，但其基本分支（n=0）对这里考虑的 l=0 模式稳定；而对于 q=2 和 q=20，在所探索的参数范围内，每个电荷都找到一个稳定的标量化分支。
classification.one_liner: 在 EEH-标量理论中，标量耦合导致 EEH 黑洞出现依赖电荷的两种标量化分支，并给出临界电荷与稳定性分析。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究 Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg 黑洞在标量场下的标量化，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，并直接匹配重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”；但它不是 AdS/CFT 或全息研究。

papers.title: Open-channel quantization of JT gravity at finite cutoff
papers.abstract: Direct canonical quantization of Jackiw--Teitelboim gravity at finite cutoff leads to a critically singular P\"oschl--Teller problem whose endpoint admits inequivalent self-adjoint domains. We solve the full one-parameter family, obtain its exact spectral data, and identify the extension parameter with a renormalized short-distance matching datum in geodesic-length space. Self-adjointness, positivity, and unitary Brown--York evolution leave a stable family, whereas a source-free local completion without an endpoint contact term selects the Friedrichs realization. With the Brown--York clock and a local cap prescription fixed, the disk amplitude distinguishes the domains. In the large-boundary limit the bulk operator becomes universally Liouville, while a cap tied to the receding endpoint can retain domain dependence. Analytic continuation also maps radial resonances to poles of the Brown--York resolvent. These results isolate the short-distance datum that distinguishes the reduced canonical realizations and that a microscopic completion would have to determine.

classification.title_zh: 有限截断下 JT 引力的开通道量子化
classification.abstract_zh: 对有限截断下的 Jackiw-Teitelboim 引力进行直接正则量子化，会导向一个临界奇异的 Pöschl-Teller 问题，其端点允许不等价的自伴域。我们求解完整的一参数族，得到精确谱数据，并将延拓参数与测地长度空间中的重整化短距离匹配数据对应起来。自伴性、正定性和幺正 Brown-York 演化留下一个稳定族，而无源局域完备化且无端点接触项时选择 Friedrichs 实现。固定 Brown-York 时钟和局域帽规定后，圆盘振幅可区分这些域。在大边界极限下，体算符普适地变为 Liouville 型，而与被推远端点的帽则可保留域依赖性。解析延拓还将径向共振映射为 Brown-York 预解式的极点。这些结果分离出区分约化正则实现所需的短距离数据，以及微观完备化必须确定的数据。
classification.one_liner: 有限截断 JT 引力的正则量子化由端点自伴延拓参数控制，并可由 Brown-York 圆盘振幅区分。
classification.relevance_reason: 与 AdS2/JT 全息及量子引力直接相关，但未涉及用户列出的全息超流超导、multi-trace 等具体重点支线。

papers.title: Topologically shadowed quantum criticality: A non-compact conformal manifold
papers.abstract: We propose a family of topological quantum critical points (tQCPs) separating non-invertible chiral topological orders in $(2+1)$ dimensions. We conjecture that these tQCPs can be captured by a family of scale-invariant field theories forming a non-compact scale-invariant manifold. A central feature of our proposal is topological shadowing: the underlying critical theory is rigorously constrained by the global topological data of the two adjacent gapped phases. These theories can be further projected into quantum field theories with universal non-local structures. The non-local coupling, however, controls dynamical observables along the scale-invariant manifold, including the VEV of Wilson loops and their exchange phase around the two non-contractible cycles of a torus. Despite the non-locality, our renormalization group calculations (up to two-loop order) strongly suggest that the theory shall maintain exact scale invariance. This supports, without supersymmetry, a continuous family of scale-invariant fixed points, which are further substantiated from a holographic perspective.

classification.primary_topic: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 拓扑遮蔽的量子临界性：非紧致共形流形
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一族拓扑量子临界点（tQCPs），它们分隔 (2+1) 维中的非可逆手性拓扑序。我们猜想，这些 tQCPs 可以由一族标度不变场论来刻画，而这些场论构成一个非紧致标度不变流形。我们提议的核心特征是拓扑遮蔽：底层临界理论被两个相邻有能隙相的全局拓扑数据严格约束。这些理论可以进一步投影为具有普适非局域结构的量子场论。然而，非局域耦合控制着沿标度不变流形的动力学可观测量，包括 Wilson 圈的真空期望值及其绕环面两个不可收缩圈的交换相位。尽管存在非局域性，我们的重整化群计算（至两圈阶）强烈表明该理论应保持精确标度不变性。这支持了无需超对称的连续族标度不变不动点，并从全息视角得到进一步佐证。
classification.one_liner: 提出分隔非可逆手性拓扑序的拓扑量子临界点，并猜想其由非紧致标度不变流形上的非局域场论描述，RG 计算与全息视角支持无超对称连续标度不变不动点。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究拓扑量子临界点与非紧致共形流形，属于相变/强关联理论，并借助全息视角佐证；与用户重点标签中的“相变与气泡成核”部分相关，但未涉及超流超导、p波、QNM、探针膜、经典引力等具体支线。

papers.title: Probing Proton Structure via Physics-Guided Neural Networks in Holographic QCD
papers.abstract: Describing the proton structure function $F_2(x,Q^2)$ across the nonperturbative and transition regimes of QCD remains a major theoretical challenge. We construct a physics-guided phenomenological representation combining fermion-resonance and Pomeron-like AdS/QCD basis functions with a neural parametrization. The resonance sector is constrained by the AdS eigenvalue problem and physical proton mass, while the neural component describes effective kinematic mixing, Pomeron normalization, and a regularized log-space correction. For 187 selected SLAC measurements, a fixed 153/34 training--test split gives $\chi^2/N_{\rm train}=0.542$, $\chi^2/N_{\rm test}=1.990$, and $\chi^2/N_{\rm all}=0.805$. Conditional on the chosen holographic basis, the fitted channel fractions evolve continuously from Pomeron-like dominance at lower measured $x$ to fermion-resonance dominance at larger $x$. The mixing midpoint is at $x\simeq0.187$, while equality of the final channel fractions occurs at $x\simeq0.226$, defining a transition region $x\simeq0.19$--$0.23$ rather than a unique boundary. Although $\alpha_0\simeq1.08$ is compatible with the data, fixed-$\alpha_0$ refits show that it is not separately identifiable from the flexible Pomeron normalization. The $x$-dependent holographic coordinates and effective excited scales should therefore be regarded as basis-dependent quantities rather than direct measurements of an $x$-dependent proton spectrum. A data-only neural baseline shows no predictive advantage for the holographic basis on the present dataset. The framework thus provides a basis-conditioned phenomenological decomposition rather than a model-independent extraction of proton dynamics.

classification.title_zh: 通过物理引导神经网络在全息QCD中探测质子结构
classification.abstract_zh: 描述质子在QCD非微扰和过渡区的结构函数 F2(x,Q^2) 仍是重大理论挑战。我们构建了一种物理引导的唯象表示，将费米子共振和类Pomeron的AdS/QCD基函数与神经网络参数化结合。共振部分由AdS本征值问题和物理质子质量约束，神经网络部分描述有效运动学混合、Pomeron归一化和正则化对数空间修正。对187个选定的SLAC测量，固定153/34训练-测试划分给出 χ²/N_train=0.542、χ²/N_test=1.990、χ²/N_all=0.805。在所选全息基下，拟合的道分数从较低测量x处类Pomeron主导连续演化到较大x处费米子共振主导。混合中点位于 x≈0.187，而最终道分数相等出现在 x≈0.226，定义了一个过渡区 x≈0.19–0.23，而非唯一边界。尽管 α0≈1.08 与数据相容，固定α0的重拟合表明它不能与灵活的Pomeron归一化分开识别。因此，依赖x的全息坐标和有效激发标度应被视为基依赖量，而不是对x依赖质子谱的直接测量。仅数据的神经网络基线在当前数据集上未显示全息基的预测优势。因此该框架提供的是以基为条件的唯象分解，而不是对质子动力学的模型无关提取。
classification.one_liner: 在全息QCD基下用物理引导神经网络分解质子结构函数，结果被明确限定为基依赖的唯象分解。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于全息QCD/质子结构唯象应用，不涉及用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM、冷原子或经典引力等支线。

papers.title: On Radiative Fluxes and Coulombic Charges in the Balance Law for Black Hole Evaporation
papers.abstract: In asymptotically-flat spacetimes, there is a clear distinction between radiative fluxes and Coulombic charges. Using the Wald-Zoupas prescription, we identify the classical radiative flux of a massless scalar field in 3+1 dimensions. In a spherically-symmetric model of black hole evaporation, the balance law yields a Bondi mass correction related to the entanglement entropy of Hawking radiation. The renormalized flux is nonnegative, differs from the Fulling-Davies formula, and coincides with the Ashtekar-Taveras-Varadarajan flux. We discuss implications for 3+1 black hole evaporation.

classification.title_zh: 论黑洞蒸发平衡律中的辐射通量与库仑荷
classification.abstract_zh: 在渐近平坦时空中，辐射通量与库仑荷有明确区分。我们利用 Wald-Zoupas 方案，在 3+1 维中识别出无质量标量场的经典辐射通量。在球对称黑洞蒸发模型中，平衡律给出与霍金辐射纠缠熵相关的 Bondi 质量修正。重整化后的通量非负，不同于 Fulling-Davies 公式，并与 Ashtekar-Taveras-Varadarajan 通量一致。我们讨论其对 3+1 维黑洞蒸发的意义。
classification.one_liner: 用 Wald-Zoupas 方案定义渐近平直时空中无质量标量场的辐射通量，并在球对称黑洞蒸发平衡律中联系 Bondi 质量修正与霍金辐射纠缠熵。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/渐近平直时空与黑洞蒸发平衡律，匹配重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”；但不涉及全息对偶、超流超导、多分量序参量或凝聚态实验启发等主要全息支线。

papers.title: Global causality constraints in rotating scalar-tensor spacetimes
papers.abstract: Modified gravity is often formulated as an effective field theory (EFT), where higher-order corrections parametrize departures from General Relativity. We argue that such corrections should be constrained by the global causal structure of curved spacetime, in addition to the usual flat-space requirements such as positivity and unitarity. We propose that within the domain of validity of the EFT, the onset of closed timelike curves should not happen in a parametrically more accessible region than in the corresponding GR background. We test this diagnostic in the quadratic k-essence sector of scalar-tensor gravity. For stationary and axisymmetric spacetimes, the invariant test for closed axial orbits is the sign of the azimuthal component of the metric \(g_{\varphi\varphi}\). We supplement this test by requiring a local time function in the space of Killing vectors. We apply these conditions to quadratic k-essence on Kerr--(A)dS backgrounds, with and without scalar charge. The zero-charge branch is exact Kerr--(A)dS, and we treat the charged branch perturbatively in scalar charge and in Hartle--Thorne slow rotation. Expanding for small spin \(\chi=a/(GM)\ll1\), frame dragging begins at \(\mathcal O(\chi)\), while the quadrupolar backreaction relevant for circular closed timelike curves enters at second order in both rotation and charge. We find that, in the truncation used here, any occurrence of \(g_{\varphi\varphi}<0\) also lies outside EFT control. A higher-order calculation or a fully nonlinear treatment is therefore needed. Finally, we discuss how quasinormal modes and black-hole echoes could probe such causal structure.

classification.title_zh: 旋转标量-张量时空中的全局因果性约束
classification.abstract_zh: 修改引力通常被表述为有效场论（EFT），其中高阶修正参数化了对广义相对论的偏离。我们认为，除了平直空间中的正性与幺正性等通常要求外，这类修正还应受到弯曲时空全局因果结构的约束。我们提出，在EFT的有效域内，闭合类时曲线的出现不应发生在比相应GR背景参数上更易达到的区域。我们在标量-张量引力的二次k-essence部分检验这一诊断。对于稳态和轴对称时空，闭合轴向轨道的协变判据是度规方位角分量g_{φφ}的符号。我们通过要求在Killing矢量空间中存在局部时间函数来补充该检验。我们将这些条件应用于Kerr-(A)dS背景上的二次k-essence，包含和不包含标量荷。零荷分支精确为Kerr-(A)dS，带电分支在标量荷和Hartle-Thorne慢转动中微扰处理。对小自旋χ=a/(GM)<<1展开时，参考系拖曳从O(χ)开始，而对接闭合类时曲线相关的四极反作用同时以转动和荷的二阶进入。我们发现，在此截断中，任何g_{φφ}<0的出现也都位于EFT控制之外。因此需要更高阶计算或完全非线性处理。最后，我们讨论准正规模和黑洞回声如何探测此类因果结构。
classification.one_liner: 在二次k-essence标量-张量引力中，用全局因果性判据约束Kerr-(A)dS背景，发现所采用的截断下闭合类时曲线出现在EFT失效区，需高阶或非线性分析，并讨论QNM/黑洞回声探测。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接对应重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”与“QNM与非线性演化”；讨论修改引力中的全局因果结构、Kerr-(A)dS背景以及QNM/黑洞回声探测。

papers.title: Dirac Observables for Gowdy Cosmologies regular at the Big Bang
papers.abstract: Gowdy cosmologies are exact, spatially inhomogeneous solutions of the vacuum Einstein equations which describe nonlinear gravitational waves coalescing at the Big Bang singularity. With toroidal spatial sections they provenly have the Asymptotic Velocity Domination property, in that close to the Big Bang dynamical spatial gradients fade out and the dynamics is governed by a Carroll-type gravity theory. Here we construct an infinite set of Dirac observables for Gowdy cosmologies, valid off-shell, strongly, and without gauge fixing. These observables stay regular at the Big Bang and can be matched to much simpler Dirac observables of the Carroll-type gravity theory. Conversely, in an adapted foliation there is a systematic anti-Newtonian expansion (in inverse powers of the reduced Newton constant) of the full Dirac observables whose leading terms are the Carroll ones. In particular, this provides an off-shell generalization of the Asymptotic Velocity Domination property.

classification.title_zh: Gowdy 宇宙学在宇宙大爆炸处正则的 Dirac 可观测量
classification.abstract_zh: Gowdy 宇宙学是真空 Einstein 方程的精确、空间非均匀解，描述在宇宙大爆炸奇点处汇聚的非线性引力波。对于环面空间截面，它们已被证明具有 Asymptotic Velocity Domination（渐近速度支配）性质：在接近大爆炸时，动力学空间梯度逐渐消失，动力学由 Carroll 型引力理论支配。本文为 Gowdy 宇宙学构造无限多个 Dirac 可观测量，这些量在离壳、强意义且无需规范固定的情况下有效。这些可观测量在大爆炸处保持正则，并可与 Carroll 型引力理论中简单得多的 Dirac 可观测量相匹配。反过来，在适配的叶状分层中，存在对完整 Dirac 可观测量的系统反牛顿展开（按约化 Newton 常数的逆幂），其领头项正是 Carroll 项。特别地，这给出了 Asymptotic Velocity Domination 性质的离壳推广。
classification.one_liner: 为 Gowdy 宇宙学构造在大爆炸处正则的离壳 Dirac 可观测量，并给出与 Carroll 型引力及渐近速度支配的联系。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究真空 Einstein 方程的 Gowdy 宇宙学及其大爆炸奇点处的 Dirac 可观测量，直接对应“经典引力/广义相对论”重点支线；不涉及 AdS/CFT 等全息对偶。

papers.title: Detection of Gravitational Anomaly at Low Acceleration from a Highest-quality Sample of 36 Wide Binaries with Accurate 3D Velocities
papers.abstract: We set out to accurately measure gravity in the low-acceleration range $(10^{-11},10^{-9})\,{\rm m}\,{\rm s}^{-2}$ from 3D motions of isolated wide binary stars. Gaia DR3 provides precise measurements of the four sky-plane components of the 3D relative displacement and velocity ($\mathbf{r}, \mathbf{v}$) for a wide binary, but not comparably precise line-of-sight (radial) separation and relative velocity $v_{r}$. Based on our new observations and the public databases/publications, we assemble a sample of 36 nearby (distance $<150$pc) wide binaries in the low-acceleration regime with accurate values of $v_{r}$ (measurement uncertainty $< 100$ m\,s$^{-1}$). Kinematic contaminants such as undetected stellar companions are well under control using various observational diagnostics such as Gaia's {\tt ruwe} parameter, the color-magnitude diagram, multi-epoch observations of radial velocities, Speckle interferometric follow-up observations, and requiring Hipparcos-Gaia proper motion consistency. For the parameter $\Gamma \equiv \log_{10}\sqrt{\gamma}$ with $\gamma \equiv G/G_{\rm N}$ (where $G$ is a parameter generalizing Newton's constant $G_{\rm N}$ in elliptical orbits), we find $\Gamma=0.102_{-0.021}^{+0.028}$ for $<10^{-9.1}\,{\rm m}\,{\rm s}^{-2}$ ($0.132_{-0.027}^{+0.035}$ for $<10^{-9.5}\,{\rm m}\,{\rm s}^{-2}$) giving a gravity boost factor of $\gamma=1.60_{-0.14}^{+0.24}$, which rules out Newton and is higher than relevant MOND predictions. This strong anomaly is dominated by two systems (the pairs of HD 189739, HD 189760, and TYC 259-236-1, TYC 259-906-1) that have 3D relative velocities exceeding their estimated Newtonian escape velocities but are unlikely to be chance associations or contaminated systems. (abridged)

classification.title_zh: 从36个具有精确三维速度的最高质量宽双星样本中探测低加速度下的引力异常
classification.abstract_zh: 我们旨在通过孤立宽双星的三维运动，精确测量低加速度范围 (10^-11,10^-9) m s^-2 内的引力。Gaia DR3 对宽双星三维相对位移和速度的四个天空平面分量给出了精确测量，但视线方向（径向）分离和相对速度 v_r 的精度并不相当。基于新观测及公共数据库/出版物，我们组装了36个邻近（距离<150 pc）宽双星样本，这些系统处于低加速度区域且具有准确 v_r 值（测量不确定度<100 m/s）。通过多种观测诊断，如 Gaia 的 ruwe 参数、颜色-星等图、多历元径向速度、散斑干涉后续观测以及要求 Hipparcos-Gaia 自行一致，运动学污染得到了良好控制。对于参数 Γ = log10 √γ，其中 γ = G/G_N（G 为椭圆轨道中推广牛顿常数 G_N 的参数），在 <10^-9.1 m s^-2 下得到 Γ=0.102_{-0.021}^{+0.028}（<10^-9.5 m s^-2 下为 0.132_{-0.027}^{+0.035}），给出引力增强因子 γ=1.60_{-0.14}^{+0.24}，排除了牛顿引力，且高于相关 MOND 预言。这一强烈异常主要由两个系统主导（HD 189739、HD 189760 对，以及 TYC 259-236-1、TYC 259-906-1 对），它们的三维相对速度超过估计的牛顿逃逸速度，但不太可能是偶然关联或受污染系统。（有删节）
classification.one_liner: 利用36个宽双星三维速度样本，在低加速度区间测得引力增强因子约1.60，排除牛顿引力并高于相关MOND预言。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文对宽双星低加速度运动进行引力检验，属于经典引力/修正引力观测研究，命中用户重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”，但与全息对偶、量子引力及其他全息支线无直接关联。

papers.title: Bounds on the minimum orbital period of four-dimensional black holes: From singular to non-singular spacetimes
papers.abstract: It was conjectured that the lower bound $T_{\min}\geq 4\pi M $ may be a universal property of four-dimensional black holes, where $M$ is the black hole mass and $T_{\min}$ is the minimum orbital period around black holes. Recently, we established an upper bound $T_{\min}\le 6\sqrt{3}\pi M$ for Schwarzschild, Reissner--Nordstr\"om and Kerr--Newman black holes [23]. In this work we incorporate that analysis, which is not intended for separate publication, into a unified treatment and extend it to the non-singular Hayward and Bardeen black holes, demonstrating that the combined bounds $4\pi M\le T_{\min}\le 6\sqrt{3}\pi M$ hold for all five types of four-dimensional black holes investigated here. For all types of studied black holes, the upper bound is saturated by the standard Schwarzschild black hole and the lower bound by the maximally rotating Kerr black hole, suggesting that these bounds $4\pi M \leq T_{\min} \leq 6\sqrt{3}\pi M$ may be a universal property of four-dimensional black holes with horizons.

classification.title_zh: 四维黑洞最小轨道周期的界限：从奇异到非奇异时空
classification.abstract_zh: 有人猜想，下界 T_min ≥ 4πM 可能是四维黑洞的普遍性质，其中 M 是黑洞质量，T_min 是绕黑洞运动的最小轨道周期。最近，我们为 Schwarzschild、Reissner–Nordström 和 Kerr–Newman 黑洞建立了上界 T_min ≤ 6√3πM [23]。在本工作中，我们将该分析（原不打算单独发表）纳入一个统一处理，并将其推广到非奇异的 Hayward 和 Bardeen 黑洞，证明联合界限 4πM ≤ T_min ≤ 6√3πM 对所研究的全部五类四维黑洞均成立。对于所有已研究的黑洞类型，上界由标准 Schwarzschild 黑洞饱和，下界由最大旋转 Kerr 黑洞饱和，这表明这些界限 4πM ≤ T_min ≤ 6√3πM 可能是具有视界的四维黑洞的普遍性质。
classification.one_liner: 证明五类四维黑洞（含 Hayward 和 Bardeen 非奇异黑洞）的最小轨道周期满足 4πM ≤ T_min ≤ 6√3πM。

papers.title: The Fuzzy-Sphere as a Black Hole in the IKKT Matrix Model: An Assessment
papers.abstract: Black-hole thermodynamics has been reproduced with remarkable success from the BFSS matrix model, but the corresponding test in the closely related IKKT matrix model has awaited its recently proposed finite-temperature formulation, within which we investigate this correspondence. Introducing a cubic Myers term, we compute the complete one-loop thermodynamics -- free energy, internal energy, entropy, and heat capacity -- of a fuzzy $S^2$ background, and compare against the D0 and D2 black holes as the closest available reference points, since no gravitational dual is known for this specific background. At fixed Myers coupling, the leading entropy exhibits an $O(N^3)$ scaling rather than the $O(N^2)$ behavior characteristic of conventional black holes. Holding the physical radius fixed instead yields a genuine $O(N^2)$ scaling, showing that the power of $N$ depends on the large-$N$ prescription and is therefore not by itself an unambiguous test of a black-hole interpretation. We further find no intrinsic Hawking temperature -- only a characteristic scale -- and a heat capacity that is negative at low temperature but positive at high temperature. The absence of an intrinsic Hawking temperature, tied to the missing gravitational dual rather than to the choice of large-$N$ prescription, persists in either scaling limit. Rather than establishing a black-hole interpretation of the finite-temperature IKKT matrix model, these results provide a quantitative benchmark against which future analytical, numerical, and holographic investigations can be tested.

classification.title_zh: 模糊球作为 IKKT 矩阵模型中的黑洞：一项评估
classification.abstract_zh: 黑洞热力学已从 BFSS 矩阵模型中以显著成功被重现，但在密切相关的 IKKT 矩阵模型中相应检验一直等待其最近提出的有限温度表述；我们在该表述下研究这一对应。引入立方 Myers 项后，我们计算了模糊 S^2 背景的完整单圈热力学——自由能、内能、熵和热容——并与作为最接近可用参照点的 D0 和 D2 黑洞比较，因为该特定背景没有已知的引力对偶。固定 Myers 耦合时，领头熵呈现 O(N^3) 标度，而非传统黑洞特征的 O(N^2) 行为。改为固定物理半径，则得到真正的 O(N^2) 标度，表明 N 的幂依赖于大 N 方案，因此本身不是黑洞解释的无歧义检验。我们进一步发现没有内禀霍金温度——只有一个特征标度——以及低温为负、高温为正的热容。缺乏内禀霍金温度与缺失引力对偶有关，而不是与大 N 方案选择有关，并且在任一标度极限下都持续存在。这些结果并未确立有限温度 IKKT 矩阵模型的黑洞解释，而是提供了一个定量基准，以供未来解析、数值和全息研究检验。
classification.one_liner: 在有限温度 IKKT 矩阵模型中，模糊 S^2 的单圈热力学未显示无歧义黑洞特征：熵标度依赖大 N 方案，且无内禀霍金温度。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 IKKT 矩阵模型与模糊球的黑洞热力学，不涉及用户列出的全息超导、p波、畴壁/孤子、multi-trace、气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7/D5探针膜或经典引力等具体支线；仅与矩阵模型/黑洞量子引力广义相关。

papers.title: Boundary-Value Problem in Type IIB Supergravity and Holography
papers.abstract: In precision holography, the Euclidean on-shell action of type IIB supergravity often fails to reproduce the leading large-$N$ free energy of the dual field theory: the type IIB pseudo action, for instance, vanishes identically on the $\mathrm{EAdS}_5\times S^5$ background. We address this issue by revisiting the boundary-value problem of the Euclidean type IIB pseudo action from first principles. Classifying the admissible boundary conditions through the variational principle, we construct a generalized pseudo action whose boundary terms implement the choice of ensemble --- fixed potentials versus fixed quantized Page charges --- in which the holographic comparison is performed. For the fixed five-form-charge ensemble, the resulting boundary term reproduces the recently proposed topological correction to the Pasti--Sorokin--Tonin formulation of type IIB supergravity for holographic backgrounds of interest. We then test the generalized pseudo action on two complementary backgrounds: the $\mathrm{EAdS}_3\times S^3\times M_4$ near-horizon geometry of the D1-D5 system and the warped $\mathrm{EAdS}_6\times S^2\times\Sigma$ solutions dual to five-dimensional SCFTs. In both cases the ten-dimensional on-shell action agrees exactly with that of the corresponding lower-dimensional supergravity, and thereby with the leading large-$N$ free energy of the dual SCFT. Our results establish the choice of boundary conditions --- and hence of ensemble --- as an essential ingredient of precision holography directly in type IIB supergravity, extending recent analyses in eleven-dimensional supergravity.

classification.title_zh: IIB 型超引力中的边值问题与全息
classification.abstract_zh: 在精密全息中，IIB 型超引力的欧几里得在壳作用量常常无法重现对偶场论的大 N 领头自由能：例如，IIB 型赝作用量在 EAdS5×S5 背景上恒为零。我们从第一性原理重新审视欧几里得 IIB 型赝作用量的边值问题。通过变分原理对可容许边界条件进行分类，我们构造了一个广义赝作用量，其边界项实现了进行全息比较时所选系综的选择——固定势 versus 固定量子化 Page 荷。对于固定五形式荷系综，所得边界项重现了最近为相关全息背景提出的 IIB 型超引力 Pasti--Sorokin--Tonin 表述的拓扑修正。随后我们在两个互补背景上检验该广义赝作用量：D1-D5 系统的 EAdS3×S3×M4 近视界几何，以及对偶于五维 SCFT 的翘曲 EAdS6×S2×Σ 解。在这两种情形中，十维在壳作用量都与相应低维超引力的结果精确一致，从而与对偶 SCFT 的大 N 领头自由能一致。我们的结果确立了边界条件的选择——亦即系综的选择——是直接在 IIB 型超引力中进行精密全息的一个基本要素，并推广了最近在十一维超引力中的分析。
classification.one_liner: 通过构造广义赝作用量并选择系综边界条件，IIB 型超引力的十维在壳作用量可精确重现对偶 SCFT 的大 N 领头自由能。

papers.title: Perturbative Double-Scalar Hair on Planar Black Holes in AdS$_{4}$-Einstein-Scalar Gravity
papers.abstract: We construct a two-scalar hairy planar black hole in four-dimensional Einstein gravity coupled to two scalars whose potential descends from the ABJM consistent truncation of eleven-dimensional supergravity. Starting from the known single-scalar hairy black brane, we switch on the second scalar $\phim$ perturbatively in its amplitude $\eps$ and solve the coupled Einstein-scalar system to order $\eps^{2}$. The linearized $\phim$ profile is an exact hypergeometric function, independent of the $\pp$ hair, whose horizon-regular branch always carries a source, so there is no spontaneous $\phim$ hair. Because the dual operator $\mathcal{O}_{-}$ is irrelevant ($\Delta=4$), the second-order response develops a logarithmically running condensate with a closed-form, scheme-independent slope $\tfrac{\sqrt{21}}{70}C_{s}^{2}$. The renormalized free energy is scheme dependent, but the geometric temperature shift $\delta T/T_{0}\approx-0.345\,\eps^{2}$ at fixed entropy is not. The full metric and $\pp$ back-reaction is obtained in closed form, diagonalizing into two P\"oschl-Teller problems with $\delta\pp=\tfrac{6}{\sqrt7}\,\delta H$. Three transport coefficients of the dual fluid remain exactly conformal to this order, while the sound speed, like the free energy, is scheme dependent.

classification.title_zh: AdS4-Einstein-标量引力中平面黑洞的微扰双标量毛
classification.abstract_zh: 我们构造了四维 Einstein 引力耦合两个标量的双标量毛状平面黑洞，其标量势来自十一维超引力的 ABJM 一致截断。我们从已知的单标量毛状黑膜出发，以振幅 eps 微扰地开启第二个标量 phim，并求解耦合 Einstein-标量系统至 eps^2 阶。线性化的 phim 剖面是精确超几何函数，独立于 pp 毛，其视界正则分支总是携带源，因此不存在自发的 phim 毛。由于对偶算符 O_- 是无关的（Δ=4），二阶响应产生对数跑动的凝聚，其斜率具有闭式且与方案无关：sqrt(21)/70 C_s^2。重整化自由能与方案有关，但在固定熵下几何温度移动 δT/T0≈-0.345 eps^2 与方案无关。完整的度规和 pp 反向反应以闭式得到，并对角化为两个 Pöschl-Teller 问题，δpp=6/sqrt(7) δH。对偶流体的三个输运系数到该阶保持精确共形，而声速像自由能一样与方案有关。
classification.one_liner: 在 AdS4-Einstein-双标量引力中微扰构造平面黑洞的双标量毛，发现第二标量不能自发毛化，但产生对数跑动凝聚和与方案无关的温度移动，并给出闭式反向反应与流体输运结果。

papers.title: Quantum Horizon Tadpole and Emergence of a de Sitter Interior
papers.abstract: In a recent paper \cite{Chu:2026dhx}, the quantum stability of the fuzzy sphere was established at large but finite $N$, where a tadpole was also identified for the scaling fluctuation mode of the matrix geometry. Here we show that this tadpole generates a positive area-conjugate microscopic response, which in isolation energetically favors contraction of the fuzzy sphere. However, when the horizon is coupled to gravity, the tadpole requires the bulk geometry to adjust according to the junction condition of general relativity. Taking the exterior geometry to be Schwarzschild, we show that the junction condition requires a positive interior cosmological constant. Imposing a static, spherically symmetric, regular vacuum interior then selects pure de Sitter space. The matching further determines a soldering relation between the interior de Sitter time and the exterior Schwarzschild time, with a relative lapse growing as $C = O(N)$. We also propose a matrix realization of the de Sitter interior in which fuzzy-sphere representation sizes determine the angular geometry while condensates of off-diagonal link fields determine the emergent radial metric. This provides a concrete consistency test for spacetime emergence from the matrix degrees of freedom. Potential cosmological implications are discussed.

classification.title_zh: 量子视界蝌蚪与 de Sitter 内部的涌现
classification.abstract_zh: 在最近的一篇论文中，模糊球的量子稳定性在大但有限的 N 下被建立，其中还识别出矩阵几何的标度涨落模式的一个蝌蚪。这里我们展示这个蝌蚪产生一个正的面积共轭微观响应，单独看它在能量上倾向于模糊球的收缩。然而，当视界与引力耦合时，蝌蚪要求体几何根据广义相对论的连接条件调整。取外部几何为 Schwarzschild，我们展示连接条件要求一个正的内秉宇宙学常数。施加静态、球对称、正则真空内部，则选择纯 de Sitter 空间。匹配进一步确定内部 de Sitter 时间和外部 Schwarzschild 时间之间的焊接关系，相对时移增长为 C = O(N)。我们还提出 de Sitter 内部的一种矩阵实现，其中模糊球表示尺寸决定角几何，而非对角链接场的凝聚决定涌现的径向度规。这为从矩阵自由度涌现时空提供了具体的自洽性检验。讨论了潜在的宇宙学意义。
classification.one_liner: 量子视界蝌蚪通过广义相对论连接条件要求正宇宙学常数，导致纯 de Sitter 内部从矩阵几何中涌现。

papers.title: Perturbative Hairy Black Branes in the $G_{2}$-Invariant Sector of Dyonic ISO(7) Gauged Supergravity
papers.abstract:
We construct perturbative black-brane solutions carrying neutral scalar hair in the $G_{2}$-invariant truncation of four-dimensional dyonic $\mathcal{N}=8$ ISO(7) gauged supergravity, an exact consistent truncation of massive type~IIA supergravity on $S^{6}$. Expanding around the $G_{2}$-symmetric AdS$_{4}$-Schwarzschild black brane in powers of a dimensionless scalar-charge parameter $\eps$, we show that the perturbation hierarchy reduces, order by order, to a nested sequence of inhomogeneous Legendre equations (demonstrated through second order). The first-order scalar satisfies a P"{o}schl--Teller equation with exact parameter $
u(
u+1)=2/3$, giving $
u=- rac{1}{2}+ rac{\sqrt{33}}{6}$, and the first-order metric is fixed algebraically by the same function, $A^{(1)}=-	frac{\sqrt{7}}{2}\phi^{(1)}$, so the entire $\mathcal{O}(\eps)$ sector is one Legendre function. An identity $
u+1=\Delta_{+}/3$, with $\Delta_{+}=(3+\sqrt{33})/2\approx 4.372$ the conformal dimension of the dual scalar operator, relates the P"{o}schl-Teller parameter to the AdS/CFT dictionary via the nonlinear Fefferman-Graham map $z \propto z_{\mathrm{FG}}^{3}$. The $\mathcal{O}(\eps^{2})$ back-reaction yields explicit corrections to the renormalized free energy and Bekenstein-Hawking entropy density at fixed temperature, consistent with the first law; equivalently, at fixed entropy or energy density it \emph{lowers} the Hawking temperature by $\delta T/T=\mathcal{O}(\eps^{2})$. For the leading transport coefficients the shear viscosity saturates $\eta/s=1/(4\pi)$, while the Eling-Oz horizon formula gives a nonzero bulk viscosity $\zeta/\eta= igl(	frac{\Delta_{+}-3}{2} igr)^{2}\eps^{2}=	frac{3(7-\sqrt{33})}{8}\eps^{2}\approx0.471\,\eps^{2}$. With $c_{s}^{2}=	frac12-\mathcal O(\eps^{2})<	frac12$, this indicates a softening of the equation of state.

classification.title_zh: Dyonic ISO(7) 规范超引力 G2 不变扇区中的微扰毛状黑膜
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在四维 dyonic N=8 ISO(7) 规范超引力的 G2 不变截断中构造携带中性标量毛的微扰黑膜解；该截断是 S^6 上 massive type IIA 超引力的精确一致截断。围绕 G2 对称的 AdS4-Schwarzschild 黑膜，以无量纲标量荷参数 ε 作幂展开，我们证明扰动层级逐阶约化为嵌套的非齐次 Legendre 方程序列（展示到二阶）。一阶标量满足 Pöschl-Teller 方程，其精确参数为 ν(ν+1)=2/3，给出 ν=-1/2+√33/6；一阶度规由同一函数代数地固定，A(1)=-√7/2 φ(1)，因此整个 O(ε) 扇区就是一个 Legendre 函数。一个恒等式 ν+1=Δ+/3，其中 Δ+=(3+√33)/2≈4.372 是对偶标量算符的共形维数，通过非线性 Fefferman-Graham 映射 z ∝ z_FG^3 将 Pöschl-Teller 参数与 AdS/CFT 字典联系起来。O(ε^2) 反作用给出固定温度下重整化自由能和 Bekenstein-Hawking 熵密度的显式修正，并与第一定律一致；等价地，在固定熵或能量密度时，它将 Hawking 温度降低 δT/T=O(ε^2)。对于领头输运系数，剪切黏度饱和为 η/s=1/(4π)，而 Eling-Oz 视界公式给出非零体黏度 ζ/η=((Δ+ - 3)/2)^2 ε^2 = 3(7-√33)/8 ε^2 ≈ 0.471 ε^2。由于 c_s^2=1/2 - O(ε^2)<1/2，这表明物态方程软化。

papers.title: Probe Dependence of the Imaginary Part of HTEE
papers.abstract: We investigate the holographic timelike entanglement entropy (HTEE) in a five-dimensional anisotropic background, dual to a strongly coupled anisotropic plasma. Using the complex extremal surface method, we compute the HTEE analytically in the high-temperature, small-anisotropy limit $aT \ll 1$. We consider two different orientations of the boundary timelike interval: one perpendicular to the anisotropy direction and one parallel to it. We find that the imaginary part of the HTEE is not a universal property of the geometry but depends sensitively on the orientation of the extremal surface relative to the anisotropy. This demonstrates that the imaginary part arising from the UV logarithmic divergence is a probe-dependent quantity. Our results suggest that the imaginary part of HTEE can serve as a diagnostic of the coupling between the extremal surface and the anisotropic degrees of freedom of the dual field theory.

classification.title_zh: 全息类时纠缠熵（HTEE）虚部的探针依赖性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了五维各向异性背景中的全息类时纠缠熵（HTEE），该背景对偶于强耦合各向异性等离子体。利用复极值曲面方法，我们在高温、小各向异性极限 $aT \ll 1$ 下解析计算了 HTEE。我们考虑了边界类时间隔的两种不同取向：一种垂直于各向异性方向，一种平行于它。我们发现 HTEE 的虚部并非几何的普适性质，而是敏感依赖于极值曲面相对于各向异性的取向。这表明由紫外对数发散产生的虚部是一个探针依赖的量。我们的结果暗示 HTEE 的虚部可以作为极值曲面与对偶场论各向异性自由度之间耦合的诊断量。
classification.one_liner: 在五维各向异性等离子体对偶背景中，HTEE 的虚部取决于极值曲面取向，因而并非几何普适量。

papers.title: Complexified Virasoro Zero-Mode Flow and the Logarithmic Graviton at the Chiral Point
papers.abstract: We investigate the relation between Virasoro zero-mode evolution and the bulk logarithmic graviton in topologically massive gravity at the chiral point. By introducing additive coordinates adapted to the global time and radial dependence of the logarithmic mode, we obtain the expression \begin{equation} y(s,\bar s) = -s+\ln2 -\ln\!\left(1+e^{-(s+\bar s)}\right), \qquad s=\rho+i\tau, \quad \bar s=\rho-i\tau . \end{equation} This relation provides a direct bulk realization of the additive coordinates previously associated with the joint Virasoro zero-mode evolution. Near the AdS$_3$ boundary, the logarithmic coefficient becomes linear in $s$ up to an additive constant and exponentially suppressed corrections, while its exact finite-radius dependence is governed by the diagonal combination $s+\bar s=2\rho$. Upon complexification of the radial coordinate, this combination also organizes the periodic branch structure underlying the previously established bulk monodromy of the logarithmic graviton. The same diagonal coordinate controls the nilpotent part of the Virasoro zero-mode representation, providing a common additive-coordinate description of the representation-theoretic Jordan structure and the radial analytic structure of the bulk solution. The corresponding operations remain distinct: finite zero-mode evolution is algebraic, whereas bulk monodromy arises from analytic continuation and winding of the multivalued gravitational solution.

classification.title_zh: 手征点处复化 Virasoro 零模流与对数引力子
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究手征点处拓扑大质量引力中 Virasoro 零模演化与体时空对数引力子之间的关系。通过引入适应对数模式的整体时间与径向依赖的加性坐标，我们得到关系 y(s,s̄)=−s+ln2−ln(1+e^{−(s+s̄)})，其中 s=ρ+iτ, s̄=ρ−iτ。该关系为此前与联合 Virasoro 零模演化相联系的加性坐标提供了直接的体时空实现。在 AdS3 边界附近，对数系数直至一个加性常数和指数压低的修正外线性依赖于 s，而其精确的有限半径依赖由对角组合 s+s̄=2ρ 控制。将径向坐标复化后，该组合也组织了此前已建立的对数引力子体单值性所依据的周期分支结构。同一对角坐标控制 Virasoro 零模表示的幂零部分，从而为表示论 Jordan 结构和体解的径向解析结构提供共同的加性坐标描述。相应的操作仍不相同：有限零模演化是代数的，而体单值性来自多值引力解的解析延拓与绕数。
classification.one_liner: 该文用复化 Virasoro 零模的加性坐标，在 AdS3/CFT2 框架下统一描述手征点对数引力子的体单值性与表示论 Jordan 结构。

papers.title: The Smarr Formula is Gauss's Law: A Kerr-Schild Single-Copy Perspective
papers.abstract: In the Kerr-Schild double copy, static and spherically symmetric black hole solutions of general relativity are mapped to purely electric solutions of Maxwell's theory in flat spacetime. We demonstrate that, for these configurations, the thermodynamic Smarr formula is structurally identical to the single-copy Gauss's law. Extending this to asymptotically anti-de Sitter spacetimes, we prove that the thermodynamic pressure-volume term naturally emerges from a gauge-theoretic background subtraction. This relationship establishes a novel connection between the classical double copy and black hole thermodynamics.

classification.title_zh: Smarr 公式即高斯定律：Kerr-Schild 单拷贝视角
classification.abstract_zh: 在 Kerr-Schild 双拷贝中，广义相对论里静态球对称黑洞解被映射为平直时空中麦克斯韦理论的纯电解。我们证明，对于这些构型，热力学 Smarr 公式与单拷贝高斯定律在结构上完全相同。将该结果推广到渐近反德西特时空后，我们证明热力学压强-体积项自然地从规范论背景减除中出现。这一关系在经典双拷贝与黑洞热力学之间建立了一种新联系。
classification.one_liner: 用 Kerr-Schild 双拷贝表明 Smarr 公式等价于单拷贝高斯定律，并把 AdS 黑洞热力学压强-体积项解释为规范论背景减除。

papers.title: Spindle solutions with hyperscalars in $D=4$ gauged supergravity
papers.abstract: We construct new classes of supersymmetric $AdS_2\times \Sigma$ solutions, where $\Sigma=\Sigma(n_N,n_S)$ is a spindle. Such solutions can arise as the near horizon limit of supersymmetric, accelerating black holes. The solutions are constructed using $D=4$ STU $U(1)^4$ gauged supergravity theory coupled to a charged hyperscalar, and can be uplifted to obtain smooth, supersymmetric $AdS_2\times Y_9$ solutions of $D=11$ supergravity. We allow $(n_N,n_S)$ to be non-coprime integers, including orbifolds of the round $S^2$. We also allow the hyperscalar to vanish at the poles. The $AdS_2$ solutions with non-vanishing hyperscalar can naturally arise as the endpoint of holographic RG flows, triggered by relevant hyperscalar deformations of the $AdS_2$ solutions of the STU model.

classification.title_zh: D=4 规范超引力中含超标量的纺锤体解
classification.abstract_zh: 我们构造了新的超对称 AdS_2×Σ 解类，其中 Σ=Σ(n_N,n_S) 是一个纺锤体（spindle）。此类解可以作为超对称加速黑洞的近地平线极限出现。这些解是在 D=4 STU U(1)^4 规范超引力理论中耦合一个带电超标量（hyperscalar）构造的，并可提升为 D=11 超引力中光滑、超对称的 AdS_2×Y_9 解。我们允许 (n_N,n_S) 为非互素整数，包括圆 S^2 的轨道折叠。我们还允许超标量在极点处消失。具有非零超标量的 AdS_2 解可以自然地作为全息 RG 流的端点出现，这些流由 STU 模型 AdS_2 解的相关超标量形变触发。
classification.one_liner: 在 D=4 STU 规范超引力中构造带带电超标量的超对称 AdS2×spindle 解，并给出 D=11 提升和全息 RG 流解释。

papers.title: Merons beyond Yang-Mills theory
papers.abstract: Within the wide variety of topological solitons supported by Yang--Mills theory, merons occupy a particularly distinguished role. Despite their simplicity, they represent genuinely non-Abelian configurations that can be regarded as the fundamental building blocks of instantons, and they provide a qualitatively accurate picture of confinement. In this work, we show that such configurations are, in fact, supported by a broad class of non-Abelian gauge theories beyond Yang--Mills, provided that suitable physical conditions are satisfied. Taking into account their gravitational backreaction, we further demonstrate that both black holes and Euclidean wormholes sourced by merons admit natural extensions within this generalized framework, which regularizes the singular behavior they exhibit in constant--curvature backgrounds. As a byproduct, we construct a regular black hole solution supported by genuinely non-Abelian gauge fields, based on a non-Abelian generalization of the Ay\'on--Beato--Garc\'ia nonlinear electrodynamics. As a consequence, physical effects intrinsic to merons are likewise expected to be inherited by these classes of theories beyond the Yang-Mills framework. A notable example is the spin from isospin effect, whereby bosonic excitations charged under the gauge group can effectively behave as fermionic degrees of freedom.

classification.primary_topic: 非均匀态/孤子/涡旋/畴壁
classification.title_zh: 超越杨-米尔斯理论的 Merons
classification.abstract_zh: 在杨-米尔斯理论所支持的各种拓扑孤子中，merons 扮演着特别独特的角色。尽管它们看似简单，却代表真正的非阿贝尔组态，可被视为瞬子的基本构件，并给出对禁闭的定性准确图像。在本工作中，我们表明，只要满足合适的物理条件，此类组态实际上被一大类超越杨-米尔斯理论的非阿贝尔规范理论所支持。考虑它们的引力反作用，我们进一步证明，由 merons 作为源的黑洞与欧几里得虫洞在这一广义框架内都有自然扩展，从而正则化了它们在常曲率背景中所表现出的奇异行为。作为附带产物，我们基于 Ayón-Beato–García 非线性电动力学的非阿贝尔推广，构造了一个由真正非阿贝尔规范场支持的规则黑洞解。因此，merons 内禀的物理效应预计也会被这些超越杨-米尔斯框架的理论类别所继承。一个显著例子是自同位旋产生自旋（spin from isospin）效应，即规范群下带电的玻色激发可以有效地表现为费米自由度。
classification.one_liner: 表明 merons 可存在于更广泛的非阿贝尔规范理论中，并在考虑引力反作用后给出规则黑洞/虫洞解，且继承自同位旋产生自旋等效应。

papers.title: Probing fuzzballs and beyond: Model-independent tests of Kerr symmetry breaking with LISA
papers.abstract: Gravitational waves provide a unique probe of the strong-field regime of gravity, offering access to physics beyond the classical black hole paradigm. We explore how space-based observations of extreme-mass-ratio inspirals (EMRIs) by the Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA) can be used to test for departures from the Kerr geometry, and in particular for the breaking of its axial and equatorial symmetries, as expected in quantum-gravity-inspired alternatives to Kerr black holes such as the fuzzball proposal. By introducing generic multipolar deformations encoding potential symmetry breakings and performing a systematic parameter estimation analysis, we forecast LISA's ability to constrain such departures from the Kerr geometry in the strong-field regime. We show that EMRI signals with realistic signal-to-noise ratios can constrain several higher-order multipoles of the primary, opening a new observational window onto strong-field deviations from the Kerr geometry. In particular, we find that LISA can constrain generic nonaxisymmetric mass quadrupole deformations at the $10^{-4}-10^{-2}$ level and axisymmetric mass octupole deformations at the $10^{-1}$-$10^{0}$ level, providing concrete observational targets for strong-field deviations from the Kerr geometry, such as those that may arise in fuzzball and other exotic-compact-object scenarios. Our results demonstrate that precision measurements of EMRI waveforms will transform LISA into a powerful laboratory for fundamental physics and offer precise constraints on quantum-gravity-motivated models of compact objects.
authors: Pablo F. Muguruza (Institute of Space Sciences
Institute of Space Studies of Catalonia
Carlos F. Sopuerta (Institute of Space Sciences
Institute of Space Studies of Catalonia)

classification.title_zh: 探测 Fuzzball 及其超越：用 LISA 对 Kerr 对称性破缺进行模型无关检验
classification.abstract_zh: 引力波为强场引力提供了独特探针，使我们能够触及经典黑洞范式之外的物理。我们探讨 LISA 对极端质量比旋近（EMRI）的太空观测如何用于检验对 Kerr 几何的偏离，尤其是其轴对称与赤道对称性的破缺——这正是 fuzzball 提案等量子引力启发下 Kerr 黑洞替代方案所预期的。通过引入编码潜在对称性破缺的一般多极形变，并进行系统的参数估计分析，我们预测 LISA 在强场区域约束此类偏离 Kerr 几何的能力。我们表明，具有现实信噪比的 EMRI 信号可以约束主天体的若干高阶多极，从而为强场下偏离 Kerr 几何打开新的观测窗口。特别地，我们发现 LISA 能够将一般非轴对称质量四极形变约束到 10^-4—10^-2 水平，并将轴对称质量八极形变约束到 10^-1—10^0 水平，为 Kerr 几何的强场偏离（例如可能出现在 fuzzball 及其他奇异致密天体场景中的偏离）提供具体的观测目标。我们的结果表明，EMRI 波形的精密测量将把 LISA 变成基础物理的强大实验室，并对量子引力启发的致密天体模型给出精确限制。
classification.one_liner: 利用 LISA 对 EMRI 波形的参数估计，模型无关地限制 Kerr 几何的轴对称与赤道对称破缺，为 fuzzball 等量子引力启发致密天体方案提供观测目标。

papers.title: Residual Symmetries and Their Algebras in the Kerr-Schild Double Copy
papers.abstract: The Kerr-Schild double copy (KSDC) is well-known for relating exact classical solutions between Yang-Mills theory and theories of gravity. However, whether this correspondence provides a more fundamental mapping between the underlying symmetries of gauge theory and gravity remains an underdeveloped area of research in the contemporary double copy program. In this paper, we demonstrate that the KSDC correspondence does not provide a mapping between the residual symmetry structures of the Kerr-Schild ansatz in Yang-Mills theory and gravity. On the gauge theory side, residual symmetries form an infinite-dimensional algebra of functions along null directions. On the gravitational side, residual diffeomorphisms preserving the Kerr-Schild form of the Schwarzschild metric generate a conformal algebra on $S^2$, which decomposes into Killing vectors and proper conformal Killing vectors (CKVs). While the Killing sector reproduces the expected global isometries, the CKV sector yields an infinite-dimensional algebra after imposing asymptotic flatness and horizon regularity. This appears to contradict the fact that the Schwarzschild solution admits no proper conformal symmetries. We resolve this apparent contradiction by constructing a Weyl-compensated BRST complex, showing that the CKV sector is BRST-exact and therefore trivial in cohomology, so that the physical symmetry algebra reduces to the global isometries of Schwarzschild. This demonstrates that the KSDC introduces an enlarged symmetry structure at the level of the ansatz, but preserves physical symmetries after a cohomological reduction, revealing a fundamental mismatch between Yang-Mills and gravity at the level of residual symmetries.

classification.title_zh: Kerr-Schild 双拷贝中的残余对称性及其代数
classification.abstract_zh: Kerr-Schild 双拷贝（KSDC）以联系 Yang-Mills 理论与引力理论之间的精确经典解而闻名。然而，这一对应是否能在规范理论与引力的底层对称性之间给出更基本的映射，仍是当代双拷贝纲领中一个发展不足的领域。本文表明，KSDC 对应并不在 Yang-Mills 理论与引力的 Kerr-Schild 拟设的残余对称结构之间建立映射。在规范理论侧，残余对称性构成沿零方向的无穷维函数代数。在引力侧，保持 Schwarzschild 度规 Kerr-Schild 形式的残余微分同胚生成 S^2 上的共形代数，并分解为 Killing 矢量与真正的共形 Killing 矢量（CKV）。Killing 部分重现预期的整体等距，而 CKV 部分在施加渐近平坦性与视界正则性后给出无穷维代数。这似乎与 Schwarzschild 解不允许真正共形对称性相矛盾。我们通过构造一个 Weyl 补偿的 BRST 复形解决了这一表观矛盾，证明 CKV 部分是 BRST 恰当的，因此在上同调中平凡，于是物理对称性代数约化为 Schwarzschild 的整体等距。这表明 KSDC 在拟设层面引入了扩大的对称结构，但在上同调约化后保持物理对称性，从而揭示了 Yang-Mills 与引力在残余对称性层面的根本失配。
classification.one_liner: 论文证明 Kerr-Schild 双拷贝在拟设层面扩大对称性，但经 BRST 上同调约化后，Schwarzschild 物理对称性仍仅为整体等距，显示 Yang-Mills 与引力残余对称结构不匹配。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/广义相对论与双拷贝对称性研究，不涉及 AdS/CFT 全息，但与用户列出的经典引力支线相关。

papers.title: One-point functions in 2D and 4D SUSY Janus
papers.abstract: We calculate one-point functions of the marginal operators dual to the space-varying dilaton in 4D and 2D holographic Janus interfaces, extending the results of \cite{Clark_2005}. We compare the strongly coupled supergravity and weakly coupled CFT limits for $\mathcal{N}=0,1,2,4$ Janus interfaces in 4D $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM and for non-supersymmetric and half-BPS Janus interfaces in the 2D D1--D5 CFT. In 4D, the $\mathcal{N}=0,1$ results agree only to first order in the jump parameter, and the $\mathcal{N}=2,4$ result agrees exactly. In 2D, exact agreement holds for the half-BPS interface, whereas the non-supersymmetric interface agrees only to first order.

classification.title_zh: 2D与4D SUSY Janus中的单点函数
classification.abstract_zh: 我们计算了4D和2D全息Janus界面中，对偶于空间变化伸缩子的边缘算符的单点函数，扩展了\cite{Clark_2005}的结果。我们比较了4D N=4 SYM中N=0,1,2,4 Janus界面的强耦合超引力和弱耦合CFT极限，以及2D D1-D5 CFT中非超对称和半BPS Janus界面。在4D中，N=0,1结果仅在跳跃参数的一阶一致，而N=2,4结果精确一致。在2D中，半BPS界面精确一致，而非超对称界面仅在一阶一致。

papers.title: Non-Lorentzian Supergravity from Matrix Theory
papers.abstract: It was recently shown that the decoupling limits leading to matrix (gauge) theories on D-branes give rise to non-Lorentzian target space geometries. Perturbatively, matrix theory describes a quantum gravity theory whose low-energy supergravity description exhibits non-Lorentzian behavior. Focusing on the D-particle case associated with the Banks-Fischler-Shenker-Susskind matrix theory, and using techniques from ambitwistor string theory, we show evidence that the dynamics of this non-Lorentzian gravity should be related to anomalies in the current algebra of the associated fundamental string worldsheet theory. At large N, the D-particle backreaction deforms the non-Lorentzian supergravity to the Lorentzian IIA theory, providing a holographic description of the BFSS matrix theory. At a moderately large N such that the D-particles decouple at the leading order, this non-Lorentzian supergravity maps holographically to the leading-order contribution of weakly coupled bulk gravity. This approximately non-Lorentzian regime is related to the null reduction of eleven-dimensional supergravity. Within the non-Lorentzian supergravity, non-trivial dynamics arises from the backreaction of extended brane objects that form BPS states with the D-particles. Finally, we generalize these results to other D-brane and string soliton holographic constructions.

classification.title_zh: 来自矩阵理论的非洛伦兹超引力
classification.abstract_zh: 最近表明，导致 D-膜上矩阵（规范）理论的解耦极限会产生非洛伦兹的目标空间几何。在微扰层面，矩阵理论描述一种量子引力理论，其低能超引力描述呈现非洛伦兹行为。我们聚焦与 Banks-Fischler-Shenker-Susskind 矩阵理论相关的 D-粒子情形，并使用 ambitwistor 弦论技术，给出证据表明这种非洛伦兹引力的动力学应与相关基本弦世界面理论的流代数反常有关。在大 N 下，D-粒子反作用将非洛伦兹超引力变形为洛伦兹 IIA 理论，从而为 BFSS 矩阵理论提供全息描述。在中等大的 N 下，使得 D-粒子在领头阶解耦，这种非洛伦兹超引力全息地映射到弱耦合体引力的领头阶贡献。这一近似非洛伦兹区域与十一维超引力的零约化（null reduction）有关。在该非洛伦兹超引力中，非平凡动力学来自与 D-粒子形成 BPS 态的延展膜物体的反作用。最后，我们将这些结果推广到其他 D-膜和弦孤子全息构造。
classification.one_liner: 论文论证矩阵理论解耦极限给出的非洛伦兹超引力可通过 D-粒子反作用全息联系到 BFSS 矩阵理论与 IIA/十一维超引力，并推广到其他 D-膜/弦孤子构造。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于矩阵理论与非洛伦兹超引力全息，未直接涉及所列重点标签（如全息超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子/双组分BEC、D3-D7/D3-D5与Floquet驱动等），仅与理论全息和 D-膜有一般关联。

papers.title: Fortuitous Chaos, BPS Black Holes, and Random Matrices
papers.abstract: The ``fortuitous'' Bogomol'nyi-Prasad-Sommerfield (BPS) sector states in gauge theory have been argued to furnish a description, through holography, of generic BPS black hole microstates. They are expected to be strongly chaotic, a necessary feature to capture the black hole dynamics. This dovetails nicely with the existence of various random matrix models of JT supergravity with extended supersymmetry, within which the BPS chaos must be contained as a subsector. This paper identifies and studies a simple random matrix model that underlies all known random matrix models of JT supergravity. It is argued that it captures many essential universal features of fortuitous BPS chaos. The model is topological, naturally interpolating between the Bessel and Airy models, where the gap energy $E_0$ controls the interpolation, and seems to have a simple intersection theory interpretation.

classification.title_zh: 偶然混沌、BPS 黑洞与随机矩阵
classification.abstract_zh: 规范理论中的“偶然”Bogomol'nyi-Prasad-Sommerfield (BPS) 扇区态被认为通过全息对一般 BPS 黑洞微态给出描述。它们预期是强混沌的，这是捕捉黑洞动力学所必需的特征。这与具有扩展超对称的 JT 超引力的各种随机矩阵模型的存在很好地契合；在其中，BPS 混沌必须作为子扇区被包含。本文识别并研究了一个简单的随机矩阵模型，它构成了所有已知 JT 超引力随机矩阵模型的基础。文章论证，它捕捉了偶然 BPS 混沌的许多基本普适特征。该模型是拓扑的，自然在 Bessel 模型和 Airy 模型之间插值，其中能隙能量 E0 控制插值，并且似乎具有简单的相交理论解释。
classification.one_liner: 本文提出一个统一已知 JT 超引力随机矩阵模型的简单拓扑随机矩阵模型，用于刻画偶然 BPS 混沌及其在全息 BPS 黑洞微态中的角色。

papers.title: Massive gravity applications for $T\overline{T}$ deformations
papers.abstract: We employ the massive gravity approach to stress-tensor deformations in a variety of scenarios, obtaining novel results and establishing new connections. Starting with perturbation theory, we show that the addition of $\text{tr} T+\Lambda_{2}$ to $T\overline{T}$ can be recovered and we construct the deformed action of an interacting non-abelian spin-1 along with spin-1/2 seed model, extending previous findings. As a result, a set of algebraic properties for certain hypergeometric functions is derived, allowing us to initiate the algebraic study of special functions directly via stress-tensor deformations and massive gravity. Moreover, we sharpen the connection between the trace-flow equation and the local renormalization group in any dimension. In $d>2$, the usual initial condition for the coupling leads to a potential known as ghost-free, minimal massive gravity. Upon expansion around the reference background, we retrieve Fierz-Pauli at leading order, matching the random geometry and holographic approaches. At the same time, we demonstrate that a change of coordinates interpretation is possible for the corresponding operator, which we verify with a simple example. Finally, we study the family of $(\text{tr} T)^{n}$ deformations advancing earlier work, and illustrate how the massive gravity description of non-linear electrodynamics can be incorporated in our framework.

classification.title_zh: 大质量引力在 $T\overline{T}$ 形变中的应用
classification.abstract_zh: 我们采用大质量引力方法来处理多种情形下的应力张量形变，获得了新结果并建立了新联系。从微扰论出发，我们表明可以恢复向 $T\overline{T}$ 中添加 $\text{tr} T+\Lambda_2$ 的构造，并且构造了相互作用非阿贝尔自旋-1 以及自旋-1/2 种子模型的形变作用量，扩展了先前的结果。由此推导出某些超几何函数的一组代数性质，使我们能够直接通过应力张量形变和大质量引力来启动特殊函数的代数研究。此外，我们锐化了任意维度中迹流方程与局域重整化群之间的联系。在 $d>2$ 中，通常的耦合初始条件导致一个被称为无鬼、最小大质量引力的势。围绕参考背景展开，我们在领头阶重新得到 Fierz-Pauli，与随机几何及全息方法相符。同时，我们证明相应算符可能存在坐标变换解释，并用一个简单例子加以验证。最后，我们研究 $(\text{tr} T)^n$ 形变族，推进先前工作，并说明非线性电动力学的大质量引力描述如何纳入我们的框架。

classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究 $T\overline{T}$ 与 $(\text{tr} T)^n$ 等多迹应力张量形变，并使用大质量引力、Fierz-Pauli 及无鬼最小大质量引力，与“multi-trace”和“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签高度匹配；摘要还明确联系全息方法。

papers.title: Supersymmetric Holomorphic Masses in AdS/CFT with Flavour
papers.abstract: In type IIB supergravity (SUGRA), in the extremal background of a number N_c of D3-branes we consider a number N_f of probe D7-branes extended along all four D3-brane directions, (x_0,x_1,x_2,x_3). Using (x_2,x_3) to define complex coordinates (z,\bar{z}) and defining the D7-branes' worldvolume scalars as (y,\bar{y}), we prove that any holomorphic function y(z) or antiholomorphic function y(\bar{z}) is a BPS solution of the D7-branes' equations of motion preserving N=(4,0) or (0,4) supersymmetry (SUSY) along (x_0,x_1), respectively. In the near-horizon geometry, five-dimensional Anti-de Sitter (AdS) spacetime times a five-sphere, the AdS/Conformal Field Theory correspondence states that type IIB SUGRA is holographically dual to four-dimensional N=4 supersymmetric SU(N_c) Yang-Mills theory at large N_c and large 't Hooft coupling, and the N_f D7-branes are dual to N_f N=2 hypermultiplets in the fundamental representation, i.e. flavour fields. Our D7-brane solutions are dual to a position-dependent hypermultiplet mass m that is holomorphic, m(z), or antiholomorphic, m(\bar{z}). We provide field theory proofs, valid for any N_c, N_f, and 't Hooft coupling, that such m preserve N=(4,0) or (0,4) SUSY along (x_0,x_1). We also perform holographic calculations with probe D7-branes to show that the theory with such m has zero energy and zero expectation value of the mass operator, and that a zero of m is dual to a superconformal defect described by chiral fermions along (x_0,x_1).

classification.title_zh: AdS/CFT 中带味道的超对称全纯质量
classification.abstract_zh: 在 IIB 型超引力中，我们考虑 N_c 个 D3 膜的极值背景中 N_f 个探针 D7 膜，沿全部四个 D3 膜方向 (x0,x1,x2,x3) 延展。用 (x2,x3) 定义复坐标 (z,\bar{z})，并将 D7 膜世界体标量定义为 (y,\bar{y})，我们证明任意全纯函数 y(z) 或反全纯函数 y(\bar{z}) 都是 D7 膜运动方程的 BPS 解，分别沿 (x0,x1) 保持 N=(4,0) 或 (0,4) 超对称。在近视界几何 AdS_5 × S^5 中，AdS/CFT 对应表明 IIB 型超引力在全息上对偶于大 N_c、大 't Hooft 耦合下的四维 N=4 超对称 SU(N_c) Yang-Mills 理论，而 N_f 个 D7 膜对偶于基本表示中的 N_f 个 N=2 超多重态，即味道场。我们的 D7 膜解对偶于依赖位置的全纯超多重态质量 m(z) 或反全纯 m(\bar{z})。我们给出场论证明（对任意 N_c、N_f 和 't Hooft 耦合成立），说明这样的 m 沿 (x0,x1) 保持 N=(4,0) 或 (0,4) 超对称。我们还用探针 D7 膜进行全息计算，表明具有这种 m 的理论能量为零，质量算符期望值为零，并且 m 的零点对偶于由沿 (x0,x1) 的手征费米子描述的超共形缺陷。
classification.one_liner: 证明带味道 AdS/CFT 中 D7 探针膜的全纯/反全纯标量解对应位置依赖的超对称超多重态质量，并给出零质量算符与超共形缺陷的对偶。

papers.title: Restoring Causality in Higher Curvature Gravity
papers.abstract: Incorporating higher curvature terms into gravity theories modifies the classical field equations, potentially leading to theoretical issues like Shapiro time advancements that violate the Camanho, Edelstein, Maldacena, and Zhiboedov (CEMZ) causality criterion. We explore this criterion within the context of Generalised Quadratic Gravity (GQG), a higher curvature theory with a distinct graviton three-point coupling from General Relativity (GR). By constructing an exact shock wave solution of GQG and calculating the Shapiro time shift for a massless probe graviton, we demonstrate that it can remain strictly positive within a classically allowed parameter space of couplings, ensuring the theory's adherence to the CEMZ criterion, due to the presence of perturbative ghosts. This finding indicates that GQG can offer a causal extension beyond GR, paving the way for further exploration into the consistency of classical higher curvature gravity theories.

classification.title_zh: 在高曲率引力中恢复因果性
classification.abstract_zh: 将高曲率项引入引力理论会修改经典场方程，可能导致诸如Shapiro时间提前等理论问题，从而违反Camanho、Edelstein、Maldacena和Zhiboedov（CEMZ）因果性判据。我们在广义二次引力（GQG）背景下探讨该判据，这是一种高曲率理论，其引力子三点耦合与广义相对论（GR）不同。通过构造GQG的精确冲击波解，并计算无质量探测引力子的Shapiro时间偏移，我们证明在经典允许的耦合参数空间内，该时间偏移可以严格保持为正，从而确保该理论满足CEMZ判据，这是由于微扰鬼场的存在。这一发现表明，GQG可以提供超越GR的因果扩展，为经典高曲率引力理论一致性的进一步探索铺平道路。
classification.one_liner: 构造GQG精确冲击波解并计算引力子Shapiro时间偏移，表明微扰鬼场可使高曲率引力在经典允许耦合下满足CEMZ因果性判据。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，研究高曲率引力经典场方程与因果性，与用户重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”直接匹配；但不涉及全息或其他重点标签。

papers.title: Connections and dynamical trajectories in generalised Newton-Cartan gravity II. An ambient perspective
papers.abstract: Connections compatible with degenerate metric structures are known to possess peculiar features: on the one hand, the compatibility conditions involve restrictions on the torsion; on the other hand, torsionfree compatible connections are not unique, the arbitrariness being encoded in a tensor field whose type depends on the metric structure. Nonrelativistic structures typically fall under this scheme, the paradigmatic example being a contravariant degenerate metric whose kernel is spanned by a one-form. Torsionfree compatible (i.e. Galilean) connections are characterised by the gift of a two-form (the force field). Whenever the two-form is closed, the connection is said Newtonian. Such a nonrelativistic spacetime is known to admit an ambient description as the orbit space of a gravitational wave with parallel rays. The leaves of the null foliation are endowed with a nonrelativistic structure dual to the Newtonian one, dubbed Carrollian spacetime. We propose a generalisation of this unifying framework by introducing a new non-Lorentzian ambient metric structure of which we study the geometry. We characterise the space of (torsional) connections preserving such a metric structure which is shown to project to (resp. embed) the most general class of (torsional) Galilean (resp. Carrollian) connections.

classification.title_zh: 广义牛顿-卡坦引力中的联络与动力学轨迹 II：环境视角
classification.abstract_zh: 与退化度规结构相容的联络已知具有奇特特征：一方面，相容性条件涉及对挠率的限制；另一方面，无挠相容联络并不唯一，其任意性由一类张量场编码，而该张量场的类型取决于度规结构。非相对论结构通常属于这一框架，典型例子是其核由一个一形式张成的逆变退化度规。无挠相容（即伽利略）联络由给定一个二形式（力场）来刻画。当该二形式闭时，该联络称为牛顿联络。这样的非相对论时空已知可作为具有平行光线的引力波的轨道空间，从而获得一种环境描述。零叶状结构的叶带有与牛顿结构对偶的非相对论结构，称为卡罗尔时空。我们通过引入一种新的非洛伦兹环境度规结构并研究其几何，提出该统一框架的推广。我们刻画保持这种度规结构的（有挠）联络空间，并证明它投影到（分别嵌入）最一般的（有挠）伽利略（分别卡罗尔）联络类。
classification.one_liner: 在非洛伦兹环境度规框架下统一刻画伽利略与卡罗尔联络，推广牛顿-卡坦引力几何。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究广义牛顿-卡坦引力中的经典非洛伦兹几何与联络，直接对应“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；与 AdS/CFT 全息无直接关系。

papers.title: Observational Features of Nonsingular Rotating Black Holes in the Dark-Energy Dominated Universe
papers.abstract: Recent DESI baryon acoustic oscillation measurements, combined with cosmic microwave background and type-Ia supernova data, suggest that dark energy may evolve with cosmic time. Along a cosmological background, an evolving dark-energy density can be expressed locally as a function of a monotonic curvature invariant, motivating an effective curvature-dependent cosmological term. Moreover, quantum field theory in curved spacetime and approaches to quantum gravity with running gravitational couplings provide complementary motivations for exploring such a term. Here we study how the phenomenology of nonsingular rotating black holes embedded in a Universe dominated by dark energy can differ substantially from that of the Kerr and Kerr--de Sitter geometries. The problem is directly formulated in phase space using a null geodesic super-Hamiltonian and a Mino-type parameter. The shadows of the black holes are calculated by backward ray tracing from a zero-angular-momentum observer. We define and analyze a comprehensive set of standard shadow observables, characterizing the size, shape, and displacement of the shadow. We show that the area of the shadow and its vertical diameter provide particularly clear signatures of a running cosmological term. In this way, joint analyses of multiple strong-field observables and of several black holes with different masses and spins could provide a realistic route to tightly constraining, or potentially measuring, the effective regularization scale behind the running of the cosmological term and statistically distinguishing the non-singular black hole geometry from Kerr/Kerr-dS solutions.

classification.title_zh: 暗能量主导宇宙中非奇异旋转黑洞的观测特征
classification.abstract_zh: 近期DESI重子声学振荡测量，结合宇宙微波背景和Ia型超新星数据，表明暗能量可能随宇宙时间演化。在宇宙学背景下，演化的暗能量密度可以局部表示为单调曲率不变量的函数，从而引出一种有效的曲率相关宇宙学项。此外，弯曲时空量子场论以及引力耦合跑动的量子引力方法也为探索此类项提供了补充动机。本文研究嵌入暗能量主导宇宙中的非奇异旋转黑洞的现象学如何显著不同于Kerr和Kerr--de Sitter几何。问题直接在以零测地线超哈密顿量和Mino型参数表述的相空间中建立。黑洞阴影通过从零角动量观测者进行反向光线追踪来计算。我们定义并分析了一组全面的标准阴影观测量，表征阴影的大小、形状和位移。我们表明，阴影面积及其垂直直径提供了跑动宇宙学项特别清晰的信号。这样，对多个强场观测量以及多个不同质量和自旋黑洞的联合分析，可能提供一条现实途径，以严格限制或潜在测量宇宙学项跑动背后的有效正则化尺度，并在统计上区分非奇异黑洞几何与Kerr/Kerr-dS解。
classification.one_liner: 研究暗能量主导宇宙中非奇异旋转黑洞的阴影观测量，并指出阴影面积与垂直直径可清晰反映跑动宇宙学项。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，研究旋转黑洞阴影与暗能量宇宙学；不涉及AdS/CFT或全息对偶。

papers.title: How Universal Is the Black Hole Zeroth Law?
papers.abstract: The black hole zeroth law asserts the thermal equilibrium of a stationary Killing horizon, yet its status beyond general relativity remains limited. We demonstrate that its validity is not governed by a universal mechanism: distinct gravitational theories enforce constancy of the surface gravity through different horizon-projections of their field equations. In general relativity, $f(R)$-gravity, and Lovelock theories, the zeroth law is known to follow from the mixed (null-transverse) horizon equations. By contrast, we show that in non-Lovelock theories the zeroth law is enforced by qualitatively different mechanisms. In generalized quadratic gravity, for instance, the null-null component of the field equations dictates its validity. Exploiting this novel diagnostic, we obtain the first exact proof of the zeroth law in the broader landscape of higher-curvature gravity, without relying on a perturbative expansion around general relativity. Our result establishes the zeroth law as a sharp probe of the underlying thermodynamic structure of gravity, and points toward a classification of modified theories according to the mechanism responsible for its validity.

classification.title_zh: 黑洞第零定律有多普适？
classification.abstract_zh: 黑洞第零定律断言稳态 Killing 视界的热平衡，但其在广义相对论之外的地位仍然有限。我们证明其有效性并非由普适机制支配：不同引力理论通过场方程的不同视界投影来强制表面引力恒定。在广义相对论、f(R) 引力和 Lovelock 理论中，第零定律已知可从混合（零-横）视界方程得出。相反，我们表明在非 Lovelock 理论中，第零定律由定性不同的机制强制。例如在广义二次引力中，场方程的零-零分量决定了其有效性。利用这种新颖的诊断，我们首次在更广泛的高阶曲率引力中获得了第零定律的精确证明，而不依赖于围绕广义相对论的微扰展开。我们的结果确立了第零定律作为引力潜在热力学结构的尖锐探针，并指向根据其有效性机制对修改理论的分类。
classification.one_liner: 不同修改引力理论通过场方程的不同视界投影强制黑洞第零定律，挑战其普适机制。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究经典引力理论中黑洞热力学的第零定律，属于‘经典引力/广义相对论’重点标签。

papers.title: Soliton solution of a gravitating chiral-quark soliton model: dynamical fermion and Dirac-sea in general relativity
papers.abstract: In this paper, we study Einstein-Dirac system based on a Dirac fermion coupled with a nonlinear chiral field on static spherically symmetric spacetime. Gravitational effects on the dynamical mass of fermions are examined. The chiral-quark soliton model (CQSM) originally was a model of hadron inspired by the low-energy regime of large-$N_\textrm{c}$ QCD, realizing localized fermions with the full inclusion of the Dirac-sea, which is derived from a regularized one-fermion loop. We extend the CQSM in spherically symmetric curved spacetime and coupled with the Einstein gravity. We successfully solve the CQSM and the Einstein equation self-consistently, and obtain the spectral flow of the fermion energies and also of the ADM mass. The Dirac-sea dilutes the effect of the energy-momentum tensor, which induces an inactive point for the impact of gravity even when the localizing matter exists. The Dirac-sea effect becomes dominant for larger dynamical mass $M\sim \langle\bar{\psi}\psi\rangle$, leading to the emergence of the negative ADM mass.

classification.title_zh: 引力化手征夸克孤子模型的孤子解：广义相对论中的动力学费米子与狄拉克海
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究了基于狄拉克费米子与非线性手征场耦合的 Einstein-Dirac 系统，背景为静态球对称时空。考察了引力对费米子动力学质量的影响。手征夸克孤子模型（CQSM）最初是受大 N_c QCD 低能区启发的一种强子模型，通过完整包含狄拉克海来实现局域化费米子，狄拉克海源自正则化的单费米子圈。我们将 CQSM 推广到球对称弯曲时空，并与 Einstein 引力耦合。我们成功自洽求解 CQSM 和 Einstein 方程，获得费米子能量谱流以及 ADM 质量谱流。狄拉克海稀释了能量-动量张量的效应，这导致即使存在局域化物质，也会出现引力影响的不活跃点。对于较大的动力学质量 M~<bar psi psi>，狄拉克海效应占主导，导致出现负 ADM 质量。
classification.one_liner: 在球对称弯曲时空中自洽求解引力手征夸克孤子模型，发现狄拉克海可稀释引力效应并在大动力学质量下导致负 ADM 质量。

papers.title: Exact horizon response and charge ensembles of Majumdar--Papapetrou black holes
papers.abstract: We determine the electrostatic Dirichlet-to-Neumann map of an arbitrary four-dimensional Majumdar--Papapetrou spacetime. For a minimally coupled spectator Maxwell field, the potentials of the disconnected extremal horizons may be prescribed independently, and the resulting flux charges are related by an exact capacitance matrix. If the centers have masses $M_A$ and coordinate separations $R_{AB}$, its entries are $C_{AA}=M_A+\sum_{B\ne A}M_AM_B/R_{AB}$ and $C_{AB}=-M_AM_B/R_{AB}$. The matrix is a positive diagonal term plus the weighted Laplacian of the complete graph of horizons, giving an exact common-mode and differential-mode decomposition of the field energy. The grounded Dirichlet Green function shows that a point charge partitions its flux among infinity and the horizons according to elementary harmonic measures. A direct translation of the multicenter Green function of Frolov and Zelnikov gives the diagonal completion used in their published Eq.~(68), whose component-resolved Gauss flux preserves the total horizon charge but generally transfers charge between horizons. The symmetric Green function that preserves every horizon charge instead contains the inverse of the full capacitance matrix. For a binary, the difference gives a finite, negative-semidefinite shift of the electrostatic self-energy and a corresponding exact self-force difference without an additional ultraviolet subtraction. We finally extend the response matrix, flux partition, and fixed-charge Green function to $D=n+3$ dimensions, where the graph weights acquire the universal factor $\pi^{n/2}/\Gamma(n/2)$.

classification.title_zh: Majumdar--Papapetrou 黑洞的精确视界响应与电荷系综
classification.abstract_zh: 我们确定了任意四维 Majumdar--Papapetrou 时空的静电 Dirichlet-to-Neumann 映射。对于最小耦合的旁观者 Maxwell 场，不连通的极值视界的势可以独立指定，并且所得的通量电荷由一个精确的电容矩阵联系。如果中心质量为 M_A，坐标间距为 R_AB，其矩阵元为 C_AA = M_A + \sum_{B\ne A} M_A M_B / R_AB 和 C_AB = -M_A M_B / R_AB。该矩阵是一个正对角项加上视界完全图的加权 Laplacian，给出场能的精确共模与差模分解。接地 Dirichlet Green 函数表明，点电荷按照初等调和测度将其通量在无穷远与各视界之间分配。对 Frolov 和 Zelnikov 的多中心 Green 函数进行直接翻译，可给出其已发表 Eq.~(68) 中使用的对角完成，其分量分辨的 Gauss 通量保持总视界电荷，但通常会在视界之间转移电荷。保持每个视界电荷的对称 Green 函数则包含完整电容矩阵的逆。对于双黑洞，二者之差给出静电能自能的有限、负半定移动，以及相应的精确自作用力之差，而无需额外的紫外减除。我们最终将响应矩阵、通量分配和固定电荷 Green 函数推广到 D=n+3 维，其中图权重获得普适因子 \pi^{n/2}/\Gamma(n/2)。
classification.one_liner: 该文为任意四维 Majumdar--Papapetrou 黑洞构造精确静电 Dirichlet-to-Neumann 电容矩阵，并给出通量分配、固定电荷格林函数及高维推广。

papers.title: Bi-scalar-tensor theory: a spatially covariant gravity approach
papers.abstract: We propose a novel method for constructing ghost-free multi-field higher-derivative scalar-tensor theories. The idea is to start from spatially covariant gravity and couple it to an additional scalar field. The resulting spatially covariant scalar field theory can be understood as a bi-scalar-tensor theory in the unitary gauge of one scalar. Within a broad class in which metric velocities enter through the extrinsic curvature and the additional scalar enters through temporal derivatives up to second order, we perform a Hamiltonian constraint analysis. We show that the theory generally propagates five physical degrees of freedom (DOFs), i.e., two tensor modes and three scalar modes. One of the scalar modes is the unwanted mode associated with the additional scalar. We then derive a degeneracy condition and an additional consistency condition. When both conditions hold, the unwanted mode is eliminated and the theory propagates four degrees of freedom. The resulting theories fall into two cases, depending on whether the preservation of the tertiary constraint closes without a new constraint or generates a quaternary constraint. We also study the two-field disformal transformation, derive its invertibility condition, and express it in the unitary gauge. Our construction provides a systematic approach to constructing bi- and multi-scalar-tensor theories with higher derivatives.

classification.title_zh: 双标量-张量理论：一种空间协变引力方法
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种构造无鬼多场高阶导数标量-张量理论的新方法。其思路是从空间协变引力出发，并将其与一个额外标量场耦合。所得空间协变标量场论可在一个标量的幺正规范下理解为双标量-张量理论。在一个宽泛类型中，度规速度通过外曲率进入，额外标量通过最高二阶时间导数进入，我们进行了哈密顿约束分析。我们表明该理论一般传播五个物理自由度，即两个张量模和三个标量模。其中一个标量模是与额外标量相关的不想要模式。随后我们推导出一个简并条件和一个额外一致性条件。当两个条件均成立时，不想要模式被消除，理论传播四个自由度。所得理论分为两种情况，取决于第三约束的保持是无需新约束而闭合，还是生成第四约束。我们还研究了双场 disformal 变换，推导其可逆性条件，并将其表示在幺正规范下。我们的构造为构造具有高阶导数的双标量和多标量-张量理论提供了系统方法。
classification.one_liner: 提出从空间协变引力构造无鬼双标量-张量理论，并通过哈密顿约束分析消除额外标量模式。

papers.title: Grey-body factor from correspondence with quasinormal mode for gravitational perturbation of higher-dimensional Reissner-Nordstr\"{o}m black hole
papers.abstract: We investigate the correspondence between quasinormal modes (QNMs) and grey-body factors (GBFs) of higher-dimensional Reissner-Nordstr\"{o}m black holes. Considering gravitational perturbations of these black holes, we systematically compute the QNMs and GBFs for scalar, vector, and tensor perturbations, including the $(+)$ and $(-)$ types of scalar and vector perturbations, to examine the validity of the correspondence. The QNMs are computed using the continued fraction method, and the integration-through-midpoints method is applied when required by the singularity structure of the Frobenius series for each perturbation type and set of black-hole parameters. We evaluate the accuracy of the correspondence for each spacetime dimension $D$ and black-hole charge by comparing the GBFs obtained from the correspondence with those obtained by numerical integration. The correspondence provides a good approximation to the GBFs for the scalar($+$), vector($+$), vector($-$), and tensor perturbations. However, for the scalar($-$) type, the correspondence exhibits pronounced deviations at low to intermediate charges in $D > 6$. At higher charges, it recovers reasonable accuracy despite the effective potential exhibiting a double-peak structure inconsistent with the assumptions underlying the Wentzel-Kramers-Brillouin (WKB)-based derivation of the correspondence. In contrast to the other types, for which the correspondence deteriorates as $D$ increases, the scalar($-$) type is more accurate in $D=8$ than in $D=7$. Furthermore, the correspondence performs well for the vector($-$) perturbation of near-extreme black holes, even though the potential develops a double-peak structure in $D>6$. These results indicate that the correspondence is applicable over a broader range than expected from the assumptions of the WKB approximation.

classification.title_zh: 高维 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞引力扰动的灰体因子：来自与准正规模的对应关系
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究高维 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞准正规模（QNMs）与灰体因子（GBFs）之间的对应关系。针对这些黑洞的引力扰动，我们系统计算了标量、矢量与张量扰动的 QNMs 和 GBFs，其中包括标量与矢量扰动的 $(+)$ 与 $(-)$ 类型，以检验该对应关系的有效性。QNMs 用连分式方法计算；当各扰动类型和黑洞参数集的 Frobenius 级数奇点结构需要时，采用中点积分法。我们通过比较由对应关系得到的 GBFs 与数值积分得到的 GBFs，评估该对应关系在不同时空维度 $D$ 与黑洞电荷下的精度。该对应关系对标量$(+)$、矢量$(+)$、矢量$(-)$与张量扰动给出良好近似。然而，对于标量$(-)$类型，在 $D>6$ 的低至中等电荷下，对应关系出现显著偏差。在较高电荷下，尽管有效势呈现双峰结构、与基于 WKB 的对应关系推导所依赖的假设不一致，该对应关系仍恢复合理精度。与其他类型随 $D$ 增大而对应关系变差不同，标量$(-)$类型在 $D=8$ 时比在 $D=7$ 时更精确。此外，对于近极端黑洞的矢量$(-)$扰动，尽管势在 $D>6$ 时出现双峰结构，该对应关系仍表现良好。这些结果表明，该对应关系的适用范围比 WKB 近似假设所预期的更广。
classification.one_liner: 检验高维 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞引力扰动中 QNM-GBF 对应关系的适用性，发现其适用范围比 WKB 预期更广。

papers.title: Renormalized Dynamical Friction in Black-Hole Spacetimes
papers.abstract: We derive the renormalized local equation of motion for the gravitational self-force on a compact object moving through matter in a black-hole spacetime. We integrate out the environment and metric perturbations on a Schwinger--Keldysh contour, obtaining a causal effective action given by a sum of curved-spacetime Feynman diagrams organized by powers of the mass ratio and environmental density. At leading order, an environmental wake gravitationally backreacts on the worldline. The corresponding diagram contains a logarithmic ultraviolet divergence that renormalizes the leading dissipative fluid--particle coupling. We isolate the divergence with a local large-momentum expansion, in which the curved-spacetime retarded Green's function reduces to its flat tangent-space form. We translate the resulting singularity into a Barack--Ori mode-sum scheme, deriving an analytic puncture and regularization parameters for an ideal-fluid environment. Mode subtraction fixes the divergent part but not the finite Wilson coefficient. For collisionless dust, we determine this coefficient by matching to an exact near-zone calculation for a black hole moving through the medium. This gives a complete renormalization prescription suitable for numerical self-force calculations.

classification.title_zh: 黑洞时空中的重整化动力学摩擦
classification.abstract_zh: 我们推导了在黑洞时空中穿过物质的致密天体所受引力自作用力的重整化局域运动方程。我们在Schwinger--Keldysh围道上一举积掉环境和度规扰动，得到由弯曲时空费曼图之和给出的因果有效作用量，这些图按质量比和环境密度的幂次组织。在领头阶，环境尾迹对世界线产生引力反作用。相应费曼图包含一个对数紫外发散，它重整化领头的耗散性流体--粒子耦合。我们用局域大动量展开分离该发散，在此展开中弯曲时空推迟格林函数约化为其平切空间形式。我们把所得奇点转换到Barack--Ori模求和方案，推导出理想流体环境的解析穿刺和正则化参数。模减法固定了发散部分，但没有固定有限Wilson系数。对于无碰撞尘埃，我们通过匹配一个黑洞穿过介质的精确近区计算来确定该系数。这给出了适用于数值自作用力计算的完整重整化方案。
classification.one_liner: 在Schwinger--Keldysh有效作用量框架下，推导黑洞时空中运动致密天体受环境反作用的自作用力重整化运动方程，并给出Barack--Ori模求和正则化方案与无碰撞尘埃的Wilson系数匹配。

papers.title: Modified Gravity Framework for the Woods-Saxon Inflation: Theoretical Foundations and Observational Constraints
papers.abstract: We investigate an inflationary scenario within a modified gravity theory that extends the Einstein-Hilbert action through a non-minimal coupling between the inflaton $\phi$ and the trace of the energy-momentum tensor $T$. This $f(\phi)T$ framework is designed to naturally recover the standard general relativity in the post-inflationary universe. Within this theory, we apply the Woods-Saxon potential. The slow-roll dynamics yields a luminal sound speed $c_s^2=1$ for our specific choice of the coupling function. For the model parameters $a \lesssim 1$ and the modest coupling $\beta=0.1$, we obtain a scalar spectral index $n_s\approx0.959$--$0.966$ and a tensor-to-scalar ratio $r<0.01$, which reveal a good agreement with the latest Planck and BICEP/Keck data on the $(n_s, r)$ constraints. Crucially, we shall demonstrate that the $f(\phi)T$ coupling is essential for the observational viability of the model with respect to the CMB two-point statistics. This work establishes a viable inflationary scenario within the scope of the inflationary observables which are considered here.

classification.title_zh: Woods-Saxon 暴胀的修正引力框架：理论基础与观测约束
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在一种修正引力理论中研究暴胀情景，该理论通过暴胀子 φ 与能量-动量张量迹 T 之间的非最小耦合来扩展 Einstein-Hilbert 作用量。这一 f(φ)T 框架旨在使暴胀后宇宙自然地回到标准广义相对论。在此理论中，我们采用 Woods-Saxon 势。对于特定选择的耦合函数，慢滚动力学给出光速声速 c_s^2=1。对于模型参数 a ≲ 1 和温和耦合 β=0.1，我们得到标量谱指数 n_s≈0.959–0.966 以及张量标量比 r<0.01，这与最新的 Planck 和 BICEP/Keck 数据对 (n_s, r) 的约束吻合良好。关键的是，我们将证明，就 CMB 两点统计而言，f(φ)T 耦合对于该模型的观测可行性是必要的。这项工作在本文所考虑的暴胀观测量范围内建立了一个可行的暴胀情景。

papers.title: Charged Klein-Gordon modes on an Ellis wormhole: magnetic confinement and conditional Heun solvability
papers.abstract: We study charged Klein-Gordon modes on a $(2+1)$-dimensional Ellis traversable wormhole in an external magnetic field defined as uniform in an auxiliary Euclidean embedding space. The spatial geometry is intrinsically catenoidal, while the embedding is used only to construct the external gauge connection. Pullback of the ambient potential yields a regular azimuthal gauge field whose associated intrinsic magnetic scalar reverses sign across the throat. Separation of the Klein-Gordon equation leads to a radial problem that is unitarily equivalent to a one-dimensional Schr\"odinger operator with a regular effective potential. For nonzero magnetic coupling, the quadratic asymptotic term produces radial confinement on the complete wormhole. The radial equation can be reduced to the confluent-Heun class. Polynomial truncation is possible only on constrained parameter submanifolds determined by simultaneous termination conditions and therefore does not represent the generic confined spectrum. We derive the corresponding relativistic energies and analyze the lowest polynomial sector, while distinguishing the formal continuous-$\ell$ solvability correlations from the integer values of the azimuthal separation constant required by the standard angular periodicity condition.

classification.title_zh: Ellis 虫洞上的带电 Klein-Gordon 模式：磁约束与条件性 Heun 可解性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究 (2+1) 维 Ellis 可穿越虫洞上的带电 Klein-Gordon 模式，外加磁场在一个辅助欧几里得嵌入空间中定义为均匀。空间几何本质上是悬链面型，而嵌入仅用于构造外规范联络。环境势的拉回给出一个规则方位角规范场，其相关内禀磁标量在虫洞喉两侧变号。分离 Klein-Gordon 方程后，径向问题幺正等价于具有规则有效势的一维 Schrödinger 算符。对于非零磁耦合，二次渐近项在整个虫洞上导致径向约束。径向方程可约化为合流 Heun 类。多项式截断仅能在由同时终止条件决定的受约束参数子流形上发生，因此不代表一般约束谱。我们导出相应相对论能量并分析最低多项式扇区，同时区分形式上的连续 ℓ 可解性关联与标准角周期性条件所需的方位角分离常数的整数值。
classification.one_liner: 在 (2+1) 维 Ellis 虫洞上，辅助均匀磁场的拉回使带电 Klein-Gordon 模产生径向磁约束，径向方程归入合流 Heun 类，且多项式解仅存在于受约束参数子流形上。

papers.title: Black Holes as Frequency-Dependent Filters of Stochastic Gravitational Waves
papers.abstract: Black holes ring when perturbed, whereas their response to a stationary gravitational-wave background is a real-frequency scattering problem, not a source of additional quasi-normal-mode lines. We make this standard distinction quantitative by treating a black hole as a frequency-, angle-, and polarization-dependent filter. For an isotropic stationary background around Schwarzschild holes, elastic scattering produces no net monopole signal, so horizon absorption is the only population-level spectral distortion. We calculate this transfer function for Schwarzschild holes in detail, identify its absorptive and phase-delay signatures, and connect the stationary response to the causal ringdown excited by a finite wave packet. We then promote the single-hole result to an angular and polarization transport kernel for a cosmological population. The resulting optical depth is negligible for realistic black-hole populations, including asteroid-mass primordial black holes comprising all dark matter. We then extend the analysis to Kerr holes, for which superradiance allows genuine amplification in selected co-rotating modes, but isotropic incidence and random spin orientations strongly dilute the diffuse signal. Observable effects are therefore more likely in rare, nearby, aligned, rapidly spinning, or transiently illuminated systems than through cumulative cosmological propagation.

classification.title_zh: 黑洞作为随机引力波的频率依赖滤波器
classification.abstract_zh: 黑洞受扰动时会振铃，而它们对稳态引力波背景的响应是一个实频散射问题，并非额外准简正模谱线的来源。我们通过把黑洞视为频率、角度和偏振依赖的滤波器，将这一标准区分定量化。对于史瓦西黑洞周围的各向同性稳态背景，弹性散射不产生净单极信号，因此视界吸收是唯一群体层面的谱畸变。我们详细计算史瓦西黑洞的这一传递函数，识别其吸收和相位延迟特征，并将稳态响应与有限波包激发的因果铃宕联系起来。随后，我们将单黑洞结果提升为宇宙学群体的角度和偏振输运核。所得光学深度对现实的黑洞群体可忽略，包括构成全部暗物质的小行星质量原初黑洞。我们进一步将分析推广到克尔黑洞：超辐射允许在选定的共转模式中产生真正的放大，但各向同性入射和随机自旋取向强烈稀释弥漫信号。因此，可观测效应更可能出现在稀有、邻近、对准、快速旋转或瞬时光照的系统中，而不是通过累积的宇宙学传播。

papers.title: Sourced Gravitational Radiation in Parity-Violating Tetrad Gravity
papers.abstract: We study linear gravitational modes, sourced far-zone fields, and quadratic energy balance in a four-parameter tetrad theory of gravity. The theory contains three parity-even torsion invariants and a parity-odd coupling $v^\mu a_\mu$, where $v_\mu$ and $a_\mu$ are the vector and axial torsion components. Linearizing around Minkowski spacetime and applying a scalar--vector--tensor decomposition, we find two tensor, two scalar, and four vector degrees of freedom in the generic nondegenerate parity-violating region. The tensor and scalar modes propagate at the speed of light, while the two vector branches have coupling-dependent propagation speeds. We derive their kinetic eigenvalues, characteristic speeds, and flux normalizations. An exact trace identity shows that the vector Hamiltonian is not positive definite in the generic branch, even when the kinetic eigenvalues are positive and the propagation speeds are real. We also derive the response to a general compact canonical source and obtain explicit source-to-amplitude relations for all eight linear polarizations. The field $V_\mu=\partial^\nu B_{\nu\mu}$ is used to illustrate intrinsic-spin multipoles. {We further prove that the quadratic Noether current equals the second-order M{\o}ller current for the chosen first-derivative tetrad Lagrangian and derive the corresponding mode-resolved energy and momentum fluxes.} The vector contribution remains a formal signed response because of the unbounded Hamiltonian. The stationary limit reproduces the results of Ref.~\cite{ShirafujiNashed1997}, and a representative parameter scan illustrates vector-mode splitting and kinetic degeneracy.

classification.title_zh: 宇称破坏四元标架引力中的有源引力辐射
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了四参数标架引力理论中的线性引力模式、有源远区场以及二次能量平衡。该理论包含三个宇称偶的挠率不变量和一个宇称奇耦合 $v^\mu a_\mu$，其中 $v_\mu$ 和 $a_\mu$ 是矢量与轴矢量挠率分量。围绕闵可夫斯基时空线性化并应用标量-矢量-张量分解，我们在一般非退化宇称破坏区域发现两个张量、两个标量和四个矢量自由度。张量和标量模式以光速传播，而两个矢量支具有依赖耦合的传播速度。我们推导了它们的动能本征值、特征速度和通量归一化。一个精确的迹恒等式表明，在一般分支中矢量哈密顿量不是正定的，即使动能本征值为正且传播速度为实数时也是如此。我们还推导了对一般紧致正则源的响应，并得到全部八种线性极化的显式源到振幅关系。场 $V_\mu=\partial^\nu B_{\nu\mu}$ 被用来展示内禀自旋多极矩。我们进一步证明，对于所选的一阶导数标架拉氏量，二次 Noether 流等于二阶 Møller 流，并推导相应的模式分辨能量和动量通量。由于哈密顿量无下界，矢量贡献仍是形式上的有符号响应。稳态极限复现了 Ref.~\cite{ShirafujiNashed1997} 的结果，一个代表性参数扫描展示了矢量模式分裂和动能退化。
classification.one_liner: 在宇称破坏四元标架引力中分析线性引力模、远区辐射与二次能量平衡，给出八种极化的源到振幅关系，并指出矢量哈密顿量非正定。
