classification.title_zh: 用于稠密核物质和中子星的全息孤子晶体
classification.abstract_zh: 我们从 Witten-Sakai-Sugimoto (WSS) 模型中的全息 QCD 构建核物质状态方程 (EOS)，超越均匀拟设，更直接地从全息重子的孤子描述构建稠密重子物质。利用由点状（核心）瞬子在弯曲背景中源出的线性化孤子尾部得到的两重子相互作用势，我们组装一个无限面心立方 (FCC) 晶体，其最近邻处于最具吸引力的通道，作为重子量子液体的近似，并计算能量密度 E(n_B)、化学势 μ_B 和压强 P。我们通过将 't Hooft 耦合 λ 和 WSS 标度 M_KK 固定到饱和密度和起始化学势性质，并加入夸克质量项以再现物理 π 介子质量 m_π=135 MeV，来校准对称物质 EOS。该拟合结果与真空介子扇区所需的参数保持相当接近，而它们的修正与稠密介质中的 Brown-Rho 标度一致，且饱和点的不可压缩性处于正确数量级，这两点均与均匀近似形成鲜明对比。随后我们扩展到 β 平衡物质，使用对称能的唯象输入，并获得与 NICER 约束兼容的混合 EOS 和中子星可观测值。
classification.one_liner: 在 WSS 全息 QCD 中构建稠密重子的 FCC 孤子晶体，得到核物质 EOS 并给出与 NICER 兼容的中子星预言。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文直接使用全息 QCD/WSS 模型研究稠密核物质、孤子晶体与中子星状态方程，属于全息 QCD/核物理，并与非均匀孤子结构重点标签高度相关。

papers.title: Polarization-Dependent Photon Propagation, Quasinormal Modes, and Gravitational Lensing in Higher-Curvature Effective Theories
papers.abstract: We investigate the impact of higher-curvature corrections on photon propagation within an effective field theory framework and their observational consequences in strong gravitational fields. We consider polarization-dependent modifications to photon trajectories in static and spherically symmetric spacetimes, focusing on Schwarzschild and Reissner--Nordstr\"om black hole backgrounds. Using the geometrical optics approximation, we derive the effective metrics governing photon propagation and study the resulting polarization-dependent shifts of the photon sphere. We compute the corresponding quasinormal modes in the eikonal limit and analyze their polarization dependence. We further investigate gravitational lensing, focusing on polarization-dependent corrections to the deflection angle in both weak- and strong-field regimes. In the strong-deflection regime, we find that even perturbatively small EFT corrections modify the coefficient of the logarithmically divergent part of the deflection angle, resulting in a potentially observable difference from the uncorrected case. This suggests that strong gravitational lensing may provide a sensitive probe of small higher-curvature corrections. While extracting EFT information directly from QNM frequencies is more subtle, QNMs may provide complementary information to gravitational lensing in future studies. Our results establish a framework for probing higher-curvature effects through polarization-dependent strong-field observables.

classification.title_zh: 高阶曲率有效理论中偏振依赖的光子传播、准正规模与引力透镜
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在有效场论框架下研究高阶曲率修正对光子传播的影响及其在强引力场中的观测后果。我们考虑静态球对称时空中光子轨迹的偏振依赖修正，重点关注 Schwarzschild 和 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞背景。利用几何光学近似，我们推导支配光子传播的有效度规，并研究由此产生的光子球偏振依赖移动。我们计算 eikonal 极限下相应的准正规模，并分析其偏振依赖性。我们进一步研究引力透镜，重点关注弱场和强场区域中偏折角的偏振依赖修正。在强偏折区域，我们发现即使微扰小的高阶曲率 EFT 修正也会改变偏折角对数发散部分的系数，从而可能产生与未修正情形可观测的差异。这表明强引力透镜可能为小的高阶曲率修正提供敏感探针。虽然直接从 QNM 频率提取 EFT 信息更为微妙，但 QNM 可能在未来研究中为引力透镜提供补充信息。我们的结果建立了一个通过偏振依赖强场可观测量探测高阶曲率效应的框架。
classification.one_liner: 在高阶曲率 EFT 中，偏振依赖修正改变光子球、eikonal QNM 与强场引力透镜偏折，强透镜可作为探测小修正的敏感探针。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究高阶曲率 EFT 下黑洞背景的偏振依赖光子传播、eikonal QNM 与引力透镜，属于经典引力/广义相对论并涉及 QNM；不涉及全息、AdS/CFT 或量子信息。

papers.title: Large primordial non-Gaussianity from transient turns in Higgs-$R^2$ inflation
papers.abstract: We investigate the generation of primordial non-Gaussianities in multifield Higgs--$R^2$ inflation, focusing on the effects of transient turning trajectories in the hyperbolic field space manifold. We compute the full bispectrum without relying on slow-roll or local approximations and follow the complete superhorizon evolution of curvature and isocurvature perturbations. We show that transient turns efficiently transfer isocurvature fluctuations into the adiabatic sector, generating sizeable local non-Gaussianities. For a benchmark Higgs nonminimal coupling $\xi_h = 0.1$ and quartic coupling $\lambda = 10^{-10}$, we obtain $f_{\rm NL}^{\rm loc}\simeq -17.7$. As the Higgs nonminimal coupling increases, the turning rate is progressively suppressed and the model approaches the effective single-field attractor, recovering the Maldacena consistency relation $f_{\rm NL}\rightarrow 0.0159$. Comparing our predictions with current CMB constraints, we find that primordial non-Gaussianity provides a sensitive probe of the Higgs nonminimal coupling and can significantly restrict the viable parameter space of the model.

classification.title_zh: Higgs-R² 暴胀中瞬态转弯产生的大原初非高斯性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究多场 Higgs–R² 暴胀中原初非高斯性的产生，重点关注双曲场空间流形中的瞬态转弯轨迹效应。我们在不依赖慢滚或局部近似的情况下计算完整双谱，并追踪曲率与等曲率扰动在超视界尺度上的完整演化。我们发现瞬态转弯能有效地将等曲率涨落转移到绝热扇区，从而产生可观的局域非高斯性。在 Higgs 非最小耦合 ξ_h=0.1、四次耦合 λ=10^-10 的基准参数下，得到 f_NL^loc≈-17.7。随着 Higgs 非最小耦合增大，转弯速率逐渐被抑制，模型趋近有效单场吸引子，并恢复 Maldacena 一致性关系 f_NL→0.0159。与当前 CMB 限制比较后，原初非高斯性为 Higgs 非最小耦合提供了灵敏探针，并能显著限制模型的可行参数空间。
classification.one_liner: 研究 Higgs-R² 暴胀中瞬态转弯如何将等曲率扰动转化为可观测的局域原初非高斯性，并用 CMB 限制 Higgs 非最小耦合。
classification.relevance_reason: 该工作属于暴胀宇宙学中的经典引力与原初非高斯性研究，虽非全息或量子引力主支线，但与经典引力/广义相对论相关，可作为非全息宇宙学背景参考。

papers.title: Naturally Light Distortion
papers.abstract: In the most general formulation of gravity, the metric and connection are independent degrees of freedom, and the connection may include torsion and non-metricity (or distortion, collectively) degrees of freedom, resulting in a huge number of possible dynamical fields. However, most fields are either non-dynamical or extremely heavy and the general relativity is recovered at low energy. We find a unique naturally light vector- or scalar-like distortion field, which can be dynamical and have phenomenological implications. In particular, a light scalar particle that mixes with the Higgs boson naturally appears.

classification.title_zh: 自然轻的畸变
classification.abstract_zh: 在引力最一般的表述中，度规和联络是独立自由度，联络可以包含挠率和非度量性（统称为畸变）自由度，从而产生大量可能的动力学场。然而，大多数场要么是非动力学的，要么极其重，并且低能下恢复广义相对论。我们发现了一个独特的自然轻的矢量型或标量型畸变场，它可以是动力学的并具有现象学意义。特别地，一个与希格斯玻色子混合的轻标量粒子会自然地出现。
classification.one_liner: 在度规-仿射引力中识别出一个自然轻的畸变场，其中轻标量可与希格斯混合。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于修改/经典引力中的度规-仿射表述，讨论挠率与非度量性畸变场，并给出与希格斯混合的轻标量粒子现象学；不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶。

papers.title: Classical emergence of the quantum-backreacted BTZ black hole from exponential electrodynamics
papers.abstract: In this work, we revisit a recently reported generalization of the Ba\~nados-Teitelboim-Zanelli black hole arising in New Massive Gravity sourced by the quantum fluctuations of scalar matter, now examined through the lens of a purely classical framework. We show that the same geometry, distinguished by its logarithmic asymptotic structure, emerges as the unique static solution of Einstein gravity coupled to an exponential nonlinear electrodynamics. We trace the origin of this correspondence and prove that this geometry belongs to a unique class of metrics constituting the intersection of the moduli spaces of the static and circularly symmetric sectors of the two theories, thereby revealing a dynamical equivalence between them. An explicit mapping is established between the global charges of the nonlinearly charged black holes and the parameters governing the quantum backreaction in New Massive Gravity, allowing for a natural reinterpretation of the quantum imprints in terms of classical charges. A detailed analysis of the horizon structure of these spacetimes is presented. In addition, the full thermodynamics of the more general configurations is constructed using the Iyer-Wald formalism, from which we derive the first law and the associated Smarr relation. Altogether, our results provide a classical realization of a semiclassical spacetime and point toward a broader correspondence between higher-curvature corrections in quantum gravity and nonlinear effects in self-gravitating electrodynamics in three dimensions.

secondary_topics: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 量子反作用BTZ黑洞从指数电动力学中的经典涌现
classification.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们重新审视最近报道的 Bañados-Teitelboim-Zanelli 黑洞的一种推广；该黑洞出现在由标量物质量子涨落作为源的新质量引力中，现在从纯经典框架的视角加以考察。我们表明，同一种以对数渐近结构为特征的几何，作为爱因斯坦引力与指数非线性电动力学耦合的唯一静态解而出现。我们追溯这种对应关系的起源，并证明该几何属于一类唯一的度规，构成两个理论的静态扇区与圆对称扇区的模空间交集，从而揭示二者之间的动力学等价性。我们建立了非线性带电黑洞的整体荷与新质量引力中控制量子反作用的参数之间的显式映射，使得量子印记可以自然地重新解释为经典荷。文中详细分析了这些时空的视界结构。此外，我们使用 Iyer-Wald 形式体系构造了更一般构型的完整热力学，并由此推导出第一定律及相关的 Smarr 关系。总之，我们的结果为半经典时空提供了一种经典实现，并指向量子引力中的高阶曲率修正与三维自引力电动力学中的非线性效应之间更广泛的对应关系。
classification.one_liner: 三维中，量子反作用修正的BTZ几何可由指数非线性电动力学经典实现，并对应高阶曲率修正与非线性电动力学之间的映射。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究三维BTZ黑洞的经典实现、非线性电动力学对应与黑洞热力学，属于用户重点关注的经典引力/广义相对论支线；但未讨论AdS/CFT全息字典或量子信息，因此与全息方向相关性为中等。

papers.title: Universal Closed Form for Dynamical Love Numbers of Black Holes
papers.abstract: Black hole static Love numbers vanish, but their dynamical counterparts do not. We present the entire scheme-independent dynamical response $\bar{F}_{\ell,s}$ of a Schwarzschild black hole in closed form, to all orders in $G$, and for every spin $s$ and multipole $\ell$. The result is $\bar{F}_{\ell,s}/4\pi R_S^{2\ell+1}=\Phi_{\ell,s}(\bar{y})-\tfrac12\eta\,\Phi_{\ell,s}'(\bar{y})$ with $\bar{y}=-\tfrac12\eta^2\tau$ and $\eta=i\omega R_S$. Here $\Phi_{\ell,s}$ is simply the leading-log solution to the renormalization group equation, but lifting the running logarithm to $\tau=\log(R_S/R)-2\sum_{k\ge2}\zeta_k\,\eta^{k-1}$ resums it to all orders. This tower of Riemann zeta values is the Newtonian phase in disguise: it originates from the long-range $1/r$ potential in the far zone, and is universal across multipole and spin. Our result exhibits a factorization pinned to three ingredients: the strength of horizon absorption, the running rate in the near zone, and the dressed logarithm in the far zone. Using shell effective field theory, we independently verify our formula for scalar, electromagnetic, and gravitational perturbations, reaching $\mathcal O(G^{15})$.

classification.title_zh: 黑洞动力学 Love 数的普适闭式
classification.abstract_zh: 黑洞静态 Love 数消失，但其动力学对应量并不消失。我们给出 Schwarzschild 黑洞的完整 scheme-independent 动力学响应 \bar{F}_{\ell,s} 的闭式，对 G 的所有阶、任意自旋 s 和多极 \ell 成立。结果为 \bar{F}_{\ell,s}/4\pi R_S^{2\ell+1}=\Phi_{\ell,s}(\bar{y})-\tfrac12\eta \Phi_{\ell,s}'(\bar{y})，其中 \bar{y}=-\tfrac12\eta^2\tau，\eta=i\omega R_S。这里 \Phi_{\ell,s} 是重整化群方程的领头对数解；将跑动对数提升为 \tau=\log(R_S/R)-2\sum_{k\ge2}\zeta_k \eta^{k-1} 可将其重求和到所有阶。这一 Riemann zeta 值塔本质上是 Newtonian 相位：它来自远区长程 1/r 势，并在多极和自旋间普适。我们的结果呈现一个由三个要素决定的因子化：视界吸收强度、近区跑动率和远区修饰对数。利用壳层有效场论，我们独立验证了标量、电磁和引力扰动下的公式，达到 \mathcal{O}(G^{15})。
classification.one_liner: 以闭式给出 Schwarzschild 黑洞动力学 Love 响应的全阶普适公式，并揭示其因子化由视界吸收、近区跑动和远区修饰对数决定。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究 Schwarzschild 黑洞的经典动力学潮汐响应/Love 数，属于经典引力与广义相对论支线，不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶。

papers.title: Stochastic modes in postquantum classical gravity
papers.abstract: We study fluctuations of the metric in the postquantum theory of classical gravity, a covariant theory which couples a classical spacetime with quantum matter fields. Mathematical consistency requires spacetime to evolve stochastically. Starting from the classical-quantum path integral, we linearize around Minkowski space and perform a scalar-vector-tensor decomposition, identifying the stochastic modes: a classical spin-2 field and spin-0 scalar, both diffusing around their respective wave equations. There is also a non-dynamical vector and scalar field. These are related to the degrees of freedom found in quadratic gravity, but here interpreted as stochastic contributions to spacetime. We show that the action is positive semi-definite (PSD) on all dynamical modes, which is a necessary condition for the theory to consistently treat spacetime classically. We compute the two-point function and power spectral density corresponding to fluctuations of the Newtonian potential, and compare it to the excess noise found in LISA Pathfinder. This sets a bound on one combination of the two dimensionless coupling constants of the theory, while bounds on the stochastic gravitational wave energy density in a FLRW background constrain another combination. We derive the effective action for matter distributions, and find that bounds from decoherence experiments are constrained by fluctuations in the Newtonian potential $\Phi$ and the curvature perturbation $\psi$. Finally, we show consistency between different formulations of the pure gravity theory, the Onsager-Machlup form of the action, the Martin-Siggia-Rose form, and that given by stochastic differential equations.

classification.title_zh: 后量子经典引力中的随机模式
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究后量子经典引力理论中度规的涨落；该理论是一个协变理论，将经典时空与量子物质场耦合起来。数学一致性要求时空随机演化。从经典-量子路径积分出发，我们在 Minkowski 空间附近线性化，并进行标量-矢量-张量分解，识别出随机模式：一个经典自旋-2 场和一个自旋-0 标量，二者都在各自波动方程附近扩散。此外还有非动力学矢量场和标量场。这些与二次引力中发现的自由度相关，但在这里被解释为对时空的随机贡献。我们证明作用量在所有动力学模式上是半正定的（PSD），这是理论能够一致地将时空作为经典量处理的一个必要条件。我们计算与牛顿势涨落对应的两点函数和功率谱密度，并将其与 LISA Pathfinder 中发现的过量噪声进行比较。这给出了对理论两个无量纲耦合常数之一组合的约束，而 FLRW 背景下随机引力波能量密度的约束则限制另一个组合。我们推导物质分布的有效作用量，并发现退相干实验的约束受到牛顿势 Φ 和曲率扰动 ψ 的涨落限制。最后，我们展示了纯引力理论的不同表述之间的一致性：Onsager-Machlup 形式的作用量、Martin-Siggia-Rose 形式，以及由随机微分方程给出的形式。
classification.one_liner: 在后量子经典引力中识别线性化随机模式，计算牛顿势噪声与随机引力波谱，并用 LISA Pathfinder、FLRW 和退相干实验约束理论耦合。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文不属于 AdS/CFT/全息，但与经典引力/时空涨落支线直接相关，涉及牛顿势噪声、随机引力波和退相干约束，故对经典引力方向有中等相关性。

papers.title: Flux tube profile from Holography: finite size and strong coupling corrections
papers.abstract: We use the holographic correspondence as a tool to study the classical flux tube profile connecting a static quark-antiquark pair in a $2+1$-dimensional strongly-coupled large $N$ QCD-like theory. The final result extends already known findings in the literature in several ways. First, it is an analytical function of both the space-like boundary coordinates; in other words, we keep track of what happens both along and transversely to the inter-quark axis. Then, we take into account the finiteness of the inter-quark distance and the first correction in the strong coupling expansion. To the same order, we also confirm the relation between the mass of the lightest glueball in the spectrum and the intrinsic width of the flux tube profile. We conclude by trying to gain some insights about the quantum fluctuations. Intriguingly, our proposal is in agreement with widespread expectations in the literature. En passant, we also derive a semi-analytical formula that gives the first correction to the scalar glueball masses in the strong coupling expansion.

classification.title_zh: 全息中的通量管剖面：有限尺寸与强耦合修正
classification.abstract_zh: 我们使用全息对偶作为工具，研究在 2+1 维强耦合大 N QCD 类理论中连接静态夸克-反夸克对的经典通量管剖面。最终结果在若干方面扩展了文献中已有发现。首先，它是两个类空边界坐标的解析函数；换言之，我们同时追踪沿夸克间轴和横向于该轴方向的行为。然后，我们考虑了夸克间距离的有限性以及强耦合展开的一阶修正。在同一阶，我们还确认了谱中最轻胶球质量与通量管剖面内禀宽度之间的关系。最后，我们尝试获得关于量子涨落的一些洞见。有趣的是，我们的提议与文献中的广泛预期一致。顺带地，我们还导出了一个半解析公式，给出强耦合展开中标量胶球质量的一阶修正。
classification.one_liner: 利用全息对偶计算 2+1 维强耦合 QCD 类理论中静态夸克-反夸克通量管剖面，包含有限距离与强耦合一阶修正，并联系胶球质量与通量管宽度。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于全息 QCD，核心是强耦合通量管非均匀剖面与胶球质量；可与“畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀”支线间接相关，但不涉及全息超导、相变气泡成核、QNM、multi-trace、探针膜或经典引力等重点方向。

papers.title: Light bending and observational bounds in dyonic Kalb-Ramond gravity
papers.abstract: We investigate the weak and strong gravitational lensing of a dyonic black hole in Kalb-Ramond gravity. After fixing the asymptotic normalization, we distinguish the effective charge governing the local null trajectories from the global angular identification associated with Lorentz-symmetry breaking. In the weak-deflection regime, we evaluate the Gaussian curvature explicitly and apply the Gauss-Bonnet theorem with a perturbed ray boundary, recovering the complete second order mass contribution. Independent calculations based on the orbit equation, the turning point integral, and Fermat's principle reproduce the same bending angle. In the strong-deflection regime, Tsukamoto's method yields closed expressions for both strong-deflection coefficients, with exact charge dependence. We derive finite-distance lens equations and the associated image positions, magnifications, flux ratios, and differential arrival times, retaining the physical winding condition. Shadow sizes inferred from observations of Sgr~A$^*$ and M87$^*$ yield conditional charge bounds, complemented by an estimate from S2 precession. We further construct combinations of strong-lensing observables that separate the effective charge from the conical parameter within the model: angular separation and relative brightness remove the explicit winding dependence, while a timing ratio incorporating an independent distance estimate isolates the conical deformation.

classification.title_zh: 双荷 Kalb-Ramond 引力中的光线偏折与观测约束
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究 Kalb-Ramond 引力中双荷黑洞的弱引力透镜和强引力透镜。在固定渐近归一化后，我们区分了支配局部零测地线的有效电荷与与洛伦兹对称性破缺相关的整体角度识别。在弱偏折区域，我们显式计算高斯曲率，并对具有微扰光线边界的区域应用 Gauss-Bonnet 定理，恢复了完整的二阶质量贡献。基于轨道方程、转折点积分和费马原理的独立计算给出相同的偏折角。在强偏折区域，Tsukamoto 方法给出两个强偏折系数的闭式表达式，并具有精确的电荷依赖。我们推导有限距离透镜方程及相应的像位置、放大率、通量比和差分到达时间，并保留物理的绕数条件。由 Sgr A* 和 M87* 观测推断的阴影大小给出条件性电荷界限，并由 S2 进动给出补充估计。我们进一步构造强透镜可观测量的组合，以在该模型中分离有效电荷和锥形参数：角分离和相对亮度消除显式绕数依赖，而纳入独立距离估计的时间比则分离出锥形形变。
classification.one_liner: 在 Kalb-Ramond 引力中计算双荷黑洞的弱/强引力透镜、阴影与观测约束，并构造分离模型参数的观测量组合。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究经典引力框架下的黑洞透镜、阴影和观测约束，符合“经典引力/广义相对论”重点支线；但并非全息或量子引力研究，也不涉及全息重点标签中的其他研究支线。

papers.title: A computer assisted existence proof for a non-Schwarzschild black hole in Einstein--Weyl gravity
papers.abstract: Static, asymptotically flat, non-Schwarzschild black holes in four-dimensional Einstein--Weyl gravity have previously been constructed by numerical shooting, while the local field equations admit horizon and asymptotic expansions to all orders. We give a computer assisted existence proof for a non-Schwarzschild solution whose dimensionless horizon radius is one in units of the massive spin-two scale, with parameters close to the previously reported numerical branch. The exterior is divided into a convergent horizon series domain, a compact core enclosed by a parameter dependent Taylor model with directed rounding, and an infinite asymptotic domain treated as a centered stable manifold fixed point problem. The resulting five-dimensional matching map between the core and tail is continuous on a rigorously specified box. After exact rational preconditioning, the signs on opposite faces satisfy the hypotheses of the Poincar\'e--Miranda theorem and therefore certify a matching zero. The solution has a regular nondegenerate horizon, no additional exterior horizon, vanishing Ricci scalar, and nonvanishing Ricci tensor. The proof establishes existence, but not uniqueness of the matching zero.

classification.title_zh: Einstein--Weyl 引力中非 Schwarzschild 黑洞的计算机辅助存在性证明
classification.abstract_zh: 静态、渐近平直的四维 Einstein--Weyl 引力中的非 Schwarzschild 黑洞此前已通过数值打靶法构造，而局部场方程允许视界展开和渐近展开到任意阶。我们给出了一个非 Schwarzschild 解的计算机辅助存在性证明，其无量纲视界半径在以有质量自旋二尺度为单位时为 1，参数接近先前报道的数值分支。外部区域被分为：收敛的视界级数区域；由带定向舍入的参数依赖 Taylor 模型包围的紧致核心；以及被处理为居中稳定流形不动点问题的无穷渐近区域。核心与尾部之间的五维匹配映射在严格指定的盒子上连续。经过精确有理预条件后，相对面上的符号满足 Poincaré--Miranda 定理的假设，因此证明存在一个匹配零点。该解具有正则非退化视界、没有额外外部视界、Ricci 标量为零而非零 Ricci 张量。该证明确立了存在性，但未证明匹配零点的唯一性。
classification.one_liner: 通过计算机辅助 Poincaré--Miranda 论证，证明四维 Einstein--Weyl 引力中存在一个非 Schwarzschild 黑洞解。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典/修改引力中的黑洞解严格存在性证明，直接匹配用户重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”；不涉及全息对偶。

papers.title: Zero Temperature, Degenerate Fermion Stars
papers.abstract: We study a degenerate, zero temperature, fermion gas with rest mass $m$, that only interacts with itself, gravitationally. We describe a self-consistent novel approach to the formation of a degenerate, quantum mechanical, star. In this approach, the fermions occupy the energy levels that are determined by the self consistent gravitational interactions, according to the Pauli exclusion principle. Then in this novel approach, the size of the highest occupied level determines the radius of the star. In the Newtonian gravitational limit, the fermions feel a potential corresponding to a simple harmonic well that smoothly attaches in the exterior to the usual $1/r$ Newtonian gravitational potential. We find analytically, solutions for stars with any radius and mass, parametrized by $m$ and $N_s$, the total number of fermions. In the Newtonian limit, we easily find that we can construct a star that is more compact than the Buchdahl bound and indeed can even be smaller than the Schwarzschild radius. Clearly, such cases are outside of the purview of the Newtonian limit. Therefore we expand our analysis to fermions in the general relativistic context, interacting gravitationally with a metric. We consider the metric corresponding to the interior Schwarzschild solution smoothly connecting to the usual exterior Schwarzschild metric. Treating matter semi-classically, we recover the Buchdahl bound in a completely independent analysis. We briefly discuss classical stability of the Newtonian solution, and its relation to Newtonian polytropic fluids.

classification.title_zh: 零温度简并费米星
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究一种零温度、简并的费米气体，其粒子具有静止质量 m，且只通过引力彼此相互作用。我们描述了一种自洽的新方法来理解简并量子力学星的形成。在该方法中，费米子根据泡利不相容原理占据由自洽引力相互作用决定的能级。于是，在这个新方法中，最高占据能级的大小决定了星的半径。在牛顿引力极限下，费米子感受到对应于简谐振子势的势，该势在外部平滑连接到通常的 1/r 牛顿引力势。我们解析地找到了任意半径和质量的星解，由 m 和总费米子数 N_s 参数化。在牛顿极限下，我们容易发现可以构造比 Buchdahl 界更致密、甚至小于 Schwarzschild 半径的星。显然，这类情形超出牛顿极限的适用范围。因此，我们将分析推广到广义相对论背景中的费米子，它们通过度规发生引力相互作用。我们考虑对应于内部 Schwarzschild 解并平滑连接到通常外部 Schwarzschild 度规的度规。半经典地处理物质，我们在完全独立的分析中重新得到 Buchdahl 界。我们简要讨论牛顿解的经典稳定性及其与牛顿多方流体（polytropic fluids）的关系。
classification.one_liner: 在牛顿与广义相对论框架下自洽求解零温简并费米星，并独立复现 Buchdahl 界。
classification.relevance_reason: 非全息研究；主要属于经典引力/广义相对论，直接研究自引力简并费米星、Schwarzschild 内部解与 Buchdahl 界，因此对经典引力支线有中等相关性，但与 AdS/CFT 无直接关系。

papers.title: Second-order scattering response of a Schwarzschild black hole
papers.abstract: Gravitational waves couple in a nonlinear fashion in the vicinity of a black hole. Black hole perturbation theory can be readily applied to compute the magnitude of this coupling, its dependence on the parity content, frequencies, and angular structure of the incoming gravitational waves. In this work we carry out this calculation, showing how the nonlinear coupling of gravitational waves generically peaks when the driven frequency matches the oscillation frequency of the fundamental quasinormal mode of the black hole. We also demonstrate how this excitation is largest at the maximal harmonics allowed, and that it only depends mildly on the parity content of the incoming modes. At low frequencies, the quadratic response computed here encodes the nonlinear, dynamical tidal deformability of the black hole spacetime itself. We demonstrate numerically that the quadratic black hole coupling coefficient scales quadratically with the driving frequency, and recover this scaling from the 5-point Compton graviton scattering amplitude.

classification.title_zh: 史瓦西黑洞的二阶散射响应
classification.abstract_zh: 引力波在黑洞附近以非线性方式耦合。黑洞微扰论可直接用于计算这种耦合的大小，以及它如何依赖 incoming 引力波的宇称内容、频率和角结构。本文完成该计算，表明引力波的非线性耦合通常在驱动频率与黑洞基频准正规模振荡频率匹配时达到峰值。作者还展示这种激发在允许的最大谐波处最强，并且仅温和依赖 incoming 模式的宇称内容。在低频下，这里计算的二次响应编码了黑洞时空本身的非线性动力学潮汐形变。数值上，作者证明二次黑洞耦合系数随驱动频率二次方标度，并从五点康普顿引力子散射振幅恢复该标度关系。
classification.one_liner: 计算史瓦西黑洞引力的二阶非线性散射响应，揭示其与基频准正规模共振及低频非线性潮汐形变的关系。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接属于经典引力/广义相对论与黑洞微扰/QNM非线性响应支线，与用户重点标签中的经典引力和QNM与非线性演化高度相关。

papers.title: Multi-Boundary Spinning $AdS_5$ Black Holes, Strongly Coupled Plasma Balls and a dual locally de Sitter spacetime
papers.abstract: We construct a new family of exact spinning black hole solutions in five-dimensional General Relativity with a negative cosmological constant, which are dual to strongly coupled spinning plasma balls on four-dimensional Minkowski spacetime. In analogy with the recent discovery of such black solutions in four bulk dimensions, the boundary Lorentz factor acts as a new coordinate in the bulk, giving rise to a new UV region that, in our case, is locally a three-dimensional de Sitter spacetime times the real line. The dual energy-momentum tensor in this region describes a conformal anisotropic fluid that satisfies the weak and strong energy conditions.

classification.title_zh: 多边界旋转 AdS₅ 黑洞、强耦合等离子体球与对偶局域 de Sitter 时空
classification.abstract_zh: 我们构造了五维广义相对论中带负宇宙学常数的一类新的精确旋转黑洞解，它们对偶于四维 Minkowski 时空上的强耦合旋转等离子体球。类比最近在四维体时空中发现的此类黑洞解，边界 Lorentz 因子在体时空中充当一个新坐标，产生一个新的 UV 区域；在我们的情形中，该区域局部为三维 de Sitter 时空与实直线的乘积。该区域的对偶能动张量描述一种共形各向异性流体，并满足弱能量条件和强能量条件。
classification.one_liner: 构造五维 AdS 旋转黑洞精确解，对偶于四维强耦合旋转等离子体球，并给出局域 dS₃×R 的 UV 区域与共形各向异性流体描述。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文构造五维 AdS 旋转黑洞精确解，属于全息对偶与经典引力/广义相对论；其边界强耦合旋转等离子体球、局域 de Sitter UV 区域和能量条件分析，与用户“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签直接相关。

papers.title: Diagnosing Inconsistencies in 4d N=1 Gauge Theories with Explainable AI
papers.abstract: Brane tilings are bipartite graphs on a 2-torus that encode the Lagrangians of 4d N=1 supersymmetric gauge theories arising on D3-branes probing toric Calabi-Yau 3-folds. Among these bipartite graphs, only those that satisfy geometric consistency conditions correspond to well-behaved quantum field theories. We train a convolutional neural network (CNN) to distinguish geometrically consistent from inconsistent brane tilings directly from their Kasteleyn matrices. We study a family of 4d N=1 theories obtained by adding diagonal edges to the hexagonal faces of the brane tiling for the abelian orbifold C^3/Z_3 x Z_3, and find that the CNN identifies geometric inconsistency with high accuracy. For inconsistent brane tilings that can be rendered consistent by Higgsing a single bifundamental chiral field, we show that gradient-based saliency analysis can be used to localize the responsible chiral fields with accuracy well above a matched random baseline. These results demonstrate that explainable AI (XAI) can be used to identify local defects responsible for inconsistencies in supersymmetric gauge theories.

classification.title_zh: 用可解释人工智能诊断四维N=1规范理论中的不一致性
classification.abstract_zh: Brane tilings 是二维环面上的二分图，编码了在探测环面Calabi-Yau 3-folds的D3-branes上产生的四维N=1超对称规范理论的拉氏量。在这些二分图中，只有满足几何一致性条件的那些才对应行为良好的量子场论。我们训练了一个卷积神经网络（CNN），直接从Kasteleyn矩阵区分几何一致与不一致的brane tilings。我们研究了一族四维N=1理论，它们通过向C^3/Z_3 x Z_3阿贝尔orbifold的brane tiling的六边形面添加对角边得到，发现CNN以高准确率识别几何不一致性。对于可以通过Higgsing单个双基本手征场而变得一致的不一致brane tilings，我们表明基于梯度的显著性分析可用于定位负责的手征场，准确率远高于匹配的随机基线。这些结果表明，可解释AI（XAI）可用于识别超对称规范理论中导致不一致性的局域缺陷。
classification.one_liner: 利用CNN和显著性分析从Kasteleyn矩阵识别brane tilings的几何不一致性，并定位导致不一致的手征场。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于弦论/全息背景下的4d N=1规范理论，使用AI诊断brane tilings，但不涉及用户重点标签如全息超流、畴壁、相变、QNM、经典引力等。

papers.title: A Split-Signature Type IIB Background on $\mathrm{AdS}_{5,\mathbb C}$
papers.abstract: We construct a maximally supersymmetric Type IIB background in signature $(5,5)$ on the real ten-manifold underlying complex $\mathrm{AdS}_5$. The spacetime is diffeomorphic to $T^*S^5$ and carries the invariant metric $G=\mathrm i(\bar q-q)$, where $q$ is the holomorphic constant-curvature metric. The real five-form $F_5=(4\mathrm i/L)(\Omega-\bar\Omega)$, built from its normalized volume form, is self-dual, and its stress tensor supports this scalar-flat, non-Einstein metric. We derive these fields from the most general $\mathrm{SL}(4,\mathbb C)$-invariant metric and five-form ansatz: self-duality and the Einstein equation fix their phases up to the overall scale, orientation, and flux sign. The fields obey the reality conditions of the untwisted $\mathrm{IIB}_5$ theory. The holomorphic coframe makes the supercovariant curvature cancellation explicit, and flat transport gives thirty-two global real Killing spinors. Their Killing superalgebra is the factor-exchanging real form of $\mathfrak{psl}(4|4,\mathbb C)$, and we identify the corresponding supercoset.

classification.title_zh: 复 AdS5 上的分裂签名 Type IIB 背景
classification.abstract_zh: 我们构造了一个在复 AdS5 的实十维流形上、签名为 (5,5) 的极大超对称 Type IIB 背景。该时空微分同胚于 T*S^5，并带有不变度规 G=i(bar q - q)，其中 q 是全纯常曲率度规。由归一化体积形式构造的实五形式 F5=(4i/L)(Ω - Ω̄) 是自对偶的，其应力张量支撑这个标量平坦但非 Einstein 的度规。我们从最一般的 SL(4,C) 不变度规与五形式 ansatz 推导这些场：自对偶性和 Einstein 方程将它们的相位固定到整体标度、取向和通量符号。这些场满足未扭曲 IIB5 理论的实条件。全纯余标架使超协变曲率抵消显式化，平坦输运给出三十二个整体实 Killing 旋量。其 Killing 超代数是 psl(4|4,C) 的因子交换实形式，我们识别出相应的超陪集。
classification.one_liner: 在复 AdS5 上构造 (5,5) 分裂签名的极大超对称 Type IIB 背景，并识别其超陪集与 Killing 超代数。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT/超引力背景构造，与用户列出的全息超流超导、QNM、探针膜、相变气泡成核等重点支线无直接交集；仅与经典引力/超引力解有间接关联。

papers.title: BMS$_3$ modules from path integrals on the coadjoint orbits
papers.abstract: In this paper, we provide a systematic construction of quantum modules associated with coadjoint orbits of asymptotic symmetry groups through the path integral quantization at one-loop order. In particular, for the orbits with Hamiltonians unbounded from below, we show that an appropriate choice of integration contour defines a convergent Euclidean half-line path integral. The reference state associate with the orbit is determined by the path integral of the geometric action on the corresponding coadjoint orbit. The coadjoint module is therefore spanned by the reference state and its descendants. We apply this formalism to the Virasoro and BMS$_3$ groups and derive the coadjoint modules corresponding to all constant orbits. We also compute the characters of all constant Virasoro and BMS$_3$ coadjoint orbits by counting the states within the modules, and the results agree with the corresponding computations from the path integral of the geometric action with a periodic Euclidean direction.

classification.title_zh: 从共伴轨道上的路径积分构造 BMS$_3$ 模
classification.abstract_zh: 本文通过单圈阶路径积分量子化，系统构造与渐近对称群共伴轨道相关的量子模。特别地，对于哈密顿量无下界的轨道，我们表明适当选择积分围道可定义收敛的欧几里得半直线路径积分。与轨道相关的参考态由相应共伴轨道上几何作用的路径积分确定。因此，共伴模由参考态及其后代张成。我们将此形式应用于 Virasoro 和 BMS$_3$ 群，并导出所有常值轨道对应的共伴模。我们还通过计数模内状态计算所有常值 Virasoro 和 BMS$_3$ 共伴轨道的特征标，结果与具有周期性欧几里得方向的几何作用路径积分的相应计算一致。
classification.one_liner: 通过单圈路径积分从共伴轨道构造 Virasoro 与 BMS$_3$ 量子模，并用态计数计算其特征标。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究 BMS$_3$/Virasoro 共伴轨道的路径积分量子化与模/特征标，属于平直时空或天球全息的形式理论；与用户列出的全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子/双组分BEC、D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜与Floquet驱动、经典引力/广义相对论等重点支线均无直接交集。

papers.title: A Geodesic Route toward Holography beyond AdS: Tessellating the Schwarzschild Black Hole
papers.abstract: In vacuum anti-de Sitter (AdS) space, the geometry admits a perfect tessellation by a geodesic network. This tessellation characterizes the background exactly, and a partial entanglement entropy (PEE) tensor-network toy model of AdS/CFT can be defined on it. It has so far been unclear whether this construction can be extended beyond vacuum AdS. In this paper we take the first step in this direction. We show that the exterior region of the Schwarzschild black hole and its Einstein--Rosen bridge are perfectly tessellated by a specific geodesic gas emitted from the boundary, so that Crofton reconstruction holds in these regions. We then prove that such a geodesic tessellation and the Crofton reconstruction it defines extend to more generic Riemannian manifolds. This allows us to construct a PEE tensor-network model of holographic duality on more generic geometric backgrounds. In the case of the PEE tensor-network model for the Schwarzschild background, we can concretely realize the Bekenstein--Hawking entropy, the Ryu--Takayanagi formula and the ER=EPR proposal. Our approach opens a new route towards holographic toy models beyond AdS/CFT.

classification.title_zh: 通向超越 AdS 全息的测地线路径：镶嵌史瓦西黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 在真空反 de Sitter (AdS) 空间中，几何可由一个测地线网络完美镶嵌。这种镶嵌精确刻画了背景，并可在其上定义 AdS/CFT 的部分纠缠熵 (PEE) 张量网络玩具模型。此前尚不清楚这一构造能否推广到真空 AdS 之外。本文迈出第一步：我们证明史瓦西黑洞外部区域及其爱因斯坦-罗森桥可由从边界发出的特定测地线气体完美镶嵌，从而在这些区域中 Crofton 重构成立。随后我们证明这种测地线镶嵌及其定义的 Crofton 重构可推广到更一般的黎曼流形。这使我们能在更一般的几何背景上构造全息对偶的 PEE 张量网络模型。对于史瓦西背景的 PEE 张量网络模型，我们可以具体实现 Bekenstein-Hawking 熵、Ryu-Takayanagi 公式和 ER=EPR 提议。我们的方法为超越 AdS/CFT 的全息玩具模型开辟了新路径。
classification.one_liner: 通过用边界发射的测地线气体镶嵌史瓦西黑洞外部与 ER 桥，并推广 Crofton 重构，构造超越 AdS 的 PEE 张量网络全息玩具模型，实现黑洞熵、RT 公式与 ER=EPR。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究将全息张量网络构造推广到史瓦西黑洞及更一般黎曼背景，涉及经典引力时空的测地线镶嵌、Crofton重构以及黑洞熵、RT公式和ER=EPR，与经典引力/广义相对论支线高度相关。

papers.title: Complex scalar field thick branes: stability of linear perturbation and evolution of scalar Kaluza-Klein modes coupled with gravity
papers.abstract: We investigate the stability and localization properties of Minkowski, de Sitter (dS), and anti-de Sitter (AdS) thick branes generated by a complex scalar field $\Phi$. The scalar self-interaction potential contains a temperature parameter $a$. As $a$ approaches its critical value, the imaginary part of $\Phi$ becomes double-kinked and the energy density splits into two peaks, indicating the formation of two sub-branes. The analysis of linear scalar, vector, and tensor perturbations shows no signs of instability in the scalar and vector sectors, while the factorization of the tensor perturbation equation excludes tachyonic tensor modes. The graviton zero mode is localized on the Minkowski and dS branes but is not normalizable on the AdS brane. We further study a real test scalar field $\Psi$ with a coupling function $F(R)$ between its kinetic term and the spacetime curvature. The scalar zero mode can always be localized on the Minkowski and dS branes, with a continuous gapless spectrum of scalar Kaluza--Klein (KK) modes. Massive scalar resonances emerge near the critical value of $a$ for suitable values of $\beta$. Increasing $\beta$ produces more resonances and prolongs the lifetimes of the lower resonances, while their time evolution exhibits the characteristic decay of metastable modes. For the AdS brane, the scalar zero mode is also localized, whereas the divergent effective potential at the boundaries traps the massive scalar KK modes as bound states, yielding a discrete mass spectrum.

secondary_topics: 非均匀态/孤子/涡旋/畴壁
classification.title_zh: 复标量场厚膜：线性微扰稳定性以及与引力耦合的标量 Kaluza-Klein 模式演化
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了由复标量场 Φ 生成的 Minkowski、de Sitter (dS) 和 anti-de Sitter (AdS) 厚膜的稳定性与局域化性质。标量自相互作用势包含温度参数 a。当 a 趋近其临界值时，Φ 的虚部变成双扭结，能量密度分裂为两个峰，表明形成两个子膜。对标量、矢量、张量线性微扰的分析表明标量和矢量扇区没有不稳定迹象，而张量微扰方程的分解排除了快子张量模式。引力子零模局域化在 Minkowski 和 dS 膜上，但在 AdS 膜上不可归一化。我们进一步研究了实检验标量场 Ψ，其动能项与时空曲率之间存在耦合函数 F(R)。标量零模总能局域化在 Minkowski 和 dS 膜上，并具有连续无隙的标量 Kaluza-Klein (KK) 模谱。对于合适的 β 值，在 a 的临界值附近出现大质量标量共振。增大 β 会产生更多共振并延长低共振的寿命，而其时间演化表现出亚稳模式的特征衰减。对于 AdS 膜，标量零模也被局域化，而边界处发散的有效势将大质量标量 KK 模束缚为束缚态，产生离散质量谱。
classification.one_liner: 复标量厚膜在线性微扰下稳定；标量 KK 模在临界参数附近出现共振，AdS 膜上则形成离散束缚态。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于膜世界/经典引力与厚膜微扰、KK 共振研究，涉及畴壁/孤子与亚稳模式衰减；不是全息 AdS/CFT 研究，但与经典引力及 QNM/共振重点标签相关。

papers.title: A Differential Form Description of Partial Entanglement Entropy: Testing a Killing Vector Construction in Covariant Phase Space
papers.abstract: The bit thread formulation provides a geometric description of holographic entanglement entropy, while partial entanglement entropy (PEE) and PEE threads resolve this structure with respect to individual boundary points. Motivated by the fact that PEE thread flows can be superposed to reconstruct conventional bit thread flows, we introduce a differential form description of PEE thread flow. For an interval in the vacuum AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$ setup, we show that the flux of the resulting form reproduces the known entanglement contour, providing a consistency check of the proposed description. We then investigate whether the PEE form can be related, possibly up to an exact form improvement, to a current constructed from the covariant phase space (CPS) formalism. As a first test, we consider exact Killing vectors in Rindler-AdS$_3$. The Rindler parameter $a$ parametrizes a one-parameter family of backgrounds. At each value of $a$, the Killing vector of the corresponding background is substituted into the Iyer-Wald surface charge form, and the full $a$-dependence of the resulting form is retained. We define a finite candidate current by integrating this surface charge form over $a$. For the reflection-symmetric PEE flow sourced at the central boundary point $r_0=0$, we find that no choice of the Killing parameters reproduces both components of the known PEE flow after transforming to Poincar\'e-AdS$_3$. This result shows that the direct Killing vector CPS construction considered here is not sufficient to reproduce the central PEE flow. Possible extensions include an exact form improvement, a different CPS current, or a more general choice of generator.

classification.title_zh: 部分纠缠熵的微分形式描述：在协变相空间中检验一个Killing矢量构造
classification.abstract_zh: 比特线表述为全息纠缠熵提供了几何描述，而部分纠缠熵（PEE）与PEE线则相对于每个边界点解析了这一结构。受PEE线流可以叠加重构常规比特线流的启发，我们引入PEE线流的微分形式描述。对于真空AdS3/CFT2中的一个区间，我们证明所得形式的通量再现了已知的纠缠轮廓，从而为该描述提供了一致性检验。随后我们研究PEE形式是否可能（最多相差一个恰当形式改进）与由协变相空间（CPS）形式构造的流相关。作为第一个检验，我们考虑Rindler-AdS3中的精确Killing矢量。Rindler参数a参数化了一族背景。在每个a值处，将相应背景的Killing矢量代入Iyer-Wald表面荷形式，并保留所得形式对a的完整依赖。我们通过对a积分该表面荷形式来定义一个有限候选流。对于中心边界点r0=0发出的反射对称PEE流，我们发现变换到Poincaré-AdS3后，没有任何Killing参数选择能同时再现已知PEE流的分量。该结果表明，这里考虑的直接Killing矢量CPS构造不足以再现中心PEE流。可能的扩展包括恰当形式改进、不同的CPS流，或更一般的生成元选择。
classification.one_liner: 本文用微分形式描述部分纠缠熵线流，并在AdS3/CFT2中检验Killing矢量协变相空间构造，发现其无法再现中心PEE流。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要涉及全息纠缠熵、部分纠缠熵与比特线/PEE线，属于AdS/CFT量子信息方向，但不属于用户列出的重点支线；虽使用协变相空间与Killing矢量，但并非以经典引力/广义相对论现象为主要研究对象。

papers.title: Entanglement entropy in holographic CFTs with generic boundaries
papers.abstract: Entanglement entropy in holographic conformal field theories with boundaries of generic spacetime signature cannot be described entirely within the standard holographic duality to a real bulk spacetime. We show, both in static and time-dependent setups, that an exact match with the conformal field theory predictions in two boundary dimensions entails an extension of the dual spacetime to complex coordinates. As a consequence, relevant bulk objects such as Ryu-Takayanagi surfaces and branes are in general complex, yet anchored on a real asymptotic boundary preserving the physical meaning of field-theoretical quantities. We also provide a third numerical check of the holographic prediction with a two-dimensional system of free Gaussian fermions exhibiting the same asymptotic regimes across different entanglement phases.

classification.title_zh: 具有一般边界的全息CFT中的纠缠熵
classification.abstract_zh: 具有一般时空签名边界的全息共形场论中的纠缠熵，不能完全用标准全息对偶到一个实体时空来描述。我们证明，在静态和含时设定下，要与两个边界维度上的共形场论预言精确匹配，需要将对偶时空延拓到复坐标。因此，诸如 Ryu-Takayanagi 面和膜等相关体对象一般而言是复的，但仍锚定在实的渐近边界上，从而保留场论量的物理意义。我们还用一个二维自由高斯费米子系统给出全息预言的第三个数值检验，该系统在不同纠缠相中表现出相同的渐近区域。
classification.one_liner: 为匹配有边界全息CFT的纠缠熵，需将体时空复化，使RT面与膜成为复对象但仍锚定实边界。

papers.title: Vector Superradiance without Separability: Instability Rates from the Worldline Effective Theory
papers.abstract: We use a point-particle effective field theory to study the superradiant instability rates of an ultralight massive vector around a slowly rotating black hole. Earlier effective-theory treatments reported an apparent $O(1)$ discrepancy with the rates obtained by solving the Proca equation on a fixed black-hole background, e.g. for the mode with $j=1$ and $\ell=2$. We show that there is in fact no discrepancy: once the leading-order states in the degenerate $\{\ell=0,\ell=2\}$ subspace are correctly identified, the effective theory (implemented here with the graviton integrated out exactly, and expanded in $\alpha$ only afterwards) reproduces \emph{all} of the $j=1$ Proca instability rates exactly, and it does so \emph{without} ever invoking the FKKS ansatz on which the full-theory calculation rests. Since it never relies on separability, the same approach applies, at least in principle, to rotating backgrounds and bodies that lack the hidden symmetries underlying that ansatz. The single ingredient beyond the far zone is a conservative worldline contact term, the static monopole response of the horizon in the parity-even $j=1$ Proca sector, which we fix by matching to the near zone. The same term shifts the fine-structure splitting of the bound states into exact agreement with the published Proca spectrum. In addition to providing a conceptually straightforward model of vector superradiance and resolving an apparent tension in the literature, we present this work to illustrate potential technical subtleties involving dissipative effects in point particle effective theories.

classification.title_zh: 无分离性的矢量超辐射：来自世界线有效理论的失稳率
classification.abstract_zh: 我们使用点粒子有效场论研究超轻大质量矢量场在缓转黑洞周围的超辐射不稳定性率。此前的有效场论处理报告了与在固定黑洞背景上求解 Proca 方程所得速率之间存在表观 O(1) 差异，例如对于 j=1、ℓ=2 的模式。我们表明实际上没有差异：一旦正确识别退化 {ℓ=0, ℓ=2} 子空间中的领头阶态，有效理论（这里将引力子精确积掉，随后仅按 α 展开）就精确重现所有 j=1 Proca 不稳定性率，而且无需引入完整理论计算所依赖的 FKKS ansatz。由于它从不依赖可分离性，同一方法原则上可应用于缺乏该 ansatz 所依赖的隐藏对称性的转动背景和天体。远区之外的唯一额外要素是一个守恒的世界线接触项，即视界在宇称偶 j=1 Proca 扇区中的静态单极响应，我们通过匹配近区来固定它。同一项还使束缚态的精细结构分裂移动至与已发表的 Proca 谱完全一致。除了提供矢量超辐射的一个概念上直接的模型并解决文献中的一个表观矛盾外，我们展示这项工作是为了说明点粒子有效理论中涉及耗散效应的潜在技术微妙之处。
classification.one_liner: 用点粒子世界线有效理论无需 FKKS 可分离性假设，精确重现缓转黑洞周围 j=1 Proca 矢量超辐射不稳定性率，并强调接触项与耗散效应的重要性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究转动黑洞背景下 Proca 场的超辐射不稳定性，属于经典引力/黑洞微扰与有效场论，并直接匹配用户重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”；不涉及全息对偶或量子引力。

papers.title: A Pontryagin class obstruction for purely electric and purely magnetic Weyl curvature tensors
papers.abstract: Do all manifolds that admit Lorentzian metrics also admit such metrics that have a purely electric (PE) or purely magnetic (PM) Weyl curvature tensor? To (partially) answer this question, we show that for all algebraic curvature tensors on a $4k$-dimensional scalar product space that are even or odd under the action of a orientation-reversing isometry, the products of Pontryagin forms that land in the top-degree exterior power of the dual vector space vanish. We use this to derive the vanishing of all products of Pontryagin classes that land in the top-degree de Rham cohomology of a $4k$-dimensional pseudo-Riemannian manifold with a PE or PM Riemann or Weyl curvature tensor. For compact manifolds, this gives nontrivial cohomological obstructions to the existence of such pseudo-Riemannian metrics with globally PE or PM Riemann or Weyl curvature tensors. These obstructions can be linked to the existence of Lorentzian metrics of several Petrov subtypes, which play an important role in classifying exact solutions to the Einstein equations. Moreover, they can be applied to foliations by nondegenerate umbilic hypersurfaces, which may appear as timeslices of spacetimes.

classification.title_zh: 关于纯电与纯磁Weyl曲率张量的Pontryagin类障碍
classification.abstract_zh: 是否所有容许洛伦兹度规的流形也都容许具有纯电（PE）或纯磁（PM）Weyl曲率张量的此类度规？为（部分）回答此问题，我们证明：对于4k维标量积空间上所有在定向反转等距作用下为偶或为奇的代数曲率张量，落在对偶向量空间最高次外幂中的Pontryagin形式乘积为零。我们由此推出：对于具有PE或PM Riemann或Weyl曲率张量的4k维伪黎曼流形，其所有落在最高次de Rham上同调中的Pontryagin类乘积均为零。对紧流形，这给出存在全局PE或PM Riemann或Weyl曲率张量的此类伪黎曼度规的非平凡上同调障碍。这些障碍可与若干Petrov子类型的洛伦兹度规存在性相联系，而Petrov分类在Einstein方程精确解分类中起重要作用。此外，它们可应用于非退化脐超曲面叶状结构，此类超曲面可能作为时空的时间切片出现。
classification.one_liner: 该文用Pontryagin类给出伪黎曼流形上全局纯电/纯磁Riemann或Weyl曲率张量存在的上同调障碍，并联系Petrov分类与Einstein方程精确解。

papers.title: Impact of soft versus hard equations of state on hybrid stars
papers.abstract: The nuclear stiffness as a dominant contribution of nuclear symmetry energy is analyzed on the properties of compact stars considering constraints from nuclear physics and astrophysics. A compact star can be a neutron star composed only of nuclear matter or a hybrid star with a quark core. Two typical models (soft and stiff) are considered for the nuclear equation of state, and for the hybrid one, a parameterized first-order phase transition approach, completed with a linear quark matter equation of state, is implemented. We show that the phase transition reduces the tension between GW170817 and NICER observations, and we illustrate the impact of nuclear stiffness for the understanding of the nature of the binary system in GW170817. The implication on nuclear symmetry energy is also discussed. We also confirm our previous findings that the GW170817 waveform is best described as a binary HS with a low-density onset of stiff quark matter. This could also be interpreted as a quarkyonic cross-over.

classification.title_zh: 软与硬状态方程对混合星的影响
classification.abstract_zh: 核刚度作为核对称能的主要贡献，在考虑核物理与天体物理约束下，被分析其对致密星性质的影响。致密星可以是仅由核物质构成的中子星，也可以是带有夸克核心的混合星。针对核状态方程考虑两种典型模型（软和硬），对于混合星，采用参数化的一阶相变方法，并辅以线性夸克物质状态方程。我们表明，相变降低了 GW170817 与 NICER 观测之间的张力，并说明了核刚度对于理解 GW170817 中双星系统性质的影响。还讨论了其对核对称能的启示。我们也证实了此前的发现：GW170817 的波形最好被描述为一个具有低密度起始的硬夸克物质的混合星双星。这也可以被解释为 quarkyonic 交叉。

papers.title: Crossover to Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev criticality in an infinite-range quantum Heisenberg spin glass
papers.abstract: A central question in frustrated quantum magnets is how quantum fluctuations destabilize spin-glass order and promote quantum spin-liquid behavior. We study the equilibrium dynamics of an infinite-range quantum Heisenberg model with random couplings, in which local magnetic moments arise from $\mathcal{N}_f$ flavors of spinful fermions. We employ an expansion in $\mathcal{N}_f$, which controls the strength of quantum fluctuations, and self-consistently include $1/\mathcal{N}_f$ corrections to the Luttinger-Ward functional. In the large-$\mathcal{N}_f$ limit, where quantum fluctuations are weak, the high- and low-temperature phases are respectively paramagnetic and spin glass ordered, with a transition temperature independent of $\mathcal{N}_f$. For small numbers of fermionic flavors, however, quantum fluctuations substantially suppress the ordering temperature. We show that this behavior reflects the proximity of the system to a Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) regime, realizing quantum spin-liquid dynamics over a broad range of finite frequencies, where both fermionic and spin spectral densities display critical behavior over a broad range of finite frequencies, with the latter exhibiting the scale-invariant form $\chi''(\omega)\sim\operatorname{sgn}(\omega)$. At the lowest energies and temperatures, spin glass dynamics ultimately take over, producing a universal sub-Ohmic dynamical spin susceptibility $\chi''(\omega)\sim\operatorname{sgn}(\omega)\sqrt{|\omega|}$. Our results highlight a direct connection between the suppression of spin-glass order and the emergence of SYK criticality in a frustrated quantum magnet.

classification.title_zh: 无限程量子海森堡自旋玻璃中向 Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev 临界性的渡越
classification.abstract_zh: 阻挫量子磁体的一个核心问题是量子涨落如何破坏自旋玻璃序并促进量子自旋液体行为。我们研究具有随机耦合的无限程量子海森堡模型的平衡动力学，其中局域磁矩来自 N_f 种自旋费米子味道。我们采用 N_f 展开（它控制量子涨落强度），并自洽地包含对 Luttinger-Ward 泛函的 1/N_f 修正。在大 N_f 极限下，量子涨落较弱，高温相和低温相分别是顺磁相和自旋玻璃有序相，转变温度与 N_f 无关。然而，对于少量费米子味道，量子涨落显著抑制有序温度。我们证明这种行为反映了系统接近 Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) 区域，在很宽的有限频率范围内实现量子自旋液体动力学，其中费米子和自旋谱密度都显示临界行为，自旋谱密度的标度不变形式为 χ''(ω) ~ sgn(ω)。在最低能量和温度下，自旋玻璃动力学最终占主导，产生普适的亚欧姆动力学自旋磁化率 χ''(ω) ~ sgn(ω) sqrt(|ω|)。我们的结果突出了阻挫量子磁体中自旋玻璃序的抑制与 SYK 临界性出现之间的直接联系。
classification.one_liner: 通过大 N_f 展开和 1/N_f 修正，论文表明无限程量子海森堡自旋玻璃在量子涨落增强时趋近 SYK 临界区，并在最低能量下恢复普适的亚欧姆自旋玻璃动力学。

papers.title: Analyzing GW231109_235456 and understanding its potential implications for population studies, nuclear physics, and multi-messenger astronomy
papers.abstract: We study the gravitational-wave trigger GW231109_235456, a sub-threshold binary neutron star merger candidate observed in the first part of the fourth observing run of the LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA collaboration. Assuming the trigger is of astrophysical origin, we analyze it using state-of-the-art waveform models and investigate the robustness of the inferred source parameters under different prior choices in Bayesian inference. We assess the implications for population studies, nuclear physics, and multi-messenger astronomy. Analyzing the component masses, we find that GW231109_235456, if astrophysical, supports the proposed double Gaussian mass distribution of neutron stars. Moreover, we find that the remnant most likely collapsed promptly to a black hole and that, because of the large distance, a possible kilonova connected to the merger was noticeably dimmer than AT2017gfo but within reach of observatories such as LSST and Roman. In addition, we provide constraints on the equation of state from the candidate GW231109_235456 alone, as well as combined with GW170817 and GW190425. In our projections for the future, we simulate a similar event using the planned next generation of ground-based gravitational-wave detectors. Our findings indicate that we can constrain the tidal deformability of a $1.4 \ M_\odot$ neutron star to about $10\%$, depending on the specific designs and network considered.

classification.title_zh: 分析 GW231109_235456 及其对族群研究、核物理和多信使天文学的潜在意义
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了引力波触发事件 GW231109_235456，这是 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 合作组第四次观测运行第一阶段观测到的亚阈值双中子星并合候选体。假设该触发事件来自天体物理起源，我们使用最先进的波形模型对其进行分析，并在贝叶斯推断中检验不同先验选择下推断源参数的稳健性。我们评估其对族群研究、核物理和多信使天文学的意义。通过分析组分质量，我们发现若 GW231109_235456 为天体物理起源，它支持中子星质量分布的双高斯模型。此外，我们发现其遗迹最可能直接坍缩为黑洞；由于距离较远，与该并合相关的可能千新星会明显比 AT2017gfo 暗，但仍处于 LSST 和 Roman 等天文台的观测能力范围内。我们还给出了仅由候选体 GW231109_235456 以及联合 GW170817 和 GW190425 对所中子星物态方程的约束。在对未来的投影中，我们使用计划中的下一代地基引力波探测器模拟了一个类似事件。结果表明，根据具体设计和所考虑的探测器网络，我们可以将 1.4 太阳质量中子星的潮汐形变约束到约 10%。
classification.one_liner: 对亚阈值双中子星并合候选体 GW231109_235456 的波形与贝叶斯分析，及其在族群、核物理和多信使天文学中的潜在意义。

papers.title: Bridging the chirp-mass gap: searching for gravitational waves from inspiraling subsolar-mass ultra-compact binaries using LIGO O4ab data
papers.abstract: Gravitational-wave searches for subsolar-mass compact binaries have left a gap between the planetary-mass regime accessible to long-duration searches and the higher masses probed by conventional compact-binary analyses. We close this gap by searching for the inspiral of ultra-compact binaries with chirp masses $10^{-2}$--$10^{-1}\,M_\odot$ in LIGO O4ab data. Using the statistically robust BinaryGFH-v2 method, a time-frequency technique to search for rapidly evolving inspirals lasting minutes to hours, we cover this previously challenging parameter space with a computational cost of only $\sim 350$ CPU-hours, and find no significant candidates. We thus set 90\% confidence upper limits on the binary merger-rate density, providing the first gravitational-wave constraints across this chirp-mass range. Assuming that primordial-black-hole binaries formed in the early Universe with no binary suppression ($f_{\rm sup}=1$), these results provide the first gravitational-wave constraints on the primordial-black-hole \dmh fraction in this mass range, yielding upper limits with $f_{\rm PBH}<1$ for equal-mass binaries with component masses $10^{-2}$--$10^{-1}\,M_\odot$ and asymmetric binaries with secondary masses $m_2=3\times10^{-4}$--$10^{-2}\,M_\odot$ for a primary mass $m_1=2.5\,M_\odot$.

classification.title_zh: 弥合啁啾质量间隙：使用 LIGO O4ab 数据搜寻旋近中的亚太阳质量超致密双星引力波
classification.abstract_zh: 对亚太阳质量致密双星的引力波搜寻在长时搜寻可及的行星质量区间与常规致密双星分析探测的较高质量区间之间留下了一个间隙。我们通过使用统计稳健的 BinaryGFH-v2 方法，在 LIGO O4ab 数据中搜寻啁啾质量为 10^-2–10^-1 M⊙ 的超致密双星旋近，弥合了这一间隙。该方法是一种时频技术，用于搜寻持续数分钟至数小时、快速演化的旋近信号；我们以仅约 350 CPU 小时的计算成本覆盖了这一此前具有挑战性的参数空间，未发现显著候选。因此，我们对双星并合率密度给出 90% 置信度上限，首次在该啁啾质量范围内提供引力波限制。假设早期宇宙形成的原初黑洞双星没有双星抑制（f_sup=1），这些结果首次给出该质量范围内原初黑洞暗物质占比的引力波限制：对于等质量双星，其组分质量为 10^-2–10^-1 M⊙，以及主星质量 m1=2.5 M⊙、次星质量 m2=3×10^-4–10^-2 M⊙ 的非对称双星，得到 f_PBH<1 的上限。
classification.one_liner: 利用 BinaryGFH-v2 在 LIGO O4ab 数据中搜寻啁啾质量 10^-2–10^-1 M⊙ 的亚太阳质量超致密双星旋近，未发现显著候选并给出首个该质量范围的引力波与原初黑洞占比上限。

papers.title: Horizon structure and extremal configurations of Kerr-Newman-anti-de Sitter black holes in f(R) gravity
papers.abstract: Exploiting the correspondence between Kerr--Newman--(A)dS black hole solutions in general relativity and their constant-curvature counterparts in $f(R)$ gravity, we employ a unified framework to investigate the horizon structure and extremal configurations of these black holes, focusing primarily on the anti--de Sitter case. By solving the extremality conditions with respect to the squared rotation parameter $a^2$ and the inverse curvature scale $l^{-2}$, we obtain closed analytic relations that provide a transparent parametrization of the extremal branch in the $(a^2,\, l^{-2})$ parameter space. We determine the physically admissible domain of the rotating extremal branch and derive the corresponding critical charge, $q_{\max}=M/2$, at which the metric becomes singular and the branch reaches its critical rotation limit. For vanishing electric charge, the rotation parameter decreases monotonically along the extremal branch and remains bounded from below, implying the existence of a minimal rotation, $a_{\min}=3\sqrt{3}M/8$. The rotating extremal branch also exhibits a distinguished internal point at which the normalized rotational and curvature scales coincide. The inclusion of electric charge introduces an additional competing scale, broadening the rotating extremal branch while lowering the corresponding minimal rotation to $a_{\min}=M/4$ at the critical charge $q_{\max}=M/2$. Comparing these results with the corresponding de Sitter case, we show that extremality in AdS is constrained by a geometric endpoint, whereas the dS branch exhibits a considerably richer structure characterized by an ultra-extremal maximum and a subsequent decay toward the non-rotating limit. Finally, we demonstrate that the algebraic mass constraint associated with the quartic horizon equation completely removes the real-root structure, yielding a class of solutions without physical horizons.

classification.title_zh: f(R)引力中Kerr-Newman-anti-de Sitter黑洞的视界结构与极端构型
classification.abstract_zh: 利用广义相对论中Kerr-Newman-(A)dS黑洞解与它们在f(R)引力中的常曲率对应解之间的对应关系，我们采用统一框架研究这些黑洞的视界结构和极端构型，主要关注anti-de Sitter情形。通过求解关于旋转参数平方a^2和逆曲率标度l^{-2}的极端性条件，我们得到闭合解析关系，从而在(a^2,l^{-2})参数空间中透明地参数化极端分支。我们确定旋转极端分支的物理允许域，并推导出相应的临界电荷q_max=M/2；此时度规变为奇异，分支达到临界旋转极限。对于零电荷，旋转参数沿极端分支单调减小且有下界，意味着存在最小旋转a_min=3√3M/8。旋转极端分支还具有一个特殊内点，在该点归一化旋转标度与曲率标度重合。引入电荷会引入额外竞争标度，拓宽旋转极端分支，并在临界电荷q_max=M/2时将最小旋转降低至a_min=M/4。与相应的de Sitter情形比较，我们表明AdS中的极端性受到几何端点约束，而dS分支结构更为丰富，具有超极端极大值以及随后向非旋转极限的衰减。最后，我们证明与四阶视界方程相关的代数质量约束完全消除实根结构，给出一类没有物理视界的解。
classification.one_liner: 在f(R)引力框架下分析Kerr-Newman-AdS黑洞的视界结构与极端构型，给出极端分支参数域、临界电荷和最小旋转，并与dS情形对比。

papers.title: Open Data from LIGO, Virgo, and KAGRA through the First Part of the Fourth Observing Run
papers.abstract: LIGO, Virgo, and KAGRA form a network of gravitational-wave observatories. Data and analysis results from this network are made publicly available through the Gravitational Wave Open Science Center. This paper describes open data from this network, including the addition of data from the first part of the fourth observing run and selected periods from the preceding engineering run, collected from 2023 May to 2024 January. The public dataset includes calibrated strain time series for each instrument, data from additional channels used for noise subtraction and detector characterization, and analysis data products from version 4.0 of the Gravitational-Wave Transient Catalog.
authors: J. F. J. van den Brand

classification.title_zh: LIGO、Virgo 和 KAGRA 第四次观测运行第一部分的开放数据
classification.abstract_zh: LIGO、Virgo 和 KAGRA 构成一个引力波天文台网络。该网络的数据和分析结果通过引力波开放科学中心公开发布。本文介绍该网络的开放数据，包括新增的第四次观测运行第一部分数据以及此前工程运行的选定时段数据，采集时间为2023年5月至2024年1月。公开数据集包括每台仪器的校准应变时间序列、用于噪声扣除和探测器表征的附加通道数据，以及引力波瞬变星表4.0版的分析数据产品。

papers.title: Relic gravitational waves from primordial gravitational collapses
papers.abstract: A large primordial density perturbation of the Hubble scale will gravitationally collapse, generating an outgoing sound shell, whether or not a primordial black hole (PBH) is formed. In this Letter, we report a hybrid numerical analysis of the stochastic gravitational wave background induced by the collision of sound shells in the early Universe. The peak frequency and amplitude in the GW spectrum depend on the Hubble horizon and the abundance of sound shells. Abundant density perturbations would lead to GW backgrounds potentially detectable for future pulsar timing arrays and ground-based/space-borne detectors. For those perturbations that collapse into PBHs, future null detection of the corresponding high-frequency GW background could put new observational constraints on those PBHs that have already evaporated.

classification.title_zh: 来自原初引力坍缩的遗迹引力波
classification.abstract_zh: 哈勃尺度的大原初密度扰动会发生引力坍缩，无论是否形成原初黑洞（PBH），都会产生一个向外传播的声壳。在这封信中，我们报告了对早期宇宙中声壳碰撞诱导的随机引力波背景的混合数值分析。引力波谱的峰值频率和振幅取决于哈勃视界和声壳丰度。丰富的密度扰动会导致未来脉冲星计时阵列和地基/空间探测器可能探测到的引力波背景。对于那些坍缩成PBH的扰动，未来对相应高频引力波背景的零探测，可以对那些已经蒸发的PBH给出新的观测约束。
classification.one_liner: 本文用混合数值分析研究了原初密度扰动坍缩形成声壳并碰撞产生的随机引力波背景，及其对原初黑洞的观测约束。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/宇宙学中的原初黑洞形成与随机引力波背景研究，匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；但不涉及AdS/CFT全息各支线，因此与全息重点方向相关性有限。

papers.title: The linear instability of Kasner spacetimes
papers.abstract: We prove linear stability of Kasner spacetimes in the direction of the Big Bang, up to an explicit finite dimensional space of non-decaying self-similar solutions. The fastest growing solution is the linearization of Taub's explicit Bianchi II solution, describing a Kasner transition. All other non-decaying solutions are inhomogeneous analogues of this, and the linearized Kasner metric. The key novelty is a notion of quasinormal modes on Kasner spacetimes, similar to quasinormal modes on stationary black holes spacetimes. All quiescent (as opposed to oscillatory) vacuum Big Bang spacetimes of dimension 4 are asymptotic to a Kasner spacetime from the perspective of a single observer at the Big Bang. They are expected to be highly unstable due to the oscillations conjectured by Belinski, Khalatnikov and Lifschitz. This paper provides a complete description of this instability on a linear level without symmetry assumptions.

classification.title_zh: Kasner 时空的线性不稳定性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们证明 Kasner 时空在趋向大爆炸方向上的线性稳定性，允许一个显式的有限维非衰减自相似解空间。增长最快的解是 Taub 显式 Bianchi II 解的线性化，描述一次 Kasner 跃迁。所有其他非衰减解都是其非均匀类比，以及线性化 Kasner 度规。关键创新是 Kasner 时空上的准正规模概念，类似静止黑洞时空上的准正规模。所有四维宁静（相对于振荡）真空大爆炸时空，从大爆炸处单个观察者的视角看，都渐近于一个 Kasner 时空。由于 Belinski、Khalatnikov 和 Lifschitz 猜想的振荡，它们预期高度不稳定。本文在没有对称性假设下，在线性层面完整描述了这种不稳定性。
classification.one_liner: 论文在无对称性假设下给出 Kasner 时空大爆炸方向线性不稳定性的完整描述，并引入 Kasner 时空准正规模。

papers.title: Stasis Combs: Gravitational-Wave Signatures of Recurrent Cosmological Stasis
papers.abstract: Cosmological stasis can recur multiple times, and each occurrence imprints a characteristic feature on the inflationary gravitational wave background (IGWB). We extend the single-epoch spectral template to an arbitrary number $N$ of consecutive stasis epochs, deriving a closed-form $N$-epoch piecewise template that factorizes cleanly: the amplitude steps at each break are determined entirely by the local equation of state $w_s^{(i)}$ of that epoch, while the inter-epoch plateau levels encode the accumulated spectral tilt from all prior epochs. Each resolved spectral feature yields an independent test of the Bessel-function consistency relation $C^2 = C^2(\alpha)$ established in~\cite{BarenboimBurns:paper1}, and the probability that $N$ such tests are simultaneously satisfied by a non-stasis spectrum falls sharply with $N$, making a confirmed multi-epoch comb the strongest available discriminator against constant-$w$ alternatives. We apply the formalism to the triple-stasis scenario of~\cite{Dienes:2023ziv}, which chains three pairwise stasis mechanisms (matter/radiation, vacuum-energy/matter, vacuum-energy/radiation) sequentially. For each block we derive the conditions under which the epoch lies within the template's validity range $w_s > -1/3$. We show that the Fig.~3 benchmark of~\cite{Dienes:2023ziv} falls outside this range and identify parameter choices that are both physically realizable and accessible to the template. We validate the inter-plateau ratio predictions numerically for representative two- and three-block chains, and work out the touching-epoch limit in which consecutive blocks share a break frequency without an intervening radiation-dominated interval. Finally, we discuss the detectability of a variety of multi-epoch stasis scenarios and give the minimum detectable tensor-to-scalar ratio as a function of the number of recurrent stasis epochs.

classification.title_zh: 停滞梳：重复宇宙学停滞的引力波特征
classification.abstract_zh: 宇宙学停滞可以多次重复，每一次都会在暴胀引力波背景（IGWB）上留下特征印记。我们将单历元谱模板推广到任意 N 个连续停滞历元，推导出闭式的 N 历元分段模板；该模板可干净地因子化：每个断点处的振幅台阶完全由该历元的局域状态方程 w_s^{(i)} 决定，而历元间平台高度则编码了此前所有历元累积的谱倾斜。每一个可分辨的谱特征都提供对文献中建立的 Bessel 函数一致性关系 C^2 = C^2(α) 的独立检验；N 个此类检验被非停滞谱同时满足的概率随 N 急剧下降，因此一个得到确认的多历元梳是对常 w 替代方案的最强判别。我们将此形式应用于文献中的三重停滞情景，该情景依次串联三种两两停滞机制（物质/辐射、真空能/物质、真空能/辐射）。对每个区块，我们导出历元位于模板有效范围 w_s > -1/3 内的条件。我们表明文献中的 Fig. 3 基准落在该范围之外，并识别出既物理可实现又可用该模板处理的参数选择。我们针对代表性的两区块和三区块链数值验证了平台间比值预言，并讨论了相邻区块共享一个断点频率、且中间没有辐射主导间隔的接触历元极限。最后，我们讨论多种多历元停滞情景的可探测性，并给出最小可探测张量标量比随重复停滞历元数的函数。
classification.one_liner: 将单历元宇宙停滞的暴胀引力波背景谱模板推广到 N 个连续停滞历元，给出可分辨梳状特征与可探测性判据。

papers.title: Lukewarm inflation, primordial black holes and gravitational waves
papers.abstract: We show that a secondary period of warm inflation, at temperatures parametrically below the GUT scale, may not only dilute any unwanted thermal relics formed after reheating but also significantly enhance the power spectrum of primordial curvature perturbations on small scales. The latter is nearly scale-invariant over an exponentially large range of comoving scales, resulting in a stochastic gravitational wave background with a nearly constant energy density over a broad range of frequencies and an associated population of sub-solar mass primordial black holes (PBHs). This scenario could, in particular, explain the NANOGrav signal if it persists at much higher frequencies with a comparable magnitude, up to a sharp cut-off, $f_{max}$. The associated PBH mass distribution may exhibit either a peak at a mass $M_*\propto f_{max}^{-2}$ or a broad plateaux above this mass threshold, depending on the spectral tilt. Moreover, in this scenario the NANOGrav signal is compatible with a significant fraction of dark matter in PBHs in the asteroid- and planetary-mass ranges.

classification.title_zh: 温凉暴胀、原初黑洞与引力波
classification.abstract_zh: 我们表明，温度参数化地低于 GUT 尺度的次级温暴胀时期，不仅可以稀释再加热后形成的任何不需要的热遗物，还可以显著增强小尺度上原初曲率扰动的功率谱。后者在指数级大的共动尺度范围内近似尺度不变，从而产生一个在宽广频率范围内能量密度近似恒定的随机引力波背景，以及伴随的亚太阳质量原初黑洞（PBH）种群。该情景尤其可以解释 NANOGrav 信号，如果该信号在更高频率上以相当幅度持续存在，直至一个尖锐截断 f_max。相关的 PBH 质量分布可能呈现为在质量 M_* ∝ f_max^{-2} 处的峰，或在该质量阈值以上的宽平台，取决于谱倾斜。此外，在该情景下，NANOGrav 信号与在小行星质量和行星质量范围内的 PBH 构成显著暗物质组分相容。
classification.one_liner: 次级温暴胀可增强小尺度曲率扰动，产生近恒定随机引力波背景和原初黑洞，并解释 NANOGrav 信号及暗物质。
