papers.title: The Page Transition in the Multi-Time Correlations of Hawking Radiation
papers.abstract: The Page curve and the island formula describe a reorganization of quantum information in Hawking radiation across the Page time. We study how this reorganization appears in correlations among emissions collected at several retarded times. The late radiation is treated as a covariant multi-time process, or process tensor, and $\chi_{\mathrm{island}}=\mathcal{N}_{\varnothing}-\mathcal{N}_{R}$ measures the temporal memory removed when the early radiation register $R$ is supplied. Operationally, this quantity is the corresponding change in the optimal distinguishability of the radiation process from a Markovian reference. We exhibit evaporation processes whose single-bin states and all process marginals below a finite order $k_\ast\geq 3$ remain fixed and coincide with a CP-divisible reference, while $\chi_{\mathrm{island}}$ changes by order one at order $k_\ast$. The Page transition can therefore appear as a transition in the Markov order of the radiation process. When the interior mediates the late-time memory, entanglement-wedge reconstruction of the predictive interior from $R$ Markovianizes the late process; conversely, when the late process has a minimal predictive memory and its future-affecting information is mediated by that memory, Markovianization by $R$ supplies a simulator of its influence. A Hayden--Preskill evaporation comb and an evaporating-JT calculation realize this mechanism. The late radiation retains temporal memory across the transition, while the early radiation becomes sufficient for predicting its future multi-time statistics.

classification.title_zh: 霍金辐射多时间关联中的 Page 转变
classification.abstract_zh: Page 曲线和 island 公式描述了跨越 Page 时间时霍金辐射中量子信息的重组。我们研究这种重组如何出现在若干延迟时间所收集发射之间的关联中。晚期辐射被处理为一个协变多时间过程，即过程张量，而 χ_island = N_∅ − N_R 度量了当早期辐射寄存器 R 被提供时被移除的时间记忆。操作上，该量对应于辐射过程与马尔可夫参考之间最优可区分性的相应变化。我们展示了一些蒸发过程，其单箱态以及低于有限阶 k_* ≥ 3 的所有过程边际保持不变，并与一个 CP-可除参考一致，而 χ_island 在阶 k_* 处发生量级为一的变化。因此，Page 转变可以表现为辐射过程马尔可夫阶的转变。当内部介导晚期记忆时，从 R 对可预测内部的纠缠楔重构使晚期过程马尔可夫化；反之，当晚期过程具有最小预测记忆，且其影响未来的信息由该记忆介导时，由 R 进行的马尔可夫化提供了其影响的模拟器。一个 Hayden--Preskill 蒸发梳和一个蒸发 JT 计算实现了这一机制。晚期辐射在转变过程中保留时间记忆，而早期辐射变得足以预测其未来多时间统计。
classification.one_liner: 该文将 Page 转变刻画为霍金辐射多时间过程马尔可夫阶的变化，并用 Hayden--Preskill 蒸发梳与蒸发 JT 计算实现该机制。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接处理 Page 曲线、island 公式、霍金辐射量子信息重组、纠缠楔重构与蒸发 JT 计算，属于全息量子引力/黑洞信息核心议题。

papers.title: Learning the Emergent Bulk Geometry of the Three Dimensional Ising Model
papers.abstract: We use Monte Carlo data for the three-dimensional Ising model at the critical temperature to predict an emergent radial geometry of the bulk using machine learning. Specifically, we employ a differentiable solver for a probe field on an asymptotically $\mathrm{AdS}_4$ background, trained to reproduce the measured momentum-space two-point functions of the boundary operators ($\sigma$ and $\epsilon$). We find that a single metric cannot simultaneously serve both operators. Fitting each channel separately improves its own residual by a factor of three to five, but degrades the other by up to two orders of magnitude. We quantify this tension between the two operators and show that it survives changes to the momentum window and the lattice size. Our results numerically demonstrate that the bulk geometry of a theory with an $\mathcal{O}(1)$ central charge, such as the 3D Ising model, is not captured by a single classical metric.

classification.title_zh: 学习三维 Ising 模型的涌现体几何
classification.abstract_zh: 我们使用三维 Ising 模型在临界温度下的蒙特卡洛数据，通过机器学习预测其体时空的涌现径向几何。具体地，我们采用一个可微求解器，在渐近 AdS4 背景上求解探针场，并训练其再现边界算符（σ 和 ε）在动量空间的两点函数。我们发现单一度规无法同时服务于这两个算符。分别拟合每个通道可将其自身残差改善三到五倍，但会使另一个通道退化最多两个数量级。我们量化了两个算符之间的这种张力，并表明它在动量窗口和格点大小改变后仍然存在。我们的结果在数值上表明，对于中心荷为 O(1) 的理论（如三维 Ising 模型），其体几何不能被单一经典度规所描述。
classification.one_liner: 通过机器学习拟合三维 Ising 临界模型的边界两点函数，发现 σ 与 ε 算符需要不同的体度规，单一经典 AdS4 度规无法同时描述。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT 基础与字典/体几何重构，但未直接涉及用户列出的全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7/Floquet 或经典引力等具体重点标签。

papers.title: Dirac oscillator in a self-gravitating cosmic string: confinement spectra beyond the conical approximation
papers.abstract: The gravitational field of a physical cosmic string is regular on the axis, curved across a finite vortex core, and only asymptotically conical. We test whether the bound-state spectrum of a transverse Dirac oscillator resolves this structure beyond the ideal-cone approximation. The fermion is treated as a test field on self-consistent Einstein--Abelian-Higgs vortex backgrounds, and the radial problem is cast as a generalized Hermitian eigenvalue problem. The numerical formulation is checked against the exact Minkowski and ideal-cone spectra and by independent shooting calculations. For a reference vortex family, the finite-core correction grows from the weak-confinement regime toward the percent level. When the normalized asymptotic cone is held fixed, the spectrum still varies with the measured Higgs-core radius, and the sampled backgrounds bracket a change of sign of the ground-state correction. The bound-state spectrum therefore contains information about the resolved core profiles that is not fixed by the asymptotic cone alone.

classification.primary_topic: 非均匀态/孤子/涡旋/畴壁
classification.title_zh: 自引力宇宙弦中的狄拉克振子：超越圆锥近似的束缚谱
classification.abstract_zh: 物理宇宙弦的引力场在轴上是正则的，在有限涡旋核内是弯曲的，并且仅渐近为圆锥形。我们检验横向狄拉克振子的束缚态谱是否能分辨理想锥近似之外的结构。费米子被当作自洽 Einstein–Abelian–Higgs 涡旋背景上的试探场，径向问题被表述为广义 Hermitian 本征值问题。数值方案通过与精确的 Minkowski 和理想锥谱以及独立打靶计算进行校验。对于参考涡旋族，有限核修正从弱束缚区域增长到百分量级。当归一化渐近锥固定时，谱仍随测得的 Higgs 核半径变化，且所采样的背景夹住基态修正的符号变化。因此束缚态谱包含有关已分辨核剖面的信息，而仅靠渐近锥无法固定这些信息。
classification.one_liner: 在自洽 Einstein–Abelian–Higgs 宇宙弦涡旋背景上计算横向狄拉克振子束缚态，表明有限核剖面修正可达百分量级且不被渐近锥唯一决定。
classification.relevance_reason: 非全息研究；涉及自引力宇宙弦/Einstein–Abelian–Higgs 涡旋与狄拉克振子束缚态，匹配经典引力/广义相对论及涡旋/非均匀重点标签，但不属于 AdS/CFT 全息支线。

papers.title: Supersymmetric boundary algebras in AdS$_3$ gravity: constraints, Dirac brackets and non-locality
papers.abstract: We study supersymmetric boundary dynamics in AdS$_3$ gravity by treating boundary conditions as constrained reductions of a generic Chern-Simons boundary phase space. We focus on how the constraint structure controls the locality and physical field content of the reduced asymptotic symmetry algebra. For supersymmetric Kac--Moody boundary conditions, the surviving bosonic currents remain local, whereas the fermion--fermion Dirac bracket contains the inverse of a field-dependent first-order differential operator and is therefore intrinsically non-local. Imposing an additional fermionic constraint reveals a further structure: after the bosonic second-class reduction, it becomes first class and generates a fermionic gauge redundancy. Generically the remaining fermionic field can be gauged away, while special backgrounds with periodic zero modes support non-trivial physical fermionic sectors. We further employ the Batalin--Fradkin--Tyutin formalism to eliminate the non-locality of the reduced symmetry algebra by converting the second-class constraints into an equivalent local first-class system on an enlarged phase space.

classification.title_zh: AdS$_3$ 引力中的超对称边界代数：约束、Dirac 括号与非局域性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们通过将边界条件视为一般 Chern-Simons 边界相空间的约束约化，研究 AdS$_3$ 引力中的超对称边界动力学。我们关注约束结构如何控制约化后渐近对称代数的局域性和物理场内容。对于超对称 Kac--Moody 边界条件，幸存的玻色流保持局域，而费米子--费米子 Dirac 括号包含一个场依赖的一阶微分算子的逆，因此本质上是非局域的。施加额外的费米子约束会揭示进一步结构：在玻色子第二类约化之后，该约束变为第一类，并产生一个费米子规范冗余。一般而言，剩余费米子场可以被规范掉，而具有周期零模的特殊背景支持非平凡的物理费米子扇区。我们进一步采用 Batalin--Fradkin--Tyutin 形式，通过在扩大的相空间上将第二类约束转化为等价的局域第一类系统，从而消除约化对称代数的非局域性。
classification.one_liner: 本文用 Chern-Simons 边界约束约化分析 AdS$_3$ 超对称边界代数，表明费米 Dirac 括号本质非局域，并用 BFT 方法在扩大相空间中恢复局域第一类描述。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT 基础与渐近对称代数方向，涉及 AdS$_3$ 边界约束和超对称代数；但未直接涉及用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7/D3-D5 探针膜或经典引力等具体支线，因此相关性为中等。

papers.title: Notes on de Sitter space
papers.abstract: We discuss classical and quantum features of spacetimes with a positive cosmological constant. After introducing basic aspects of de Sitter cosmology and the classical geometry of de Sitter space, we consider de Sitter space both as a rigid background, on which quantum fields propagate, and as a fluctuating spacetime in its own right. We review the wavefunction of an expanding universe, black holes in de Sitter space, and the de Sitter entropy, and compare the cosmological horizon with the black hole horizon. The final three sections are dedicated to concrete models of de Sitter space in two, three and four spacetime dimensions.

classification.title_zh: 德西特空间笔记
classification.abstract_zh: 我们讨论具有正宇宙学常数的时空的经典与量子特征。在介绍德西特宇宙学的基本方面和德西特空间的经典几何之后，我们将德西特空间既视为量子场在其上传播的刚性背景，也视为自身涨落的时空。我们回顾膨胀宇宙的波函数、德西特空间中的黑洞和德西特熵，并比较宇宙学视界与黑洞视界。最后三节致力于二维、三维和四维时空中的具体德西特空间模型。
classification.one_liner: 关于德西特时空经典几何、量子场、黑洞、熵以及低维具体模型的综述性笔记。
classification.relevance_reason: 摘要主题为德西特时空的经典与量子性质、视界与熵，属于经典引力与宇宙学范畴；用户重点标签中仅“经典引力/广义相对论”有部分关联，未涉及全息超导、QNM、探针膜等具体全息支线。

papers.title: Fortuity on the conifold
papers.abstract: To study the BPS black hole states in typical $\mathcal{N}=1$ AdS$_5$/CFT$_4$ models, we formulate a classical cohomology problem in the Klebanov-Witten theory, which is defined at a strongly coupled RG fixed point. We set up its weakly coupled cohomology problem in the UV theory, suggesting a refined notion of monotonous and fortuitous cohomologies so that simple baryonic operators belong to the former. We construct infinitely many fortuitous cohomologies in the $SU(2)\times SU(2)$ theory and interpret some of them as $N=2$ versions of hairy black hole states dressed by baryonic condensates. We also comment that the recently constructed fortuitous cohomologies in ABJM exhibit generalized monotonicity.

classification.title_zh: conifold 上的偶然性
classification.abstract_zh: 为了研究典型 N=1 AdS5/CFT4 模型中的 BPS 黑洞态，我们在 Klebanov-Witten 理论中表述了一个经典上同调问题，该理论定义在强耦合 RG 不动点。我们在 UV 理论中建立其弱耦合上同调问题，提出单调上同调和偶然上同调的精细概念，使得简单重子算符属于前者。我们在 SU(2)×SU(2) 理论中构造了无穷多个偶然上同调，并将其中一些解释为由重子凝聚装饰的 N=2 版带毛黑洞态。我们还评论说，最近在 ABJM 中构造的偶然上同调表现出广义单调性。
classification.one_liner: 在 Klebanov-Witten/ABJM 型 AdS5/CFT4 中，用经典上同调与单调/偶然上同调分类研究 BPS 黑洞态及重子凝聚。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文属于 AdS/CFT 中 BPS 黑洞态与上同调分类，未直接涉及所列重点标签（全息超流超导、p波/多分量、畴壁/孤子、multi-trace、相变/气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7/D3-D5、经典引力）。

papers.title: Algebraic Complexity and Black Hole Complementarity
papers.abstract: We develop an operator algebraic generalization of the Yoshida-Kitaev information recovery protocol that applies to von Neumann algebras of arbitrary type. The construction is based on finite-index inclusions, with the Jones basic construction and canonical endomorphisms providing the central algebraic tools. Unlike the finite-dimensional qubit description, the infinite-dimensional theory exhibits new structural phenomena that play an essential role in information recovery. In particular, the diary information is represented non-locally by a choice of Pimsner-Popa basis associated with the inclusion. Exploiting the Temperley-Lieb relations satisfied by the Jones projections, we introduce an algebraic notion of computational complexity and show that it is naturally measured by the Jones-Kosaki index. For irreducible depth-two inclusions, we demonstrate that the information transfer is implemented by an algebraic Fourier transform. Finally, we discuss a potential spacetime interpretation of the construction, including the emergence of an island algebra in terms of (non-)isometric embeddings and an operator algebraic realization of black hole complementarity.

classification.title_zh: 代数复杂度与黑洞互补性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们发展了 Yoshida-Kitaev 信息恢复协议的算子代数推广，使其适用于任意类型的冯·诺依曼代数。该构造基于有限指标的包含，其中 Jones 基本构造和典范自同态提供了核心代数工具。与有限维量子比特描述不同，无限维理论展现出在信息恢复中起关键作用的新结构现象。特别地，日记信息由与包含相关联的 Pimsner-Popa 基的选择非局域地表示。利用 Jones 投影满足的 Temperley-Lieb 关系，我们引入计算复杂度的代数概念，并证明它自然由 Jones-Kosaki 指标度量。对于不可约深度二包含，我们证明信息转移由一个代数傅里叶变换实现。最后，我们讨论该构造的潜在时空解释，包括以（非）等距嵌入出现的岛代数，以及黑洞互补性的算子代数实现。
classification.one_liner: 用任意类型冯·诺依曼代数和有限指标包含推广 Yoshida-Kitaev 信息恢复，并以代数复杂度、岛代数联系黑洞互补性。
classification.relevance_reason: 与黑洞信息、岛、互补性及量子信息/复杂度相关，属于全息/量子引力信息方向；但摘要未明确给出 AdS/CFT 或具体全息对偶模型，需保守看待。

papers.title: Strong coupling spectrum of $\mathrm{AdS}_3\times \mathrm{S}^3$ from string field theory
papers.abstract: We consider type IIB string theory on $\mathrm{AdS}_3\times \mathrm{S}^3\times \mathbb{T}^4$ in a large AdS radius expansion at arbitrary values of the relative RR and NS-NS fluxes. We develop a method for computing scaling dimensions in the dual CFT in this limit by combining a string field theory calculation, valid at finite quantized NS-NS flux but perturbative in RR flux, with a finite mixed-flux ansatz, which is constrained by worldsheet parity and motivated by classical string solutions. We apply the method to three families of states. In the pure-RR limit, our results agree both with a family of states computed using the worldsheet bootstrap and with another family computed using integrability.

classification.title_zh: 来自弦场论的 AdS3×S3 强耦合谱
classification.abstract_zh: 我们考虑在 AdS3×S3×T4 上的 IIB 型弦理论，在大 AdS 半径展开下，相对 RR 和 NS-NS 通量取任意值。我们发展了一种计算该极限下对偶 CFT 中标度维度的方法，将弦场论计算（在有限量子化 NS-NS 通量下有效，但对 RR 通量微扰）与一个有限混合通量拟设相结合；该拟设受世界面宇称约束，并受经典弦解启发。我们将该方法应用于三族态。在纯 RR 极限下，我们的结果既与用世界面 bootstrap 计算的一族态一致，也与用可积性计算的另一族态一致。
classification.one_liner: 结合弦场论、混合通量拟设与可积性/世界面 bootstrap，计算 AdS3×S3×T4 全息对偶 CFT 的强耦合标度维度。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT 与弦场论谱计算，但未涉及用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、p波、畴壁/孤子、multi-trace、相变气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7/D3-D5 或经典引力等支线。

papers.title: Schwarzschild Black Hole in Uniform Magnetic Field in Einstein-Maxwell-Dilaton Theories
papers.abstract: We obtain the Kerr black hole in an external uniform magnetic field in the Kaluza-Klein (KK) theory via a standard solution-generating technique. Using this as our starting point, we construct exact static solutions describing a Schwarzschild black hole immersed in the external uniform magnetic field in general string-inspired Einstein-Maxwell-dilaton (EMD) theories, thereby embedding the static Kerr-Bertotti-Robinson (KBR) solution into the general framework of EMD theories. We also construct electrovacuum solutions involving both electric and magnetic fields in EMD theories and generalize the system to include mutltiple Maxwell fields and dilatons. These equations of motion can be reduced to Toda-like equations, allowing us to obtain analytic electrovacua associated with Toda equations of all rank-2 Lie groups. We further construct exact solutions of a Schwarzschild black hole immersed in these electrovacua.

classification.title_zh: Einstein-Maxwell-Dilaton 理论中均匀磁场里的 Schwarzschild 黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 我们通过标准解生成技术，在 Kaluza-Klein (KK) 理论中获得了处于外部均匀磁场中的 Kerr 黑洞。以此作为出发点，我们构造了精确静态解，描述在一般弦论启发的 Einstein-Maxwell-Dilaton (EMD) 理论中浸没于外部均匀磁场的 Schwarzschild 黑洞，从而将静态 Kerr-Bertotti-Robinson (KBR) 解嵌入 EMD 理论的一般框架。我们还构造了 EMD 理论中同时包含电场和磁场的电真空解，并将系统推广到包含多个 Maxwell 场和 dilaton 的情形。这些运动方程可约化为 Toda 型方程，使我们能够得到与所有 rank-2 Lie 群的 Toda 方程相关的解析电真空。我们进一步构造了浸没于这些电真空中的 Schwarzschild 黑洞的精确解。
classification.one_liner: 通过解生成技术构造 KK/EMD 理论中浸没于均匀磁场及 Toda 型电真空的 Schwarzschild 黑洞精确解。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论方向的精确解研究，直接匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签，涉及黑洞、均匀磁场、EMD/KK 与 Toda 方程；不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶。

papers.title: Deterministic Hypergraph SYK: Melonic Dominance and Maximal Chaos Without Disorder Averaging
papers.abstract: We show that SYK-like melonic solvability and maximal chaos survive in a sparse deterministic model, without disorder averaging. Our deterministic hypergraph SYK model (hSYK) consists of $N$ Majorana fermions on a $q$-uniform, $d$-regular interaction hypergraph with only $O(dN)$ interaction terms and uniform positive couplings. Under explicit geometric and spectral expansion conditions, its two-point function satisfies the standard melonic Schwinger-Dyson equation up to $O(d^{-1})$ corrections, while the leading bilocal effective action coincides with that of ordinary SYK at the dominant large-$d$ saddle. Its connected four-point function factorizes into a temporal SYK ladder kernel and a line-graph random walk. A finite line-graph spectral gap controls the visibility of the maximally chaotic uniform mode in generic localized OTOCs and, by gapping non-uniform spatial modes in the bilocal spectrum, excludes additional light fluctuation modes beyond the Schwarzian. Exact diagonalization further shows melonic two-point scaling, single-instance Wigner-Dyson statistics, and the predicted graph-controlled spatial decay of OTOCs. The model therefore offers a disorder-free realization of the essential melonic and chaotic features of SYK, in a form more amenable to quantum simulation.

classification.title_zh: 确定性超图 SYK：无需无序平均的 melonic 主导与最大混沌
classification.abstract_zh: 我们证明，类似 SYK 的 melonic 可解性与最大混沌可以在一个稀疏确定性模型中存活，而无需无序平均。我们的确定性超图 SYK 模型（hSYK）由位于一个 q-均匀、d-正则相互作用超图上的 N 个 Majorana 费米子构成，只有 O(dN) 个相互作用项和均匀正耦合。在显式的几何与谱展开条件下，其两点函数满足标准 melonic Schwinger-Dyson 方程，精度到 O(d^{-1}) 修正；而在主导的大 d 鞍点处，领头双局域有效作用量与普通 SYK 相同。其连通四点函数分解为一个时间 SYK 梯形核与一个线图随机游走。一个有限线图谱隙控制着最大混沌均匀模在一般局域 OTOC 中的可见性，并通过对双局域谱中的非均匀空间模式打开能隙，排除了 Schwarzian 之外的额外轻涨落模式。精确对角化进一步显示了 melonic 两点标度、单实例 Wigner-Dyson 统计，以及所预言的 OTOC 图控空间衰减。因此，该模型提供了 SYK 基本 melonic 与混沌特征的一种无无序实现，其形式更适合量子模拟。
classification.one_liner: 确定性超图 SYK 模型无需无序平均即可保持 melonic 可解性与最大混沌，并给出可控 OTOC 空间衰减，便于量子模拟。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接研究 SYK/melonic 可解性、最大混沌、OTOC 与 Schwarzian，属于 AdS2/JT 全息与量子混沌的核心方向。

papers.title: Cosmological Correlators from Scattering Amplitudes: A Review
papers.abstract: The primordial statistics underlying the CMB and large-scale structure are encoded in late-time cosmological correlation functions (constructed from the coefficients of the wavefunction of the universe). They are the closest analogue cosmology has to an $S$-matrix, yet the standard $S$-matrix toolkit does not directly apply. This review explains how the modern scattering-amplitudes program (spinor helicity, on-shell recursion, the double copy, positive geometry, and generalized unitarity) has nevertheless been extended to cosmology and, through a single analytic continuation, to Euclidean anti-de Sitter space, where the same objects appear as holographic boundary correlators and are often cleanest to compute. The organizing framework is momentum space on the late-time boundary, where the primordial statistics are simplest and where the total energy of the external legs, the sum of their momentum magnitudes, controls the analytic structure. At the total-energy singularity, the flat-space scattering amplitude emerges. We develop this toolkit starting from the wave equation and use it to compute tree-level scalar, gauge-field, and graviton correlators, exposing relations across spins and dimensions. We then show how bulk integrals can be bypassed using cosmological polytopes, on-shell recursion, and curved-space versions of the double copy, before extending the discussion to loops, soft limits, transition amplitudes, and (A)dS cutting rules. Finally, we connect these structures to inflationary observables and to three allied programs: the cosmological optical theorem, the cosmological bootstrap, and the cosmological collider. We conclude with a map of the current frontier and a set of open and interesting problems.

classification.title_zh: 从散射振幅出发的宇宙学关联函数：综述
classification.abstract_zh: CMB 和大尺度结构背后的原初统计信息编码在晚期宇宙学关联函数中（这些关联函数由宇宙波函数的系数构造）。它们是宇宙学中最接近 S 矩阵的类比物，然而标准 S 矩阵工具并不能直接适用。本综述解释现代散射振幅纲领（旋量螺旋度、在壳递归、双拷贝、正几何和广义幺正性）如何仍被推广到宇宙学，并通过一次解析延拓推广到欧几里得反 de Sitter 空间；在那里，同样的对象表现为全息边界关联函数，并且通常最易于计算。组织框架是晚期边界上的动量空间，在那里原初统计最简单，并且外腿的总能量（其动量模之和）控制解析结构。在总能量奇点处，平直空间散射振幅浮现。我们从波动方程出发发展这套工具，并用它计算树级标量、规范场和引力子关联函数，揭示不同自旋和维度之间的关系。随后我们展示如何利用宇宙学多胞形、在壳递归以及双拷贝的弯曲空间版本绕过体积分，然后推广到圈图、软极限、跃迁振幅和 (A)dS 切割规则。最后，我们将这些结构与暴胀可观测量以及三个相关纲领联系起来：宇宙学光学定理、宇宙学自举和宇宙学对撞机。我们以当前前沿的地图以及一组开放且有趣的问题作结。
classification.one_liner: 综述如何将散射振幅技术推广到宇宙学关联函数，并经由解析延拓联系到欧几里得 AdS 全息边界关联函数。
classification.relevance_reason: 摘要核心是宇宙学关联函数与散射振幅，并联系到AdS全息边界关联函数，属于dS/AdS交叉方向；但与用户重点列出的具体支线（全息超流超导、p波、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7/Floquet、经典引力）均无直接匹配。

papers.title: Topological entanglement entropy in 3D gravity
papers.abstract: We derive an entropy formula for a recently proposed tensor network model of states in 3D gravity which satisfy the constraint equations of diffeomorphism invariance, and including the effects of matter. After accounting for the invertibility of the spacetime metric, we argue that this formula matches the quantum extremal surface formula (for small but finite $G_N$), and is not restricted to time symmetric spacetimes. We derive the result via canonical quantization without relying on path integrals, and discuss an extension to compact bulk subregions.

classification.title_zh: 三维引力中的拓扑纠缠熵
classification.abstract_zh: 我们为由最近提出的三维引力态张量网络模型推导出一个熵公式，这些态满足微分同胚不变性的约束方程，并包含物质效应。在考虑时空度规可逆性之后，我们论证该公式在小而有限的 G_N 下与量子极值面公式一致，且不限于时间对称时空。我们通过正则量子化推导该结果，不依赖路径积分，并讨论了向紧致体子区域的推广。
classification.one_liner: 在三维引力的张量网络模型中，用正则量子化导出与量子极值面一致的拓扑纠缠熵公式，并推广至含物质、非时间对称情形。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文聚焦三维引力/全息量子信息中的纠缠熵与量子极值面，未涉及用户列出的全息超导、p波、畴壁/孤子、multi-trace、相变、QNM、冷原子或D3-D7探针膜等重点支线。

papers.title: Thermodynamics of polymerized vacuum regular black holes in anti-de Sitter spacetime
papers.abstract: We derive a class of vacuum regular black holes inspired by effective loop quantum gravity dynamics and extend the construction to asymptotically anti-de Sitter spacetimes. The derivation is based on a deparameterized Lemaitre--Tolman--Bondi formulation, where an auxiliary dust field is introduced only to define an internal time and does not act as a matter source. In spherical symmetry, the dynamics reduces to a set of independent radial shells, giving rise to a factorized shell Hamiltonian and to a Birkhoff-type property: for a fixed reconstruction function and cosmological constant, the static geometry is uniquely determined by the mass. Within this framework, we establish the conditions for curvature regularity at the center and construct several regular black hole models with de Sitter cores and corresponding models with anti-de Sitter cores. We then study their thermodynamics in the extended phase space, using the Hawking--Page transition to compare the de Sitter- and anti-de Sitter-core branches and show that their quantitative differences arise from the deformation of the physical outer-horizon branch rather than from regularity alone.

classification.primary_topic: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 反德西特时空中聚合化真空规则黑洞的热力学
classification.abstract_zh: 我们推导了一类受有效圈量子引力动力学启发的真空规则黑洞，并将该构造推广到渐近反德西特时空。推导基于去参数化的 Lemaitre--Tolman--Bondi 表述，其中引入辅助尘埃场仅用于定义内时，而不作为物质源。在球对称下，动力学约化为一组独立的径向壳层，产生因子化的壳层哈密顿量以及一个 Birkhoff 型性质：对于固定的重构函数和宇宙学常数，静态几何由质量唯一确定。在此框架内，我们建立了中心曲率规则性的条件，并构造了若干具有 de Sitter 核心的规则黑洞模型以及相应的具有 anti-de Sitter 核心的模型。随后我们在扩展相空间中研究其热力学，利用 Hawking--Page 相变比较 de Sitter 核心和 anti-de Sitter 核心分支，并表明它们的定量差异来自物理外视界分支的形变，而非仅来自规则性。
classification.one_liner: 构造了有效圈量子引力启发的 AdS 真空规则黑洞，并在扩展相空间中用 Hawking--Page 相变比较 dS 核与 AdS 核分支，指出热力学差异主要源于外视界分支形变而非规则性本身。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接涉及 AdS 黑洞热力学、扩展相空间与 Hawking-Page 相变，并属于经典/半经典规则黑洞构造，契合“相变与气泡成核”和“经典引力/广义相对论”重点；但它不建立 AdS/CFT 字典，也不讨论全息对偶、量子信息或强关联，因此不属于理论全息。

papers.title: Wave-optics gravitational wave lensing in modified gravity
papers.abstract: We initiate the study of gravitational-wave lensing in the wave-optics regime within modified gravity. We consider a phenomenological setup in which the gravitational-wave amplitude obeys a curvature-coupled propagation equation. This framework reproduces the standard GR behaviour in the geometric-optics regime, while leading to qualitatively different infrared dynamics. In particular, the usual argument implying that the amplification factor approaches unity in the zero-frequency limit no longer applies. This is due to the persistence of curvature-induced interactions in the infrared, which modify the natural propagation basis itself. As a result, the standard Fresnel treatment ceases to be valid at sufficiently low frequency. The correct infrared regime is instead controlled by an interacting static Green function, with a finite-frequency completion provided by a partial-wave formulation. We show that this structure admits an equivalent distorted-wave interpretation, in which the curvature interaction is absorbed into a dressed reference propagation basis, while the residual lensing effect is encoded in finite-frequency phase shifts. We further demonstrate that these phenomena admit a natural interpretation in the language of scattering amplitudes. Wave-optics lensing can therefore probe propagation-level departures from GR that remain entirely invisible in geometric optics.

classification.title_zh: 修改引力中的波光学引力波透镜
classification.abstract_zh: 我们启动了修改引力中波光学区引力波透镜的研究。我们考虑一个现象学设置，其中引力波振幅服从曲率耦合的传播方程。该框架在几何光学区再现标准广义相对论行为，同时导致定性不同的红外动力学。特别地，通常论证零频极限下放大因子趋于1不再适用。这是由于红外中曲率诱导相互作用的持续存在，改变了自然传播基本身。因此，标准菲涅耳处理在足够低频下失效。正确的红外区反而由相互作用的静态格林函数控制，有限频率完成由分波表述提供。我们证明该结构允许等价的畸变波解释，其中曲率相互作用被吸收进修饰的参考传播基，而残余透镜效应编码在有限频率相移中。我们进一步证明这些现象在散射振幅语言中有自然解释。因此，波光学透镜可以探测几何光学中完全不可见的传播层面偏离广义相对论。
classification.one_liner: 修改引力中波光学引力波透镜在红外区偏离广义相对论，可由静态格林函数、分波相移与散射振幅描述。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究经典引力/修改引力中的引力波波光学透镜，属于用户重点关注的经典引力/广义相对论支线。

papers.title: Memory of Robinson-Trautman waves
papers.abstract: The memory effect for Robinson-Trautman waves is explicitly worked out. In a first step, we construct the combined frame rotation and coordinate transformation in which Robinson-Trautman waves are manifestly locally asymptotically flat at future null infinity. This allows us to apply well-established results on how to derive the memory effect in this context. In a second step, we construct a suitably improved generalized mass aspect that provides a local Lyapunov function for the flow in the sense that it is manifestly positive. News-free solutions are studied in detail and shown to coincide with the vacuum sector of Euclidean Liouville theory. They correspond to a boosted and rescaled Schwarzschild black hole. As a by-product, we show that the displacement and non-linear memory effects in locally asymptotically flat spacetimes at future null infinity are invariant under supertranslations and covariant under $\mathrm{BMS}_4$ Lorentz transformations and constant rescalings. A novel interpretation of modified flows that control the low harmonics in terms of keeping the system in its instantaneous rest frame is provided.

classification.title_zh: Robinson-Trautman 波的记忆效应
classification.abstract_zh: 本文明确计算了 Robinson-Trautman 波的记忆效应。第一步，我们构造了联合的标架旋转与坐标变换，使得 Robinson-Trautman 波在未来零无穷处显式地局部渐近平坦。这使我们能够应用关于如何在此背景下推导记忆效应的已有结果。第二步，我们构造了一个适当改进的广义质量 aspect，它提供了流的局部 Lyapunov 函数，即它显式为正。我们详细研究了无 news 解，并表明它们与欧几里得 Liouville 理论的真空 sector 一致。它们对应于一个作 boost 和重标度的 Schwarzschild 黑洞。作为副产品，我们表明未来零无穷处局部渐近平坦时空中的位移记忆效应和非线性记忆效应在超平移下不变，并在 BMS4 洛伦兹变换和常数重标度下协变。我们还给出了对控制低次谐波的修正流的一种新解释，即将其解释为保持系统处于其瞬时静止系。
classification.one_liner: 在局部渐近平坦未来零无穷处推导 Robinson-Trautman 波的位移与非线性记忆效应，并构造正定的广义质量 Lyapunov 函数。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接研究经典广义相对论中的 Robinson-Trautman 波、引力记忆效应与 BMS 渐近对称性，属于经典引力/广义相对论重点支线。

papers.title: Building Holographic Entanglement by Measurement
papers.abstract: We propose a framework for preparing quantum states with a holographic entanglement structure, in the sense that the entanglement entropies are governed by minimal surfaces in a chosen bulk geometry. We refer to such entropies as holographic because they obey a relation between entropies and bulk minimal surfaces, known as the Ryu-Takayanagi (RT) formula, that is a key feature of holographic models of quantum gravity. Typically in such models, the bulk geometry is determined by solving Einstein's equations. Here, we simply choose a bulk geometry, then discretize the geometry into a coupling graph comprising bulk and boundary nodes. Evolving under this graph of interactions and measuring the bulk nodes leaves behind the desired pure state on the boundary. We numerically demonstrate that the resulting entanglement properties approximately reproduce the predictions of the Ryu-Takayanagi formula in the chosen bulk geometry. We consider graphs associated with hyperbolic disk and wormhole geometries, but the approach is general. We also introduce a procedure for decorating the graph which, when applied to the hyperbolic disk, yields a genuine CFT ground state with power-law correlations but which only partially obeys RT. The minimal ingredients in our proposal involve only Gaussian operations and measurements and are readily implementable in photonic and cold-atom platforms.

classification.title_zh: 通过测量构建全息纠缠
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个制备具有全息纠缠结构的量子态的框架，这里的含义是纠缠熵由所选体几何中的极小曲面支配。我们把这类熵称为全息的，因为它们满足熵与体极小曲面之间的关系，即 Ryu-Takayanagi（RT）公式，这是量子引力全息模型的一个关键特征。通常在这类模型中，体几何由求解 Einstein 方程确定。这里，我们直接选择一个体几何，然后将该几何离散化为一个由体和边界节点组成的耦合图。在该相互作用图下演化并测量体节点，会在边界上留下所需的纯态。我们数值证明，所得的纠缠性质近似再现所选体几何中 Ryu-Takayanagi 公式的预言。我们考虑与双曲圆盘和虫洞几何相关的图，但该方法是一般的。我们还引入一种装饰图的过程，将其应用于双曲圆盘时，会得到一个具有幂律关联但仅部分满足 RT 的真正 CFT 基态。我们方案中的最小要素仅涉及高斯操作和测量，并且容易在光子和冷原子平台上实现。
classification.one_liner: 通过图上的高斯演化和体节点测量，在边界制备出纠缠熵近似遵循选定体几何 RT 公式的全息纠缠态。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接研究全息纠缠、RT 公式与测量制备，并提及冷原子/光子平台实现，属于全息量子信息核心方向。

papers.title: Gravitational equal-area law and critical phenomena of cuspy black hole shadow
papers.abstract: The formation of a cusp on a black hole shadow is a striking signature of physics beyond the Kerr paradigm. Using the Konoplya-Zhidenko metric, a general parametrized deformation of Kerr black hole, we demonstrate that this morphological change fundamentally alters the shadow's topology with the topological charge flipping from 1 to -1. To analyze this topological transition, we introduce a gravitational equal-area law, analogous to Maxwell's construction in thermodynamics, and identify a critical point for cusp formation. Near this point, we uncover universal behavior characterized by a critical exponent 1/2, which places this gravitational lensing system within the mean-field universality class. These results establish a new framework for testing fundamental physics of black hole shadows, reframing the search for deviations from general relativity as a targeted hunt for a distinct topological and critical phenomenon.

secondary_topics: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 引力等面积定律与尖点黑洞阴影的临界现象
classification.abstract_zh: 黑洞阴影上尖点的形成是超越 Kerr 范式的物理的显著信号。利用 Konoplya-Zhidenko 度规——Kerr 黑洞的一种一般参数化变形——我们证明这种形态变化从根本上改变了阴影的拓扑，使拓扑荷从 1 翻转为 -1。为分析这一拓扑转变，我们引入引力等面积定律，类似于热力学中的麦克斯韦构造，并确定了尖点形成的临界点。在该点附近，我们发现由临界指数 1/2 表征的普适行为，这将该引力透镜系统置于平均场普适类中。这些结果建立了一个检验黑洞阴影基础物理的新框架，并将对广义相对论偏离的搜索重新表述为对一种独特拓扑与临界现象的有目标搜寻。
classification.one_liner: 在 Konoplya-Zhidenko 变形 Kerr 黑洞中，阴影尖点对应拓扑荷从 1 到 -1 的翻转，并可用引力等面积定律与临界指数 1/2 的临界现象描述。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究经典引力/广义相对论中的黑洞阴影、Kerr 变形、拓扑转变与临界现象，属于用户重点标签中的经典引力支线。

papers.title: Echoes of the Maldacena-Milekhin-Popov traversable wormhole
papers.abstract: We study linear perturbations of massless scalar and vector gauge fields, treated as test fields, on the four-dimensional traversable wormhole of Maldacena, Milekhin, and Popov~\cite{Maldacena:2018gjk}. Both effective potentials vanish throughout the throat and rise in each mouth to a single barrier peaked at the extremal photon-sphere radius $r=2r_e$ for every multipole. In the tortoise coordinate these two barriers are only $\mathcal{O}(10^2)$ wide but sit a distance $2D\simeq\pi L_{\rm wh}\sim10^{35}$ apart, which puts direct time-domain evolution out of reach. We instead compute the single-barrier scattering amplitudes by Numerov integration, validated against an exactly solvable barrier and against an independent time-domain evolution, and then sum the multiple reflections in closed form. The parabolic WKB formula always gives a transmission probability of $1/2$ at the barrier top, whereas the true value is $0.62$. It also fails below the top, where the transmission falls as $|\kappa|^2\propto\omega^{6.4}$ for $l=1$. Echoes emerge at $T_m=(2m+1)D$ as narrow-band wave packets near the light-ring frequency. Their frequency decreases with each reflection and the energy decays algebraically, $E_m\propto m^{-1}$. The quasinormal spectrum splits into two families. Modes trapped between the barriers are extraordinarily long-lived, with quality factors up to $10^{41}$, and carry the same astronomical time-scale as the echoes. The photon-sphere modes of a single mouth are damped $10^{36}$ times faster than cavity modes, with quality factors of order unity at low multipoles. Only this second family of quasinormal modes is observable, characterising the ringdown of a single mouth. The echoes and the trapped cavity modes instead characterise the late-time dynamics of the throat, not a detectable signal.

classification.title_zh: Maldacena-Milekhin-Popov 可穿越虫洞的回声
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究无质量标量场和矢量规范场作为试探场，在 Maldacena、Milekhin 和 Popov 的四维可穿越虫洞上的线性扰动。对于所有多极，两个有效势在喉部处处为零，并在每个口处上升为单个势垒，其峰值位于极值光子球半径 r=2r_e。在龟坐标中，这两个势垒宽度仅为 O(10^2)，但相距 2D≃π L_wh ∼10^35，这使得直接的时域演化无法进行。我们改用 Numerov 积分计算单势垒散射振幅，并用一个精确可解势垒以及独立的时域演化进行验证，然后以闭合形式对多次反射求和。抛物 WKB 公式在势垒顶部总是给出透射概率 1/2，而真实值为 0.62。它在顶部以下也失效，此时对于 l=1，透射率按 |κ|^2∝ω^6.4 下降。回声出现在 T_m=(2m+1)D，为光环绕频率附近的窄带波包。其频率随每次反射而降低，能量代数衰减，E_m∝m^{-1}。准正规模谱分裂为两个族。被囚禁在势垒之间的模式寿命极长，品质因子可达 10^41，并携带与回声相同的天文时间尺度。单个口的光子球模式比腔模式衰减快 10^36 倍，在低多极时品质因子为 1 量级。只有第二族准正规模是可观测的，表征单个口的铃宕。回声和被囚禁的腔模式则表征喉部的晚期动力学，而不是可探测信号。
classification.one_liner: 在 MMP 可穿越虫洞上计算标量与矢量试探场的线性扰动，发现回声和极长寿命腔模式，但可观测信号仅来自单口光子球准正规模。
classification.relevance_reason: 主题涉及准正规模、回声和经典弯曲时空中的线性扰动，与 QNM 及经典引力支线相关，但不涉及全息超导、p波与多分量序参量、相变气泡成核、multi-trace 或 Floquet 驱动等具体重点方向。

papers.title: Dirichlet walls and the end of time
papers.abstract: We study evolution in Einstein-Hilbert gravity with Dirichlet boundary conditions imposed on a finite surface. We argue that there are open sets of initial data where such evolutions terminate at finite times due to singularities that reach the boundary. In any dimension, the simplest such examples occur in cosmologies. However, in 2+1 dimensions we also show that Dirichlet walls initially outside a BTZ black hole can fall through the horizon, and that this also leads to generic singularities. A similar construction in higher dimensions leads to trapped surfaces that reach the wall, though the end result of such evolutions is more difficult to study.

classification.title_zh: Dirichlet 墙与时间的终结
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在有限曲面上施加 Dirichlet 边界条件的 Einstein-Hilbert 引力中的演化。我们认为，存在开集初值使此类演化在有限时间终止，原因是奇点到达边界。在任意维度，最简单的例子出现在宇宙学中。然而，在 2+1 维中我们还表明，初始位于 BTZ 黑洞外部的 Dirichlet 墙可以穿过视界，这也会导致一般性奇点。高维中的类似构造会产生到达墙的捕获面，尽管此类演化的最终结果更难研究。
classification.one_liner: 在带 Dirichlet 边界面的 Einstein-Hilbert 引力中，某些初值演化会在有限时间终结：低维含宇宙学与 BTZ 黑洞穿视界导致奇点，高维则出现抵达边界的捕获面。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究 Einstein-Hilbert 经典引力、Dirichlet 边界条件、BTZ 黑洞及时空奇点/捕获面演化，属于用户列出的经典引力/广义相对论重点支线；摘要未涉及全息对偶或量子信息，因此不归为理论全息。

papers.title: Holographic complexity of de Sitter black holes
papers.abstract: We investigate holographic complexity within the Schwarzschild-de Sitter (SdS) black hole spacetime. Two distinct de Sitter holography prescriptions are examined: the static patch scheme restricted to the stretched horizon and the de Sitter/Conformal Field Theory (dS/CFT) correspondence scheme defined at asymptotic future and past infinities. We evaluate the Complexity equals Volume (CV) conjecture and extend the analysis to codimension-zero proposals, specifically Complexity equals Spacetime Volume (CV2.0) and Complexity equals Action (CA), through the Wheeler-DeWitt (WDW) patch we construct. The behaviors of the complexity in the static patch holography at late time and in the dS/CFT at infinite spacelike boundary coordinate are studied, respectively. We find that under both the CV and CV2.0 conjectures, the static patch holographic complexity and the dS/CFT holographic complexity consistently exhibit linear growth. Conversely, regarding the CA conjecture, the holographic complexity growth rates for both the static patch and the dS/CFT correspondence vanish. This behavior is attributed to the finiteness of the (regularized) action within the restricted WDW region. Furthermore, we find that, in the limit in which the boundary coordinate is taken to infinity, the complexity growth rate in the static patch prescription coincides with its counterpart in the dS/CFT prescription. This agreement suggests a deeper connection between the two descriptions and may point toward a unified understanding of bulk dynamics in de Sitter holography.

classification.title_zh: de Sitter 黑洞的全息复杂度
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究 Schwarzschild-de Sitter (SdS) 黑洞时空中的全息复杂度。考察两种不同的 de Sitter 全息方案：限制在拉伸视界上的静态补丁方案，以及定义在渐近未来和过去无穷远的 de Sitter/共形场论 (dS/CFT) 对应方案。我们评估“复杂度等于体积”(CV) 猜想，并通过构造 Wheeler-DeWitt (WDW) patch，将分析推广到余维零提议，特别是“复杂度等于时空体积”(CV2.0) 和“复杂度等于作用量”(CA)。分别研究了静态补丁全息在晚期以及 dS/CFT 在空间类边界坐标趋于无穷时的复杂度行为。我们发现，在 CV 和 CV2.0 猜想下，静态补丁全息复杂度和 dS/CFT 全息复杂度均一致地呈现线性增长。相反，对于 CA 猜想，静态补丁和 dS/CFT 对应的全息复杂度增长率均消失。这种行为归因于受限 WDW 区域内（正则化）作用量的有限性。此外，我们发现，在边界坐标趋于无穷的极限下，静态补丁方案中的复杂度增长率与 dS/CFT 方案中的对应结果一致。这一一致性暗示两种描述之间存在更深联系，并可能指向 de Sitter 全息中体动力学的一个统一理解。
classification.one_liner: 在Schwarzschild-de Sitter黑洞时空中比较静态补丁与dS/CFT两种全息方案，CV/CV2.0显示线性增长而CA增长率为零，并在边界无穷极限下两者增长率一致。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于de Sitter全息与全息复杂度交叉，涉及经典黑洞时空和WDW作用量，与经典引力/全息复杂度关注相关；但未直接匹配用户重点标签中的超流、多分量、QNM、气泡成核等具体支线。

papers.title: Decoding multiway gravitational junctions in AdS in terms of holographic quantum maps
papers.abstract: It has been shown that multiway junctions gluing $n$ copies of locally AdS$_3$ spacetimes ($n\geq 2$) can be described by $n-1$ strings obeying non-linear Nambu-Goto equations coupled by Monge-Amp\`{e}re like terms. Here we study how such junctions along with their stringy degrees of freedom can be interpreted in terms of an interface between $n$ identical holographic conformal theories each defined on a semi-infinite line (wire). We study the gravitational scattering problem at the multiway junction, and show that at the linearized order the dual interfaces correspond to quantum maps which factorize into a product of a scattering matrix determined only by the tension of the dual junction and relative automorphisms of the Virasoro algebra governed by the $n-1$ stringy modes. Both of these are universal in the sense that they are independent of linear modifications of the background state. These generalize earlier results for the 2-way junctions implying that the dual interface is a tunable energy transmitter. We comment on understanding the quantum map corresponding to the full non-linear gravitational problem, and study Ward identities and unitarity bounds.

secondary_topics: 非均匀态/孤子/涡旋/畴壁
classification.title_zh: 用全息量子映射解读 AdS 中的多路引力结
classification.abstract_zh: 已有研究表明，将 n 份局部 AdS3 时空（n≥2）粘合而成的多路结可由 n−1 条满足非线性 Nambu-Goto 方程、并通过类似 Monge-Ampère 项耦合的弦描述。本文研究此类结及其弦自由度如何解释为 n 个相同全息共形场论之间的界面，每个共形场论定义在半无限直线（线）上。我们研究多路结处的引力散射问题，并表明在线性化阶，对偶界面对应于量子映射；该映射因子化为一个仅由对偶结张力决定的散射矩阵与由 n−1 个弦模支配的 Virasoro 代数相对自同构的乘积。二者都是普适的，即不依赖于背景态的线性修改。这些结果推广了此前两路结的结果，意味着对偶界面是可调的能量传输器。我们评论了对完整非线性引力问题所对应量子映射的理解，并研究了 Ward 恒等式与幺正性界。
classification.one_liner: 将 AdS3 中多路引力结的对偶界面表述为由结张力散射矩阵和 Virasoro 自同构构成的量子映射，并讨论其普适性、Ward 恒等式与幺正性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT 全息对偶，核心对象是多路引力结/界面，直接对应‘非均匀态/畴壁/孤子/涡旋’支线；其引力侧涉及 AdS3 经典结与 Nambu-Goto 弦，因此也与经典引力支线相关。

papers.title: Resumming Spinning Black Hole Dynamics at Third Post-Minkowskian Order
papers.abstract: We investigate the relativistic scattering of spinning black holes using modern amplitude methods within a heavy-mass effective field theory formalism at third post-Minkowskian order. Using a systematic self-force expansion up to first order in the mass ratio, the gravitational amplitude and the associated eikonal-like phase are computed for a spin-aligned binary system comprising a heavy and a light black hole up to fifth order in the total spin and up to quadratic order in the spin of the light black hole. We also consider the resummation of the heavy black hole's spin in both the probe limit and the radiation-reaction sector, and verify that the resulting phase displays the characteristic ring singularity features associated with the Kerr metric.

classification.title_zh: 在三阶后闵可夫斯基阶重求和自旋黑洞动力学
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在第三后闵可夫斯基阶，使用重质量有效场论形式下的现代振幅方法研究自旋黑洞的相对论散射。通过将自力展开系统地进行到质量比的一阶，我们计算了由重黑洞和轻黑洞组成的自旋对齐双星系统的引力振幅及相关的类 eikonal 相位，结果保留到总自旋的五阶以及轻黑洞自旋的二次阶。我们还考虑在探针极限和辐射反作用部分对重黑洞自旋进行重求和，并验证所得相位显示出与 Kerr 度规相关的特征环奇异性。
classification.one_liner: 用重质量 EFT 与振幅方法在 3PM 阶计算自旋黑洞散射，并重求和重黑洞自旋，重现 Kerr 环奇异性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究后闵可夫斯基阶自旋黑洞散射与经典引力动力学，直接符合“经典引力/广义相对论”重点方向。

papers.title: Shadow and Polarized Images of Schwarzschild-MOG Black Hole Illuminated by Thick Accretion Disk
papers.abstract: Recent EHT polarimetric observations provide a powerful probe of near-horizon physics and modified gravity. We investigate the shadow and polarization images of a static Schwarzschild-MOG black hole illuminated by geometrically thick, optically thin accretion flows. Adopting a phenomenological model and the Hou disk model, and solving null geodesics and relativistic radiative transfer, we study how the MOG parameter, inclination angle, anisotropic synchrotron emission, and flow geometry affect the total intensity and linear polarization. It is found that the MOG parameter mainly enlarges and brightens higher-order photon rings and broadens the shadow, while the inclination angle breaks axial symmetry and enhances polarized emission inside the shadow. The Hou disk model suppresses off-equatorial radiative interference and localizes polarization signals within higher-order rings. Electric vector position angle (EVPA) patterns are mostly azimuthal but vary rapidly near lensed images. These results provide theoretical diagnostics for constraining MOG with EHT/ngEHT polarimetric observations.

classification.title_zh: 厚吸积盘照亮的 Schwarzschild-MOG 黑洞阴影与偏振图像
classification.abstract_zh: 近期 EHT 偏振观测为近视界物理和修改引力提供了有力探针。我们研究了由几何厚、光学薄吸积流照亮的静态 Schwarzschild-MOG 黑洞的阴影和偏振图像。采用现象学模型和 Hou 盘模型，并求解零测地线与相对论辐射转移，我们考察了 MOG 参数、倾角、各向异性同步辐射和流几何对总强度与线偏振的影响。发现 MOG 参数主要增大和增亮高阶光子环并展宽阴影，而倾角破坏轴对称性并增强阴影内部的偏振辐射。Hou 盘模型抑制偏离赤道面的辐射干涉，并将偏振信号局域在高阶环内。电场矢量位置角（EVPA）图样大多为方位角向，但在透镜像附近快速变化。这些结果为利用 EHT/ngEHT 偏振观测限制 MOG 提供了理论诊断。
classification.one_liner: 通过厚吸积盘辐射转移计算，研究 Schwarzschild-MOG 黑洞阴影和偏振图像对 MOG 参数、倾角与盘几何的响应。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力与黑洞阴影/偏振成像方向，与重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”相关；但不涉及全息对偶、量子引力或量子信息。

papers.title: Horizon--orbit scale competition in chaos bound violation for spinning particles in the black-bounce--Kerr--Newman spacetime
papers.abstract: In this paper, we investigate the chaos bound through the local radial instability of charged spinning test particles on unstable circular orbits in the black-bounce--Kerr--Newman spacetime. Our results show that violation of the bound is governed by the competition between the local orbital-instability scale and the surface gravity scale, with variations of the black hole background and the particle dynamics providing two complementary routes to the same threshold crossing. Background variations affect both scales and can drive the system into the bound-violating regime when the surface gravity is suppressed more strongly than the orbital instability. At fixed background, by contrast, the surface gravity remains unchanged, and the transition across the threshold is driven by changes in the unstable orbit dynamics induced by the particle parameters. The background-controlled and probe-dynamics-controlled routes therefore represent two realizations of a unified horizon--orbit scale competition rather than independent mechanisms. Among the particle parameters considered, the total angular momentum plays the leading role in controlling the local radial instability, while the spin and charge further modify the instability strength and shift the threshold for chaos bound violation.

classification.title_zh: 黑洞反弹-Kerr-Newman时空中自旋粒子违反混沌界限的地平线-轨道尺度竞争
classification.abstract_zh: 本文通过黑洞反弹-Kerr-Newman时空中带电自旋测试粒子在不稳定圆轨道上的局域径向不稳定性研究混沌界限。结果表明，混沌界限的破坏由局域轨道不稳定性尺度与表面引力尺度之间的竞争决定；黑洞背景变化和粒子动力学变化提供两条互补的越界途径。背景变化同时影响两个尺度，当表面引力被压制得比轨道不稳定性更强时，系统可进入破坏界限的区域。在固定背景下，表面引力不变，越界转变由粒子参数引起的不稳定轨道动力学变化驱动。因此，背景控制与探针动力学控制两种路径是统一的地平线-轨道尺度竞争的两种实现，而非彼此独立的机制。在所考虑的粒子参数中，总角动量对局域径向不稳定性起主导作用，自旋和电荷进一步改变不稳定性强度并移动混沌界限破坏的阈值。
classification.one_liner: 在黑洞反弹-Kerr-Newman时空中，自旋测试粒子的混沌界限破坏取决于地平线表面引力与轨道不稳定性尺度之间的竞争，背景变化和粒子参数可分别驱动越界。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论分支，研究弯曲时空中测试粒子轨道稳定性与混沌界限，不涉及 AdS/CFT、全息对偶或量子引力；与经典引力/广义相对论重点标签直接相关，但与全息研究主线相关性有限。

papers.title: Symmetry preservation in black hole quasinormal mode spectra
papers.abstract: We establish a general relation between symmetries of gravitational theories and black hole (BH) quasinormal mode (QNM) spectra. We show that a symmetry implies isospectrality when it induces a bijection between the corresponding QNM boundary value problems. However, conformally related BHs have been reported to exhibit both conformal factor dependent and independent QNM spectra. To resolve this issue, we develop a reduction scheme for higher order perturbation equations. Applied to pure Weyl gravity, it yields the complete axial spectrum of Schwarzschild, including Regge-Wheeler and spin-1 branches. Our results show that these seemingly contradictory conclusions result from differences in the perturbation dynamics or in the boundary conditions.

classification.title_zh: 黑洞准正规模式谱中的对称性保持
classification.abstract_zh: 我们建立了引力理论对称性与黑洞（BH）准正规模式（QNM）谱之间的一般关系。我们表明，当对称性诱导相应 QNM 边值问题之间的双射时，它意味着等谱性。然而，已有报道称共形相关的黑洞会表现出依赖于共形因子和独立于共形因子的 QNM 谱。为了解决这一问题，我们为高阶微扰方程发展了一种约化方案。将其应用于纯 Weyl 引力，可得到 Schwarzschild 的完整轴向谱，包括 Regge-Wheeler 和自旋-1 分支。我们的结果表明，这些看似矛盾的结论源于微扰动力学或边界条件的差异。
classification.one_liner: 建立引力对称性与黑洞 QNM 谱等谱性的联系，并用高阶微扰约化方案解决共形相关黑洞谱矛盾，在纯 Weyl 引力中给出 Schwarzschild 完整轴向 QNM 谱。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究黑洞准正规模式谱、对称性及经典引力微扰，直接匹配重点标签“QNM与非线性演化”（QNM部分）与“经典引力/广义相对论”；但不涉及全息或 AdS/CFT。

papers.title: Updated estimates of post-merger gravitational wave energy released in GW170817 and the maximum neutron star mass
papers.abstract: In this work, benefiting from the increased sample of neutron stars with measured masses and radii as well as the incorporation of the chiral effective field theory and perturbative QCD constraints, the tidal parameter $\kappa_2^T$ is constrained to be $78^{+17}_{-11}$ (68.3% credible interval, mainly adopted in this work unless mentioned specifically) for the binary neutron stars involved in GW170817. Such a $\kappa_2^T$ is in favor of strong gravitational wave radiation in the post-merger phase and the corresponding energy is estimated to be $E_{\rm GW,p} \simeq 0.051^{+0.022}_{-0.017}\,M_\odot c^2$. Assuming the remnant from binary neutron star merger is a supramassive neutron star, as suggested by the modeling of the electromagnetic counterparts of GW170817, we examine the maximum mass of nonrotating neutron stars ($M_{\rm TOV}$) while accounting for the uncertainty in the remnant's lifetime ($t_{\rm c}$). Our results show that $M_{\rm TOV}$ varies from $2.09^{+0.11}_{-0.09}\,M_\odot$ for $t_{\rm c}=0.1$ s to $2.18^{+0.10}_{-0.09}\,M_\odot$ for $t_{\rm c}=1$ s. This result is consistent with that independently inferred from the re-construction of the equation of state of neutron star matter, i.e., $M_{\rm TOV,exc}=2.16^{+0.10}_{-0.07}M_\odot$, particularly if the very massive neutron stars with masses measured indirectly have been removed in constructing the prior distribution of $M_{\rm TOV}$. The consistency of the maximum mass of nonrotating neutron stars found in different approaches suggests a reasonable understanding of this key parameter for dense-matter physics.

classification.title_zh: GW170817 后合并阶段释放引力波能量与最大中子星质量的更新估计
classification.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，得益于具有质量和半径测量值的中子星样本增加，以及手征有效场论和微扰 QCD 约束的纳入，对于 GW170817 所涉及的双中子星，潮汐参数 κ2^T 被限制为 78^{+17}_{-11}（68.3% 可信区间，除非特别说明，本工作主要采用此值）。这样的 κ2^T 有利于后合并阶段的强引力波辐射，相应能量估计为 E_GW,p ≃ 0.051^{+0.022}_{-0.017} M⊙ c^2。假设双中子星并合遗迹是超大质量中子星，如 GW170817 电磁对应体建模所建议，我们在考虑遗迹寿命 t_c 不确定性的情况下检验非旋转中子星的最大质量（M_TOV）。结果表明，M_TOV 从 t_c=0.1 s 时的 2.09^{+0.11}_{-0.09} M⊙ 变化到 t_c=1 s 时的 2.18^{+0.10}_{-0.09} M⊙。该结果与独立地从中子星物质状态方程重建推断的结果一致，即 M_TOV,exc=2.16^{+0.10}_{-0.07} M⊙，特别是在构建 M_TOV 先验分布时移除了间接测量的大质量中子星后。不同方法得到的非旋转中子星最大质量的一致性表明，对致密物质物理这一关键参数有合理理解。
classification.one_liner: 结合扩展的中子星样本和核物理约束，本文更新了 GW170817 双中子星并合的潮汐参数及后合并引力波能量，并给出非旋转中子星最大质量的估计。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究双中子星并合后的引力波能量和中子星最大质量，属于经典引力/致密天体与引力波方向，与“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签相关；但不涉及全息对偶等理论全息主题。

papers.title: Stochastic Thermodynamics of Dynamical Thin-Shell Wormholes: Effective Temperatures, Fluctuations and Conditional Quasi-Horizon Unification
papers.abstract: We develop an effective stochastic and semiclassical framework for dynamical thin-shell wormholes connecting two asymptotic spacetime regions. The Israel junction geometry is separated from the phenomenological open-system description: stochastic dynamics is formulated in the radial phase space $(a,\dot a)$, whereas $\sigma$, $P$, and the effective temperature scales are induced observables. A one-dimensional Langevin--Fokker--Planck model is obtained only after an explicit overdamped/adiabatic approximation. Local acceleration scales are interpreted as reservoir temperatures only under additional KMS and detailed-balance assumptions. For a symmetric Schwarzschild--Schwarzschild wormhole, the transparent conservative shell defines the reference potential and restoring frequency, while dissipation and noise are introduced as open-system corrections. The stable linear response is closed by the constitutive slope $\beta_0^2=(dP/d\sigma)_0$. For $2M<a_0<3M$, stability requires a lower bound on $\beta_0^2$ that diverges as $a_0\to2M^+$. Moreover, the derivative along the family of static configurations equals the marginal-stability slope and must not be identified with the constitutive derivative of a stable stochastic shell. The reduced model determines stationary distributions, fluctuations, correlations, Markovian and non-Markovian spectra, and entropy production. Near the horizon, the junction conditions yield $T_{\rm stress}=T_{\rm acc}+O(\hbar\gamma/a)$, with equality at leading order under a specified dominance condition. A peeling temperature participates only if the ray-tracing map satisfies generalized Unruh/peeling and adiabaticity conditions. Thus, the three-temperature correspondence is conditional, while the stochastic coefficients remain phenomenological pending a microscopic shell--reservoir model.

classification.title_zh: 动态薄壳虫洞的随机热力学：有效温度、涨落与条件性准视界统一
classification.abstract_zh: 我们为连接两个渐近时空区域的动态薄壳虫洞发展了一个有效的随机半经典框架。Israel 衔接几何与现象学开放系统描述被分离开来：随机动力学在径向相空间 (a, \dot a) 中表述，而 σ、P 和有效温度标度是诱导可观测量。只有在显式过阻尼/绝热近似之后，才得到一维 Langevin–Fokker–Planck 模型。局域加速度标度只有在额外的 KMS 和细致平衡假设下才被解释为热库温度。对于对称 Schwarzschild–Schwarzschild 虫洞，透明保守壳定义参考势和恢复频率，而耗散和噪声作为开放系统修正引入。稳定的线性响应由本构斜率 β_0^2=(dP/dσ)_0 封闭。对于 2M<a_0<3M，稳定性要求 β_0^2 有一个下界，且该下界在 a_0→2M^+ 时发散。此外，沿静态构型族的导数等于边际稳定斜率，不能与稳定随机壳的本构导数等同。约化模型决定了稳态分布、涨落、关联、马尔可夫和非马尔可夫谱以及熵产生。在视界附近，衔接条件给出 T_{\rm stress}=T_{\rm acc}+O(\hbarγ/a)，在指定的主导条件下领头阶相等。剥离温度只有在光线追踪映射满足广义 Unruh/peeling 和绝热条件时才参与。因此，三温度对应是条件性的，而随机系数在微观壳–热库模型建立之前仍是现象学的。
classification.one_liner: 为动态薄壳虫洞建立随机半经典有效描述，并指出有效温度对应依赖 KMS/细致平衡与视界附近条件。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/广义相对论支线（薄壳虫洞、Israel 衔接、Schwarzschild 稳定性），并涉及随机非平衡与有效温度；不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶，因此对全息标签相关性低，但对经典引力重点标签直接相关。

papers.title: What does "instant thermalization" in large-$q$ SYK models mean?
papers.abstract: Motivated by the Planckian thermalization rate $\Gamma \sim T$ observed in the two-body interacting SYK model, we study thermalization in the $q/2$-body case. Previous studies of such systems have established the notion of instantaneous thermalization to leading order in $1/q$. It was conjectured that the thermalization may still be Planckian but with a divergent rate $\Gamma \sim T q$, explaining the ``instantaneous'' part. For an analytically and numerically tractable system, we calculate the effective temperatures after a quench at time $t = 0$ and indeed find a Planckian rate, albeit with the unexpected decaying behavior $\Gamma \sim T q^{-1} $. This is contrasted with the behavior of the causal Green's function $\mathcal{G}(t_1, t_2)$, which instantly acquires a thermal form in the two-time plane block $t_1, t_2 > 0$. The resulting picture is that instant thermalization is a meaningful concept only for this block, while the off-diagonal blocks $t_1 \cdot t_2 < 0$ are inherently non-thermal at any $q$. Since the effective temperature is obtained from correlations spanning all blocks, it inherits a finite rate set by the off-diagonal. We illustrate this directly by studying the non-thermal correlations' time dependence.

classification.title_zh: 大-$q$ SYK 模型中的“瞬时热化”意味着什么？
classification.abstract_zh: 受两体相互作用 SYK 模型中观测到的普朗克热化率 $\Gamma \sim T$ 启发，我们研究 $q/2$ 体情形下的热化。此类系统的先前研究已在 $1/q$ 领头阶确立了瞬时热化的概念。有人曾猜想热化可能仍是普朗克的，但具有发散速率 $\Gamma \sim T q$，从而解释“瞬时”部分。对于一个解析和数值上可处理的系统，我们计算了在 $t=0$ 时刻淬火后的有效温度，并确实发现普朗克速率，尽管具有出乎意料的衰减行为 $\Gamma \sim T q^{-1}$。这与因果格林函数 $\mathcal{G}(t_1, t_2)$ 的行为形成对比，后者在双时平面块 $t_1, t_2 > 0$ 中瞬间获得热的形式。由此得到的图像是：瞬时热化仅对这个块有意义，而非对角块 $t_1 \cdot t_2 < 0$ 在任何 $q$ 下本质上都是非热的。由于有效温度来自跨越所有块的关联，它继承了由非对角块设定的有限速率。我们通过研究非热关联的时间依赖性直接说明了这一点。
classification.one_liner: 大-$q$ SYK 的“瞬时热化”只发生在 $t_1,t_2>0$ 的因果格林函数块中；跨块的非热关联给出有限热化率 $\Gamma \sim T/q$。

papers.title: Scalar quasinormal and quasibound states of weakly magnetized Ernst--Schwarzschild spacetime: a confluent-Heun Wronskian approach
papers.abstract: We study the quasinormal-mode and quasibound-state spectra of a massless scalar field in weakly magnetized Ernst--Schwarzschild spacetime. In the separated $O(B_0^2)$ regime, the Klein--Gordon equation reduces to a radial confluent-Heun equation. We construct an endpoint-selected spectral Wronskian directly from the canonical confluent-Heun recurrence and its regular-to-irregular connection limit. Quasinormal modes and quasibound states are then obtained as zeros of the same analytic spectral function on the radiative and bound sheets, respectively, providing a unified treatment of the two spectral sectors within the separated weak-field problem. The resulting QNM and QBS frequencies agree with independent weak-field Ernst and massive-Schwarzschild benchmarks available in the literature. We further show, for representative cases, that the frequencies selected by the local Heun-series termination relation examined here do not satisfy the endpoint-selected quasibound-state condition. The construction therefore provides a direct horizon-to-infinity spectral condition for both radiative and bound states within the weak-field Ernst problem.

classification.title_zh: 弱磁化 Ernst--Schwarzschild 时空中标量准正规模与准束缚态：一种合流 Heun Wronskian 方法
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究弱磁化 Ernst--Schwarzschild 时空中无质量标量场的准正规模和准束缚态谱。在分离的 O(B0^2) 区域，Klein--Gordon 方程约化为径向合流 Heun 方程。我们直接从标准合流 Heun 递推及其正则到非正则连接极限构造端点选择的谱 Wronskian。随后，准正规模和准束缚态分别作为同一解析谱函数在辐射叶和束缚叶上的零点获得，从而在分离弱场问题中统一处理这两个谱扇区。所得 QNM 和 QBS 频率与文献中独立的弱场 Ernst 及有质量 Schwarzschild 基准一致。我们进一步对代表性情形表明，此处考察的局部 Heun 级数终止关系所选出的频率不满足端点选择的准束缚态条件。因此，该构造在弱场 Ernst 问题中为辐射态和束缚态提供了直接的从事件视界到无穷远的谱条件。
classification.one_liner: 用合流 Heun Wronskian 统一给出弱磁化 Ernst--Schwarzschild 时空中标量准正规模与准束缚态的谱条件。

papers.title: First-Law Entropy and a Degenerate Extremal Remnant in a Minimal-Length Simpson--Visser-Type Regular Black Hole: Geometrothermodynamics, Phase Structure, and Observational Discriminants
papers.abstract: We construct the first-law-consistent entropy of a geometrically minimal-length-deformed Schwarzschild spacetime, obtained via the areal-radius substitution $R(r)=\sqrt{r^{2}+\ell^{2}}$ on $r\in[0,+\infty)$ with $f(R)=1-2M/R$, whose nonvanishing Einstein tensor sources an effective geometric fluid with no classical matter counterpart. Integrating the first law gives $S=\pi[r_{h}R_{h}+\ell^{2}\ln((r_{h}+R_{h})/\ell)]$. This coincides in functional form with the semiclassical term found independently by Joshi and Joshi, but we fix its boundary condition $S(r_h=0)=0$ on independent physical grounds and adopt it, rather than the Bekenstein--Hawking area law, as the complete entropy of the model, building the free energy, geometrothermodynamics, and mode-stability analysis on it. Evaporation, governed by the Helmholtz free energy $F(M)$, terminates at $M_{\min}=\ell/2$ in a previously unrecognised endpoint: a degenerate extremal regular black hole, where the regular centre coincides with a degenerate Killing horizon of quadratic order, $f\approx r^{2}/(2\ell^{2})$, at areal radius $\ell$, with $T_{H}\to 0$, $S\to 0$, $C\to 0^{+}$, and finite curvature everywhere; we display its Penrose--Carter structure for the first time. The same entropy, with $\ell$, defines the equilibrium state space of a Legendre-invariant geometrothermodynamic (GTD) description whose curvature scalar diverges independently at the Davies-type transition $M^{*}=\ell/\sqrt{2}$ and at $M_{\min}$, a divergence with no counterpart in the minimal-length black hole literature, specific to a genuine horizon at $S=0$. We embed this remnant within the observational discriminant noted qualitatively by Tsukamoto: exact shadow degeneracy combined with a measurable photon-ring flux enhancement $r_{n}=e^{-2\pi/a}>e^{-2\pi}$, accessible to next-generation very-long-baseline interferometry.

classification.title_zh: 最小长度 Simpson--Visser 型正则黑洞中的第一定律熵与退化极端遗迹：几何热力学、相结构与观测判别
classification.abstract_zh: 我们通过面积半径替换 R(r)=√(r^2+ℓ^2)（r∈[0,+∞)）并在 f(R)=1-2M/R 下，构造了一个几何最小长度变形 Schwarzschild 时空的第一定律一致熵；其非零 Einstein 张量作为有效几何流体源，没有经典物质对应。积分第一定律给出 S=π[r_h R_h+ℓ^2 ln((r_h+R_h)/ℓ)]。该式在函数形式上与 Joshi 和 Joshi 独立得到的半经典项一致，但我们基于独立物理理由固定边界条件 S(r_h=0)=0，并采用它而非 Bekenstein--Hawking 面积律作为模型的完整熵，在此基础上构建自由能、几何热力学和模式稳定性分析。由 Helmholtz 自由能 F(M) 支配的蒸发终止于 M_min=ℓ/2，出现此前未认识的端点：一个退化极端正则黑洞，其中正则中心与二次阶退化 Killing 视界重合，f≈r^2/(2ℓ^2)，面积半径为 ℓ，且 T_H→0、S→0、C→0^+，曲率处处有限；我们首次展示其 Penrose--Carter 结构。同一熵（含 ℓ）定义了 Legendre 不变的几何热力学 (GTD) 描述的平衡态空间，其曲率标量在 Davies 型转变 M^*=ℓ/√2 与 M_min 处独立发散；这一发散在最小长度黑洞文献中没有对应，是 S=0 处真实视界特有的。我们将该遗迹嵌入 Tsukamoto 定性指出的观测判别：精确阴影退化与可测量的光子环通量增强 r_n=e^{-2π/a}>e^{-2π}，下一代甚长基线干涉测量可及。

papers.title: Noether and Mei symmetries in static spherically symmetric quadratic gravity: variational consistency, constraints, and conserved curvature flux
papers.abstract: The symmetry content of static spherical $f(R)$ gravity is reconsidered for the pure quadratic model. We first derive the radial action without prematurely eliminating the equation carried by the radial metric variable. The Schwarzschild-type gauge may then be imposed while retaining its associated gravitational constraint. For the resulting system, radial translations and one combined scaling are exact off-shell Noether symmetries. The scaling charge reduces, on the constraint surface, to a conserved radial flux of the scalar curvature. The same flux follows independently from the trace of the four-dimensional field equations. Noether invariance, the strong point-Mei criterion, and Lie invariance of the Euler--Lagrange system are examined separately. Within the full polynomial point ansatz of total degree at most two, the Lie algebra contains precisely three independent generators. The flux also separates the solution space into a nonzero constant-curvature Einstein sector, a degenerate scalar-flat sector, and a dynamical-curvature sector. In particular, the scalar-flat sector permits a Reissner--Nordstr\"om-form metric, although its inverse-square coefficient has no electromagnetic meaning in the absence of a Maxwell field.

classification.title_zh: 静态球对称二次引力中的 Noether 与 Mei 对称性：变分一致性、约束与守恒曲率通量
classification.abstract_zh: 重新考虑静态球对称 f(R) 引力在纯二次模型中的对称性内容。我们首先在不预先消去径向度规变量所满足方程的情况下导出径向作用量。随后可以施加 Schwarzschild 型规范，同时保留其关联的引力约束。对于所得系统，径向平移与一个组合标度变换是精确的离壳 Noether 对称性。该标度荷在约束面上约化为标量曲率的守恒径向通量。同一通量也可独立地从四维场方程的迹得到。分别考察 Noether 不变性、强点 Mei 判据以及 Euler-Lagrange 系统的 Lie 不变性。在总次数至多二的完整多项式点拟设内，Lie 代数恰好包含三个独立生成元。该通量还将解空间分为非零常曲率 Einstein 扇区、退化的标量平坦扇区和动力学曲率扇区。特别地，标量平坦扇区允许 Reissner-Nordström 形式的度规，尽管在没有 Maxwell 场时其平方反比系数没有电磁意义。
classification.one_liner: 在静态球对称纯二次 f(R) 引力中，通过保持径向约束的变分分析识别出精确 Noether 对称性、守恒曲率通量及三类解扇区。

papers.title: When duality changes the poles: $SL(2,\mathbb{Z})$ transformations of linear response EFTs
papers.abstract: We study how $SL(2,\mathbb Z)$ transformations act on pole-truncated linear-response effective theories in $(2+1)$ dimensions. For correlators meromorphic within a finite low-frequency domain, the EFT data include both derivative-expanded transport coefficients and the retained non-hydrodynamic poles. Since the $S$-trans\-for\-mation inverts the optical conductivity and exchanges its poles and zeros, it does not necessarily commute with the infrared truncation. We derive explicit maps for static susceptibilities, the Einstein relation and AC transport coefficients. In the purely hydrodynamic sector the map closes on the original transport data, while in quasihydrodynamic regimes the transformed pole positions and, in general, residues constitute additional infrared data. We test the construction in the alternatively quantised D3/D5 probe-brane system, where an EFT retaining one original gapped pole can correspond to transformed EFTs retaining zero, one or two. The holographic results verify the analytic maps and exhibit an inverse-Drude conductivity at large values of the control parameter.

classification.title_zh: 当对偶改变极点：线性响应 EFT 的 SL(2,Z) 变换
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究 SL(2,Z) 变换如何作用于 (2+1) 维中极点截断的线性响应有效理论。对于在有限低频区域内亚纯的关联函数，EFT 数据既包括导数展开的输运系数，也包括保留的非流体力学校点。由于 S 变换反转光学电导率并交换其极点和零点，它不一定与红外截断对易。我们推导了静态磁化率、爱因斯坦关系和 AC 输运系数的显式映射。在纯流体力学区域，映射闭合于原始输运数据；而在准流体力学区域，变换后的极点位置以及一般情况下的留数构成额外的红外数据。我们在交替量子化的 D3/D5 探针膜系统中检验该构造，其中保留一个原始有能隙极点的 EFT 可以对应于保留零个、一个或两个极点的变换后 EFT。全息结果验证了解析映射，并在控制参数大时表现出逆德鲁德电导率。
classification.one_liner: 研究 SL(2,Z) 对偶如何改变 (2+1) 维线性响应 EFT 的极点截断，并在 D3/D5 探针膜中验证输运映射。

papers.title: Reading Topological Hair from Black-Hole Entanglement
papers.abstract:
Black-hole hair can affect boundary mixed-state entanglement through local stress-energy and through topological information invisible to the classical metric. We separate these channels for a Nielsen--Olesen vortex on a nonrotating BTZ black hole. A superselection theorem shows that Shannon sector entropy cancels from the Markov gap, while standard $U(1)$ symmetry-resolved reflected entropy in a thermal $U(1)_k$ CFT is equipartitioned at leading order, excluding a universal $\log|n|$ term in the imbalance-resolved gap. We therefore define a Wilson-threaded reflected moment in a probe $U(1)_k$ Chern--Simons completion coupled to the compact vortex-flux class. In a reflected-replica sector with linking number $
u$, its normalised phase is $2\pi\kappa pn
u/k$, where $\kappa\in\mathbb Z$ is the mixed topological coupling; for $\gcd(\kappa
u,k)=1$, a discrete Fourier transform reconstructs $n mod k$. The RT connectivity transition switches the specified linked contour on or off, whereas the independent scale $\ell_\star r_+/L^2=1.128378\ldots$ determines the direction of the vortex-induced shift of that transition. The charged-moment modulus and the ordinary Markov gap remain geometric observables and are computed from a horizon-anchored Einstein-Abelian-Higgs solution with a complete first-variation kernel including the motion of the entanglement-wedge cross-section endpoints. This phase and modulus separation distinguishes topological hair from gravitational dressing without assigning an unsupported winding-dependent entropy.

classification.title_zh: 从黑洞纠缠读取拓扑毛
classification.abstract_zh: 黑洞毛可以通过局域应力能量以及经典度规不可见的拓扑信息影响边界混合态纠缠。我们针对非旋转 BTZ 黑洞上的 Nielsen-Olesen 涡旋分离这些通道。一个超选择定理表明 Shannon 扇区熵从 Markov gap 中相消，而热 U(1)_k CFT 中的标准 U(1) 对称分辨反射熵在领头阶是均分的，排除了非平衡分辨 gap 中普适的 log|n| 项。因此我们定义 Wilson 穿线反射矩，在探针 U(1)_k Chern-Simons 完成中与紧致涡旋磁通类耦合。在链接数 ν 的反射副本扇区中，其归一化相位为 2πκpnν/k，其中 κ∈Z 是混合拓扑耦合；对于 gcd(κν,k)=1，离散 Fourier 变换重构 n mod k。RT 连通性转变开启或关闭指定的链接围道，而独立标度 ℓ⋆ r_+/L^2=1.128378... 决定涡旋诱导的该转变移动方向。带电矩模量与普通 Markov gap 仍是几何可观测量，并由锚定于视界的 Einstein-Abelian-Higgs 解计算，包含完整的一阶变分核，包括纠缠楔截面端点的运动。这种相位与模量分离将拓扑毛与引力 dressing 区分开，而不赋予不支持的绕数依赖熵。

papers.title: Deep learning emergent spacetime from fermionic spectral functions in holography
papers.abstract: We present a physics-informed machine learning framework based on Neural Ordinary Differential Equations that solves the holographic inverse problem: reconstructing the bulk spacetime and gauge field of a charged AdS black hole directly from boundary fermionic spectral functions. Encoding the UV asymptotics, horizon regularity, and zero temperature extremality as hard constraints in the neural network architecture, our framework reliably reconstructs the extremal Reissner-Nordstr\"om AdS geometry across three quantum critical regimes set by the $U(1)$ probe charge---non-Fermi liquid, marginal Fermi liquid (strange metal), and Fermi-liquid-like states---and can jointly infer the probe charge itself to sub-percent accuracy. Relaxing the near-AdS boundary constraint uncovers a geometrical degeneracy: bulk profiles that differ throughout the radial direction but share the same near-horizon $AdS_2 \times \mathbb{R}^2$ data reproduce identical spectral functions near the Fermi surface. This isospectral non-uniqueness is precisely the bulk degeneracy expected on general holographic grounds at zero temperature, and its spontaneous emergence across independent training runs shows that the network isolates the IR CFT universality rather than overfitting a single UV completion.

classification.title_zh: 全息中从费米子谱函数深度学习涌现时空
