papers.title: The Fuzzy-Sphere as a Black Hole in the IKKT Matrix Model: An Assessment
papers.abstract: Black-hole thermodynamics has been reproduced with remarkable success from the BFSS matrix model, but the corresponding test in the closely related IKKT matrix model has awaited its recently proposed finite-temperature formulation. We investigate this correspondence within that framework. Introducing a cubic Myers term, we compute the complete one-loop thermodynamics -- free energy, internal energy, entropy, and heat capacity -- of a fuzzy $S^2$ background. No gravitational dual is known for this specific background, so we compare these quantities against the D0 and D2 black holes as the closest available reference points. At fixed Myers coupling, the leading entropy exhibits an $O(N^3)$ scaling rather than the $O(N^2)$ behavior characteristic of conventional black holes; this scaling mismatch is the central result of our analysis. We further find no intrinsic Hawking temperature -- only a characteristic scale -- and a heat capacity that is negative at both the low- and high-temperature endpoints. Holding the physical radius fixed instead yields a genuine $O(N^2)$ scaling, so the power of $N$ is convention-dependent rather than an unambiguous prediction -- though the sign and temperature-scale mismatches persist either way. Rather than establishing a black-hole interpretation of the finite-temperature IKKT matrix model, these results provide a quantitative benchmark against which future analytical, numerical, and holographic investigations can be tested.

classification.title_zh: 模糊球作为 IKKT 矩阵模型中的黑洞：一项评估
classification.abstract_zh: BFSS 矩阵模型已非常成功地再现了黑洞热力学，但在密切相关的 IKKT 矩阵模型中，相应的检验一直有待其最近提出的有限温度表述。我们在该框架内研究这一对应。引入立方 Myers 项后，我们计算了模糊 S^2 背景的完整单圈热力学——自由能、内能、熵和热容。对于这一特定背景，尚不知道任何引力对偶，因此我们将这些量与 D0 和 D2 黑洞作为最接近的可用参考点进行比较。在固定 Myers 耦合下，领头熵表现出 O(N^3) 标度，而不是常规黑洞特征的 O(N^2) 行为；这一标度不匹配是我们分析的核心结果。我们进一步发现没有内禀 Hawking 温度——只有一个特征尺度——并且热容在低温端和高温端均为负。若改为固定物理半径，则得到真正的 O(N^2) 标度，因此 N 的幂次依赖于约定，而不是一个无歧义的预言——尽管符号和温度尺度的不匹配在两种情况下都持续存在。这些结果并未确立有限温度 IKKT 矩阵模型的黑洞解释，而是提供了一个定量基准，供未来解析、数值和全息研究检验。
classification.one_liner: 在有限温度 IKKT 矩阵模型中计算模糊 S^2 背景的单圈热力学，发现熵标度与常规黑洞不符，因而未能支持其黑洞解释。
classification.relevance_reason: 主题为 IKKT 矩阵模型/模糊球的黑洞热力学，未涉及用户重点标签中的全息超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子、D3-D7/Floquet 或经典引力等具体支线。

papers.title: The Conformal $w$-Algebra
papers.abstract: Einstein gravity in four asymptotically flat dimensions is governed by a tower of soft theorems obeying an $\mathcal{L}w_{1+\infty}$ commutator algebra. This algebra is deformed to $\mathcal{L}_\Lambda w_{1+\infty}$ in the conformally related AdS$_4$ and dS$_4$ spacetimes. Here we construct the larger ``conformal $w$-algebra", denoted $\mathcal{C}w_{1+\infty}$, which acts on conformal gravity in all of these spacetimes. It includes $\mathcal{L}w_{1+\infty}$, $\mathcal{L}_\Lambda w_{1+\infty}$ and the $\mathfrak{so}(4,2)$ 4D conformal algebra as subalgebras. We show that $\mathcal{C}w_{1+\infty}$ is the conformal completion of either $\mathcal{L}w_{1+\infty}$ or $\mathcal{L}_\Lambda w_{1+\infty}$. A derivation of $\mathcal{C}w_{1+\infty}$ is given as the symmetry of the twistor action of self-dual conformal gravity.

classification.title_zh: 共形 w-代数
classification.abstract_zh: 四维渐近平直时空中的爱因斯坦引力由一族满足 $\mathcal{L}w_{1+\infty}$ 交换子代数的软定理支配。该代数在共形相关的 AdS$_4$ 和 dS$_4$ 时空中变形为 $\mathcal{L}_\Lambda w_{1+\infty}$。这里我们构造更大的“共形 w-代数”，记作 $\mathcal{C}w_{1+\infty}$，它作用在这些时空中的共形引力上。它包含 $\mathcal{L}w_{1+\infty}$、$\mathcal{L}_\Lambda w_{1+\infty}$ 以及 $\mathfrak{so}(4,2)$ 四维共形代数作为子代数。我们证明 $\mathcal{C}w_{1+\infty}$ 是 $\mathcal{L}w_{1+\infty}$ 或 $\mathcal{L}_\Lambda w_{1+\infty}$ 的共形完备化。作为 $\mathcal{C}w_{1+\infty}$ 的一个推导，它被给出为自对偶共形引力 twistor 作用的对称性。
classification.one_liner: 构造了作用在平直、AdS$_4$ 和 dS$_4$ 中共形引力上的共形 w-代数 $\mathcal{C}w_{1+\infty}$，并证明其是 $\mathcal{L}w_{1+\infty}$ 或 $\mathcal{L}_\Lambda w_{1+\infty}$ 的共形完备化，作为自对偶共形引力 twistor 作用的对称性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究软定理与渐近对称代数，属于天球/平直全息方向，与用户列出的全息超导、QNM、探针膜、冷原子等支线及经典引力现象无直接重叠。

papers.title: Matrix Theory from Holography
papers.abstract: We propose a setup that embeds Matrix Theory for M-theory into the AdS/CFT correspondence, allowing the former to be tested using the latter. The central claim is a triality among the BMN matrix model of rank $m$, a large-charge monopole sector of ABJM theory with charge $J$, and M-theory on the maximally supersymmetric eleven-dimensional pp-wave with a compact lightlike direction. The relevant ABJM limit sends $N,k,J\to\infty$ while keeping $N/k^2$ and $m=J/k$ fixed. We provide quantitative evidence for this triality by showing that, in this triple-scaling limit, the ABJM superconformal index agrees precisely with a grand-canonical sum of Witten indices of the $U(m)$ BMN matrix model. This relation also yields a compact grand-canonical expression for the BMN index, which we use to revisit its large-$m$ behavior. Our analytic and numerical results reveal strong boson--fermion cancellations and show no evidence for the previously claimed $e^{O(m^2)}$ growth when the BMN charge scales as $Q \sim m^2$. We further study the correspondence between the BPS cohomologies of the two theories by constructing a letter-level dictionary. This leads to a new notion of BPS fortuity in ABJM theory that survives even at strict $N=\infty$: although the usual fortuity associated with finite-$N$ trace relations disappears in the triple-scaling limit, each fixed-monopole sector is governed by the effective rank $m$, and finite-$m$ trace relations generate fortuitous states that map directly to fortuitous states of the BMN matrix model. Finally, we discuss connections to related concepts such as large-charge matrix models, open--closed--open triality, and worldline holography.

classification.title_zh: 来自全息的矩阵理论
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个将 M 理论的矩阵理论嵌入 AdS/CFT 对应的方案，从而可用后者检验前者。核心主张是 rank m 的 BMN 矩阵模型、荷为 J 的 ABJM 理论大荷磁单极子扇区、以及具有紧致类光方向的十一维极大超对称 pp-wave 上的 M 理论之间的三重对偶。相关 ABJM 极限为 N,k,J→∞，同时保持 N/k^2 和 m=J/k 固定。我们通过证明在该三重标度极限下 ABJM 超共形指标精确等于 U(m) BMN 矩阵模型 Witten 指标的大正则求和，给出该三重对偶的定量证据。该关系还给出 BMN 指标的一个紧致大正则表达式，我们用它重新审视其大 m 行为。我们的解析与数值结果显示出强玻色—费米抵消，并未发现在 BMN 荷按 Q~m^2 标度时先前所声称的 e^{O(m^2)} 增长证据。我们进一步通过构造 letter 层面的字典研究两个理论 BPS 上同调之间的对应，由此引出 ABJM 理论中一种即使在严格 N=∞ 仍存活的新 BPS fortuity 概念：尽管与有限 N trace relation 相关的通常 fortuity 在三重标度极限中消失，每个固定磁单极子扇区由有效 rank m 支配，有限 m trace relation 产生可直接映射到 BMN 矩阵模型 fortuitous 态的 fortuitous 态。最后，我们讨论与大荷矩阵模型、open-closed-open triality 和 worldline holography 等相关概念的联系。
classification.one_liner: 提出 BMN 矩阵模型、ABJM 大荷磁单极子扇区与十一维 pp-wave 上 M 理论的三重对偶，并用超共形指标给出定量证据。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT、矩阵模型与 M 理论方向，但未直接匹配用户列出的重点标签（全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子/双组分BEC、D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜与Floquet驱动、经典引力/广义相对论）。

papers.title: Electromagnetic Duality Sensitivity of Holographic Complexity
papers.abstract: We investigate electromagnetic duality as a diagnostic of the sensitivity of information content of holographic complexity via "complexity=anything" in Einstein-ModMax theory. Functionals constructed solely from gravitational invariants are duality invariant, whereas matter-sensitive functionals can distinguish electromagnetic configurations that share the same bulk geometry and energy-momentum tensor. As an explicit example, we consider a functional involving $F_{\mu\nu}F^{\mu\nu}$ and show that its complexity and complexity growth vary along the duality orbit, interpolating between purely electric, mixed electric-magnetic, and purely magnetic configurations. This provides an explicit realization of the freedom inherent in generalized holographic complexity and shows that different choices of complexity functional can retain different sensitivity to information about the bulk matter sector even when the gravitational geometry is insensitive to that information.

classification.title_zh: 全息复杂度的电磁对偶敏感性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究电磁对偶，将其作为在 Einstein-ModMax 理论中通过“complexity=anything”诊断全息复杂度信息内容敏感性的工具。仅由引力不变量构造的泛函具有对偶不变性，而物质敏感泛函可以区分共享同一体几何和能量-动量张量的电磁位形。作为一个显式例子，我们考虑一个涉及 $F_{\mu\nu}F^{\mu\nu}$ 的泛函，并展示其复杂度和复杂度增长沿对偶轨道变化，在纯电场、电场-磁场混合和纯磁场位形之间插值。这显式实现了广义全息复杂度所固有的自由度，并表明即使引力几何对该信息不敏感，不同复杂度泛函的选择也可以保留对体物质部门信息的不同敏感性。
classification.one_liner: 在 Einstein-ModMax 理论中，含 F^2 的 complexity=anything 泛函沿电磁对偶轨道变化，证明全息复杂度可敏感于体物质信息而几何不变。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于全息复杂度/AdS-CFT 理论，但与用户列出的全息超导、p波、畴壁、multi-trace、相变、QNM、冷原子、探针膜和经典引力等重点方向无直接交集。

papers.title: Modular flow and the area operator
papers.abstract: In the context of the AdS/CFT correspondence, the Jafferis-Lewkowycz-Maldacena-Suh (JLMS) formula relates the boundary modular Hamiltonian to the HRT area operator and the corresponding bulk modular Hamiltonian. In standard discussions of a holographic code built from perturbative excitations on a fixed classical background, the $A/4G$ term dominates over the bulk modular Hamiltonian in the limit $G \to 0$. However, this setup is insufficient to describe the action of boundary modular flows that change the classical background. In contrast, our recent discussion of `large' codes provides a useful framework to obtain a JLMS formula that relates bulk and boundary modular flows acting on appropriate states in the code. Here, one sees that the bulk modular Hamiltonian is not in fact subdominant when the modular flow defined by one state acts on another state peaked around a sufficiently different classical background. Instead, the bulk modular Hamiltonian can be of order $1/G$ and can dominate over the $A/4G$ term. Nevertheless, we show that if the two states have the same classical background except for data conjugate to the HRT area then, under mild assumptions and over a large range of flow parameters, the modular-flowed state is described by a classical background given by the HRT-area flow alone.

classification.title_zh: 模流与面积算符
classification.abstract_zh: 在 AdS/CFT 对应背景下，Jafferis-Lewkowycz-Maldacena-Suh（JLMS）公式将边界模哈密顿量与 HRT 面积算符及相应的体模哈密顿量联系起来。在基于固定经典背景上微扰激发构建的全息码的标准讨论中，当 G → 0 时，A/4G 项主导体模哈密顿量。然而，这种设置不足以描述改变经典背景的边界模流作用。相比之下，我们近期关于“大”码的讨论为获得一个 JLMS 公式提供了有用框架，该公式将作用于码中适当态上的体与边界模流联系起来。在这里可以看到，当一个态定义的模流作用于另一个围绕足够不同经典背景的态时，体模哈密顿量实际上并不次主导。相反，体模哈密顿量可以是 1/G 量级，并可能主导 A/4G 项。尽管如此，我们证明，如果两个态具有相同的经典背景，除了与 HRT 面积共轭的数据不同，那么在温和假设下并在很大的流参数范围内，模流后的态由仅由 HRT 面积流给出的经典背景描述。
classification.one_liner: 在全息大码框架中，模流作用于不同经典背景态时体模哈密顿量可主导 A/4G；若两态仅相差 HRT 面积共轭数据，则模流态由 HRT 面积流描述。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文聚焦 JLMS 公式、模流与 HRT 面积算符，属于 AdS/CFT 基础与量子信息方向，不直接涉及用户重点列出的全息超流超导、p波/多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7/D3-D5 探针膜或经典引力等支线。

papers.title: Holographic Casimir Effect for Mixed Boundary Conditions and non-CFTs
papers.abstract: This paper investigates the holographic Casimir effect in AdS/BCFT with a brane-localized scalar field. The scalar field takes different values at the strip's two boundaries, leading to mixed boundary conditions. The massive brane-localized scalar field typically breaks the boundary conformal symmetries, allowing us to study the holographic Casimir effect in non-CFTs. In two-dimensional spacetime, we apply the holographic g-theorem to prove the holographic bound on the Casimir effect for general brane-localized matter fields. In higher dimensions, we find that the brane-localized scalar field reduces the Casimir amplitude when the mass squared \(m^2=0\), but can increase it when \(m^2 < 0\). Additionally, there is a no-hair theorem for the cases where \(m^2>0\). These findings indicate that relevant boundary deformations can enhance the Casimir effect. As a byproduct, we obtain a gravitational dual of the repulsive Casimir force under mixed boundary conditions and argue that it aligns with the cosmic censorship conjecture.

classification.title_zh: 混合边界条件与非 CFT 中的全息卡西米尔效应
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究 AdS/BCFT 中带有膜局域标量场的全息卡西米尔效应。标量场在条带两个边界取不同值，导致混合边界条件。有质量的膜局域标量场通常会破坏边界共形对称性，使我们能够研究非 CFT 中的全息卡西米尔效应。在二维时空中，我们应用全息 g-定理证明了对一般膜局域物质场的卡西米尔效应的全息界。在更高维中，我们发现当质量平方 m^2=0 时，膜局域标量场降低卡西米尔振幅，但当 m^2<0 时可以增大它。此外，对于 m^2>0 的情况存在无毛定理。这些发现表明相关边界形变可以增强卡西米尔效应。作为副产品，我们获得了混合边界条件下排斥卡西米尔力的引力对偶，并论证它与宇宙监督猜想一致。
classification.one_liner: 在 AdS/BCFT 中研究带膜局域标量场与混合边界条件的全息卡西米尔效应，发现非 CFT 边界形变可增强卡西米尔力，并给出排斥卡西米尔力的引力对偶与宇宙监督的联系。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/BCFT 全息与卡西米尔效应，并涉及经典引力中的无毛定理与宇宙监督；但与用户列出的全息超导、探针膜、QNM、冷原子等具体重点支线无直接重合。

papers.title: M2 brane in AdS$_4\times S^7/\mathbb Z_k$: 2-loop correction to $\frac{1}{2}$-BPS Wilson loop vs localization in ABJM theory
papers.abstract: We study the quantization of an M2 brane wrapping $\mathrm{AdS}_2\times S^1$ inside $\mathrm{AdS}_4\times S^7/\mathbb{Z}_k$, dual to the $\frac{1}{2}$-BPS circular Wilson loop in ABJM theory. The classical action and the one-loop contribution were previously shown to reproduce the gauge-theory localization result. Here we extend the analysis to the two-loop order. In an adapted static and $\kappa$-symmetry gauge the world-volume action contains no cubic interaction vertices, so that the two-loop correction is determined entirely by quartic interactions and is manifestly free of logarithmic UV divergences. We find that the bosonic and fermionic contributions combine into a perfect square $ {\mathscr X}^2$ where ${\mathscr X}$ is a linear combination of the bosonic and fermionic 3d Green's functions and their derivatives. The evaluation of $\mathscr X$ requires fixing the $\mathrm{AdS}_2$ boundary quantization of the massless fermionic modes. With the boundary conditions selected by the preserved supersymmetry, $\mathscr X$ vanishes and hence the complete two-loop correction is found to be zero. This result would not be consistent with identifying the M2-brane loop expansion directly with the large-$N$ expansion of the canonical, fixed-$(N,k)$ localization prediction. Instead, it agrees precisely with the recent proposal that the semiclassical M2-brane partition function should be matched to the gauge-theory grand-canonical ensemble, in which the Wilson loop expectation value is perturbatively one-loop exact. The vanishing of the two-loop correction thus provides a non-trivial test of this grand-canonical identification.

classification.title_zh: AdS4×S7/Zk 中的 M2 膜：ABJM 理论中 1/2-BPS Wilson 圈的双圈修正与局域化对比
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究在 AdS4×S7/Zk 内部包裹 AdS2×S1 的 M2 膜的量子化，其对偶是 ABJM 理论中的 1/2-BPS 圆 Wilson 圈。此前已证明经典作用量和单圈贡献能重现规范理论的局域化结果。这里我们将分析推广到双圈阶。在适当的静态且 κ 对称规范下，世界体积作用量不包含三阶相互作用顶点，因此双圈修正完全由四次相互作用决定，并且明显没有对数紫外发散。我们发现玻色子和费米子贡献合并为一个完全平方 X^2，其中 X 是玻色子和费米子三维格林函数及其导数的线性组合。计算 X 需要固定无质量费米子模式的 AdS2 边界量子化。在由保持的超对称所选择的边界条件下，X 为零，因此完整的双圈修正为零。该结果与将 M2 膜圈展开直接等同于正则固定 (N,k) 局域化预言的大 N 展开不一致。相反，它精确符合最近的提议：半经典 M2 膜配分函数应与规范理论巨正则系综相匹配，其中 Wilson 圈期望值在微扰意义下单圈精确。因此双圈修正的消失为这一巨正则对应提供了非平凡检验。
classification.one_liner: 在 AdS4×S7/Zk 中计算对偶于 ABJM 1/2-BPS 圆 Wilson 圈的 M2 膜双圈修正，发现修正为零，支持半经典 M2 膜配分函数对应规范理论巨正则系综、Wilson 圈微扰单圈精确的提议。
classification.relevance_reason: 核心属于 AdS/CFT 基础与字典中的 M2 膜/Wilson 圈/局域化精确检验，但未直接涉及用户列出的全息凝聚态、相变、QNM、探针膜等具体重点支线。

papers.title: Attraction and repulsion along extremal Einstein--two-Maxwell--dilaton branches
papers.abstract: We study extremal mass branches in four-dimensional Einstein gravity coupled to one dilaton and two Maxwell fields with opposite-sign dilaton couplings. For generic couplings the extremal mass is governed by a nonlinear first-order equation with no known closed-form solution. We prove that this equation has a unique positive $C^2$ solution on the full real charge-ratio line and that the solution is real analytic, so positivity on the entire positive charge cone selects a unique global mass branch. Along this branch, any two nonproportional positive charge vectors attract for $ab>-1$, have vanishing leading force at $ab=-1$, and repel for $ab<-1$. The same transition fixes the transverse convexity of the extremal mass surface and the sign of the mass difference under arbitrary finite positive-charge partitions. The sign theorem extends to higher dimensions through the known dimensional rescaling. A radial reconstruction then shows that every point of the mass branch defines an asymptotically flat exterior with a finite-area inner endpoint, while smooth or analytic horizon extension is a separate condition that restricts the couplings and scalar flow.

classification.title_zh: 沿极端 Einstein-双 Maxwell-伸缩子分支的吸引与排斥
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了四维 Einstein 引力与一个伸缩子和两个具有相反符号伸缩子耦合的 Maxwell 场耦合时的极端质量分支。对于一般耦合，极端质量由无已知闭式解的非线性一阶方程支配。我们证明该方程在整个实电荷比直线上有唯一正 C^2 解，并且该解实解析，因此整个正电荷锥上的正性选出唯一整体质量分支。沿此分支，任意两个不成比例的正电荷矢量在 ab>-1 时吸引，在 ab=-1 时领头力为零，在 ab<-1 时排斥。同一转变决定了极端质量面的横向凸性以及任意有限正电荷划分下质量差的符号。符号定理通过已知量纲标度推广到更高维。径向重构随后表明，质量分支的每一点定义一个渐近平坦外部，并具有有限面积的内端点，而光滑或解析视界延拓是单独条件，会限制耦合和标量流。
classification.one_liner: 证明 Einstein-双 Maxwell-伸缩子极端质量分支的唯一性，并给出电荷间吸引/排斥的符号转变及渐近平坦外部重构。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究经典 Einstein-Maxwell-伸缩子引力中的极端质量分支、力符号与渐近平坦外部，属于用户重点的经典引力/广义相对论支线。

papers.title: Spectral Chaos from a Fluctuating Quantum Horizon
papers.abstract: Black holes are conjectured to be maximally chaotic, with their quantum spectra expected to exhibit universal random-matrix correlations. This expectation, however, has so far rested largely on holographic descriptions or on many-body models in which randomness is introduced rather than derived from the microscopic degrees of freedom of the horizon itself. In the horizon matrix model, the fuzzy sphere supports highly degenerate parton states whose multiplicity accounts for the black-hole entropy. We show that quantum fluctuations of the horizon geometry lift this degeneracy and generate an ensemble of one-parton Hamiltonians. Both the operator structure and the rank-dependent covariance of this ensemble are determined by the microscopic model, rather than fixed by quenched couplings. Despite this structured covariance, the resulting spectra exhibit GOE, GUE, and GSE statistics dictated by their antiunitary symmetry classes, with the adjacent-gap statistic becoming increasingly self-averaging with matrix size. The model also realizes the universal Pandey--Mehta orthogonal-to-unitary crossover, with the crossover scale determined by the microscopic geometric covariance. A rank-resolved variance analysis shows that the fluctuation strength remains broadly distributed across tensor ranks up to the microscopic cutoff, providing a microscopic basis for the observed Wigner--Dyson universality and effectively nonlocal dynamics. The antiunitary symmetry acts directly on the fuzzy-sphere geometry, so the Dyson class of a conditional Hamiltonian is determined by the antiunitary symmetry of the underlying quantum geometry. This provides a microscopic counterpart of the Stanford--Witten relation between geometry and random-matrix universality in JT gravity. These results establish a microscopic route from quantum horizon geometry to black-hole spectral chaos.

classification.title_zh: 来自涨落量子视界的谱混沌
classification.abstract_zh: 黑洞被推测是最大混沌的，其量子谱预期表现出普适的随机矩阵关联。然而，这一预期迄今主要依赖于全息描述，或依赖于随机性是被引入而非从视界本身微观自由度导出的多体模型。在视界矩阵模型中，模糊球支持高度简并的部分子态，其重数解释了黑洞熵。我们证明，视界几何的量子涨落解除了这一简并，并生成一个单部分子哈密顿量系综。该系综的算符结构和依赖于秩的协方差均由微观模型决定，而不是由淬火耦合固定。尽管具有这种有结构的协方差，所得谱仍表现出由其反幺正对称类决定的 GOE、GUE 和 GSE 统计，其中相邻能隙统计随矩阵尺寸增大而变得越来越自平均。该模型还实现了普适的 Pandey--Mehta 正交到幺正交叉，交叉尺度由微观几何协方差决定。按秩分辨的方差分析表明，涨落强度在直至微观截断的张量秩上仍广泛分布，为观测到的 Wigner--Dyson 普适性和有效非局域动力学提供了微观基础。反幺正对称直接作用于模糊球几何，因此条件哈密顿量的 Dyson 类由底层量子几何的反幺正对称决定。这为 JT 引力中几何与随机矩阵普适性之间的 Stanford--Witten 关系提供了微观对应物。这些结果建立了一条从量子视界几何到黑洞谱混沌的微观路径。
classification.one_liner: 在视界矩阵模型中，视界几何量子涨落生成结构化随机矩阵系综，并给出由量子几何反幺正对称决定的 GOE/GUE/GSE 谱混沌及 Pandey-Mehta 交叉。
classification.relevance_reason: 与所列重点标签不直接重合；其黑洞谱混沌、随机矩阵与 JT/矩阵模型主题属于更广的量子引力与非平衡混沌方向，而非全息超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子/双组分BEC、D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜与Floquet驱动或经典引力等指定支线。

papers.title: A fluid dual to large $D$ membrane paradigm at first subleading order
papers.abstract: The large $D$ membrane paradigm establishes a duality between the dynamics of black holes and the evolution of a codimension-one timelike membrane in a non-gravitational background. In this work, we formulate the relativistic fluid dynamics dual to an uncharged black hole in asymptotically flat spacetime at the first subleading order in the $1/D$ expansion. Due to the absence of a timelike asymptotic boundary, unlike in AdS/CFT fluid-gravity duality, we construct an effective fluid intrinsically on the dynamical membrane, whose equations of motion are exactly equivalent to the subleading order membrane equations. By performing this fluid-dynamical analysis in the Landau frame, we show that the system behaves as a fluid influenced by an effective background force. Out-of-equilibrium viscous effects emerge naturally, allowing us to extract the fluid transport coefficients directly from the bulk viscous pressure and shear stress tensor. Furthermore, the fluid exhibits a negative pressure, capturing the intrinsic surface tension of the $(D-1)$-dimensional membrane worldvolume.

classification.title_zh: 大 D 膜范式一阶次领头阶的流体对偶
classification.abstract_zh: 大 D 膜范式建立了黑洞动力学与非引力背景中余维一维类时膜演化之间的对偶。在本工作中，我们在 1/D 展开的一阶次领头阶，为渐近平直时空中的不带电黑洞构建对偶的相对论流体动力学。由于不存在类时渐近边界，与 AdS/CFT 流体-引力对偶不同，我们在动态膜上内蕴地构造有效流体，其运动方程精确等价于次领头阶膜方程。通过在 Landau 框架中开展这一流体动力学分析，我们表明该系统表现为受有效背景力影响的流体。非平衡粘性效应自然出现，使我们能够直接从体粘性压强和剪切应力张量中提取流体输运系数。此外，该流体呈现负压，捕捉了 (D-1) 维膜世界体积的内禀表面张力。
classification.one_liner: 在大 D 展开次领头阶，渐近平直黑洞的膜动力学可表述为动态膜上的相对论流体，其运动方程与膜方程等价并给出输运系数。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 large D 膜范式的引力/流体对偶，主要处理渐近平直黑洞的经典引力与膜方程，匹配用户“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；但不对应全息超导、QNM、相变与气泡成核等具体支线。

papers.title: Black holes and phase transitions in Conformal Gravity
papers.abstract: We explore the thermodynamic properties of static black holes in conformal gravities in arbitrary, even dimensions. In the spherically symmetric case, up to local Weyl rescalings, these spacetimes are static and unique, due to a Birkhoff's theorem that applies for all conformal gravities whose Lagrangians are complete contractions of $k$ Weyl tensors in dimension $D=2k$. The solutions can be chosen to be asymptotically locally (A)dS or flat, and the horizon can be extended to be a surface of arbitrary constant curvature, $\gamma$. We focus on the asymptotically AdS case, for which the cosmological constant at infinity is an integration constant, and compute the mass of the spacetime in terms of the diverse hair parameters which have a purely gravitational origin. We show that the first law of thermodynamics is satisfied, and study phase transitions in the canonical ensemble, showing the existence of zeroth-order black-hole/black-hole phase transitions for arbitrary dimension.

classification.primary_topic: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 共形引力中的黑洞与相变
classification.abstract_zh: 我们探讨任意偶数维共形引力中静态黑洞的热力学性质。在球对称情形下，直到局部 Weyl 重标度，这些时空是静态且唯一的，这归因于一个适用于所有共形引力的 Birkhoff 定理：其拉氏量为 D=2k 维中 k 个 Weyl 张量的完全收缩。这些解可选为渐近局部 (A)dS 或平坦，且视界可扩展为任意常曲率曲面 γ。我们聚焦渐近 AdS 情形，其中无穷远处的宇宙学常数为积分常数，并根据具有纯引力起源的多种 hair 参数计算时空质量。我们证明热力学第一定律成立，并研究正则系综中的相变，表明在任意维度存在零阶黑洞/黑洞相变。
classification.one_liner: 共形引力中静态 AdS 黑洞满足 Birkhoff 定理，热力学第一定律成立，并存在任意维零阶黑洞/黑洞相变。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接涉及经典引力中的黑洞热力学相变，匹配重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”和“相变与气泡成核”；摘要未涉及全息对偶或量子信息。

papers.title: String charge density/bit threads correspondence and its S-duality in type IIB supergravity
papers.abstract: We identify the spatial projection of a conserved string charge density with a bit-thread flow. This correspondence gives bit threads a string worldsheet description and allows us to compute black hole entropy from the maximal entropy flux of a worldsheet-derived current. We first reproduce the BTZ entropy and then extend the construction to the ten-dimensional F1-NS5-P and D1-D5-P systems. Under Type IIB S-duality, the F1 current maps to the D1 current. Although the local currents, metrics, and flow norms change, the maximal physical flux remains unchanged and gives the same entropy. This provides a nontrivial check of the correspondence. Finally, we propose a D1-D5 boundary-matching conjecture. In the coarse-grained picture, each string-charge line defines an entropy-carrying tube. The boundary CFT entanglement entropy and the bulk black hole entropy both fix the product of the number of tubes and the maximum entropy carried by each tube. For a fixed tube discretization, they assign the same capacity to each tube. They therefore describe the same conserved maximal entropy flux, providing an information-flow interpretation of the equality between entanglement entropy and black hole entropy.

classification.title_zh: 弦电荷密度/比特线对应及其在 IIB 型超引力中的 S-对偶
classification.abstract_zh: 我们将守恒弦电荷密度的空间投影与比特线流对应起来。该对应赋予比特线一种弦世界面描述，并使我们能够从由世界面导出的电流的最大熵通量计算黑洞熵。我们首先重现 BTZ 熵，然后将该构造推广到十维 F1-NS5-P 和 D1-D5-P 系统。在 IIB 型 S-对偶下，F1 电流映射为 D1 电流。虽然局域电流、度规和流范数发生改变，最大物理通量保持不变并给出相同熵。这为该对应提供了非平凡检验。最后，我们提出一个 D1-D5 边界匹配猜想。在粗粒化图像中，每条弦电荷线定义一根携带熵的管。边界 CFT 纠缠熵和体黑洞熵都确定管数与每根管携带的最大熵的乘积。对于固定的管离散化，它们为每根管分配相同容量。因此，它们描述相同的守恒最大熵通量，为纠缠熵与黑洞熵相等提供了信息流解释。
classification.one_liner: 该文将守恒弦电荷密度与比特线流对应，用世界面电流的最大熵通量重现 BTZ 及 D1-D5-P 等系统黑洞熵，并用 IIB S-对偶和 D1-D5 边界匹配猜想为纠缠熵-黑洞熵相等提供信息流解释。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文研究比特线/弦电荷密度对应、黑洞熵与纠缠熵，属于全息量子信息与黑洞信息方向；与用户列出的全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子/双组分BEC、D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜与Floquet驱动、经典引力/广义相对论等重点支线无直接重合。

papers.title: A Unified Numerical Study of Axion Stars: From the Nonrelativistic Regime to General Relativity
papers.abstract: Axion-star mass-radius relations are commonly computed using different orders of relativistic approximation, making it important to determine where these descriptions remain reliable. We perform a unified numerical comparison of axion-star ground-state configurations in the Newtonian Schr\"odinger-Poisson description, first- and second-order relativistic effective field theories, and the full Einstein-Klein-Gordon system for a real scalar field. Using the same attractive quartic self-interaction in all four descriptions, we scan $|\widetilde{\lambda}|=(M_{\rm Pl}/f_a)^2$ and determine the maximum masses and corresponding enclosed-mass radii. All descriptions recover the common large-$|\widetilde{\lambda}|$ dilute-star scaling, while substantial differences appear at weak and moderate coupling. The relativistic EFTs interpolate systematically between the Newtonian and full-GR results. For part of the maximum-mass sequence where $\max|\phi|/f_a=O(1)$, we test the temporal-harmonic and potential truncations explicitly in full GR. The higher-harmonic expansion shows rapid convergence, while restoring the complete single-cosine potential changes the maximum mass only at the percent level and $R_{95}$ at the several-percent level. Together with the systematic convergence of the relativistic EFT descriptions toward full GR, these results show that the large weak-coupling departure from the Schr\"odinger-Poisson prediction reflects the breakdown of the nonrelativistic structural description. Our results provide a systematic benchmark for determining when Newtonian, relativistically corrected, or fully general-relativistic descriptions are required for axion-star structure. The numerical implementation used in this work is available in the Axion Star Solvers repository at https://github.com/Parisa-Arabameri/AxionStar.

classification.title_zh: 轴子星的统一数值研究：从非相对论区域到广义相对论
classification.abstract_zh: 轴子星的质量-半径关系常用不同阶的相对论近似计算，因此确定这些描述在何处可靠十分重要。本文对轴子星基态构型进行统一数值比较，涵盖牛顿薛定谔-泊松描述、一阶与二阶相对论有效场论，以及实标量场的完整爱因斯坦-克莱因-戈登系统。四种描述均采用相同的吸引四阶自相互作用，扫描 |\widetilde{\lambda}|=(M_{\rm Pl}/f_a)^2，并确定最大质量及相应的包含质量半径。所有描述都重现共同的大 |\widetilde{\lambda}| 稀薄星标度，但在弱与中等耦合下出现显著差异。相对论 EFT 系统地在牛顿与完整广义相对论结果之间插值。对于 max|\phi|/f_a=O(1) 的部分最大质量序列，我们在完整广义相对论中显式检验了时间谐波截断和势截断。高阶谐波展开收敛迅速，而恢复完整单余弦势仅使最大质量在百分量级变化、R_95 在几个百分量级变化。结合相对论 EFT 描述向完整广义相对论的系统收敛，这些结果表明弱耦合下相对薛定谔-泊松预测的显著偏离反映了非相对论结构描述的失效。本文结果为判断轴子星结构何时需要牛顿描述、相对论修正描述或完整广义相对论描述提供了系统基准。数值实现可在 Axion Star Solvers 仓库获取。
classification.one_liner: 统一比较轴子星基态在牛顿薛定谔-泊松、相对论 EFT 与完整爱因斯坦-克莱因-戈登下的质量-半径关系，界定非相对论结构描述的适用边界。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究轴子星在完整 Einstein-Klein-Gordon 系统及相对论近似下的结构，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，并涉及自引力孤子；不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶。

papers.title: On the Classical, Penrose, and Reverse Isoperimetric Inequalities in Black Holes: Insights From AdS to Flat Riemannian Backgrounds
papers.abstract: A collection of evidence is presented showing that the conjectured reverse isoperimetric inequality (RII) for asymptotically anti-de Sitter (AdS) as well as de Sitter (dS) black holes, ${\cal R}_\text{RII} \ge 1$, is of fundamental importance and its violation (${\cal R}_\text{RII} < 1$) gives rise to either thermodynamic instabilities, or physically unreasonable solutions, or naked singularities. We show that AdS black holes violating reverse isoperimetric inequality, known as superentropic black holes, satisfy neither mechanical stability requirement of ${\kappa _T} \geqslant {\kappa _S} \geqslant 0$ nor thermal stability requirement of ${C_P} \geqslant {C_V} \geqslant 0$. This property makes them thermodynamically unstable for the whole range of parameter space and explains all the diverse behaviors so far reported. We conjecture this statement holds for all superentropic black holes. We confirm that there is no counterexample to the thermodynamic instability conjecture of superentropic black holes and extend this to dS space by presenting the first example of superentropicity in dS space. By bringing evidence, we then propose two other conjectures: 1) there is no asymptotically flat limit of superentropic black holes, and 2) there exist two stronger versions of Penrose isoperimetric inequality (PII) for asymptotically flat black holes; the first is the asymptotically flat limit of the RII and the second is a new inequality in terms of the ADM mass and the thermodynamics volume, that we call thermo-volumetric inequality, obtained via insights from the $\Lambda \to 0$ limit of extended black hole thermodynamics in AdS. We show that the Penrose isoperimetric inequality (PII) is weaker than the reverse isoperimetric inequality (RII), as demonstrated explicitly for $D=4,5$ and for all black hole families we have examined.

classification.title_zh: 黑洞中的经典、Penrose 与逆等周不等式：从 AdS 到平坦黎曼背景的洞察
classification.abstract_zh: 本文提出一系列证据，表明对渐近反德西特（AdS）以及德西特（dS）黑洞所猜想的逆等周不等式（RII），${\cal R}_\text{RII} \ge 1$，具有根本重要性；违反它（${\cal R}_\text{RII} < 1$）会导致热力学不稳定性、物理上不合理的解或裸奇点。我们证明，违反逆等周不等式的 AdS 黑洞，即超熵黑洞，既不满足力学稳定性要求 ${\kappa _T} \geqslant {\kappa _S} \geqslant 0$，也不满足热稳定性要求 ${C_P} \geqslant {C_V} \geqslant 0$。这一性质使它们在整个参数空间范围内热力学不稳定，并解释了迄今报道的所有不同行为。我们猜测这一陈述对所有超熵黑洞成立。我们确认超熵黑洞热力学不稳定性猜想没有反例，并通过给出 dS 空间中超熵性的第一个例子将其推广到 dS 空间。通过提供证据，我们随后提出另外两个猜想：1）超熵黑洞不存在渐近平直极限；2）对渐近平直黑洞存在两个更强的 Penrose 等周不等式（PII）版本；第一个是 RII 的渐近平直极限，第二个是用 ADM 质量和热力学体积表示的新不等式，我们称之为热体积不等式，它通过 AdS 中扩展黑洞热力学的 $\Lambda \to 0$ 极限的洞见得到。我们证明 Penrose 等周不等式（PII）弱于逆等周不等式（RII），并针对 $D=4,5$ 以及我们考察的所有黑洞族明确展示了这一点。
classification.one_liner: 本文论证 AdS/dS 黑洞违反逆等周不等式意味着热力学不稳定，推测超熵黑洞无渐近平直极限，并通过扩展黑洞热力学提出更强的平直时空 Penrose 型不等式。

papers.title: Simulation of PBH formation in a matter-dominated universe
papers.abstract: We investigate primordial black hole (PBH) formation during an early matter-dominated era using fully nonlinear numerical relativity. The initial condition is set by a functional form of the curvature perturbation including ellipticity, which makes the configuration triaxial. Two kinds of matter descriptions are considered: dust fluid and collisionless particles. In the dust fluid description, numerical computation crashes associated with the appearance of a singularity at which the fluid density diverges, unless the singularity is hidden well inside the apparent horizon. We found that, for the dust fluid description, to observe the horizon formation before calculations crash, the initial amplitude must be larger than the previous analytic estimation by a factor of 2. On the other hand, with the particle system description, calculations do not crash, and we may observe black hole formation after subsequent evolution of the system. Then the threshold of black hole formation is significantly smaller than the previous analytic estimation by an order of magnitude.

classification.title_zh: 物质主导宇宙中原初黑洞形成的模拟
classification.abstract_zh: 我们使用全非线性数值相对论研究早期物质主导时期原初黑洞（PBH）的形成。初始条件由包含椭率、使构型呈三轴的曲率扰动函数形式设定。考虑两类物质描述：尘埃流体与无碰撞粒子。在尘埃流体描述中，除非奇点被充分隐藏在表观视界内部，否则数值计算会因流体密度发散而崩溃。我们发现，对于尘埃流体描述，要在计算崩溃前观测到视界形成，初始振幅必须比先前解析估计大约 2 倍。另一方面，在粒子系统描述中计算不会崩溃，且可在系统后续演化后观测到黑洞形成；此时黑洞形成阈值比先前解析估计小约一个数量级。
classification.one_liner: 用全非线性数值相对论研究早期物质主导时期的原初黑洞形成，比较尘埃流体与无碰撞粒子描述并修正形成阈值。

papers.title: Localization of Vector and Fermion Fields on a Thick Brane with a Lump-type Scalar Background
papers.abstract: We study a thick braneworld model in asymptotically anti-de Sitter spacetime, supported by a non-topological lump-type scalar field. Unlike in boson stars, which are also non-topological solutions, the complex scalar field in our setup must have zero oscillation frequency. Consequently, the background scalar field is static and real, which breaks the global $U(1)$ symmetry. This is similar to spontaneous symmetry breaking, but it is not the same. We then investigate the localization of vector and fermion fields within this framework. By introducing a specific non-minimal coupling, we demonstrate that the zero modes of both fields can be successfully localized. Notably, this mechanism allows for the simultaneous localization of both left- and right-handed fermion zero modes.

classification.title_zh: 具有 Lump 型标量背景的厚膜上矢量场与费米子场的局域化
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个渐近反德西特时空中的厚膜世界模型，它由非拓扑 lump 型标量场支撑。与玻色星（同样是非拓扑解）不同，我们设置中的复标量场必须具有零振荡频率。因此，背景标量场是静态且实的，这破坏了整体 U(1) 对称性。这类似于自发对称破缺，但并不相同。随后我们考察了该框架中矢量场和费米子场的局域化。通过引入特定的非最小耦合，我们证明两类场的零模都能成功局域化。特别地，该机制允许同时局域化左手和右手费米子零模。
classification.one_liner: 研究渐近 AdS 厚膜中由非拓扑 lump 标量场支撑的背景，并通过非最小耦合实现矢量场与左右手费米子零模的局域化。

papers.title: Full set of scenarios of high energy collision in the Schwarzschild background and kinematic censorship
papers.abstract: We consider collisions between particles moving freely in the Schwarzschild background. We suggest classification of scenarios that lead to unbounded energy output in the center of mass frame. Although this is forbidden in the exterior of a black hole, the phenomenon becomes possible with account of white hole region and mirror universe in the complete space-time diagram. Also, we scrutinize collisions in the vicinity of the bifurcation point and reveal the role of resting observers in the inner region beyond the horizon. In some scenarios $E_{c.m.}$ not only diverges but becomes seemingly infinite that is, as a matter of fact, impossible according to the principle of so-called kinematic censorship. We resolve a corresponding paradox and argue, why this principle remains valid.

classification.title_zh: 史瓦西背景下高能碰撞的全套情景与运动学审查
classification.abstract_zh: 我们考虑在史瓦西背景中自由运动的粒子之间的碰撞。我们提出对导致质心系能量无界输出的情景的分类。尽管这在黑洞外部被禁止，但考虑到完整时空图中的白洞区域和镜像宇宙，该现象成为可能。我们还仔细研究了分岔点附近的碰撞，并揭示了视界内内部区域静止观测者的作用。在某些情景中，质心能量 E_{c.m.} 不仅发散，而且看似无限；事实上，根据所谓的运动学审查原理，这是不可能的。我们解决了相应的悖论，并论证了该原理为何仍然成立。
classification.one_liner: 在史瓦西完整时空图中分类自由粒子高能碰撞情景，并论证运动学审查如何消除表观无限质心能量。

papers.title: Perturbations of a Schwarzschild black hole and Newman-Unti gauge
papers.abstract: In this paper, we derive the complete transformations of a generic first order perturbative metric in Schwarzschild spacetime to the Newman-Unti (NU) gauge in series expansion near null infinity. This allows us to determine the asymptotic shear, the mass aspect and the angular momentum aspect of the perturbative fields. As a direct application, we derive the corresponding asymptotic NU data for quasinormal modes (QNMs) of a Schwarzschild black hole. The total energy and angular momentum of QNMs obtained from the asymptotic NU data vanish but classical supertranslation charges are non-trivial, which can be applied to fix the BMS frame at first perturbative order.

classification.title_zh: Schwarzschild黑洞微扰与Newman-Unti规范
classification.abstract_zh: 本文推导了Schwarzschild时空中一般一阶微扰度规到Newman-Unti（NU）规范在零无穷附近级数展开的完整变换。这使我们能够确定微扰场的渐近剪切、质量面和角动量面。作为直接应用，我们推导了Schwarzschild黑洞准正规模（QNM）对应的渐近NU数据。由渐近NU数据得到的QNM总能量和角动量消失，但经典超平移荷非平凡，可用于在一阶微扰阶固定BMS框架。
classification.one_liner: 将Schwarzschild黑洞一阶微扰变换到Newman-Unti规范，并用渐近NU数据描述QNM与BMS框架固定。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文与经典引力、黑洞微扰和QNM渐近数据直接相关，匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”和“QNM与非线性演化”重点标签；但不涉及AdS/CFT或其他全息对偶。

papers.title: Lower-dimensional behavior from factorized infrared geometries along holographic RG flows
papers.abstract: We study the emergence of effective lower-dimensional behavior in heavy-scalar two-point functions along holographic RG flows. For charged asymptotically AdS black holes, the equal-time spatial correlator remains exponentially screened, while the temporal correlator exhibits distinct temperature-dependent regimes. Away from extremality, the controlled late-time sector is the Schwarzschild-connected saddle, whose decay rate requires matching to the full geometry. Near extremality, an AdS$_2$ throat supports an additional sector whose leading decay rate is fixed by the throat data. For RN-AdS$_4$, sufficiently near extremality, this throat contribution dominates at asymptotically late times if its matched amplitude is nonzero. At extremality, the thermal throat exponential is replaced by the AdS$_2$ power law. We also study the complete zero-density magnetic-brane flow from AdS$_5$ to AdS$_3\times \mathbb{R}^2$. The transverse heavy-scalar correlator remains exponentially screened, whereas the longitudinal correlator approaches the AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$ power law in the infrared. These results show that factorized infrared geometries can support effective lower-dimensional conformal dynamics whose realization depends on temperature, direction, and the relevant saddle sector, without implying dimensional reduction of the microscopic QFT.

classification.title_zh: 沿全息 RG 流的因子化红外几何导致的低维行为
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究沿全息 RG 流的重标量两点函数中有效低维行为的出现。对于带电荷的渐近 AdS 黑洞，等时空间关联子仍呈指数屏蔽，而时间关联子表现出不同的温度依赖区域。远离极端性时，受控的晚期扇区是 Schwarzschild 连接的鞍点，其衰减率需要与完整几何匹配。近极端性时，AdS2 喉部支持一个额外扇区，其领头衰减率由喉部数据固定。对于 RN-AdS4，在足够接近极端性时，如果匹配振幅非零，该喉部贡献在渐近晚期占主导。在极端性处，热喉部指数被 AdS2 幂律取代。我们还研究了从 AdS5 到 AdS3×R^2 的完整零密度磁膜流。横向重标量关联子仍呈指数屏蔽，而纵向关联子在红外趋近 AdS3/CFT2 幂律。这些结果表明，因子化红外几何可以支持有效低维共形动力学，其实现依赖于温度、方向和相关鞍点扇区，而不意味着微观 QFT 的维度约化。
classification.one_liner: 全息 RG 流中的因子化红外几何可在特定方向与温度区间产生有效低维共形关联，但不代表微观 QFT 降维。
classification.relevance_reason: 涉及全息 RG 流、AdS2 喉部与关联子晚期衰减/幂律，和 QNM/低维有效行为相关；但未直接覆盖用户列出的超流、multi-trace、探针膜等主线。

papers.title: Holographic Correlators from Thermal Bootstrap
papers.abstract: Holographic thermal two-point functions can be analyzed using the operator product expansion which contains contributions from both multi-stress-tensor and double-trace operators. The former can be computed by analyzing the bulk equation of motion in a near-boundary expansion, but the latter has remained elusive-in practice, one resorts to solving a partial differential equation with limited accuracy. We show that imposing the Euclidean periodicity condition on the holographic correlator (also known as the KMS condition or thermal bootstrap), followed by Pad\'e-Borel resummation, provides an efficient method for computing double-trace thermal coefficients. The resulting series converges rapidly and yields numerical values in excellent agreement with those obtained from solving the partial differential equation.

classification.title_zh: 从热 Bootstrap 计算全息关联函数
classification.abstract_zh: 全息热两点函数可以利用算符乘积展开来分析，其中包含多应力张量算符和双迹算符的贡献。前者可以通过在近边界展开中分析体运动方程来计算，但后者一直难以处理——实际中人们只能以有限精度求解一个偏微分方程。我们表明，对全息关联函数施加欧几里得周期性条件（也称为 KMS 条件或热 bootstrap），随后进行 Padé-Borel 重求和，提供了一种计算双迹热系数的有效方法。所得级数收敛迅速，并且给出的数值与求解偏微分方程得到的结果高度一致。
classification.one_liner: 用欧几里得周期性（KMS/热 Bootstrap）结合 Padé-Borel 重求和高效计算全息热关联函数中的双迹热系数。
classification.relevance_reason: 摘要直接涉及全息关联函数中双迹算符热系数的计算，与重点标签 multi-trace 高度相关。

papers.title: Holographic codes and bulk RG flows
papers.abstract: We consider the coarse-graining of holographic quantum error correcting codes under a generalized notion of bulk renormalization-group flow. In particular, we study the renormalization under this flow of the $A/4G$ term in the Faulkner-Lewkowycz-Maldacena formula and in its R\'enyi generalization. This provides a general quantum code perspective on the arguments of Susskind and Uglum. Specifically, given a 'UV' code with two-sided recovery and appropriately flat entanglement spectrum together with a set of 'seed' states in the UV code, we explicitly construct an 'IR' code with corresponding properties which contains the given seed states and is of minimal size in a sense we describe.

classification.title_zh: 全息码与体重整化群流
classification.abstract_zh: 我们考虑在全息量子纠错码的粗粒化，基于广义的体重整化群流概念。特别地，我们研究在该流下 Faulkner-Lewkowycz-Maldacena 公式中 A/4G 项及其 Rényi 推广的重整化。这为 Susskind 与 Uglum 的论证提供了一般的量子码视角。具体而言，给定一个具有双侧恢复和适当平坦纠缠谱的“UV”码，以及 UV 码中的一组“种子”态，我们显式构造一个具有相应性质的“IR”码，它包含给定种子态，并且在我们描述的意义下具有最小尺寸。
classification.one_liner: 在全息量子纠错码框架下定义广义体 RG 流，并构造包含给定种子态的最小 IR 码，从而以量子码视角理解 A/4G 项及其 Rényi 推广的重整化与 Susskind-Uglum 论证。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文直接研究全息码、体 RG 流以及 A/4G 和 Rényi 推广的重整化，属于 AdS/CFT 基础与量子信息交叉的核心全息理论工作。

papers.title: Gravitational Algebras with Two Areas
papers.abstract: We study gravitational algebras on spacetimes with two extremal surfaces. In the example of a long wormhole with two asymptotic AdS boundaries and two compact extremal surfaces, we discuss the assignment of gravitational algebras to various regions bounded by the extremal surfaces and/or asymptotic boundaries. Using the split property, we construct type II algebras from the crossed product in the left exterior, right exterior, the middle ``python's lunch'' region, and their complement regions. We also study the case where only the area sum operator or area difference operator is included as part of the gravitational algebra. This can be achieved by picking the appropriate microcanonical ensemble, and these gravitational algebras can either be type II or type III depending on the region. In the case where we include only the area difference mode, the crossed product gives rise to a weight that restricts to a trace on the middle region. Differences of relative entropies with respect to this weight give differences in generalized entropies. This provides an algebraic understanding of the order parameter that controls the phase transitions between entanglement wedges. We emphasize the role of operator-valued weights used in our construction.

classification.title_zh: 具有两个面积的引力代数
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究具有两个极值曲面的时空上的引力代数。在两个渐近 AdS 边界和两个紧致极值曲面的长虫洞例子中，我们讨论将引力代数分配到由极值曲面和/或渐近边界围成的各个区域。利用分裂性质，我们通过交叉乘积在左外部、右外部、中间“python's lunch”区域及其补区域构造类型 II 代数。我们还研究仅将面积和算符或面积差算符包含为引力代数一部分的情形。这可以通过选取适当的微正则系综实现，并且这些引力代数依区域可以是类型 II 或类型 III。在仅包含面积差模式的情况下，交叉乘积产生一个权重，该权重在中间区域上限制为迹。相对于该权重的相对熵之差给出广义熵之差。这为控制纠缠楔之间相变的序参量提供了代数理解。我们强调构造中使用的算符值权重的作用。
classification.one_liner: 通过交叉乘积构造双极值面 AdS 虫洞中的类型 II/III 引力代数，并用算符值权重代数地理解纠缠楔相变的序参量。
keywords: 类型 II 冯诺依曼代数
classification.relevance_reason: 属于 AdS/CFT 与量子引力/量子信息交叉的引力代数工作，涉及纠缠楔相变；但不直接落在所列重点标签中的全息超导、p波、multi-trace、D3-D7/Floquet、QNM 或经典引力等主线。

papers.title: The JLMS formula in a large code with approximate error correction
papers.abstract: Gauge/gravity duality is often described as a quantum error correcting code. However, as seen in the Jafferis-Lewkowycz-Maldacena-Suh (JLMS) formula, exact quantum error correction with complementary recovery (and thus entanglement wedge reconstruction) emerges only in the limit $G \to 0$. As a result, precise arguments controlling error terms have focused on what we call `small' codes which, as $G \to 0$, describe only perturbative excitations near a given classical solution. Such settings are quite restrictive and, in particular, they prohibit discussion of any modular flow that would change the classical background. As a result, they forbid consideration of modular flows generated by semiclassical bulk states at order-one modular parameters. In contrast, we present a single `large' code for the bulk theory that can accommodate such flows and, in particular, in the $G \to 0$ limit includes superpositions of states associated with distinct classical backgrounds. This large code is assembled from small codes that each satisfy an approximate Faulkner-Lewkowycz-Maldacena formula. In this extended setting we clarify the meaning of the (approximate) JLMS relation between bulk and boundary modular Hamiltonians and quantify its validity in an appropriate class of states.

classification.title_zh: 具有近似量子纠错的大码中的 JLMS 公式
classification.abstract_zh: 规范/引力对偶常被描述为量子纠错码。然而，如 JLMS 公式所示，具有互补恢复的精确量子纠错（因而纠缠楔重构）仅在 G→0 极限下出现。因此，控制误差项的精确论证集中于我们所谓的“小”码；当 G→0 时，它们只描述给定经典解附近的微扰激发。此类设定限制很强，尤其禁止讨论会改变经典背景的任何模流，从而禁止考虑由半经典体态生成的、模参数为量级一的模流。相反，我们为体理论提出一个单一“大”码，可以容纳这类流，并且在 G→0 极限下包含与不同经典背景相关的态的叠加。该大码由若干小码组装而成，每个小码满足近似的 Faulkner-Lewkowycz-Maldacena 公式。在此扩展设定中，我们澄清体与边界模哈密顿量之间（近似）JLMS 关系的含义，并在一类合适态中量化其有效性。
classification.one_liner: 通过由小码组装的大码，将 JLMS 关系推广到包含不同经典背景叠加的近似量子纠错设定，并量化其有效性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT 基础与量子纠错/模哈密顿量方向，是全息对偶的核心理论进展，但不直接对应给定的全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、D3-D7/D3-D5 探针膜等重点标签。

papers.title: Irregular higher-spin generating equations and chiral perturbation theory
papers.abstract: We present a complementary approach to the standard Vasiliev framework for nonlinear higher-spin interactions in four dimensions, aimed at identifying their minimally nonlocal form. Our proposal introduces a generating system for higher-spin vertices at the level of classical equations, which we refer to as irregular, in contrast to the regular case described by Vasiliev. This system extends the recently proposed equations for (anti)holomorphic interactions by incorporating the mixed sector. Its perturbative series encompasses the entire (anti)holomorphic sector in the leading order, with vertices related to powers of the complex parity-breaking parameter $\eta$ or $\bar\eta$. The subsequent corrections facilitate the mixing of the two sectors, with vertices carrying mixed powers of $\eta$ and $\bar\eta$. The consistency relies on the nonlinear algebraic constraint, which is shown to be satisfied at least in the quadratic and cubic approximations. As a result, the previously discussed (anti)holomorphic interactions in the literature can be systematically extended to generate vertices of the form $\eta^N \bar\eta^k$ and their conjugate, at least for $k \leq 2$ and any $N$. As a byproduct of our analysis, we also identify the new higher-spin structure dualities.

classification.title_zh: 非规则高自旋生成方程与手征微扰理论
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种与 Vasiliev 标准框架互补的四维非线性高自旋相互作用方法，旨在确定其最小非局域形式。我们的方案在经典方程层面引入高自旋顶点的生成系统，并将其称为非规则的，以区别于 Vasiliev 所描述的规则情形。该系统扩展了近期提出的（反）全纯相互作用方程，纳入混合部分。其微扰级数在领头阶包含整个（反）全纯部分，顶点与复宇称破缺参数 η 或 \barη 的幂相关。后续修正促成两个部分的混合，顶点带有 η 与 \barη 的混合幂。自洽性依赖于非线性代数约束，我们证明至少二次和三次近似下该约束得到满足。因此，文献中先前讨论的（反）全纯相互作用可被系统扩展，以生成形式为 η^N \barη^k 及其共轭的顶点，至少对于 k ≤ 2 和任意 N。作为分析副产品，我们还识别出新的高自旋结构对偶性。
classification.one_liner: 提出非规则高自旋生成方程，在 Vasiliev 框架之外系统构造混合（反）全纯高自旋顶点并发现新的结构对偶性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于高自旋理论/Vasiliev 框架，与全息对偶相关，但未涉及用户重点标签中的全息超导、p波、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7/D3-D5 探针膜或经典引力等具体支线。

papers.title: Giant graviton integrated correlators at finite coupling and all orders in $1/N$
papers.abstract: We study the giant graviton integrated correlator in SU$(N)$ $\mathcal{N}=4$ super Yang-Mills at finite complexified coupling $\tau$. Despite the formidable complexity arising from the heavy nature of the operators considered, the large-$N$ expansion simplifies dramatically and exhibits manifest modular invariance. At each order in $1/N$, the expansion coefficients are linear combinations of non-holomorphic Eisenstein series thus capturing the full spectrum of perturbative and non-perturbative effects in the Yang-Mills coupling. Furthermore, we find additional contributions which are modular functions exponentially suppressed in $N$. In the 't Hooft limit, this yields an all-orders result in the $1/N$ expansion at arbitrary coupling $\lambda$, extending beyond prior results of leading orders. For the U$(N)$ theory, we obtain a closed-form expression valid for all $N$ and $\tau$, and show that the coupling-dependent sector of the large-$N$ expansion is universal between SU$(N)$ and U$(N)$ to all orders. Crucially, we exploit the integrated correlator constraints and determine the giant graviton correlator itself to two-loop order at finite $N$, previously only accessible in the planar limit.

classification.title_zh: 有限耦合及 1/N 全阶的巨引力子积分关联子
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究 SU(N) N=4 超杨-米尔斯理论在有限复化耦合 τ 下的巨引力子积分关联子。尽管所考虑算符的重性质带来了巨大复杂性，大 N 展开显著简化并展现出明显的模不变性。在 1/N 的每一阶，展开系数是非全纯 Eisenstein 级的线性组合，从而捕获 Yang-Mills 耦合中完整的微扰和非微扰效应。此外，我们发现额外贡献，它们是模函数且在 N 中指数压制。在 't Hooft 极限下，这给出任意耦合 λ 下 1/N 展开的全阶结果，超越先前领头阶结果。对于 U(N) 理论，我们得到对所有 N 和 τ 有效的闭式表达式，并证明大 N 展开中依赖耦合的部分在 SU(N) 与 U(N) 之间到所有阶是普适的。关键地，我们利用积分关联子约束，确定有限 N 下巨引力子关联子本身到两圈阶，此前仅在平面极限可及。
classification.one_liner: 在 N=4 超杨-米尔斯理论中研究巨引力子积分关联子，得到有限耦合大 N 全阶展开及有限 N 两圈结果。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT 基础与精确关联函数，涉及 N=4 SYM 大 N 展开、模不变性和巨引力子，但未直接涉及用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、p波/多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、探针膜、经典引力等具体支线。

papers.title: Bulk Monodromy of Logarithmic Graviton Descendants in Critical Topologically Massive Gravity
papers.abstract: We study the bulk analytic structure of the logarithmic graviton and its global descendants in critical topologically massive gravity. Starting from the Grumiller--Johansson mode, we complexify the radial coordinate and derive its monodromy directly from the branch structure and winding data of the logarithmic radial factor. We then construct the global logarithmic descendants by explicit differential action and show that each descendant decomposes into a universal logarithmic contribution and a log-free meromorphic remainder. This implies a universal unipotent monodromy throughout the global descendant space. The associated nilpotent operator, obtained directly from the bulk analytic continuation, is shown to intertwine the full global $SL(2,\mathbb R)_L\times SL(2,\mathbb R)_R$ action. These results provide a direct bulk analytic realization of the logarithmic structure, linking radial monodromy and global conformal symmetry.

classification.title_zh: 临界拓扑大质量引力中对数引力子后代的体单值性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了临界拓扑大质量引力中对数引力子及其整体后代的体解析结构。从 Grumiller--Johansson 模式出发，我们将径向坐标复化，并直接从对数径向因子的分支结构和绕数数据推导其单值性。然后，我们通过显式微分作用构造整体对数后代，并证明每个后代都分解为一个普适的对数贡献和一个无对数的亚纯余项。这意味着整个整体后代空间具有普适的幂幺单值性。由体解析延拓直接得到的相应幂零算子被证明与完整的整体 SL(2,R)_L × SL(2,R)_R 作用交织。这些结果为对数结构提供了直接的体解析实现，将径向单值性与整体共形对称性联系起来。
classification.one_liner: 临界拓扑大质量引力中，对数引力子的整体后代具有普适幂幺单值性，其幂零算子与整体共形对称性交织。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于 AdS/CFT、三维引力与对数共形场论的基础性研究，与全息和经典引力相关，但不直接涉及用户重点支线中的全息超导、p波、畴壁、QNM、探针膜等具体方向。

papers.title: Evaporating Black Hole Interior and Complexity Evolution
papers.abstract: We study the evolution of the interior of an evaporating black hole in a simple model of Jackiw-Teitelboim (JT) gravity with an end-of-the-world (EoW) brane, where evaporation is modeled by entangling the brane's internal states with an auxiliary radiation system. To probe the black hole interior, we consider a geodesic length extracted from a boundary-to-brane two-point function and interpret its renormalised value as a measure of subsystem complexity. Our computation, based on quenched disorder averaging, includes non-perturbative gravitational effects from both spacetime wormholes and replica wormholes, encoding ensemble averaging over the dual random Hamiltonian and brane-state couplings. Unlike non-evaporating black holes, for which complexity first grows linearly and then plateaus at late times $\sim{\cal O}(e^{S_{\rm BH}})$, we find that complexity evolution of the black hole subsystem in the evaporating case differs drastically, depending nontrivially on the dimension of the emitted radiation Hilbert space. It grows linearly at early times, reaches a maximum shortly before the Page-time crossover $\sim{\cal O}({S_{\rm BH}})$, and then decays exponentially. We further show that the relative fluctuations of the interior length remain small before the Page time but become of order one and eventually large at later times: this signals a loss of self-averaging, with the ensemble-averaged complexity dominated by rare configurations rather than by typical realisations.

classification.title_zh: 蒸发黑洞内部与复杂度演化
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究在一个带世界末端（EoW）膜的 Jackiw-Teitelboim（JT）引力简单模型中，蒸发黑洞内部的演化；其中蒸发通过将膜的内部状态与辅助辐射系统纠缠来建模。为探测黑洞内部，我们考虑从边界到膜的两点函数中提取的测地线长度，并将其重整化值解释为子系统复杂度的一种度量。我们的计算基于淬火无序平均，包含来自时空虫洞和复制虫洞的非微扰引力效应，编码了对偶随机哈密顿量以及膜态耦合的系综平均。与不蒸发黑洞（其复杂度先线性增长，后在晚期约 O(e^{S_BH}) 达到平台）不同，我们发现蒸发情形下黑洞子系统的复杂度演化显著不同，并且非平凡地依赖于发射辐射希尔伯特空间的维度。它在早期线性增长，在 Page 时间交叉之前不久达到最大值（约 O(S_BH)），随后指数衰减。我们进一步表明，内部长度的相对涨落在 Page 时间之前保持很小，但在之后变为量级为一并最终变大：这表明自平均性的丧失，系综平均复杂度由稀有构型而非典型实现主导。
classification.one_liner: 在带 EoW 膜并耦合辐射的 JT 引力中，蒸发黑洞子系统的复杂度先线性增长、Page 时间前达峰后指数衰减，且晚期由稀有构型主导。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于全息对偶、JT 引力、黑洞蒸发与量子信息/复杂度交叉方向，与黑洞/量子引力/信息核心主题相关；但未直接落在所列重点支线（如全息超导、p波、QNM、D3-D7 探针膜等）上。

papers.title: How traversable is a traversable wormhole?
papers.abstract: To answer the above question, we study low-frequency scattering in the four-dimensional traversable wormhole of Maldacena, Milekhin, and Popov. The resulting transmission probabilities reveal that wormhole traversability depends strongly on the nature of the probe. For scalar probes, both neutral and charged, traversability depends on the time scale. On time scales of order the light-crossing time after sending in a signal, the transmission is parametrically suppressed, with most of the incoming signal reflected or temporarily trapped inside the wormhole throat. As time progresses, the trapped signal gradually leaks out, so that at late times the accumulated transmission cross-section approaches one half of the corresponding black hole absorption cross-section. Despite this generic suppression at low frequencies, the transmission spectrum also exhibits resonant frequencies at which transmission becomes perfect. Charged massless fermions tell a very different story. Unlike scalars, they traverse the wormhole with essentially unit probability at low energies. The same mechanism underlies their efficient absorption by magnetic black holes and realizes a channel closely analogous to the Callan-Rubakov effect, revealing unexpected connections with monopole-fermion scattering. Putting everything together, we conclude that scalar probes are best suited for uncovering distinct features of these magnetic wormholes, while charged massless fermions are the ideal carriers of information through them.

classification.title_zh: 可穿越虫洞有多可穿越？
classification.abstract_zh: 为回答上述问题，我们研究了 Maldacena、Milekhin 和 Popov 四维可穿越虫洞中的低频散射。所得透射概率表明，虫洞的可穿越性强烈依赖于探针性质。对于中性及带电标量探针，可穿越性依赖时间尺度。在信号发出后约光穿越时标上，透射按参数被压低，大部分入射信号被反射或暂时困在虫洞喉部。随时间推移，被困信号逐渐泄漏，因此在晚时累积透射截面趋近相应黑洞吸收截面的一半。尽管低频下存在这种普遍压制，透射谱仍表现出使透射变为完美的共振频率。带电无质量费米子则给出非常不同的图景。与标量不同，它们在低能下以基本为单位概率穿过虫洞。同一机制也解释了它们被磁黑洞的高效吸收，并实现了一条与 Callan-Rubakov 效应密切类似的通道，揭示了与磁单极-费米子散射的意外联系。综合来看，我们得出结论：标量探针最适合揭示这些磁虫洞的独特特征，而带电无质量费米子是穿过它们传递信息的理想载体。
classification.one_liner: 研究四维可穿越虫洞低频散射：标量透射受时间尺度与共振影响，带电无质量费米子低能近乎全透射，类似 Callan-Rubakov 效应。
classification.relevance_reason: 摘要未提及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶，主要讨论四维可穿越虫洞、黑洞吸收与弯曲时空中的低频散射，因此归入经典引力/广义相对论支线；与用户重点标签中的“经典引力/广义相对论”相关，但不属于全息超导、multi-trace 或 D3-D7 等全息重点支线。

papers.title: Large-$N$ Carrollian Thermodynamics from AdS Black-Hole Phase-Space Contractions
papers.abstract: We develop the boundary large-rank interpretation of finite Carrollian black-hole thermodynamics and its sourced stress, scalar spectral and interacting thermal observables. Correlated scaling of the time generator and Newton coupling preserves the extended Hamiltonian differential while the generator temperature vanishes and the holographic normalization grows. The Brown--York source variation fixes the relative weights of energy density, momentum density and spatial stress, giving Ward equations on the Carrollian and thermal time scales. Boundary volume and normalization variations reproduce the bulk pressure work and characterize the Hawking--Page crossing through a chemical potential. Source coupling fixes the scalar operator map and spectral clock Jacobian. Numerical solutions in four-dimensional Schwarzschild-AdS determine angular transmission and finite-frequency absorption. In the type IIB family, the logarithmic scrambling interval imposes an additional hierarchy between rank and 't Hooft coupling. We derive a correlated limit in which the string length vanishes while a finite transverse Regge kernel survives in the normalized four-point functional. Its integrated attenuation and spatial width obey a common relation. This interacting observable distinguishes large-rank sequences with the same leading thermodynamics and asymptotic Regge growth rate. Thermal Fourier--Mellin moments retain the scalar spectrum in a contracting frequency window. Time translations shift their weights with angular source terms retained. The BTZ dictionary supplies the corresponding large-central-charge equilibrium example.

secondary_topics: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 从 AdS 黑洞相空间收缩出发的大 N Carrollian 热力学
classification.abstract_zh: 我们发展了有限 Carrollian 黑洞热力学的边界大秩（large-N）解释，以及其带源应力、标量谱和相互作用热观测量。时间生成元与牛顿耦合的关联标度保持扩展哈密顿微分形式，同时生成元温度消失而全息归一化增长。Brown-York 源变分固定了能量密度、动量密度和空间应力的相对权重，给出 Carrollian 与热时间尺度上的 Ward 方程。边界体积与归一化变分重现体压力功，并通过化学势刻画 Hawking-Page 穿越。源耦合固定标量算符映射和谱钟 Jacobian。四维 Schwarzschild-AdS 的数值解确定角透射和有限频率吸收。在 type IIB 族中，对数 scrambling 间隔在秩与 't Hooft 耦合之间施加额外层级。我们推出一个关联极限：弦长消失，而有限横向 Regge 核保留在归一化四点泛函中。其积分衰减与空间宽度服从共同关系。该相互作用观测量可区分具有相同领头热力学和渐近 Regge 增长速率的大秩序列。热 Fourier-Mellin 矩在收缩频率窗口中保留标量谱。时间平移改变其权重，同时角源项保留。BTZ 字典提供相应的大中心荷平衡例子。
classification.one_liner: 从 AdS 黑洞相空间收缩构造大 N Carrollian 边界热力学，给出 Brown-York Ward 方程、标量谱与 Regge 相互作用观测量，并以 Schwarzschild-AdS 和 BTZ 为示例。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文涉及 AdS 黑洞热力学、Hawking-Page 相变、Carrollian 全息字典和有限频率吸收/谱响应，与“相变与气泡成核”及部分 QNM/响应支线相关；但不涉及全息超流超导、多分量序参量、multi-trace、探针膜 Floquet 或冷原子实验。

papers.title: On Black Holes Surrounded by Radiation: I. Classical Considerations
papers.abstract: We consider spherically symmetric static solutions to Einstein's equations describing a Schwarzschild black hole enveloped by a thick shell of orbiting massless particles with zero radial pressure. The orbiting gas is ultra-compact and ultra-relativistic, and can be viewed as the marginally stable limit of a stable Einstein cluster. These solutions, which we refer to as "hillingar black holes", extend the photon sphere into a region of arbitrary depth. We compare these objects to black holes surrounded by other gases and note they have numerous special properties at the classical level; in particular, they appear optically indistinguishable from ordinary black holes to observers at infinity. We speculate concerning the possibility that these objects (or others much like them) might exist in nature, and whether they might be observable despite their similar outward appearance to ordinary black holes. We examine their thermodynamics and stability in companion papers.

classification.title_zh: 论被辐射包围的黑洞：I. 经典考量
classification.abstract_zh: 我们考虑爱因斯坦方程的球对称静态解，描述一个被厚壳层轨道运动无质量粒子包裹的 Schwarzschild 黑洞，该壳层径向压强为零。轨道气体是超致密且超相对论性的，可视为稳定爱因斯坦星团（Einstein cluster）的边际稳定极限。这些解——我们称为“hillingar 黑洞”——将光子球延伸为一个任意深度的区域。我们将这些对象与由其他气体包围的黑洞进行比较，并指出它们在经典层面具有许多特殊性质；特别是，对无穷远观测者而言，它们似乎在光学上与普通黑洞不可区分。我们推测这些对象（或与之非常相似的对象）可能存在于自然界，以及尽管它们外观与普通黑洞相似，是否仍可能被观测到。我们将在配套论文中考察它们的热力学与稳定性。
classification.one_liner: 构建并研究被轨道无质量粒子厚壳包裹的 Schwarzschild 黑洞经典解（“hillingar 黑洞”），其光子球区域可延伸且外部光学上类似普通黑洞。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究 Einstein 方程、经典黑洞时空与光子球结构，属于“经典引力/广义相对论”重点支线；不涉及全息对偶或量子引力。

papers.title: On Black Holes Surrounded by Radiation II: Thermodynamics
papers.abstract: In a companion paper we considered a Schwarzschild black hole of mass $m$ enveloped by a thick "ocean" of massless particles that extends the black hole's photon sphere into a region of finite depth. There we showed that this "hillingar black hole", of ADM mass $M$, optically mimics an ordinary black hole of the same mass. Here we find it also mimics the black hole thermodynamically: the formal assumption of thermal equilibrium implies the system has the same temperature and entropy as an ordinary black hole of mass $M$. We check this result carefully using multiple methods; a further method and indications of metastability are given by one of us in a companion paper. In AdS space, the mimicry does not hold, and the solutions have a richer structure. While it is far from clear that these systems are models for more realistic ones, we note possible connections with black hole evolution. In particular, assuming thermal equilibrium can be established and maintained, an HBH in a cavity of radius $\geq 3M$ can evaporate, potentially posing the information puzzle in a small finite volume.

secondary_topics: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 被辐射包围的黑洞 II：热力学
classification.abstract_zh: 在一篇姊妹论文中，我们考虑了质量为 m 的 Schwarzschild 黑洞被一层厚重的无质量粒子“海洋”包裹，将黑洞光子球延伸为有限深度区域。那里我们证明，这个 ADM 质量为 M 的“hillingar 黑洞”在光学上模仿同质量普通黑洞。这里我们发现它在热力学上也模仿普通黑洞：形式上的热平衡假设意味着该系统与质量为 M 的普通黑洞具有相同温度和熵。我们用多种方法仔细检验了这一结果；我们中的一人在姊妹论文中给出了进一步方法以及亚稳态迹象。在 AdS 空间中，这种模仿不成立，解具有更丰富结构。虽然远不清楚这些系统是否能作为更现实系统的模型，我们指出其与黑洞演化的可能联系。特别地，若热平衡能够建立并维持，位于半径 ≥3M 空腔中的 HBH 可以蒸发，可能在小有限体积中提出信息疑难。
classification.one_liner: 被无质量粒子海洋包裹的 Schwarzschild 黑洞在热力学上模仿同质量普通黑洞，但该性质在 AdS 中失效，并可能影响蒸发与信息疑难。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究经典黑洞热力学、辐射包裹黑洞及蒸发/information puzzle，匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；但不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶。

papers.title: As Cold as a Black Hole: Extended Photon Spheres
papers.abstract: It is widely believed that self-gravitating radiation cannot reach thermal equilibrium with a black hole in asymptotically flat spacetime. We describe a marginally stable continuum exception to the standard instability argument. Our main observation is that the photon sphere controls the Israel junction conditions (IJCs), the Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff (TOV) equation, and finite-radius black hole thermodynamics: the IJCs and TOV equation are equivalent at zero radial pressure, the inverse specific heat at the photon sphere is proportional to $-\Lambda$, and adding shells at fixed total mass \textit{lowers} the asymptotic Hawking temperature if and only if the local specific heat is positive. Using these results, we show how to compute thermodynamic entropies without the Euclidean path integral. The exception described here results from companion work with M.J. Strassler, where we found that a "hillingar black hole" (HBH) mimics an ordinary Schwarzschild black hole of mass $M$, sharing its Hawking temperature, photon ring, and, in equilibrium, its coarse-grained entropy $S = 4 \pi M^2$. Here, we show these features are not tuned; they follow uniquely from joint mechanical and thermodynamic constraints. Conditions for thermodynamic mimicry and for the formation of extended photon spheres are found; for self-similar solutions they coincide. A one-parameter family of self-similar systems -- all of which, excepting the HBH, require massless walls at the edges of their extended photon spheres -- satisfies both conditions. This family includes "stiffest stars" and "frozen stars".

secondary_topics: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 像黑洞一样冷：延展光子球
classification.abstract_zh: 人们普遍认为，在渐近平直时空中，自引力辐射无法与黑洞达到热平衡。我们描述了对标准不稳定性论证的一个边缘稳定的连续例外。我们的主要观察是：光子球控制 Israel 连接条件（IJCs）、Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff（TOV）方程以及有限半径黑洞热力学：在零径向压强下 IJCs 与 TOV 方程等价；光子球处的比热倒数正比于 -Λ；在固定总质量下增加壳层会降低渐近 Hawking 温度，当且仅当局部比热为正。利用这些结果，我们展示如何在不使用欧几里得路径积分的情况下计算热力学熵。这里描述的例外来自与 M.J. Strassler 的伴随工作，其中我们发现“hillingar black hole”（HBH）模仿质量为 M 的普通 Schwarzschild 黑洞，共享其 Hawking 温度、光子环，并在平衡时共享其粗粒化熵 S=4πM^2。在这里，我们表明这些特征并非调参所得；它们唯一地来自力学与热力学联合约束。我们找到了热力学模仿以及延展光子球形成的条件；对于自相似解，它们重合。一个单参数自相似系统族——除 HBH 外，其所有成员都需要在延展光子球边缘存在无质量壁——满足这两个条件。该族包括“最硬星”和“冻结星”。
classification.one_liner: 光子球通过 Israel 连接条件与 TOV 方程控制有限半径黑洞热力学，给出自引力辐射热平衡的连续例外和 HBH 热力学模仿。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究经典广义相对论中的光子球、TOV 方程、Israel 连接条件与有限半径黑洞热力学，直接对应“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；不涉及全息对偶。

papers.title: On Integrable Structures on Non-compact Boundaries in Three-Dimensional Gravity
papers.abstract: We study three-dimensional Einstein gravity with negative cosmological constant on non-compact spatial boundaries within the Chern-Simons formulation. Using an exact fluid/gravity correspondence, we derive a closed radial flow equation for the quasi-local stress tensor and show that it realizes the holographic $\sqrt{T\bar T}$ deformation at finite cutoff. We further develop the inverse-scattering description of the boundary dynamics, identifying the gravitational interpretation of the associated spectral data and analyzing the finite-cutoff deformation of soliton solutions. Although the boundary evolution is governed by an integrable bi-Hamiltonian hierarchy, we show that the radial flow itself is not Hamiltonian with respect to the canonical Poisson structure. Our results establish a unified framework connecting integrability, quasi-local gravitational observables, inverse scattering, and finite-cutoff holography on non-compact boundaries.

secondary_topics: 非均匀态/孤子/涡旋/畴壁
classification.title_zh: 三维引力中非紧致边界上的可积结构
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在 Chern-Simons 表述下研究具有负宇宙学常数的三维 Einstein 引力在非紧空间边界上的性质。利用精确的流体/引力对应，我们推导出准局域应力张量的闭合径向流方程，并表明它实现了有限截断下的全息 $\sqrt{T\bar T}$ 变形。我们进一步发展边界动力学的逆散射描述，识别相关谱数据的引力解释，并分析孤子解的有限截断变形。尽管边界演化由可积的双哈密顿族控制，我们表明径向流本身相对于正则 Poisson 结构并非哈密顿的。我们的结果建立了一个统一框架，将可积性、准局域引力可观测量、逆散射以及非紧边界上的有限截断全息联系起来。
classification.one_liner: 在 Chern-Simons 三维引力中，非紧边界上的准局域应力张量径向流实现有限截断全息 TTbar 变形，并联系可积性、逆散射与孤子解。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文涉及全息有限截断、TTbar 变形、三维经典引力、可积性与孤子解，与用户重点标签中的经典引力和孤子/非均匀方向相关；但其核心贡献在可积结构和有限截断全息，并非用户列出的全息超导、multi-trace、QNM 等具体支线。

papers.title: Elastic stiffness of three-dimensional black holes and wormholes from Liouville line defects
papers.abstract: We study elastic deformations of thin-shell black holes and wormholes in AdS$_3$ gravity. These geometries are sourced by line defects in the dual conformal field theory, and their shape and mass distribution define elastic moduli of the gravitational saddle. We compute the quadratic response of the partition function to these deformations, defining stiffness kernels for both transverse shape fluctuations and inhomogeneous mass-density fluctuations. The computation of the stiffness kernels can be realized as a hyperbolic response to a conformal welding problem which reduces to the universal Schwarzian response in the heavy-shell limit. The stiffness kernels are two-point functions of defect-local operators in CFT: the displacement operator, which measures the response to shape deformations, and a mass-density operator, which measures the response to local changes in the shell density. We compute the spectrum of these operators in the semiclassical limit, in various black hole and wormhole backgrounds. The spectrum can be discrete or continuous depending on the existence of a non-compact direction transverse to the shell in the geometry. We also provide a Lorentzian interpretation for the stiffness kernels using linear response theory and compute the relaxation time scales towards the corresponding transient deformations in the dual holographic CFT. Lastly, we compute the effect of these elastic deformations on black hole microstate statistics and black hole entropy.

secondary_topics: 非均匀态/孤子/涡旋/畴壁
classification.title_zh: 来自 Liouville 线缺陷的三维黑洞与虫洞的弹性刚度
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究 AdS3 引力中薄壳黑洞与虫洞的弹性变形。这些几何由对偶共形场论中的线缺陷提供源，其形状和质量分布定义了引力鞍点的弹性模量。我们计算配分函数对这些变形的二次响应，定义横向形状涨落和非均匀质量密度涨落的刚度核。刚度核的计算可实现为对共形焊接问题的双曲响应，在重壳极限下约化为普适 Schwarzian 响应。刚度核是 CFT 中缺陷局域算符的两点函数：位移算符，测量对形状变形的响应；质量密度算符，测量对壳层密度局域变化的响应。我们计算半经典极限下这些算符在多种黑洞和虫洞背景中的谱。谱可以是离散或连续的，取决于几何中存在横向于壳层的非紧方向。我们还利用线性响应理论给出刚度核的洛伦兹解释，并计算对偶全息 CFT 中趋向相应瞬态变形的弛豫时间尺度。最后，我们计算这些弹性变形对黑洞微态统计和黑洞熵的影响。
classification.one_liner: 在 AdS3/CFT2 中，薄壳黑洞与虫洞的弹性刚度由线缺陷的位移与质量密度算符两点函数给出，并影响黑洞微态统计与熵。

papers.title: Kibble-Zurek Mechanism and Current-Phase Relation in a Holographic Josephson Junction
papers.abstract: We present a comprehensive study of the current-phase relation of the Josephson junction in a holographic superfluid ring, realized from the stochastic and non-equilibrium dynamics according to the Kibble-Zurek mechanism. By employing a spatially modulated charge density to engineer a weak link, the current-phase relation is investigated in a range of geometric and thermodynamic parameters. The seminal sinusoidal relation between the current and the phase emerges periodically due to the compact shape of the geometry. We also identify the relations between the critical current and the geometric parameters of the junction: the width, steepness and depth. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the critical current exhibits a characteristic exponential decaying against the final temperature, reflecting the thermal degradation of the order parameter in a strong-coupling regime. Our results establish a robust framework for holographic Josephson devices, offering experimentally testable predictions for the non-equilibrium dynamics of high-$T_c$ superconductors.

classification.title_zh: 全息约瑟夫森结中的Kibble-Zurek机制与电流-相位关系
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在全息超流环中，对约瑟夫森结的电流-相位关系进行了综合研究，其实现基于Kibble-Zurek机制所描述的随机非平衡动力学。通过采用空间调制的电荷密度来构造弱链接，我们在多种几何与热力学参数下考察了电流-相位关系。由于几何的紧致形状，电流与相位之间经典的正弦关系周期性地出现。我们还确定了临界电流与结的几何参数（宽度、陡度和深度）之间的关系。此外，我们证明临界电流随最终温度呈特征指数衰减，反映了强耦合区序参量的热退化。我们的结果建立了全息约瑟夫森器件的稳健框架，为高温超导体的非平衡动力学提供了可实验检验的预言。
classification.one_liner: 通过Kibble-Zurek随机非平衡动力学构建全息超流环中的约瑟夫森结弱链接，研究电流-相位关系及临界电流对几何和温度的依赖。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文直接研究全息超流/超导中的约瑟夫森结、电流-相位关系以及Kibble-Zurek非平衡动力学，与用户重点关注的“全息超流超导”和非平衡相变支线高度契合。

papers.title: Holographic Renormalization of String-Derived Lovelock--Horndeski Theory
papers.abstract: String-derived higher-curvature scalar--tensor gravities encode microscopic coupling data in boundary response, raising the question of whether holographic observables can reconstruct the underlying higher-dimensional parameters. We answer this question for the five-dimensional string-derived Lovelock--Horndeski (SDLH) theory on its exact linear-dilaton asymptotically locally AdS branch, constructing the renormalized generating functional for an arbitrary boundary metric and spacetime-dependent scalar source. A boundary-covariant radial hierarchy unifies the variational problem, local backreaction, logarithmic obstruction, finite one-point functions, and Ward identities. Two response determinants organize the recursion, resonant obstructions, and metric--scalar mixing. The Weyl anomaly condenses into an Euler density, a Weyl-squared density, and a single curvature--scalar square whose paired variations generate the metric and scalar obstructions. The resulting renormalized functional carries string-selected coupling data into boundary geometry, operator response, anomaly coefficients, and a calculable interface with gravitational observables. On the regular branch, four scalar-normalization-invariant holographic combinations admit a global rational inverse to the continuous reduced couplings. At fixed compactification dimension the map has maximal rank, while the curvature-anomaly sum reconstructs the higher-dimensional Gauss--Bonnet coefficient without sign ambiguity. Holographic response thus provides an explicit, overdetermined boundary fingerprint of the underlying string reduction.

classification.title_zh: 弦论导出的 Lovelock--Horndeski 理论的全息重整化
classification.abstract_zh: 弦论导出的高曲率标量-张量引力将微观耦合数据编码在边界响应中，这提出了全息可观测量能否重构底层高维参数的问题。我们针对五维弦论导出 Lovelock--Horndeski (SDLH) 理论在其精确线性伸张子渐近局部 AdS 分支上回答该问题，为任意边界度规和依赖时空的标量源构造重整化生成泛函。一个边界协变的径向层级统一了变分问题、局域反作用、对数阻碍、有限单点函数和 Ward 恒等式。两个响应行列式组织递推、共振阻碍以及度规-标量混合。Weyl 反常凝聚为 Euler 密度、Weyl 平方密度和一个曲率-标量平方，其后者的配对变分生成度规和标量阻碍。所得重整化泛函将弦选择的耦合数据带入边界几何、算符响应、反常系数以及与引力可观测量的可计算接口。在正规分支上，四个标量归一化不变的全息组合允许对连续约化耦合的全局有理逆。在固定紧化维度下，该映射具有最大秩，而曲率-反常求和可无符号歧义地重构高维 Gauss--Bonnet 系数。因此全息响应为底层弦约化提供了一个显式、超定的边界指纹。
classification.one_liner: 在五维弦论导出的 Lovelock--Horndeski 理论中构造全息重整化生成泛函，并用边界响应反推高维耦合与反常系数。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究 AdS/CFT 框架下的全息重整化、边界生成泛函、Weyl 反常与 Ward 恒等式，属于全息对偶基础与字典的核心内容；同时涉及 Lovelock--Horndeski 高曲率标量-张量引力。

papers.title: On flat space limits of $AdS_4$ black holes
papers.abstract: With a view towards understanding flat space holography, we study the flat space limit of asymptotically $AdS_4$ black holes in gauged $\mathcal{N}=2$ supergravity. Using holographic renormalisation, we carefully analyse the flat space limit of the on-shell action of various black holes in this setting and make explicit the states that contribute to the partition function in this limit. We find several features: large black holes lead to a divergence in the partition function which can be understood as a thermodynamic volume divergence. Meanwhile, semiclassically, small black holes reproduce the partition function of their flat space counterparts, and we clarify the mapping between BPS, (near-)extremal or non-extremal black holes on both sides for charged and rotating solutions. Finally, by studying a suitable flat limit of the BPS Kerr-Newman-$AdS_4$ black hole in M-theory, we obtain a charged BPS solution in flat space. On the dual side, we determine a Carrollian-like limit on the known ABJM partition function on $S^1\times S^2$ at large $N$, and show that it reproduces the correct entropy of the BPS charged black hole in asymptotically flat space.

classification.title_zh: 论 AdS4 黑洞的平直空间极限
classification.abstract_zh: 为了理解平直空间全息，我们研究规范 N=2 超引力中渐近 AdS4 黑洞的平直空间极限。利用全息重整化，我们仔细分析该背景下各类黑洞壳上作用量的平直空间极限，并明确在此极限下对配分函数有贡献的态。我们发现若干特征：大黑洞导致配分函数发散，这可理解为热力学体积发散。半经典地，小黑洞重现其平直空间对应体的配分函数，我们厘清两侧 BPS、(近)极端或非极端带电与转动黑洞之间的映射。最后，通过研究 M 理论中 BPS Kerr-Newman-AdS4 黑洞的适当平直极限，我们得到平直空间中的带电 BPS 解。对偶地，我们在 large N 下确定已知 S^1×S^2 上 ABJM 配分函数的类 Carrollian 极限，并表明它重现渐近平直空间中 BPS 带电黑洞的正确熵。
classification.one_liner: 研究 AdS4 黑洞的平直空间极限，并通过 ABJM 配分函数的类 Carrollian 极限重现平直空间 BPS 带电黑洞熵。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要属于平直空间全息与 AdS/CFT 分区函数，并涉及黑洞解、壳上作用量与热力学；这与重点标签中的“经典引力/广义相对论”相关，但不直接落入全息超导、探针膜、QNM 等其他重点支线，因此相关度中等。

papers.title: Quantum Chaos and Spread of States in Krylov Subspace: A Topical Review
papers.abstract: Krylov state complexity, or spread complexity, has emerged as a sharp and versatile diagnostic of quantum chaos, information spreading, and many-body dynamics. Built from the Lanczos algorithm and grounded in the optimal-basis theorem, Krylov complexity thereby provides a robust spectroscopic window into quantum dynamics. A central theme is the characteristic overshoot observed in chaotic systems: a complexity peak in which chaotic evolution drives the state deeper into the Krylov chain than in integrable systems before relaxing to equilibrium. This behavior, tied to random-matrix universality classes of spectral statistics, is illustrated across a broad range of models, including quantum billiards, quantum spin chains, and variants of the SYK model. We also discuss proposed holographic descriptions of Krylov complexity in Einstein gravity, and conclude by outlining future directions and open problems, including time-dependent systems and quantum-field-theoretic formulations. A Mathematica notebook is provided for numerical exploration of Krylov complexity and spectral statistics across models.

classification.title_zh: Krylov子空间中的量子混沌与态扩散：专题综述
classification.abstract_zh: Krylov态复杂度，或称扩展复杂度，已成为量子混沌、信息扩散和多体动力学的一种敏锐且通用的诊断工具。它建立在Lanczos算法之上并以最优基定理为基础，从而为量子动力学提供了稳健的光谱窗口。一个核心主题是混沌系统中观察到的特征性过冲：混沌演化使态在Krylov链上比可积系统中更深入，然后弛豫到平衡。这种行为与谱统计的随机矩阵普适类相关，并在广泛模型中得到展示，包括量子台球、量子自旋链以及SYK模型的变体。我们还讨论了在Einstein引力中对Krylov复杂度的全息描述的提议，最后概述未来方向和开放问题，包括含时系统和量子场论表述。文中提供了一个Mathematica笔记本，用于跨模型数值探索Krylov复杂度和谱统计。
classification.one_liner: 专题综述：Krylov/spread复杂度作为量子混沌、信息扩散与多体动力学的诊断，并讨论其在Einstein引力中的全息描述。
classification.relevance_reason: 主要讨论Krylov复杂度、量子混沌与SYK，并包含Einstein引力中的全息描述；与全息量子信息和量子混沌相关，但不直接落在用户列出的全息超流、相变/气泡成核或探针膜等重点支线。

papers.title: Testing holographic computation of entanglement pseudo-entropy in dS3/ICFT2
papers.abstract: We establish a bottom-up model for studying the `would-be' de-Sitter/interface CFT (dS/ICFT) correspondence on the gravity side, using the Coleman-De Luccia instanton. After absorbing the region where the inflaton changes dramatically by a brane, the spacetime consists of two de Sitter spacetimes with different radii joined by a brane, which is expected to be dual to an interface CFT provided that the dS/CFT conjecture is correct. Our goal is to analyze existing prescriptions for the holographic computation of pseudo-entropy, i.e. the extremal surface in such a spacetime and argue that some of them would cause parodox with the results expected the universal properties of interface CFT and compare our results with that of Anti de Sitter/interface CFT correspondence (AdS/ICFT) after analytic continuation. We also read off the $g$-function from the entanglement entropy associated with a subregion perpendicular to the interface.

classification.title_zh: 在 dS3/ICFT2 中检验纠缠赝熵的全息计算
classification.abstract_zh: 我们建立了一个自下而上的模型，在引力侧研究“would-be” de-Sitter/interface CFT (dS/ICFT) 对应，使用 Coleman-De Luccia 瞬子。将暴胀子剧烈变化的区域用一个膜吸收后，时空由两个半径不同的 de Sitter 时空组成，并由一个膜连接；若 dS/CFT 猜想正确，这预期对偶于一个 interface CFT。我们的目标是分析现有的全息计算赝熵的方案，即在此类时空中的极值面，并论证其中一些方案会与 interface CFT 的普适性质所预期的结果产生矛盾；在解析延拓后，我们将结果与 Anti de Sitter/interface CFT 对应 (AdS/ICFT) 的结果进行比较。我们还从垂直于界面的子区域的纠缠熵中读出 g-函数。
classification.one_liner: 构造 Coleman-De Luccia 瞬子给出的 dS3/ICFT2 引力模型，检验全息赝熵处方并与 AdS/ICFT 解析延拓结果比较，且从垂直界面子区的纠缠熵提取 g-函数。
classification.relevance_reason: 涉及 dS/ICFT 全息、赝熵与纠缠熵、Coleman-De Luccia 瞬子以及界面/膜结构，与 dS/CFT、全息纠缠和气泡成核/界面等主题相关。

papers.title: Positivity constraints on the dynamics of cusped impurities in CFTs
papers.abstract: The cusp anomalous dimension is the universal logarithmic contribution to the free energy of a line defect with a cusp, and provides a useful observable characterizing defect dynamics. We generalize this notion to cusped line defects in the presence of a planar conformal boundary or interface. The geometry is characterized by three angles, and the distance of the cusp from the boundary or interface which separates short-distance and long-distance regimes. The resulting free energy contains two large logarithmic terms: a short-distance contribution governed by the usual vacuum cusp anomalous dimension, and a new long-distance contribution sensitive to the boundary or interface. Using reflection positivity for transverse deformations of the defect rays, we derive several constraints on the coefficients of these logarithmic terms, which can be packaged into negative semi-definiteness of their angular Hessians. We also derive constraints on the continuation of these coefficients to Lorentzian kinematics. We compute these coefficients and verify the constraints explicitly in free scalar and Maxwell theories and in planar $\mathcal N=4$ super-Yang-Mills theory at weak coupling for various choices of boundary conditions. At strong coupling, we compute the logarithmic coefficients in the holographic D3-D5 defect CFT and find a Gross-Ooguri-like phase transition between competing string worldsheets driven by the geometry of the cusp relative to the interface. We also observe a close connection of the cusp free energy in this setup with holographic corner entanglement entropy.
