classification.title_zh: 爱因斯坦-狄拉克-希格斯方程的类粒子解：基态、激发态与多费米子态
classification.abstract_zh: 我们扩展研究了最小耦合爱因斯坦-狄拉克-希格斯方程在渐近闵可夫斯基时空中的引力局域化类孤子解。描述这些汤川耦合狄拉克星的方程被推广到任意偶数个组成费米子。我们首先扩展了对 Leith 等人 [Phys. Rev. D. 107, 106020 (2023)] 最初分析的两费米子基态解的讨论。将分析推广到激发态和多费米子态后，我们发现两者表现出与两费米子基态对应物不同的行为。在这些激发态和多费米子态中，希格斯场可能呈现阶梯式增加，有时在孤子内部减少，这在两费米子基态中未曾见过。我们还提出在强汤川耦合态中存在的显著 ADM 质量与费米子质量差异的可能原因。
classification.one_liner: 研究爱因斯坦-狄拉克-希格斯方程在渐近闵可夫斯基时空中的类孤子解，并推广至激发态与多费米子态。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论支线的自引力孤子与狄拉克星研究，不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶；但与用户列出的经典引力重点标签直接相关。

papers.title: Tidal Love numbers of wormholes as black-hole mimickers
papers.abstract: We study the dynamical scalar tidal Love numbers of wormholes that provide viable mimickers for black holes, focusing on thin-shell Schwarzschild and Damour-Solodukhin geometries. Using a matched near- and far-zone expansion, we determine their tidal response in the low-frequency regime. The presence of a long throat introduces an additional characteristic scale and naturally separates the modes into two classes. Super-throat modes probe the global wormhole geometry and are sensitive to both asymptotic regions, whereas sub-throat modes probe only one side of the wormhole and effectively perceive the throat as a black-hole horizon. We derive the scalar tidal Love numbers analytically for both classes of modes and show that their dissipative parts exhibit distinct low-frequency behavior, reflecting whether one or both potential barriers participate in the scattering process. We further find that, as the wormhole approaches the black-hole limit, the super-throat contribution becomes progressively negligible, while the sub-throat response smoothly reduces to that of a Schwarzschild black hole. These results demonstrate that the tidal response of wormholes depends crucially on whether the perturbation probes the global structure of the throat.

classification.title_zh: 作为黑洞模拟体的虫洞潮汐洛夫数
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了可作为黑洞可行模拟体的虫洞的动力学标量潮汐洛夫数，重点关注薄壳史瓦西和 Damour-Solodukhin 几何。利用近区-远区匹配展开，我们在低频区域确定了它们的潮汐响应。长喉的存在引入了额外特征尺度，自然将模式分为两类。超喉模式探测整体虫洞几何并对两个渐近区域都敏感，而亚喉模式只探测虫洞一侧，并有效将喉视为黑洞视界。我们对两类模式解析导出了标量潮汐洛夫数，并表明其耗散部分展现出不同的低频行为，反映了散射过程中是一个还是两个势垒参与。进一步发现，当虫洞趋近黑洞极限时，超喉贡献逐渐可忽略，而亚喉响应平滑退化为史瓦西黑洞的结果。这些结果表明虫洞的潮汐响应关键取决于扰动是否探测喉的整体结构。
classification.one_liner: 研究薄壳虫洞的标量潮汐洛夫数，发现长喉将模式分为超喉和亚喉两类，并在黑洞极限下恢复史瓦西响应。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究经典引力中的虫洞潮汐响应，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，与用户重点标签高度匹配。

papers.title: Revisit the relationship between spread complexity rate and radial momentum
papers.abstract: This article discusses the relationship between the boundary spread complexity rate and the radial momentum in the bulk within the framework of AdS/CFT. We demonstrate that the radial momentum of a freely falling particle, as measured by a stationary observer in the bulk, is equal to the spread complexity rate of the boundary conformal field theory. This relationship has been discussed in two previous works, but their formulations appear distinct. However, this paper demonstrates their consistency. While earlier studies focused on particles with large mass and massless particles, we show that the relationship \textit{formally} holds for particles of any mass. Additionally, we provide a simple method for obtaining spread complexity from radial momentum using optical geometry.

classification.title_zh: 重新审视扩展复杂度率与径向动量的关系
classification.abstract_zh: 本文在 AdS/CFT 框架下讨论边界扩展复杂度率与体径向动量之间的关系。我们证明，体中的静止观察者所测得的自由下落粒子的径向动量，等于边界共形场论的扩展复杂度率。此前两项工作讨论过该关系，但其表述似乎不同；本文证明它们是一致的。早期研究关注大质量粒子与无质量粒子，而我们表明该关系在形式上对任意质量粒子都成立。此外，我们提供了一种利用光学几何从径向动量得到扩展复杂度的方法。
classification.one_liner: 在 AdS/CFT 中证明边界扩展复杂度率等于体内静止观察者测得的自由下落粒子径向动量，并统一此前表述且推广到任意质量。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于 AdS/CFT 全息复杂度主题，但未直接涉及用户列出的全息超导、p波与多分量序参量、探针膜与Floquet驱动、QNM与非线性演化、相变与气泡成核等具体重点支线。

papers.title: Six-loop gravitational interactions at the sixth post-Newtonian order
papers.abstract: We compute the gravitational interaction of two coalescing compact objects at sixth post-Newtonian order in the static limit, employing the diagrammatic approach within the effective field theory framework of General Relativity. The calculation requires the evaluation of six-loop Feynman diagrams that are mapped onto two-point integrals with a gauge-theory-like structure, which are computed here for the first time. The resulting seventh-order contribution in Newton's constant is finite in three space dimensions. This result provides the most technically demanding missing ingredient for the determination of the conservative dynamics of the gravitational two-body system at sixth post-Newtonian order.

classification.title_zh: 第六后牛顿阶的六圈引力相互作用
classification.abstract_zh: 我们采用广义相对论有效场论框架中的图方法，计算了两个并合致密天体在第六后牛顿阶静态极限下的引力相互作用。该计算需要计算六圈费曼图，这些图映射到具有类似规范理论结构的两点积分，并在此首次计算。所得牛顿常数七阶贡献在三维空间中是有限的。这一结果为确定第六后牛顿阶引力双体系统的保守动力学提供了技术上要求最高的缺失要素。
classification.one_liner: 在广义相对论有效场论框架下首次计算六圈费曼图，得到第六后牛顿阶静态极限引力相互作用及牛顿常数七阶有限贡献。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论中的后牛顿近似与双体保守动力学，直接对应“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；不涉及全息或量子引力。

papers.title: Branching Universes
papers.abstract: We propose the idea that our Universe is a realization among different possible branches, which can be observationally tested through the modified dispersion relation of the gravitational waves. We achieve this through a framework of spatially constrained vector fields. We show that the simplest realizations of such theories in flat and cosmological spacetimes do not introduce new propagating modes, but they give rise to tensor perturbations that differ from those of standard general relativity. As a result, they avoid the strong coupling issues or ghost modes that otherwise easily appear in vector-field models. We further show that such theories admit stealth black hole solutions, and we recover weak gravitational potentials, thus passing the solar system experiments. Finally, we discuss the implications of such theories and propose further generalizations.

classification.title_zh: 分支宇宙
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个想法：我们的宇宙是不同可能分支中的一种实现，可通过引力波的修正色散关系进行观测检验。我们通过空间约束矢量场框架实现这一点。我们表明，这类理论在平直和宇宙学时空中的最简单实现不会引入新的传播模式，但会产生不同于标准广义相对论的张量扰动。因此，它们避免了矢量场模型中容易出现的强耦合问题或鬼模。我们进一步表明，这类理论允许 stealth 黑洞解，并且我们恢复了弱引力势，从而通过太阳系实验。最后，我们讨论这些理论的含义并提出进一步推广。
classification.one_liner: 提出用空间约束矢量场构造分支宇宙框架，预言引力波修正色散关系，同时避免鬼模并保留 stealth 黑洞与太阳系检验。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典/修改引力与宇宙学，涉及引力波色散和 stealth 黑洞；与全息无关，但契合经典引力重点标签。

papers.title: Universal Lichnerowicz Lifting of Near-Horizon Soft Modes
papers.abstract: A recurring universality appears in the low-temperature quantum thermodynamics of near-extremal black holes, where distinct parent geometries often lead to the same logarithmic temperature dependence at one loop. In this work, we study the Lichnerowicz spectral origin of this infrared universality and understand why the relevant spectral data become insensitive to the details of the parent geometry. For extremal near-horizon geometries containing a two-dimensional maximally symmetric throat, we construct the normalizable transverse-traceless tensor zero modes associated with near-horizon reparametrizations. Turning on a small temperature lifts these zero modes through the first-order deformation of the Lichnerowicz operator. Although the local matrix element depends on detailed parent-geometry data, these data cancel after projection onto normalized tensor modes, leaving the universal result. For static spherically symmetric backgrounds, the resulting eigenvalue shift is proportional to the Fourier mode number and temperature. For rotating backgrounds, the same structure persists in the near-horizon reparametrization tensor sector, while angular warp factors only modify the overall projection factor. We fix the normalized coefficient explicitly, showing how radial integration and bulk normalization remove the near-horizon Taylor coefficients. We further show that this lifted bulk spectrum is the Lichnerowicz realization of the Schwarzian soft sector. Thus, the universal one-loop temperature dependence in the tensor sector is traced to an infrared bulk-boundary matching between near-horizon tensor zero modes and boundary reparametrization dynamics.

classification.title_zh: 近视界软模的普适 Lichnerowicz 提升
classification.abstract_zh: 近极端黑洞的低温柔量热力学中反复出现一种普适性：不同的母几何往往在一圈层次给出相同的对数温度依赖。本文研究这种红外普适性的 Lichnerowicz 谱起源，并理解为何相关谱数据对母几何细节不敏感。对于包含二维最大对称喉部的极端近视界几何，我们构造与近视界重参数化相关的可归一化横向无迹张量零模。开启小温度会通过 Lichnerowicz 算符的一阶形变抬起这些零模。尽管局域矩阵元依赖于详细的母几何数据，但在投影到归一化张量模后这些数据相消，留下普适结果。对于静态球对称背景，所得本征值移动正比于傅里叶模数和温度。对于旋转背景，同样的结构在近视界重参数化张量扇区中持续存在，而角度翘曲因子仅修改整体投影因子。我们显式固定归一化系数，展示径向积分和体归一化如何消除近视界泰勒系数。我们进一步表明，这个被抬升的体谱是 Schwarzian 软扇区的 Lichnerowicz 实现。因此，张量扇区中普适的一圈温度依赖被追溯到近视界张量零模与边界重参数化动力学之间的红外体-边界匹配。
classification.one_liner: 通过 Lichnerowicz 谱分析，近极端黑洞近视界张量零模在有限温度下的提升是普适的，并对应边界 Schwarzian 软扇区。
classification.relevance_reason: 核心是近极端黑洞/近视界软模与 Schwarzian 全息，方法上涉及 Lichnerowicz 算符的经典引力微扰谱，因此与“经典引力/广义相对论”支线相关；但不属于全息超流、p波、畴壁、multi-trace、相变气泡、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7 等重点标签。

papers.title: BMPV black holes in higher-derivative supergravity
papers.abstract: There are five independent four-derivative superinvariants for the five-dimensional STU model, of which two are vector invariants that do not involve curvature tensors. We construct the corrected BMPV black hole directly in five dimensions with this set of general four-derivative couplings, a computation made possible with the help of AI. We find that the vector invariants do not correct the solution or the entropy, while the entropy associated with the heterotic corrections agrees with recent results.

classification.title_zh: 高导数超引力中的 BMPV 黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 对于五维 STU 模型，存在五个独立的四导数超不变量，其中两个是不含曲率张量的矢量不变量。我们利用这组一般的四导数耦合，直接在五维中构造了修正后的 BMPV 黑洞；这一计算借助 AI 得以完成。我们发现，矢量不变量不会修正该解或熵，而与异质弦修正相关的熵与近期结果一致。
classification.one_liner: 用五维 STU 超引力的四导数不变量构造修正 BMPV 黑洞，发现矢量不变量不改变解与熵，异质弦修正的熵与近期结果一致。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文研究高导数超引力中的经典黑洞解与熵修正，不涉及 AdS/CFT 全息对偶；与用户重点标签中的经典引力/广义相对论支线相关，但与全息凝聚态、QNM、相变等具体支线无直接交集。

papers.title: Quasinormal-mode residues and pole coalescence in hypergeometric black-hole models
papers.abstract: We study source-normalized quasinormal-mode residues in radial boundary-value problems reducible to the Gauss hypergeometric equation. Hypergeometric connection coefficients separate the spectral condition from the normalization and spatial dependence of the frequency-domain Green function. We illustrate this construction for Dirichlet modes of the rotating Ba\~nados--Teitelboim--Zanelli black hole and mixed boundary conditions in two-dimensional anti-de Sitter spacetime, and then apply it to the P\"oschl--Teller/Nariai problem. Near pole coalescence, we obtain finite-position residues for the two simple poles, while at the critical point both coefficients of the second-order Laurent expansion are reduced to closed finite sums. The subleading coefficient depends explicitly on the frequency derivative of the Green-function numerator and is therefore not determined by the spectral function alone. We also identify the range in which the usual vanishing-discriminant criterion characterizes the P\"oschl--Teller coalescence: it holds for the positive barrier considered here, whereas other double zeros or cancellations can occur outside that regime. These results provide a normalization-controlled analytic benchmark for relating spectral coalescence to sourced quasinormal response.

classification.title_zh: 超几何黑洞模型中的准正规模残数与极点并合
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究可化为高斯超几何方程的径向边值问题中源归一化的准正规模残数。超几何连接系数将谱条件与频域格林函数的归一化和空间依赖性分离。我们以旋转 Bañados-Teitelboim-Zanelli 黑洞的 Dirichlet 模和二维反 de Sitter 时空中的混合边界条件为例说明该构造，然后将其应用于 Pöschl-Teller/Nariai 问题。在极点并合附近，我们得到两个单极点的有限位置残数，而在临界点，二阶 Laurent 展开的两个系数都化为闭式有限和。次领头系数显式依赖于格林函数分子的频率导数，因此不能仅由谱函数决定。我们还确定了通常的判别式消失判据刻画 Pöschl-Teller 并合的范围：对于此处考虑的正势垒它成立，而在该范围之外可能出现其他二重零点或相消。这些结果为将谱并合与有源准正规模响应联系起来提供了一个归一化控制的解析基准。
classification.one_liner: 用超几何连接系数研究黑洞准正规模残数与极点并合，并给出有限残数及临界点 Laurent 系数的解析基准。
classification.relevance_reason: 研究黑洞准正规模的解析结构、残数与极点并合，涉及 BTZ/AdS2 和经典引力；与 QNM 和经典引力标签相关，但未直接讨论全息对偶或凝聚态应用。

papers.title: Mass inflation and thin shells in quasi-topological gravity
papers.abstract: We study the null junction conditions in (re-summed) quasi-topological gravity theories, showing that no null thin shells exist within the realms of standard distributional theory for the pure gravity regular black hole solutions we have analyzed. This implies that the usual derivation of the mass inflation instability, which makes use of null thin shells, is not applicable in these theories. The problem of stability of inner horizons of regular black holes in quasi-topological gravity is hence still open and must be addressed with a more refined analysis, which does not rely on thin shells or the vacuum condition.

classification.title_zh: 准拓扑引力中的质量膨胀与薄壳
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究（重求和）准拓扑引力理论中的零类接头条件，表明在我们所分析的一类纯引力规则黑洞解中，标准分布理论框架下不存在零薄壳。这意味着通常利用零薄壳的质量膨胀不稳定性推导在这些理论中不适用。因此，准拓扑引力中规则黑洞内视界的稳定性问题仍然开放，必须通过不依赖薄壳或真空条件的更精细分析来处理。
classification.one_liner: 在准拓扑引力中，标准分布理论下不存在零薄壳，因此基于零薄壳的质量膨胀推导不适用于所分析的规则黑洞，内视界稳定性仍待更精细分析。
classification.relevance_reason: 摘要聚焦准拓扑引力中规则黑洞内视界与质量膨胀的经典时空分析，未涉及 AdS/CFT、纠缠或量子信息；但与用户列出的经典引力/广义相对论支线直接相关。

papers.title: Analytical solution of traversable wormholes in the presence of positive cosmological constant
papers.abstract: The construction of traversable wormholes with a cosmological constant, $\Lambda$, introduces significant challenges and leads to non-trivial modifications of the spacetime geometry. In this work, we obtain an analytical solution describing a locally traversable wormhole for $\Lambda>0$ following a perturbative approach. Starting from the Ellis-Bronnikov wormhole geometry, we derive the metric deformation induced by the cosmological constant at linear order, assuming $\Lambda r^2_0\ll 1$, where $r_0$ represents the throat of the Ellis-Bronnikov wormhole. We further identify the radial domain of validity of the perturbative solution, which is restricted to $r\ll\sqrt{3/\Lambda}$. Within this domain, we find that the Ellis-Bronnikov wormhole is modified by the cosmological constant; interestingly, the shape function takes a de Sitter-like form. Nevertheless, we verify that the flare-out condition holds at the deformed throat and find a violation of the null energy condition in its vicinity, as required for traversable WHs. Traversability is further analyzed by evaluating tidal forces and deriving constraints on the velocity required for safe human passage. Additionally, we discuss the possibility of constructing a global extension by matching the perturbative wormhole solution to a Schwarzschild-de Sitter exterior spacetime. Given the recent advances in the observational study of astrophysical compact objects, together with a variety of astrophysical and cosmological observations indicating the existence of a positive cosmological constant, the analytical solution presented here may be of considerable phenomenological interest.

classification.title_zh: 正宇宙学常数存在时可穿越虫洞的解析解
classification.abstract_zh: 构造带有宇宙学常数 Λ 的可穿越虫洞会带来显著挑战，并导致时空几何发生非平凡修正。本文采用微扰方法，获得了描述 Λ>0 时局部可穿越虫洞的解析解。我们从 Ellis-Bronnikov 虫洞几何出发，在假设 Λ r_0^2 ≪ 1（其中 r_0 为 Ellis-Bronnikov 虫洞喉部）的条件下，推导了宇宙学常数在线性阶诱导的度规形变。我们进一步确定了微扰解的径向有效范围，其限制为 r ≪ sqrt(3/Λ)。在此范围内，我们发现 Ellis-Bronnikov 虫洞被宇宙学常数修正；有趣的是，形状函数呈现 de Sitter 型形式。尽管如此，我们验证了在形变后的喉部 flare-out 条件仍然成立，并发现其附近违背零能量条件，这是可穿越虫洞所要求的。我们还通过评估潮汐力并推导安全人体通过所需速度约束，进一步分析了可穿越性。此外，我们讨论了将微扰虫洞解与 Schwarzschild-de Sitter 外部时空匹配以构造整体延拓的可能性。鉴于近期对天体物理致密天体观测研究的进展，以及多种表明正宇宙学常数存在的天体物理和宇宙学观测，本文给出的解析解可能具有相当大的现象学意义。
classification.one_liner: 从 Ellis-Bronnikov 虫洞出发，用微扰方法得到 Λ>0 下局部可穿越虫洞的解析度规，并检验 flare-out、零能量条件与潮汐力。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接属于经典引力/广义相对论重点标签，研究带正宇宙学常数的可穿越虫洞解析解与经典时空性质。

papers.title: Conservation law of super-Lorentz charges across spatial infinity
papers.abstract: Under assumptions compatible with generic gravitational scattering, the vacuum relativistic gravitational field is entirely determined at leading order in the large radius expansion at spatial infinity by its supermomentum, its dual supermomentum and its global supertranslation frame. At subleading order, the gravitational field is determined by three additional sets of charges: the super-Lorentz charges, the leading mixed tail/ peeling-breaking charges and the leading peeling-breaking charges. In this work we provide a proper-supertranslation-invariant definition of these charges in terms of asymptotic Bondi-Sachs fields as well as a corresponding proper supertranslation and logarithmic translation invariant definition of these charges in terms of Beig-Schmidt fields. Using the properties of homogeneous and inhomogeneous solutions to relevant wave equations over the boundary de Sitter spacetime at spatial infinity, we derive the conservation law of super-Lorentz charges between the future and past of spatial infinity. We obtain that the super-Lorentz aspects are non-locally defined from the Bondi-Sachs fields.

classification.title_zh: 超洛伦兹荷跨越空间无穷远的守恒律
classification.abstract_zh: 在与一般引力散射相容的假设下，真空相对论引力场在空间无穷远处大半径展开的首阶完全由其超动量、对偶超动量和整体超平移参考系决定。在次阶，引力场由三组额外荷决定：超洛伦兹荷、领头混合尾/剥离破缺荷以及领头剥离破缺荷。本文用渐近 Bondi-Sachs 场给出这些荷的 proper 超平移不变定义，并用 Beig-Schmidt 场给出相应的 proper 超平移和对数平移不变定义。利用空间无穷远处边界 de Sitter 时空上相关波动方程的齐次与非齐次解的性质，我们推导了空间无穷远未来与过去之间超洛伦兹荷的守恒律。结果表明，超洛伦兹方面由 Bondi-Sachs 场非局域地定义。
classification.one_liner: 在空间无穷远处用渐近场定义超洛伦兹荷，并证明其在无穷远过去与未来之间守恒。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文属于经典引力/渐近对称性与空间无穷远结构研究，与用户重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”直接相关；但不涉及全息、量子信息或所列其他全息专题。

papers.title: Massive quantum divergence on the Cauchy horizon of a black hole
papers.abstract: We investigate a quantum massive scalar field in the interior of a charged and spherically-symmetric (Reissner-Nordstr\"om) black hole. We examine the behaviour for varying values of the black hole charge, field mass and coupling constant when the field is in two quantum states: Hartle-Hawking (representing a black hole in thermal equilibrium) and Unruh (representing a black hole evaporating via the emission of Hawking radiation). We show that the vacuum polarization as well as the angular components of the quantum stress-energy tensor diverge on the Cauchy horizon, in stark contrast to what happens for massless fields. We also calculate the energy fluxes in Eddington-Finkelstein coordinates $\{u,v\}$. We show that these fluxes on the Cauchy horizon do not generically vanish. This implies, in particular, that in regular, Kruskal coordinates $\{U,V\}$ the ingoing flux diverges like $V^{-2}$ on the Cauchy horizon (where $V=0$). This divergence suggests that its backreaction via the semiclassical Einstein equations would yield a strong singularity, as opposed to its weaker, classical counterpart. Interestingly, there are exceptions, in which the energy fluxes in Eddington-Finkelstein coordinates vanish: (i) in the extremal limit (where the black hole is maximally charged); (ii) certain fine-tuned regions of parameter space, where the fluxes change sign.

classification.title_zh: 黑洞柯西视界上的大质量量子发散
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了带电球对称（Reissner-Nordström）黑洞内部的大质量量子标量场。考察黑洞电荷、场质量与耦合常数取不同值时，场处于两种量子态——Hartle-Hawking 态（代表热平衡黑洞）和 Unruh 态（代表通过霍金辐射蒸发的黑洞）——的行为。我们证明，真空极化以及量子应力-能量张量的角分量在柯西视界上发散，这与无质量场的情形形成鲜明对比。我们还计算了 Eddington-Finkelstein 坐标 {u,v} 中的能量通量，并表明这些通量在柯西视界上一般不为零。特别地，这意味着在正则 Kruskal 坐标 {U,V} 中，入射通量在柯西视界上以 V^{-2} 发散（其中 V=0）。这种发散表明，通过半经典 Einstein 方程的反作用会产生强奇异性，而非较弱的经典对应物。值得注意的是，也存在例外，此时 Eddington-Finkelstein 坐标中的能量通量消失：(i) 极端极限（黑洞达到最大电荷）；(ii) 参数空间的某些精细调节区域，通量变号。
classification.one_liner: 大质量标量场在 RN 黑洞柯西视界上产生发散的量子应力张量，半经典反作用可能形成强奇异性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于弯曲时空量子场论/半经典引力下的黑洞柯西视界研究，涉及经典 RN 黑洞时空与半经典反作用；与“经典引力/广义相对论”重点分支相关，但不是全息研究，也不涉及所列全息凝聚态、QCD、纠缠等支线。

papers.title: Theoretical Aspects of Direct Waves in Kerr Black Holes: Pole-Splitting Method for Ringdown Analysis
papers.abstract: We formulate the theoretical aspects of direct waves (DWs) in the case of extreme-mass merger. A DW is a source-driven waveform characterized by a complex frequency $\omega_{\rm G}$, which reflects the orbital motion of the particle in the vicinity of the black hole, including a part of the orbit inside the ergoregion: its real part is governed by frame dragging and its imaginary part by the redshift of the source. Using the Green's function technique, we derive the source-driven frequency $\omega_{\rm G}$, describe its screening by the potential barrier, and discuss its relation to dynamically excited quasinormal modes (QNMs). We then introduce a pole-splitting method that divides the full waveform into a QNM-pole sector and a non-QNM sector. Unlike QNM filtering, which multiplies the waveform spectrum by a filter function and thereby deforms it through a frequency-dependent time shift (i.e., group delay), our pole-splitting method merely divides the transfer function into pole and non-pole parts, separating the full waveform. Simulating a quasi-circular plunge into a Kerr black hole with medium and rapid spins, we find that the frequency and decay rate of the non-pole sector in the dominant mode, $\ell = m = 2$, evolve consistently with $\omega_{\rm G}$-or with its screened counterpart $\omega_{\rm screen}$-establishing the DW as a probe of the ergoregion and of the redshift effect around a black hole.

classification.title_zh: Kerr黑洞中直接波的理论方面：用于ringdown分析的极点分裂方法
classification.abstract_zh: 我们针对极端质量合并的情形，建立了Kerr黑洞中直接波（DW）的理论框架。DW是一种源驱动波形，由复频率 ω_G 表征，反映粒子在黑洞附近（包括轨道位于能层内的一部分）的轨道运动：其实部由参考系拖曳决定，虚部由源的红移决定。利用格林函数方法，我们推导了源驱动频率 ω_G，描述了它如何被势垒屏蔽，并讨论了它与动态激发的准正规模（QNM）的关系。随后，我们引入极点分裂方法，将完整波形分为 QNM 极点部分和非 QNM 部分。与 QNM 滤波不同——后者通过将波形频谱乘以滤波函数，从而以频率依赖的时间移动（即群延迟）使其变形——我们的极点分裂方法只是把传递函数拆成极点部分和非极点部分，从而分离完整波形。模拟中等和快速自旋下准圆轨道俯冲进入 Kerr 黑洞，我们发现主导模式 ℓ=m=2 中非极点部分的频率和衰减率与 ω_G 或其被屏蔽的对应量 ω_screen 一致演化，从而确立 DW 可作为黑洞周围能层与红移效应的探针。
classification.one_liner: 提出极点分裂方法分离Kerr黑洞ringdown中的QNM极点与非极点直接波成分，并用源驱动频率ω_G刻画能层与红移效应。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文直接研究Kerr黑洞ringdown、QNM与经典引力波形分析方法，匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”和“QNM与非线性演化”重点标签；不涉及全息对偶。

papers.title: Phase Structure and Gravitational-Wave Phenomenology of a Thermal First-Order Phase Transition
papers.abstract: We investigate the phase structure and gravitational-wave (GW) phenomenology of a cosmological first-order phase transition described by the finite-temperature effective potential $V(\phi,T)=D(T^2-T_0^2)\phi^2-ET\phi^3+\lambda\phi^4/4$. We derive the critical temperature and the broken-phase order parameter and identify the dimensionless combination $E^2/(D\lambda)$ that controls the critical-temperature shift. We then construct a dense numerical atlas containing $30\,000$ parameter points and map the resulting transition parameters onto the characteristic GW frequency and peak amplitude. The scan resolves the multidimensional correlations among $T_*$, $\alpha$, $\beta/H_*$, $v_w$, $f_{\rm peak}$ and $\Omega_{\rm GW}^{\rm peak}h^2$. The present analysis is phenomenological: $T_*$ is defined by the prescription $T_*=0.95T_c$, while $\beta/H_*$ and $v_w$ are treated as scan inputs. Consequently, the resulting GW signals are not interpreted as first-principles predictions. We identify the additional ingredients required for a predictive calculation, including the thermal bounce action, nucleation and percolation temperatures, the transition duration and a microscopic treatment of bubble-wall friction. The resulting framework provides a systematic numerical characterization of the connection between the phase structure of the finite-temperature potential and the corresponding phenomenological GW parameter space.

classification.primary_topic: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 热一阶相变的相结构与引力波现象学
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了由有限温有效势 V(φ,T)=D(T^2-T_0^2)φ^2-ETφ^3+λφ^4/4 描述的宇宙学一阶相变的相结构和引力波（GW）现象学。我们推导临界温度和破缺相序参量，并识别控制临界温度移动的无量纲组合 E^2/(Dλ)。然后构建包含 30000 个参数点的密集数值图谱，将所得相变参数映射到特征 GW 频率和峰值振幅。该扫描解析了 T_*、α、β/H_*、v_w、f_peak 和 Ω_GW^peak h^2 之间的多维关联。当前分析是唯象的：T_* 由 T_*=0.95T_c 的规定定义，而 β/H_* 和 v_w 被当作扫描输入。因此，所得 GW 信号不被解释为第一性原理预言。我们指出进行预测性计算所需的额外要素，包括热反弹作用、成核与渗流温度、相变持续时间以及气泡壁摩擦的微观处理。所得框架系统性地数值刻画了有限温势的相结构与相应唯象 GW 参数空间之间的联系。
classification.one_liner: 用三万个参数点扫描有限温有效势的一阶相变，唯象映射相变参数到引力波频谱，并列出预测化所需物理要素。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于宇宙学一阶相变与引力波现象学，未涉及 AdS/CFT、全息对偶、量子信息或量子引力；与全息理论主线无关。

papers.title: On The Regularized McVittie Black Bounce and a Family of Traversable Wormholes
papers.abstract: The McVittie metric describes a self-gravitating compact object embedded in an expanding universe. It inherits two singularities: a curvature singularity at $r \to 0$ and a cosmological singularity at $a(t) \to 0$. Motivated by the construction of black-bounce geometries, we regularize both of these singularities and propose a regularized McVittie metric. The central singularity is regularized by replacing $r \to \sqrt{r^{2}+b^{2}}$, leading to a geometry that interpolates between a cosmological black hole, a black bounce, and a traversable wormhole. Similarly, the cosmological singularity is regularized by introducing a non-vanishing scale factor $a \rightarrow \sqrt{a^{2} + a_b^{2}}$. The resulting spacetime is supported by an effective imperfect fluid with finite anisotropic stress. We investigate the formation of the apparent horizon, analyze the circular geodesic structure, and argue that the geometry can also be interpreted as a conformally evolving Morris-Thorne wormhole embedded in a regular cosmological background.

classification.title_zh: 正则化 McVittie 黑洞反弹与一类可穿越虫洞
classification.abstract_zh: McVittie 度规描述嵌入膨胀宇宙中的自引力致密天体，它包含两类奇点：r→0 的曲率奇点和 a(t)→0 的宇宙学奇点。受黑洞反弹几何构造的启发，我们正则化这两个奇点，提出正则化 McVittie 度规。中心奇点通过替换 r→√(r^2+b^2) 正则化，所得几何在宇宙学黑洞、黑洞反弹和可穿越虫洞之间插值。类似地，宇宙学奇点通过引入非零尺度因子 a→√(a^2+a_b^2) 正则化。得到的时空由具有有限各向异性应力的有效非理想流体支撑。我们研究视界的形成，分析圆轨道测地线结构，并论证该几何也可解释为嵌入正则宇宙学背景中的共形演化 Morris-Thorne 虫洞。
classification.one_liner: 通过正则化 McVittie 的中心与宇宙学奇点，构造出在宇宙学黑洞、黑洞反弹和可穿越虫洞之间插值的经典时空几何。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典广义相对论与致密天体/虫洞几何，直接对应经典引力支线；但未涉及全息对偶或量子引力，因此与全息重点相关性中等。

papers.title: Shadows and gravitational perturbations of black bounces
papers.abstract: We investigate axial gravitational perturbations and shadow formation in black-bounce geometries supported by anisotropic fluids within general relativity. Two distinct classes of solutions are analyzed: a symmetric Simpson--Visser-like black bounce and an asymmetric deformation of the Reissner--Nordstr\"om metric, which can feature either a bounded interior region or an unbounded wormhole-like extension. Our findings indicate that configurations with horizons, whether symmetric or asymmetric, exhibit single-barrier effective potentials and quasinormal frequencies nearly indistinguishable from those of standard black holes. In contrast, horizonless symmetric configurations may develop multiple potential barriers, giving rise to gravitational-wave echoes whose amplitude and separation depend sensitively on the bounce parameter $a$ and the density parameter $\rho_0$. Horizonless asymmetric solutions, on the other hand, exhibit regularized effective potentials that do not produce echoes and remain phenomenologically close to the Reissner--Nordstr\"om case. From the optical perspective, both classes of solutions with horizons exhibit a single relevant photon sphere and shadow profiles nearly indistinguishable from those of their black-hole counterparts, while horizonless symmetric configurations can sustain multiple photon rings. Horizonless asymmetric configurations may instead support either a single photon ring or none. Finally, we recover the standard eikonal correspondence between quasinormal modes and the instability of circular null geodesics for configurations with horizons. For horizonless geometries, however, the emergence of multiple potential barriers prevents a straightforward extension of this relation, although the strong similarity between the wave and optical sectors suggests that a meaningful phenomenological correspondence may still persist.

classification.title_zh: 黑洞反弹的阴影与引力扰动
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了广义相对论中由各向异性流体支撑的 black-bounce 几何中的轴向引力扰动和阴影形成。分析了两种不同的解：对称的 Simpson--Visser 型黑洞反弹，以及 Reissner--Nordström 度规的非对称变形，后者可以具有有界内部区域或无界虫洞式延伸。我们的发现表明，具有视界的构型，无论对称还是非对称，都表现出单势垒有效势和与标准黑洞几乎不可区分的准正频率。相反，无视界的对称构型可能形成多重势垒，产生引力波回声，其振幅和间隔敏感依赖于反弹参数 a 和密度参数 ρ0。另一方面，无视界的非对称解表现出正则化有效势，不产生回声，并且在现象学上接近 Reissner--Nordström 情形。从光学角度看，两类具有视界的解都表现出单个相关光子球和与对应黑洞几乎不可区分的阴影轮廓，而无视界对称构型可以维持多重光子环。无视界非对称构型则可能支持单个光子环或没有光子环。最后，对于具有视界的构型，我们恢复了准正模式与圆形零测地线不稳定性之间的标准 eikonal 对应。然而，对于无视界几何，多重势垒的出现阻碍了这种关系的直接推广，尽管波动和光学扇区之间的强烈相似性表明，一种有意义的唯象对应可能仍然存在。
classification.one_liner: 研究各向异性流体支撑的 black-bounce 几何的轴向引力扰动与阴影，发现视界存在与否决定 QNM、回声和光子环结构，并检验 eikonal 对应。

papers.title: Analytic motions of spinning particles in Schwarzschild-(anti-)de Sitter spacetime
papers.abstract: The motion of a spinning test particle in a static, spherically symmetric spacetime with a cosmological constant is studied within the Mathisson-Papapetrou-Dixon formalism, working to linear order in the particle's spin. By exploiting the symmetries of the background, the radial and latitudinal dynamics are reduced to first-order equations governed by a spin-deformed quintic polynomial. A complete classification of the real root structure of this quintic is carried out, from which the allowed orbital types for spinning particles in the Schwarzschild-anti-de Sitter and Schwarzschild-de Sitter geometries follow directly. The parameter dependence of the root structure and of the stable circular orbit interval is analyzed. In particular, for values of the cosmological constant beyond the Stuchl\'ik limit, where spinless particles admit no bound orbits, spinning particles can still remain bound. The radial motion is expressed piecewise in terms of Lauricella hypergeometric functions, with the simple positive real roots of the quintic acting as branch cuts. The latitudinal motion consists of small oscillations about an equatorial plane, and its phase, governed by the same quintic, admits an analogous analytic representation.

classification.title_zh: 施瓦茨希尔德-(反)德西特时空中自旋粒子的解析运动
classification.abstract_zh: 在具有宇宙学常数的静态球对称时空中，在 Mathisson-Papapetrou-Dixon 形式框架内、保留到粒子自旋线性阶，研究自旋测试粒子的运动。利用背景对称性，将径向和纬向动力学约化为由自旋形变五次多项式支配的一阶方程。对该五次多项式的实根结构进行了完整分类，由此直接得到自旋粒子在 Schwarzschild-anti-de Sitter 和 Schwarzschild-de Sitter 几何中允许的轨道类型。分析了根结构以及稳定圆轨道区间对参数的依赖。特别地，对于超过 Stuchlík 极限的宇宙学常数值，无自旋粒子不存在束缚轨道时，自旋粒子仍可保持束缚。径向运动分段用 Lauricella 超几何函数表示，五次多项式的简单正实根作为分支割线。纬向运动由绕赤道面的小振荡组成，其相位由同一五次多项式支配，并具有类似的解析表示。
classification.one_liner: 在 Schwarzschild-(A)dS 时空中，用 MPD 形式在线性自旋阶给出自旋测试粒子轨道的五次多项式分类及 Lauricella 超几何解析解。

papers.title: Clock-noise propagation and calibration for phase-locking configurations in space-based gravitational-wave detectors
papers.abstract: In space-based gravitational-wave detectors, laser phase locking transfers the phase of weak received light to a local laser and maintains the interspacecraft heterodyne frequencies within the phasemeter bandwidth. Fluctuations of the onboard ultrastable oscillators introduce clock noise into these heterodyne phase measurements, requiring additional calibration in time-delay interferometry (TDI). Existing formulations based on six independently formed one-way measurements do not explicitly describe the common-reference clock structure of a master--slave phase-locking configuration. In this work, we formulate clock-noise propagation and calibration directly for this configuration. Starting from carrier and sideband readouts, we derive the clock-noise couplings and construct an ordered sideband-calibration rule. The rule retains noncommuting delays and applies to two-branch TDI combinations satisfying propagation and clock-coefficient closure. For mutually independent onboard clocks with identical fractional-frequency noise spectra, we compare matched realizations with and without phase locking. In the adopted frozen equal-arm model, 45 second-generation combinations with up to 16 links considered here have smaller clock-noise residuals in the phase-locking realization throughout 0.1--10~mHz, before final clock calibration. Numerical simulations of two representative 16-link combinations reproduce the analytical spectra and verify the predicted reduction and calibration. These results show that the phase-locking realizations reduce the clock-noise contribution before final calibration, while the cancellation of master-laser phase noise still relies on TDI.

classification.title_zh: 空间引力波探测器中锁相配置的时钟噪声传播与校准
classification.abstract_zh: 在空间引力波探测器中，激光锁相将微弱接收光的相位转移到本地激光，并使星间外差频率保持在相位计带宽内。星载超稳定振荡器的涨落会在这类外差相位测量中引入时钟噪声，因此在时间延迟干涉测量（TDI）中需要额外校准。现有基于六个独立单向测量的表述没有明确描述主从锁相配置的共参考时钟结构。本文直接针对该配置建立时钟噪声传播与校准形式。我们从载波和边带读出出发，推导时钟噪声耦合，并构造一种有序边带校准规则。该规则保留非对易延迟，适用于满足传播闭合和时钟系数闭合的两支 TDI 组合。对于具有相同分数频率噪声谱的相互独立星载时钟，我们比较了锁相与不锁相的匹配实现。在所采用的冻结等臂模型中，这里考虑的多达 16 条链路的 45 个第二代组合，在 0.1--10 mHz 范围内，锁相实现中的时钟噪声残差在最终时钟校准前更小。对两个代表性 16 链路组合的数值模拟复现了解析谱，并验证了预测的降低和校准。结果表明，锁相实现可在最终校准前降低时钟噪声贡献，而主激光相位噪声的抵消仍依赖 TDI。
classification.one_liner: 针对空间引力波探测器主从锁相配置，直接推导时钟噪声耦合与有序边带校准规则，并在冻结等臂模型中显示锁相实现可降低最终校准前的时钟噪声残差。

papers.title: Prospects of electromagnetic follow-up of neutron star-black hole mergers in the LIGO-India era
papers.abstract: Neutron star-black hole (NSBH) mergers are promising multimessenger sources, but only a subset is expected to produce detectable electromagnetic (EM) counterparts, depending on the binary mass ratio, black hole (BH) spin, and neutron star (NS) equation of state (EoS). We investigate the prospects for detecting kilonova counterparts to NSBH mergers in the LIGO-India era using the Vera C. Rubin Observatory (Rubin). We simulate GW230529-motivated NSBH populations with two effective tidal deformability ranges, estimate gravitational-wave detections for the LHV (LIGO-Livingston, LIGO-Hanford, Virgo) and LHVA (LHV with LIGO-India at Aundha) detector networks, and model the detectability of the associated kilonova emission with Rubin. We find that adding LIGO-India approximately doubles the number of EM follow-ups, primarily by increasing the duty cycle and reducing the median sky-localization area, and notably increases the number of such detections at large distances. For fixed-exposure strategies, the EM detection rate saturates at exposure times of a few hundred seconds, reflecting the trade-off between depth and sky coverage. We therefore introduce an event-specific exposure-time optimization strategy based on the expected counterpart brightness and sky-localization area. With this strategy, the expected NSBH GW+EM detection rate per year is 4.19(-3.58,+9.66) for the optimistic and 0.79(-0.68,+1.83) for the conservative population with the LHVA network, compared to 1.46(-1.25,+3.37) and 0.27(-0.23,+0.62), respectively, for LHV. The required Rubin follow-up time remains within the expected Target-of-Opportunity allocation. These results show that in the next decade, a few such NSBH follow-ups may take place, with a fraction of them in the redshift range of about 0.1-0.2, which will not only be useful for measuring the Hubble constant but can also help us in probing the Hubble parameter.

classification.title_zh: LIGO-India 时代中子星-黑洞并合电磁跟进观测的前景
classification.abstract_zh: 中子星-黑洞（NSBH）并合是有前景的多信使源，但仅有一部分预期会产生可探测的电磁（EM）对应体，这取决于双星质量比、黑洞自旋和中子星状态方程。我们研究在 LIGO-India 时代利用薇拉·鲁宾天文台（Rubin）探测 NSBH 并合千新星对应体的前景。我们模拟了受 GW230529 启发的 NSBH 群体，采用两个有效潮汐形变范围，估计 LHV（LIGO-Livingston、LIGO-Hanford、Virgo）和 LHVA（LHV 加上位于 Aundha 的 LIGO-India）探测器网络的引力波探测，并对 Rubin 对相关千新星发射的可探测性建模。我们发现，加入 LIGO-India 大致使 EM 跟进数量翻倍，主要通过提高占空比和减小中位天空定位面积，并显著增加远距离此类探测的数量。对于固定曝光策略，EM 探测率在几百秒曝光时间处饱和，反映了深度与天空覆盖之间的权衡。因此，我们引入一种基于预期对应体亮度和天空定位面积的事件特定曝光时间优化策略。采用该策略，LHVA 网络下乐观和保守群体的预期 NSBH GW+EM 年探测率分别为 4.19(-3.58,+9.66) 和 0.79(-0.68,+1.83)，而 LHV 分别为 1.46(-1.25,+3.37) 和 0.27(-0.23,+0.62)。所需 Rubin 跟进时间仍在预期的目标机会分配范围内。这些结果表明，在未来十年中，可能会有少数此类 NSBH 跟进发生，其中一部分红移约在 0.1-0.2，这不仅有助于测量哈勃常数，也可帮助探测哈勃参数。
classification.one_liner: 该文模拟 LIGO-India 加入后 NSBH 并合的引力波探测及 Rubin 千新星电磁跟进，评估探测率与 Hubble 参数测量前景。

papers.title: Critical Scalarization for a Self-Gravitating Bosonic Condensate
papers.abstract: We establish a minimal nonrelativistic realization of scalarization in a self-gravitating bosonic condensate coupled to a scalar response field. A local effective-mass shift and nonlinear saturation generate a multibranch structure with two distinct transition routes. In the linearly stable regime, a finite perturbation drives a first-order transition with type-I logarithmic scaling near threshold. Beyond the linear onset, small perturbations grow tachyonically, and the response time controls both the growth and the subsequent breathing dynamics. These results identify a common mechanism for scalarization across relativistic compact objects and nonrelativistic condensates, and point toward laboratory analogues in coherent media.

classification.title_zh: 自引力玻色凝聚体的临界标量化
classification.abstract_zh: 我们建立了一个自引力玻色凝聚体与标量响应场耦合的标量化最小非相对论实现。局域有效质量移动和非线性饱和产生具有两条不同转变路径的多分支结构。在线性稳定区域，有限扰动驱动一阶转变，在阈值附近呈现 I 型对数标度。超过线性起始后，小扰动以快子方式增长，响应时间控制增长以及随后的呼吸动力学。这些结果识别了相对论致密天体和非相对论凝聚体中标量化的共同机制，并指向相干介质中的实验室类比。
classification.one_liner: 本文提出自引力玻色凝聚体中标量化的最小非相对论模型，揭示一阶转变、对数标度与快子增长/呼吸动力学。

papers.title: Testing Source Dependence in Gravitational-Wave Tests of General Relativity with Mutual Information
papers.abstract: Phenomenological deviation parameters used in gravitational-wave tests of general relativity need not represent universal fundamental properties of the sources. Instead, a deviation parameter can be a derived quantity that depends on source properties. Apparent violations of general relativity arising from waveform systematics or data-quality issues can also depend on source properties. In addition to diagnosing individual events, it is helpful to identify systematic trends at the population level. We introduce a nonparametric framework that uses mutual information to test whether the deviations depend on source properties. We validate the framework using simulations with massive graviton waveforms. Assuming we do not have prior knowledge of the underlying theory, massive graviton effects can be captured by a parameterized post-Einstein coefficient that is expected to depend on the luminosity distance and source mass. The results show that the mass and distance dependencies become clear for graviton masses of $\geq 1\times10^{-22}\,\mathrm{eV}$ at detector sensitivities representative of the current fourth observing run, while the controlled general relativity simulations yield null results. We then analyze public real-data products for tests of general relativity from GWTC-4.0 and 4-OGC, including phenomenological parameterized tests, modified dispersion tests, and parity violation tests. The phenomenological deviation parameters have tentative correlations with effective spin, and correlations of modified-dispersion or parity-violation parameters with source mass are visible. These results demonstrate that catalog-level dependence can identify patterns and thus be used to diagnose the origin of deviations in testing general relativity. The framework therefore complements single-event analyses and parameterized hierarchical population tests.

classification.title_zh: 用互信息检验引力波广义相对论检验中的源依赖性
classification.abstract_zh: 引力波广义相对论检验中使用的唯象偏差参数未必代表源的普适基本性质。相反，偏差参数可以是一个依赖于源性质的导出量。由波形系统误差或数据质量问题引起的表观广义相对论违反也可能依赖于源性质。除了诊断单个事件外，识别族群层面的系统性趋势也很有帮助。我们引入一个非参数框架，利用互信息检验偏差是否依赖于源性质。我们用大质量引力子波形模拟验证该框架。假设事先不知道底层理论，大质量引力子效应可由参数化的后爱因斯坦系数捕获，该系数预期依赖于光度距离和源质量。结果表明，在当前第四观测运行代表性的探测器灵敏度下，对于引力子质量不小于 1e-22 eV，质量依赖和距离依赖变得清晰，而受控的广义相对论模拟给出零结果。随后我们分析来自 GWTC-4.0 和 4-OGC 的公开真实数据产物中的广义相对论检验，包括唯象参数化检验、修改色散检验和宇称破缺检验。唯象偏差参数与有效自旋存在暂定相关性，修改色散或宇称破缺参数与源质量的相关性可见。这些结果表明，目录层面的依赖性可以识别模式，从而用于诊断广义相对论检验中偏差的来源。因此该框架补充了单事件分析和参数化层级族群检验。
classification.one_liner: 用互信息检验引力波广义相对论检验中的偏差参数是否依赖源性质，并在模拟与 GWTC-4.0/4-OGC 数据中寻找族群层面的系统趋势。

papers.title: Pulsar Timing Response and Spatial Correlations of Shear Modes in Torsionless Palatini Spacetime
papers.abstract: In the nanohertz band, spatial correlations between pulsar timing residuals provide a key observable for characterizing stochastic gravitational-wave backgrounds and probing their polarization content. In torsionless Palatini spacetime, nonmetricity can generate two additional shear modes, referred to as the shear-$x$ and shear-$y$ modes. In this work, we investigate the pulsar timing response produced by the shear-induced motions of the emitting pulsar and the receiving Earth. Assuming that the electromagnetic field is minimally coupled to the physical metric and that the Earth and pulsar possess non-negligible effective hypermomentum responses, we derive the single-pulsar redshift, the frequency-domain two-point correlation function, and the corresponding spatial correlation. For a stationary and isotropic stochastic shear background, the normalized overlap reduction function (ORF) for distinct pulsars reduces in the short-wavelength limit to the pure dipolar form $\Gamma_{ab}^{\mathrm{sh}}(\zeta)=\cos\zeta$, where $\zeta$ is the angular separation between the two pulsars. The same dipolar correlation can also be produced by isotropic Solar System ephemeris errors, leading to a spatial degeneracy between the two signals. This degeneracy highlights the importance of information beyond the angular correlation for identifying Palatini shear signatures in PTA data.

classification.title_zh: 无挠 Palatini 时空中剪切模式的脉冲星计时响应与空间关联
classification.abstract_zh: 在纳赫兹频段，脉冲星计时残差之间的空间关联是刻画随机引力波背景及其偏振内容的关键观测量。在无挠 Palatini 时空中，非度规性可以产生两种额外的剪切模式，称为剪切-x 和剪切-y 模式。本文研究由发射脉冲星和接收地球的剪切诱导运动所产生的脉冲星计时响应。假设电磁场与物理度规最小耦合，并且地球和脉冲星具有不可忽略的有效超动量响应，我们推导了单脉冲星红移、频域两点关联函数以及相应的空间关联。对于稳态且各向同性的随机剪切背景，不同脉冲星的归一化重叠约化函数（ORF）在短波极限下约化为纯偶极形式 Γ_ab^sh(ζ)=cos ζ，其中 ζ 是两颗脉冲星之间的角分离。相同的偶极关联也可以由各向同性的太阳系历表误差产生，从而导致两种信号之间的空间简并。这种简并凸显了在 PTA 数据中识别 Palatini 剪切特征时，角度关联之外的信息的重要性。
classification.one_liner: 在无挠 Palatini 时空中推导剪切模式诱导的脉冲星计时空间关联，短波极限下为纯偶极形式，并与太阳系历表误差简并。

papers.title: Parity symmetry as a diagnostic for spin-precessing binary-black-hole waveform models
papers.abstract: Parity invariance of general relativity imposes exact relations between waveforms and remnant properties of binary-black-hole configurations related by reversal of the in-plane spins and observer direction. We summarize these relations and construct consistency tests for spin-precessing waveform and remnant models. Applying a conservative, unmaximized overlap diagnostic to seven state-of-the-art waveform models, we find that models built from aligned-spin calibrated waveforms and parity-covariant precession dynamics satisfy the symmetry to numerical precision. The original \texttt{IMRPhenomXO4a} and \texttt{IMRPhenomXPNR} implementations instead exhibit median parity residuals of approximately $1.6\times10^{-3}$ with broad upper tails, while \texttt{NRSur7dq4} shows its largest violations at high mass ratio and large spin magnitude. The asymmetric extension of \texttt{SEOBNRv5PHM} exhibits a smaller, localized violation, while \texttt{NRSur7dq4Remnant} shows larger residuals in the recoil than in the final mass and spin. We trace these violations to an observer-dependent phase anchor in the \texttt{IMRPhenom} antisymmetric mode, non-invariant parameterization of the \texttt{NRSur7dq4} surrogate fits, and one non-invariant NR-calibrated coefficient in the asymmetric \texttt{SEOBNRv5PHM} extension. Local corrections restore waveform parity to numerical precision for the \texttt{IMRPhenom} and \texttt{SEOBNRv5PHM} cases; restoring it in \texttt{NRSur7dq4} requires refitting the surrogate. Reanalyses of eight GWTC-5.0 events show no qualitative change in astrophysical interpretation, although the \texttt{IMRPhenom} correction yields Jensen-Shannon divergences up to $5\times10^{-2}$ in individual marginalized posteriors. Exact symmetries thus provide inexpensive, model-independent consistency tests and should be imposed by construction in calibrated waveform models.

classification.title_zh: 宇称对称性作为自旋进动双黑洞波形模型的诊断工具
classification.abstract_zh: 广义相对论的宇称不变性对由面内自旋反向和观测方向反转相联系的双黑洞构型的波形与残余性质施加精确关系。我们总结这些关系，并为自旋进动波形和残余模型构建一致性检验。将一种保守的、未最大化的重叠诊断应用于七个最先进的波形模型，我们发现，由对齐自旋校准波形和宇称协变进动动力学构建的模型在数值精度上满足该对称性。原始的 IMRPhenomXO4a 和 IMRPhenomXPNR 实现反而表现出约 1.6×10^-3 的中位宇称残差，并带有宽的上尾，而 NRSur7dq4 在高质量比和大自旋量级处显示出最大的破坏。SEOBNRv5PHM 的非对称扩展表现出较小的局域破坏，而 NRSur7dq4Remnant 在反冲中的残差大于最终质量和自旋中的残差。我们将这些破坏追溯到 IMRPhenom 反对称模式中依赖观测者的相位锚点、NRSur7dq4 代理拟合的非不变参数化，以及非对称 SEOBNRv5PHM 扩展中一个非不变的 NR 校准系数。局域修正使 IMRPhenom 和 SEOBNRv5PHM 情形的波形宇称恢复到数值精度；在 NRSur7dq4 中恢复它需要重新拟合代理。对八个 GWTC-5.0 事件的再分析显示天体物理解释没有定性变化，尽管 IMRPhenom 修正会在单个边缘化后验中产生高达 5×10^-2 的 Jensen-Shannon 散度。因此，精确对称性提供了廉价、模型无关的一致性检验，并应在校准波形模型中通过构造加以施加。
classification.one_liner: 该文利用广义相对论的宇称不变性检验七个自旋进动双黑洞波形/残余模型，定位并修正若干模型的宇称破坏。

papers.title: A Novel Scheme for Inter-Satellite Integrated Laser Ranging and Communication in Space-Based GW Detection
papers.abstract: Adopting pseudo-random noise (PRN) codes for inter-satellite ranging, the resulting data-encoded PRN signal induces excessive laser phase measurement noise under the currently adopted integrated scheme in space-based gravitational wave (GW) detection systems. To suppress the noise, a scheme of inter-satellite integrated laser link is presented in this Letter, in which the data-encoded PRN signal for inter-satellite absolute distance measurement and communication is phase-modulated onto the ultra-stable oscillator (USO) clock signal before phase modulation onto the laser carrier. Theoretical analysis and simulation results show that in the proposed scheme the noise is significantly suppressed compared with the currently-adopted one, while the noise stemming from the data-encoded PRN signal on clock noise transfer is limited within the requirement.

classification.title_zh: 空间引力波探测中星间集成激光测距与通信的新方案
classification.abstract_zh: 在星间测距中采用伪随机噪声（PRN）码时，当前空间引力波探测系统所采用的集成方案会使数据编码的 PRN 信号引入过大的激光相位测量噪声。为抑制该噪声，本文提出一种星间集成激光链路方案：将用于星间绝对距离测量和通信的数据编码 PRN 信号先相位调制到超稳振荡器（USO）时钟信号上，再相位调制到激光载波上。理论分析和仿真结果表明，与当前采用的方案相比，所提方案显著抑制了噪声，同时数据编码 PRN 信号对时钟噪声传递所引入的噪声被限制在要求范围内。
classification.one_liner: 提出将数据编码 PRN 信号先调制到 USO 时钟再调制到激光载波的星间集成激光链路方案，以抑制空间引力波探测中的相位测量噪声。
classification.relevance_reason: 主题属于空间引力波探测的激光链路工程，与经典引力/广义相对论支线中的引力波探测相关，但不涉及全息对偶或量子引力理论。

papers.title: Decoding the Imprints of Energy-Momentum Squared Gravity in Neutron Stars with Machine Learning Analysis
papers.abstract: Neutron stars (NSs) provide a unique laboratory for testing gravity in the strong-field regime and for searching for deviations from General Relativity (GR). In this work, we investigate the effects of Energy-Momentum Squared Gravity (EMSG) on NS structure and examine whether its signatures can be identified from observable stellar properties using supervised machine learning (ML). We solve the modified Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff equations for approximately $10^{4}$ nuclear equations of state (EOSs) for EMSG coupling parameters $\alpha=\{-5.01,-2.50,0,+2.50,+5.01\}\times10^{-38}\,\mathrm{erg}^{-1}\mathrm{cm}^{3}$, and calculate the gravitational mass $M$, radius $R$, dimensionless tidal deformability $\Lambda$, and fundamental $f$-mode oscillation frequency for each stellar configuration. Imposing observational constraints on $M$, $R$, and $\Lambda$, we split our datasets into train and test sets, and we employ Random Forest (RF), K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Support Vector Machine (SVM), Logistic Regression (LR), and Gaussian Naive Bayes (GNB) to classify the representative sectors $\alpha=\{-5.01,0,+5.01\}\times10^{-38}\,\mathrm{erg}^{-1}\mathrm{cm}^{3}$ using $(M, R,\Lambda,f)$. The RF classifier performs best, achieving an accuracy of approximately $99.85\%$ with precision, recall, and F1-scores exceeding $99.8\%$, while KNN also achieves accuracy above $99\%$. The nearly diagonal confusion matrices demonstrate that the observationally viable NS configurations associated with different EMSG sectors remain highly separable in the multidimensional observable space. Our results show that NS observables retain robust signatures of EMSG even after observational filtering, establishing ML-assisted NS observations as a promising complementary approach for probing modified gravity with current and future multi-messenger observations.

classification.title_zh: 用机器学习分析解码能量-动量平方引力在中子星中的印记
classification.abstract_zh: 中子星（NSs）为在强场区域检验引力以及寻找对广义相对论（GR）的偏离提供了独特实验室。在本工作中，我们研究能量-动量平方引力（EMSG）对中子星结构的影响，并利用监督机器学习（ML）考察能否从可观测恒星性质中识别其印记。我们对约 10^4 个核物态方程（EOSs）求解修正的 Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff 方程，EMSG 耦合参数取 α = {-5.01, -2.50, 0, +2.50, +5.01}×10^{-38} erg^{-1} cm^3，并计算每个恒星位形的引力质量 M、半径 R、无量纲潮汐形变 Λ 以及基本 f 模振荡频率。在施加对 M、R 和 Λ 的观测约束后，我们将数据集分为训练集和测试集，并使用随机森林（RF）、K 近邻（KNN）、支持向量机（SVM）、逻辑回归（LR）和高斯朴素贝叶斯（GNB），基于 (M, R, Λ, f) 对代表性区间 α = {-5.01, 0, +5.01}×10^{-38} erg^{-1} cm^3 进行分类。RF 分类器表现最佳，准确率约 99.85%，精确率、召回率和 F1 分数均超过 99.8%；KNN 的准确率也超过 99%。近乎对角的混淆矩阵表明，与不同 EMSG 区间对应的、在观测上可行的中子星位形在多维可观测空间中仍高度可分离。我们的结果表明，即使经过观测筛选，中子星可观测星仍保留 EMSG 的稳健印记，从而确立机器学习辅助的中子星观测为一种有前景的补充方法，可用当前和未来的多信使观测探测修改引力。
classification.one_liner: 对约万个核物态方程求解EMSG修正TOV方程并用监督学习分类，发现中子星(M,R,Λ,f)仍能高精度区分EMSG参数。

papers.title: Global time-frequency search for stellar-mass binary black holes in LISA
papers.abstract: We present a complete pipeline for detecting and characterizing gravitational waves (GWs) produced by the inspiral of stellar-mass binary black holes in data from the Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA). The analysis framework relies on an efficient time-frequency implementation of an adaptive semi-coherent detection statistic, which we show to be robust against non-stationary noise and the presence of gaps of varying duration and cadence. The search is able to detect signals with coherent signal-to-noise ratios as low as $\approx 11-14$ over the full parameter space of binary black holes with spins aligned to the orbital angular momentum and orbital eccentricity $\le 0.01$ when deployed on the 2-year-long LISA Data Challenge Yorsh. The search can be run within a day using $\approx 40$ GPUs. The techniques presented here have wider applications in GW astronomy, in particular the search for extreme-mass-ratio inspirals in LISA data.

classification.title_zh: LISA 中恒星质量双黑洞的全局时频搜索
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一套完整流程，用于在激光干涉空间天线（LISA）数据中探测和表征由恒星质量双黑洞旋近产生的引力波。分析框架基于一种高效时频实现的自适应半相干探测统计量；我们表明该统计量对非平稳噪声以及不同持续时间和采样节奏的数据缺口具有鲁棒性。在为期两年的 LISA Data Challenge Yorsh 数据上，对于自旋与轨道角动量对齐、轨道偏心率 ≤0.01 的双黑洞全参数空间，该搜索能够探测相干信噪比低至约 11–14 的信号。使用约 40 个 GPU，该搜索可在一天内完成。这里提出的技术还可广泛用于引力波天文学，特别是 LISA 数据中极端质量比旋近的搜索。
classification.one_liner: 为 LISA 中恒星质量双黑洞旋近提出全局时频半相干搜索流程，可在非平稳噪声与数据缺口下探测低信噪比信号。

papers.title: Gravitational and kinematic redshifts of black holes in nonlinear electrodynamics
papers.abstract: Spacetimes arising from nonlinear electrodynamics (NED) are a good laboratory for studying both the nature of regular black hole (RBH) solutions and the imprints of nonlinear electromagnetic fields within this context. Over the past few decades, NED-sourced black hole (BH) spacetimes have attracted considerable attention, but electrically charged RBHs obtained in the so-called $F$ framework have been less addressed in the literature. We consider two electrically charged, fully regular members of the h-family that are solutions to general relativity minimally coupled to NED. Because of their potential astrophysical and astronomical applications, we mainly focus our investigation on the motion of photons and its implications for the gravitational and kinematic redshifts, as well as for the shadow radius, considering the effective geometry followed by photons in NED. Moreover, we consider the observational data for Sagittarius A$^{\star}$ and Messier 87$^{\star}$ BHs to impose some constraints on the charge-to-mass ratio of the fully RBHs. We obtain the general equations that govern the gravitational and kinematic redshifts of NED-sourced BH spacetimes. In particular, for fully RBHs with BH charge-to-mass ratios above some moderate value, we observe discrepancies in their physical and geometrical properties compared to those of the Reissner--Nordstr\"om (RN) BH. Therefore, our results indicate that it is possible to distinguish NED-based RBH solutions from RN BHs, from the perspective of gravitational and kinematic redshifts, suggesting potential astrophysical relevance.

classification.title_zh: 非线性电动力学中黑洞的引力红移和运动学红移
classification.abstract_zh: 由非线性电动力学（NED）产生的时空是研究正则黑洞（RBH）解的性质以及非线性电磁场在此背景下印记的良好实验室。过去几十年中，NED 源黑洞（BH）时空引起了广泛关注，但在所谓的 F 框架下获得的带电 RBH 在文献中较少被讨论。我们考虑两个带电的、完全正则的 h 族成员，它们是广义相对论与 NED 最小耦合的解。由于它们潜在的天体物理和天文学应用，我们主要关注光子的运动及其对引力红移和运动学红移以及阴影半径的影响，同时考虑 NED 中光子遵循的有效几何。此外，我们考虑人马座 A* 和 M87* 黑洞的观测数据，以对完全 RBH 的荷质比施加一些约束。我们获得了支配 NED 源黑洞时空的引力红移和运动学红移的一般方程。特别地，对于荷质比高于某个中等值的完全 RBH，我们观察到其物理和几何性质与 Reissner–Nordström (RN) 黑洞存在差异。因此，我们的结果表明，从引力红移和运动学红移的角度，有可能区分基于 NED 的 RBH 解与 RN 黑洞，这暗示了潜在的天体物理相关性。
classification.one_liner: 研究非线性电动力学中带电正则黑洞的光子运动与红移，并利用观测数据约束荷质比，表明可与 RN 黑洞区分。

papers.title: Multi-messenger detectability of continuous gravitational waves from the near future to next generation detectors
papers.abstract: Continuous gravitational waves have the potential to transform gravitational wave astronomy and yield fresh insights into astrophysics, nuclear and particle physics, and condensed matter physics. We evaluate their detectability by combining various theoretical and observational arguments from the literature and systematically applying those arguments to known astronomical objects and future gravitational wave detectors. We detail and update previous estimates made in support of Cosmic Explorer [M. Evans et al., arXiv:2306.13745; I. Gupta et al., Class. Quantum Grav. 41, 245001 (2024)]. It is commonly argued that the spins of accreting neutron stars are regulated by gravitational wave emission and that millisecond pulsars contain a young pulsar's magnetic field buried under accreted material. If either of these arguments holds, the first detection of continuous gravitational waves is likely with near future upgrades of current detectors, and many detections are likely with next generation detectors such as Cosmic Explorer and the Einstein Telescope. A lack of detections in the next several years would begin to raise serious doubts about current theories of millisecond pulsar formation.

classification.title_zh: 从近期到下一代探测器连续引力波的多信使可探测性
classification.abstract_zh: 连续引力波有潜力改变引力波天文学，并为天体物理、核与粒子物理以及凝聚态物理带来新见解。我们通过结合文献中的各种理论与观测论据，并将这些论据系统地应用于已知天体和未来引力波探测器，评估其可探测性。我们详细说明并更新了此前为支持 Cosmic Explorer 所作的估计 [M. Evans et al., arXiv:2306.13745; I. Gupta et al., Class. Quantum Grav. 41, 245001 (2024)]。通常认为，吸积中子星的自转由引力波辐射调节，并且毫秒脉冲星在被吸积物质掩埋下保留着年轻脉冲星的磁场。如果其中任一论据成立，连续引力波的首次探测很可能通过当前探测器的近期升级实现，而下一代探测器（如 Cosmic Explorer 和 Einstein Telescope）则可能实现大量探测。未来几年内若仍无探测，将开始对当前毫秒脉冲星形成理论提出严重质疑。

papers.title: Effects of massive spin-2 fields on gravitational wave propagation
papers.abstract: Massive spin-2 fields in addition to the standard massless graviton arise naturally in extensions of general relativity, such as massive bigravity or models with extra dimensions. This work explores the observational signatures of these fields on the propagation of gravitational waves. Adopting a phenomenological framework consistent with such theories, we derive an analytical transfer function in the ultrarelativistic limit and establish detectability bounds for inspiral sources. Finally, we provide forecasts for the accessible parameter space using current and future gravitational wave detectors.

classification.title_zh: 大质量自旋-2场对引力波传播的影响
classification.abstract_zh: 在广义相对论的扩展中，例如大质量双引力或额外维度模型，除标准无质量引力子外，会自然出现大质量自旋-2场。本文探讨这些场对引力波传播的观测印记。我们采用与这类理论一致的现象学框架，在极端相对论极限下推导出解析转移函数，并为旋近源建立可探测性界限。最后，我们利用当前和未来引力波探测器给出可及参数空间的预言。
classification.one_liner: 研究大质量自旋-2场在极端相对论极限下对引力波传播的修正，并预测当前与未来引力波探测器的可及参数空间。

papers.title: Effect of noise characterization on the detection of mHz stochastic gravitational waves
papers.abstract: Pulsar timing arrays' hint for a stochastic gravitational-wave background (SGWB) leverages the expectations of a future detection in the millihertz band, particularly with the LISA space mission. However, finding an SGWB with a single orbiting detector is challenging: It calls for cautious modelling of instrumental noise, which is also mainly stochastic. It was shown that agnostic noise reconstruction methods provide robustness in the detection process. We build on previous work to include more realistic instrumental simulations and additional degrees of freedom in the noise inference model and analyze the impact of LISA's sensitivity to SGWBs. Particularly, we model the two main types of noise sources with separate transfer functions and power spectral density spline fitting. We assess the detectability bounds and their dependence on the flexibility of the noise model and on the prior probability, allowing us to refine previously reported results.

classification.title_zh: 噪声表征对毫赫兹随机引力波探测的影响
classification.abstract_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列对随机引力波背景（SGWB）的暗示，增强了对毫赫兹频段未来探测的预期，尤其是借助 LISA 空间任务。然而，用单个轨道探测器发现 SGWB 具有挑战性：这要求对仪器噪声进行谨慎建模，而仪器噪声也主要是随机的。已有研究表明，不可知论式噪声重构方法能在探测过程中提供稳健性。我们在先前工作基础上，纳入更真实的仪器模拟和噪声推断模型中更多自由度，并分析 LISA 对 SGWB 灵敏度的受影响情况。特别地，我们用独立的传递函数和功率谱密度样条拟合来建模两类主要噪声源。我们评估可探测性界限及其对噪声模型灵活性和先验概率的依赖，从而改进此前报道的结果。
classification.one_liner: 研究更真实的仪器模拟与噪声推断自由度如何影响 LISA 对毫赫兹随机引力波背景的可探测性。

papers.title: Ringing of rapidly rotating black holes in effective field theory
papers.abstract: Within the effective field theory approach to gravity, deviations from general relativity can be systematically described by higher-curvature operators. However, computing the resulting corrections to black hole quasinormal mode spectra remains challenging in the rapidly rotating regime, where perturbative expansions in the spin break down. We use recently constructed numerical rotating black hole solutions to compute quasinormal mode frequency corrections at leading order in the effective field theory. Focusing on scalar perturbations, we evaluate cubic-curvature corrections, which constitute the leading modifications. We employ a pseudo-spectral collocation method to solve the resulting perturbation equations on these backgrounds, enabling accurate computation across a broad parameter range. We obtain frequency corrections for fundamental modes with $l\le5$ for all $m$, and the first overtone of $2 \le l \le 5$ modes for all $m$ for spins up to $a=0.99M$, with relative errors below $10^{-4}$. We observe that corrections to certain modes grow significantly as the spin approaches the near-extremal regime.

classification.title_zh: 有效场论中快速旋转黑洞的振铃
classification.abstract_zh: 在引力的有效场论方法中，对广义相对论的偏离可由高阶曲率算符系统描述。然而，在快速旋转区域，计算由此产生的黑洞准正规模谱修正仍然困难，因为自旋微扰展开在此失效。我们使用近期构造的数值旋转黑洞解，计算有效场论领头阶的准正规模频率修正。聚焦标量扰动，我们评估三次曲率修正，它们构成领头修正。我们采用伪谱配置法在这些背景上求解所得扰动方程，从而在广泛参数范围内实现精确计算。我们得到 l≤5 的所有 m 基本模频率修正，以及 2≤l≤5 的所有 m 一阶泛音频率修正，自旋达到 a=0.99M，相对误差低于 10^{-4}。我们观察到某些模式的修正随着自旋接近近极端区域而显著增长。
classification.one_liner: 利用数值旋转黑洞背景和伪谱法计算高阶曲率有效场论对标量准正规模频率的领头修正，覆盖近极端自旋。

papers.title: A Master Equation for Screening in Luminal Horndeski Gravity
papers.abstract: Determining the active screening mechanism from a general scalar-tensor Lagrangian remains a challenging problem. As a diagnostic tool, we present a systematic study of nonlinear cosmological perturbations in luminal Horndeski theories. Working in the $\alpha$-basis on a flat FLRW background, we derive and organise the full set of unapproximated second-order perturbation equations and systematically apply the quasistatic and weak-field limits. We find that second-order effects modify only the scalar-field equation. We derive, for static and spherically symmetric configurations, a master screening equation that classifies the nonlinear operators driving screening, recovering the Vainshtein mechanism and the onset of chameleon screening. We also identify a novel candidate regime, which we term Phaedrus screening, characterised by a screening radius that scales linearly with the source mass. For each mechanism, we derive analytical and numerical solutions and clarify the conditions under which they activate. Two new publicly available software packages are introduced: (i) xAlpha, a Mathematica package to compute and organize perturbation equations in scalar-tensor theories, and (ii) escut, a python module to solve the nonlinear scalar equation. In many cases, these tools enable the identification of the active screening type directly from a luminal Horndeski Lagrangian.

classification.title_zh: 光速 Horndeski 引力中屏蔽的主方程
classification.abstract_zh: 从一般的标量-张量拉格朗日量确定活跃的屏蔽机制仍然是一个具有挑战性的问题。作为诊断工具，我们系统研究了光速 Horndeski 理论中的非线性宇宙学扰动。在平直 FLRW 背景上采用 α-基，我们推导并整理了完整的未近似二阶扰动方程，并系统地应用准静态和弱场极限。我们发现二阶效应只修正标量场方程。对于静态球对称位形，我们推导出一个主屏蔽方程，对驱动屏蔽的非线性算符进行分类，重现 Vainshtein 机制和 chameleon 屏蔽的开端。我们还识别出一个新的候选区域，称为 Phaedrus 屏蔽，其特征是屏蔽半径随源质量线性标度。对于每种机制，我们推导解析和数值解，并阐明其激活条件。引入两个新的公开软件包：(i) xAlpha，一个用于计算和整理标量-张量理论中扰动方程的 Mathematica 包；(ii) escut，一个用于求解非线性标量方程的 Python 模块。在许多情况下，这些工具能够直接从光速 Horndeski 拉格朗日量识别活跃的屏蔽类型。
classification.one_liner: 在光速 Horndeski 理论中推导静态球对称主屏蔽方程，统一分类 Vainshtein、chameleon 及新提出的 Phaedrus 屏蔽并发布配套计算工具。

papers.title: Validating Timing-Model Accuracy for Continuous Gravitational Waves: A Comparison of LALSuite and PINT
papers.abstract:
We present results of a systematic validation of the \lalsuite{} timing model for continuous gravitational waves against \pint{}, a modern high-accuracy pulsar-timing package. An accurate timing model is essential for tracking the signal phase, and hence for detecting and accurately characterizing continuous gravitational waves. In order to quantify the impact of timing inaccuracies, we derive and validate the leading-order relation $\mu \approx (2\pi f)^2\stddtau^2$, where $\mu$ is the fractional loss of signal power, $f$ is the signal frequency, and $\stddtau^2$ is the variance of the timing errors. We then compare the solar-system and binary components of the \lalsuite{} timing model against the corresponding models in \pint{}. With the original \lalsuite{} Einstein-delay implementation, the total disagreement is dominated by that component and has $\stddtau\simeq\SI{2.3}{\micro\second}$ (corresponding to $\mu\simeq\SI{0.02}{\percent}$ at $f=\SI{1000}{\hertz}$). With the newer Einstein-delay implementation, the total disagreement (over one year) drops to $\stddtau\lesssim\SI{31}{
ano\second}$ (or $\mu\lesssim
um{4e-8}$ at $f=\SI{1000}{\hertz}$) and is dominated by the observatory contribution to the \Romer{} delay, owing to the approximate Earth-rotation model used by \lalsuite{}. We additionally test binary delays using orbital parameters from 
um{474} catalogued binary pulsars and verify the self-consistency of the \lalsuite{} source-time derivatives. Finally, we derive and discuss the \lalsuite{} Shapiro delay for signals passing through the solar interior, a case only relevant to gravitational waves.

classification.title_zh: 验证连续引力波计时模型的精度：LALSuite 与 PINT 的比较
classification.abstract_zh: 我们报告了对连续引力波 LALSuite 计时模型进行系统性验证的结果，并以高精度现代脉冲星计时软件包 PINT 作为对照。精确的计时模型对于跟踪信号相位，从而探测并准确刻画连续引力波至关重要。为量化计时不准确性的影响，我们推导并验证了领头阶关系 μ ≈ (2π f)^2 stdτ^2，其中 μ 是信号功率的分数损失，f 是信号频率，stdτ^2 是计时误差的方差。随后，我们将 LALSuite 计时模型的太阳系分量和双星分量与 PINT 中对应模型进行比较。使用原始 LALSuite Einstein 延迟实现时，总不一致由该分量主导，stdτ ≈ 2.3 μs（在 f=1000 Hz 对应 μ≈0.02%）。使用较新的 Einstein 延迟实现后，总不一致（一年内）降至 stdτ ≲31 ns（在 f=1000 Hz 对应 μ≲4×10^-8），并由 Roemer 延迟中天文台贡献主导，这是由于 LALSuite 使用了近似地球自转模型。我们还使用来自 474 颗编目双星脉冲星的轨道参数测试双星延迟，并验证 LALSuite 源时导数的自洽性。最后，我们推导并讨论 LALSuite 对穿过太阳内部信号的 Shapiro 延迟，这种情况仅与引力波相关。
classification.one_liner: 系统比较 LALSuite 与 PINT 对连续引力波的计时模型，量化相位误差导致的功率损失，并评估太阳系与双星延迟项差异。

papers.title: Basic Data Processing of Gravitational Waves
papers.abstract: This paper provides a comprehensive guide to gravitational wave data processing, with a particular focus on signal generation, noise modeling, and optimization techniques. Beginning with an introduction to gravitational waves and the detection techniques used by LIGO and Virgo, the manual covers the essentials of signal processing, including Fourier analysis, filtering, and the generation of quadratic chirp signals. The analysis of colored Gaussian noise and its impact on interferometric detectors like LIGO is explored in detail, alongside signal detection methods such as the Generalized Likelihood Ratio Test (GLRT). The paper also delves into optimization techniques like Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), which can be applied to improve signal estimation accuracy. By providing MATLAB-based implementations, this manual serves as both a theoretical and practical resource for researchers in the field of gravitational wave astronomy.

classification.title_zh: 引力波基础数据处理
classification.abstract_zh: 本文提供了引力波数据处理的综合指南，特别关注信号生成、噪声建模和优化技术。首先介绍引力波以及 LIGO 和 Virgo 使用的探测技术，随后涵盖信号处理基础，包括傅里叶分析、滤波和二次啁啾信号的生成。文中详细探讨了有色高斯噪声及其对 LIGO 等干涉探测器的影响，以及广义似然比检验 (GLRT) 等信号检测方法。本文还深入研究了粒子群优化 (PSO) 等优化技术，这些技术可用于提高信号估计精度。通过提供基于 MATLAB 的实现，本手册为引力波天文学领域的研究人员提供了兼具理论和实践价值的资源。
classification.one_liner: 一本关于引力波数据处理的手册，涵盖信号生成、噪声建模与优化技术，并提供 MATLAB 实现。

papers.title: Constraining initial orbital eccentricity of inspiral-dominated gravitational-wave events with an analytic approximant
papers.abstract: The LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA consortium has sporadically detected inspiral-dominated gravitational-wave events such as GW170817 and GW190425. These events offer an opportunity to constrain possible initial (residual) orbital eccentricities using inspiral template families. We detail an LALSuite approximant, TaylorF2Ecck, which analytically models inspiral gravitational waves from nonspinning compact binaries in post-Newtonian (PN)-accurate eccentric orbits and restricts initial-eccentricity contributions to leading order. Specifically, our frequency-domain approximant consistently incorporates orbital, advance of periastron, and gravitational-wave emission effects up to 3PN order. We conduct parameter-estimation studies of GW170817 and GW190425 using TaylorF2Ecck, following comprehensive sanity checks to validate model performance and investigate the influence of eccentricity and periastron advance in the relevant parameter space. The results indicate that the initial eccentricity at 20 Hz is negligible within the 90 percent credible intervals (less than 0.016 for GW170817 and less than 0.023 for GW190425, with both posterior distributions railing toward zero), and Bayes factors show no strong evidence favoring the eccentric waveform over the quasicircular waveform. At such negligible initial eccentricities, comparisons between eccentric models with and without periastron advance show no clear signature of this effect, with no significant model-dependent shifts in the posterior distributions and no strong Bayes-factor evidence favoring one model over the other. Additionally, these detailed studies reveal the importance of incorporating initial-eccentricity contributions at least up to 3.5PN order and discuss its implications. We substantiate this inference using versions of the quasicircular TaylorF2 approximant that incorporate Fourier phase contributions beyond the conventional 3.5PN order.

classification.title_zh: 用解析近似模型限制旋进主导引力波事件的初始轨道偏心率
classification.abstract_zh: LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA合作组已零星探测到GW170817和GW190425等旋进主导的引力波事件。这些事件提供了利用旋进模板族限制可能初始（残余）轨道偏心率的机会。我们详细介绍一个LALSuite近似模型TaylorF2Ecck，它在后牛顿（PN）精度下解析建模非自旋致密双星在偏心轨道上的旋进引力波，并将初始偏心率贡献限制在领头阶。具体而言，我们的频率域近似模型一致地纳入至3PN阶的轨道、近星点进动和引力波辐射效应。我们在进行全面合理性检验以验证模型性能并研究相关参数空间中偏心率与近星点进动影响后，使用TaylorF2Ecck对GW170817和GW190425进行参数估计研究。结果表明，在90%可信区间内，20 Hz处的初始偏心率可忽略（GW170817小于0.016，GW190425小于0.023，两个后验分布均趋向零），贝叶斯因子没有显示出强证据支持偏心波形优于准圆波形。在如此可忽略的初始偏心率下，包含与不包含近星点进动的偏心模型比较未显示该效应的清晰特征，后验分布没有显著依赖模型的移动，也没有强贝叶斯因子证据支持一个模型优于另一个。此外，这些详细研究揭示了至少纳入至3.5PN阶初始偏心率贡献的重要性，并讨论了其意义。我们使用包含超出传统3.5PN阶傅里叶相位贡献的准圆TaylorF2近似模型版本来证实这一推断。
classification.one_liner: 构建TaylorF2Ecck解析近似并用于GW170817/GW190425参数估计，发现初始偏心率在90%可信区间内可忽略。

papers.title: Accretion, Jets, and Recoil in a Merging Supermassive Black Hole Binary: A Prompt Electromagnetic Postmerger Counterpart for LISA
papers.abstract: We report the first three-dimensional general relativistic magnetohydrodynamic simulation to follow, self-consistently in a dynamical spacetime, the magnetized gas around a misaligned-spin supermassive binary black hole, from late inspiral through merger to the gravitational-wave recoil of the remnant. The equal-mass binary, in a $\textit{hang-up kick}$ configuration, is embedded in an equilibrated circumbinary disk (CBD), relaxed for 165 binary orbits before we evolve the final $\sim\!40$ orbits. During the inspiral, each black hole hosts a strongly warped minidisk whose jet follows the local spin axis near the horizon before aligning with the binary's angular momentum farther out. The merger imparts a recoil of $\simeq\!1032$ $km\,s$$^{-1}$ to the remnant, which nonetheless retains its gravitationally bound CBD, and the relaunched jet preserves its pre-merger orientation. The bolometric luminosity brightens by a factor $\sim\!2.2$, powered by merger-driven shocks concentrated within $r \lesssim 15\,M$, and the enhancement persists through the recoil. We identify a distinctive postmerger electromagnetic signature: magnetized structures, generated at coalescence, drive correlated quasi-periodic modulations of the horizon magnetic flux, the Poynting flux, and the thermal output, decoupled from the accretion rate. The postmerger radiative efficiency $L_{\rm EM}/\dot{M}c^2$ rises by a factor $\simeq 2.6$ at nearly constant accretion rate, showing that this emission is powered by the merger rather than accretion. The transient turns on within minutes and lasts at least several hours for a $10^6 \ M_{\odot}$ LISA source, establishing recoiling remnants as prompt postmerger counterparts to massive black hole mergers and a first-principles framework for interpreting candidates such as 3C186.

classification.title_zh: 合并超大质量双黑洞中的吸积、喷流与反冲：LISA 的瞬发电磁并合后对应体
classification.abstract_zh: 我们报告了首个三维广义相对论磁流体动力学模拟，该模拟在动态时空中自洽地追踪了一个自旋错位超大质量双黑洞周围的磁化气体，从晚期旋近经过并合到引力波反冲遗迹的过程。等质量双黑洞处于“悬挂踢出”构型，嵌入在已弛豫的环双星盘中，在演化最后约40个轨道之前已弛豫了165个双星轨道。在旋近期间，每个黑洞都拥有一个强烈扭曲的迷你盘，其喷流在视界附近沿局部自旋轴方向，随后在更远处与双星角动量方向对齐。并合使遗迹获得约1032 km/s的反冲速度，但遗迹仍保留其引力束缚的环双星盘，且重新发射的喷流保持并合前的取向。热光度增亮约2.2倍，由集中在r ≲ 15M范围内的并合驱动激波提供能量，且这种增强在反冲过程中持续存在。我们识别出一个独特的并合后电磁特征：在并合时产生的磁化结构驱动视界磁通量、坡印廷通量和热输出的相关准周期调制，且与吸积率解耦。并合后辐射效率L_EM/Ṁc²在吸积率几乎不变的情况下上升约2.6倍，表明这一辐射由并合而非吸积提供能量。对于10^6倍太阳质量的LISA源，该瞬变现象在几分钟内开启并至少持续数小时，确立了反冲遗迹作为大质量黑洞并合的瞬发并合后对应体，并为解释如3C186这类候选体提供了第一性原理框架。
classification.one_liner: 首次三维广义相对论磁流体模拟显示超大质量双黑洞并合反冲后喷流保持方向，产生由并合而非吸积驱动的瞬发准周期电磁对应体。

papers.title: Axial Quasi-normal Modes of Boson-Fermion Stars
papers.abstract: We study axial quasi-normal modes of boson-fermion stars composed of ordinary nuclear matter and a self-interacting bosonic dark matter component. The equilibrium configurations are obtained by solving the coupled two-fluid Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff equations, where the neutron sector is modeled with several realistic equations of state and the bosonic sector is described by a repulsively self-interacting complex scalar field in the strong-coupling regime. We analyze linear axial perturbations governed by a Regge-Wheeler type equation whose effective potential reflects the combined matter distribution. Using a continued-fraction method, we compute the complex eigenfrequencies of the fundamental and overtone $w$ modes. We obtain the quasi-normal mode spectrum and investigate its dependence on the dark matter particle mass, self-coupling, and the central densities of both fluids for several realistic neutron star equations of state. We find that increasing the dark matter fraction shifts the oscillation frequencies and damping times. It can also reorder the mode hierarchy through crossings, and it drives a continuous transition from neutron star-like to boson star-like ringdown behavior. Our results demonstrate that the ringdown gravitational-wave signal from post-merger compact objects could encode clear imprints of a dark matter component, offering a new probe of the dark sector with future gravitational-wave observatories.

classification.title_zh: 玻色-费米星的轴向准正规模
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究由普通核物质和自相互作用玻色暗物质成分构成的玻色-费米星的轴向准正规模。平衡位形通过求解耦合的双流体 Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff 方程获得，其中中子部分使用若干现实状态方程建模，玻色部分由强耦合区域中具有排斥自相互作用的复标量场描述。我们分析由 Regge-Wheeler 型方程支配的线性轴向微扰，其有效势反映组合物质分布。使用连分式方法，我们计算基频和泛音 w 模的复本征频率。我们得到准正规模谱，并针对若干现实中子星状态方程研究其对暗物质粒子质量、自耦合以及两种流体中心密度的依赖。我们发现，增加暗物质占比会移动振荡频率和阻尼时间。它还可以通过交叉重新排列模式层级，并驱动从中子星型到玻色星型铃宕行为的连续转变。我们的结果表明，后并合致密天体的铃宕引力波信号可以编码暗物质成分的清晰印记，为未来引力波天文台探测暗部门提供新探针。
classification.one_liner: 通过双流体TOV与Regge-Wheeler扰动计算玻色-费米星轴向准正规模，显示暗物质占比改变铃宕频率、阻尼及模式层级。
