papers.title: AdS/CFT, Ultralimits and Baby universes
papers.abstract: We propose boundary theories, CFT$_{p}$ with $p\in \beta\mathbb{N}/\mathbb{N}$, which can be interpreted as an ensemble of theories in the context of AdS/CFT duality, when the boundary spacetime dimension is more than one. These theories are only emergent in the infinite $N$ limit of the boundary CFT and depend on $p$, which corresponds to the different ways one can take a generalized form of the infinite $N$ limit, in the presence of a chaotic or an oscillatory operator. This generalized infinite $N$ limit is called an \emph{ultralimit}, and $p$ is a \emph{free ultrafilter} on $\mathbb{N}$. We propose that the gravitational path integral computes an average of CFT$_{p}$ in each of its sectors; and in the appropriate cases, it produces baby universes and spacetime wormholes. We apply this proposal to the Antonini-Sasieta-Swingle (AS$^{2}$) like states.

classification.title_zh: AdS/CFT、超极限与婴儿宇宙
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出边界理论 CFT_p（其中 p ∈ βN/N），在边界时空维数大于一时，这些理论可被解释为 AdS/CFT 对偶语境下的理论系综。这些理论仅在边界 CFT 的无限 N 极限中涌现，并依赖于 p；p 对应于在存在混沌或振荡算子时，取广义无限 N 极限的不同方式。这种广义无限 N 极限被称为“超极限”（ultralimit），而 p 是自然数集上的自由超滤子（free ultrafilter）。我们提出引力路径积分在其每个扇区中计算 CFT_p 的平均值；在适当情况下，它会产生婴儿宇宙和时空虫洞。我们将此提议应用于 Antonini-Sasieta-Swingle (AS^2) 类态。
classification.one_liner: 论文提出一种通过超极限构造的边界理论系综，解释 AdS/CFT 中的婴儿宇宙和时空虫洞。

papers.title: Tidal effects on radiation in gravitational shockwave collisions
papers.abstract: We compute high frequency gravitational wave radiation in shockwave collisions of a light mass compact object with energy $\mu_L$ off a heavy compact object (black hole) with energy $\mu_H \gg \mu_L$. A formal solution is obtained in terms of shockwave propagators that provide snapshots of $O(\mu_L\mu_H^n)$ tidal response functions sensitive to classical and potentially semi-classical dynamics of black hole formation. In a perturbative expansion, the first nontrivial contribution of $O(\mu_L\mu_H)$ is the emission of a graviton from the Lipatov vertex generated by the fusion of two reggeized gravitons. For graviton frequencies $\omega\rightarrow 0$, the Lipatov amplitude reduces to the ultrarelativistic limit of the single-graviton exchange Weinberg amplitude. At $O(\mu_L\mu_H^2)$, the Lipatov amplitude includes a piece accounting for the rescattering of the graviton off a reggeized graviton and another, corresponding to graviton emission from a vertex fusing three reggeized gravitons. These nontrivial contributions again simplify to the Weinberg radiative amplitude for two-graviton exchange in the soft limit. We highlight throughout double copy structures to gluon radiation in dilute-dense collisions of Yang-Mills shockwaves. We relate our shockwave results to the eikonal multiple scattering framework of Veneziano et al.

classification.title_zh: 引力冲击波碰撞中辐射的潮汐效应
classification.abstract_zh: 我们计算了轻质紧凑天体（能量 μ_L）与重紧凑天体（黑洞）（能量 μ_H ≫ μ_L）冲击波碰撞中的高频引力波辐射。我们通过冲击波传播子获得了形式解，这些传播子提供了对 O(μ_L μ_H^n) 潮汐响应函数的快照，这些函数对黑洞形成的经典和潜在的半经典动力学敏感。在微扰展开中，O(μ_L μ_H) 的首个非平凡贡献是来自两个 Regge 引力子融合产生的 Lipatov 顶点的引力子发射。对于引力子频率 ω→0，Lipatov 振幅还原为单引力子交换 Weinberg 振幅的超相对论极限。在 O(μ_L μ_H^2) 阶，Lipatov 振幅包含一项解释引力子被 Regge 引力子再散射的部分，以及另一项对应从融合三个 Regge 引力子的顶点发射引力子的部分。这些非平凡贡献在软极限下同样简化为双引力子交换的 Weinberg 辐射振幅。我们在整篇文章中强调与 Yang-Mills 冲击波的稀密碰撞中胶子辐射的双复制结构。我们将冲击波结果与 Veneziano 等人的 eikonal 多重散射框架联系起来。
classification.one_liner: 该论文通过冲击波传播子和 Regge 方法计算了致密天体碰撞中的高频引力波辐射，揭示了在软极限下与 Weinberg 振幅的联系，并强调了双复制结构。

papers.title: The Late-time Ramp of the Double-Scaled SYK Model from the large-$n$ tail of Cactus Diagram
papers.abstract: We derive the late-time ramp of the finite-temperature spectral form factor in the double-scaled SYK model directly from cactus diagrams, which is introduced as a multi-trace generalization of chord diagram in Ref \cite{Berkooz:2020fvm}. Although single-trace observables admit an exact chord-diagram description, multi-trace sums are obstructed by the chord-intersection weights $q_{IJ}$, which cannot be averaged independently to $q$. Our key idea is that the non-analytic contribution responsible for the ramp is controlled by the large-order tail of the Cactus-diagram expansion and is insensitive to finite changes in its low-order analytic terms. Decomposing the contribution with $n$-cross-trace-pairings Cactus diagram into two buds $B_n$ and a kernel $\mathcal K_n$, we determine their large-$n$ asymptotics with fixed $0\leq q<1$ and resum the resulting tail. For $\beta_L=\beta+it$ and $\beta_R=\beta-it$, we obtain \begin{equation*} Z_s^{\mathrm{sing}}(\beta+it,\beta-it) =s_p c_N \frac{|t|}{2\pi} \int_{E_{min}}^{E_{max}} e^{-2\beta E} dE+O(1), \qquad s_p=\begin{cases}2,&4\mid p,\\1,&4\nmid p.\end{cases} \end{equation*} This result reproduces the linear ramp predicted by random matrix theory, including its temperature dependence and symmetry factor, and agrees with the semiclassical predictions. It provides a direct microscopic origin of the ramp within the general $q$-deformed quantum algebra. While the plateau lies beyond the scope of the present analysis and calculation.

classification.title_zh: 双标度SYK模型的晚期斜坡：来自仙人掌图的大n尾部
classification.abstract_zh: 我们直接从仙人掌图推导了双标度SYK模型中有限温度谱形式因子的晚期斜坡，仙人掌图是Ref \cite{Berkooz:2020fvm}中引入的弦图的多迹推广。尽管单迹可观测量允许精确的弦图描述，多迹求和受到弦交点权重$q_{IJ}$的阻碍，这些权重不能独立平均为$q$。我们的关键思想是，负责斜坡的非解析贡献由仙人掌图展开的大阶尾部控制，并且对其低阶解析项的有限变化不敏感。将具有$n$个交叉迹配对的仙人掌图的贡献分解为两个芽$B_n$和一个核$\mathcal K_n$，我们确定了它们在固定$0\leq q<1$下的大$n$渐近行为，并重求和得到的尾部。对于$\beta_L=\beta+it$和$\beta_R=\beta-it$，我们得到\begin{equation*} Z_s^{\mathrm{sing}}(\beta+it,\beta-it) =s_p c_N \frac{|t|}{2\pi} \int_{E_{min}}^{E_{max}} e^{-2\beta E} dE+O(1), \qquad s_p=\begin{cases}2,&4\mid p,\\1,&4\nmid p.\end{cases} \end{equation*} 这个结果重现了随机矩阵理论预测的线性斜坡，包括其温度依赖性和对称因子，并与半经典预测一致。它为一般$q$变形量子代数中的斜坡提供了直接的微观起源。而平台（plateau）超出了当前分析和计算的范围。
classification.one_liner: 该论文通过解析仙人掌图的大阶尾部，直接推导出双标度SYK模型谱形式因子的晚期线性斜坡，重现随机矩阵理论结果。

papers.title: Universal and Transcendental Structures in Protected ABJM Two-Point Functions
papers.abstract: We consider two-loop corrections to two-point functions of protected scalar operators in ABJM theory. We infer a compact finite-rank formula valid for operators of arbitrary dimension and multi-trace structure. The result is governed by the exact tree-level metric and a simple kernel on the Young lattice, while the planar limit reduces to a simple partition-theoretic rule. The required integrals organize into uniformly transcendental combinations, providing evidence for uniform transcendentality of these protected two-point functions.

classification.title_zh: 受保护 ABJM 两点函数中的普适与超越结构
classification.abstract_zh: 我们考虑了 ABJM 理论中受保护标量算符两点函数的双圈修正。我们推断出一个适用于任意维数和多重迹结构的紧致有限秩公式。该结果由精确树级度量和杨格上的简单核主导，而平面极限约化为简单的分拆理论规则。所需积分组织成均匀超越组合，为这些受保护两点函数的均匀超越性提供了证据。
classification.one_liner: 本文推导了 ABJM 理论中受保护标量算符两点函数的双圈修正，发现其具有普适的有限秩结构和均匀超越性。

papers.title: Self-Dual Yang-Mills in AdS$_4$
papers.abstract: Quantum Yang-Mills theory in Euclidean AdS$_4$ with Neumann boundary conditions is studied as a function of the complex couplings $\frac{1}{g_\pm^2} \equiv \frac{1}{g^2}\mp \frac{i \theta }{8 \pi^2}$. We define a "self-dual limit" by $g_- \to 0$ with $g_+ ~{\rm fixed}$. We argue that the limiting theory is well-defined perturbatively and equivalent to the BF formulation of self-dual Yang-Mills theory with a particular boundary condition relating $B$ and $F$ at the boundary $\partial$AdS$_4$. $g_+$ is the loop-counting parameter of the self-dual theory. This is in stark contrast to flat space, where $\theta$ has no effect on perturbative dynamics. In the self-dual limit, it is shown that all tree-level zero-plus and single-plus boundary correlators vanish. A closed form expression is given for any number of gluons for the double-plus tree correlators. Finally, we show that in the flat space limit of AdS$_4$, the total energy poles in the tree boundary correlators correctly reduce to the single-minus gluon amplitudes.

classification.title_zh: AdS4 中的自对偶杨-米尔斯理论
classification.abstract_zh: 研究了欧几里得 AdS4 中具有 Neumann 边界条件的量子杨-米尔斯理论，作为复耦合 1/g_±^2 = 1/g^2 ∓ iθ/(8π^2) 的函数。定义自对偶极限为 g_- → 0 而 g_+ 固定。论证该极限理论在微扰下定义良好，等价于自对偶杨-米尔斯理论的 BF 表述，具有在边界 ∂AdS4 联系 B 和 F 的特定边界条件。g_+ 是自对偶理论的圈计数参数。这与平直空间形成鲜明对比，在平直空间中 θ 对微扰动力学没有影响。在自对偶极限下，证明了所有树级零正和单正边界关联函数为零。对于任意数量胶子的双正树级关联函数给出了闭合表达式。最后，展示在 AdS4 的平直空间极限下，树级边界关联函数中的总能量极点正确约化为单负胶子振幅。
classification.one_liner: 在 AdS4 中定义杨-米尔斯理论的自对偶极限，证明边界树级关联函数的特殊零点并给出双正胶子闭式表达。

papers.title: Superconformal index of large N and long quivers
papers.abstract: We develop a universal framework for computing generating functions in quiver gauge theories in the large $N$ limit. We apply this method to the superconformal index of 4d $\mathcal{N}=2$ gauge theories, as well as to the 0-instanton index of 5d $\mathcal{N}=1$ theories, both for finite quivers of arbitrary shape and in the long quiver limit, including both special unitary and orthosymplectic gauge groups, demonstrating its versatility. In the Hall--Littlewood limit, we show that the series expansion of the resulting index captures the expected Higgs branch chiral ring generators. Our exact expressions in the long quiver limit provide new predictions for the supergravity index of the holographically dual warped AdS$_5$ and AdS$_6$ backgrounds.

classification.title_zh: 大N与长quiver的超共形指标
classification.abstract_zh: 我们开发了一个通用框架，用于计算大N极限下quiver规范理论中的生成函数。我们将此方法应用于4维N=2规范理论的超共形指标，以及5维N=1理论的0-瞬子指标，包括任意形状的有限quiver和长quiver极限，覆盖特殊酉群和正交辛群规范群，展示了其通用性。在Hall-Littlewood极限下，我们表明指标级数展开能够捕获预期的Higgs支环生成元。我们在长quiver极限下的精确表达式为全息对偶的warped AdS5和AdS6背景的超引力指标提供了新的预言。
classification.one_liner: 开发了大N极限下quiver规范理论超共形指标的通用计算框架，并给出长quiver极限的新全息预言。

papers.title: Holographic Ensembles in Type IIB
papers.abstract: We study holographic ensembles in type IIB string theory on the Schur twisted AdS$_5 \times S^5$ background, and its corresponding boundary partition function: the Schur index of $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM. In the supergravity limit the two natural ensembles are either at fixed flux on $S^5$, corresponding to a boundary theory at fixed rank, or its conjugate choice of fixed potential on the boundary of AdS$_5$, corresponding on the boundary to a grand canonical ensemble of theories at fixed chemical potential. Due to the self-dual nature of the five-form in type IIB supergravity the choice of ensembles is not seen in the standard bulk action, but rather by the coupling of an additional topological term. We compute the bulk partition function to one loop, including the Kaluza-Klein determinant and the measure of the ensemble-changing sum, and show that depending on the sign of this topological term it matches the perturbative boundary partition function in either the canonical or the grand canonical ensemble.

classification.title_zh: IIB型中的全息系综
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了型IIB弦理论在Schur扭曲的AdS5×S5背景上的全息系综，以及其对应的边界配分函数：N=4 SYM的Schur指标。在超引力极限下，两种自然系综要么是S^5上的固定通量（对应固定秩的边界理论），要么是AdS5边界上固定势的共轭选择（对应边界上固定化学势的巨正则系综）。由于型IIB超引力中五形式场的自对偶性质，系综的选择在标准体作用量中不可见，而是通过一个附加拓扑项的耦合体现。我们计算了体配分函数至一圈，包括Kaluza-Klein行列式和改变系综求和的测度，并表明取决于该拓扑项的符号，它可以匹配微扰边界配分函数在正则或巨正则系综中的结果。
classification.one_liner: 通过拓扑项在一圈水平匹配AdS5×S5背景上全息系综的正则与巨正则边界配分函数。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究全息系综与Schur指标，与用户重点标签（全息超流、QNM、经典引力等）无直接关联。

papers.title: Stress-Testing Swampland Bounds with Class S Theories
papers.abstract: We test the Sharpened Distance Conjecture (SharpDC) for CFTs, as well as the Refined Distance Conjecture (RDC), in AdS$_5$ gravitational spacetimes, using the CFT dual. The former provides a lower bound on the exponential mass decay rate of the tower of states becoming light at infinite distance in the conformal manifold, while the latter bounds the bulk field range that can be traversed before the exponential behaviour of the tower kicks in. We prove the SharpDC for any large $N$ Lagrangian supersymmetric gauge theory with a finite number $M$ of gauge factors and vanishing one-loop $\beta$-function. We also investigate whether it universally holds in the limits of large central charge, finding that it does not: We exhibit concrete examples in Class S theories where the conjecture is violated in the $M\rightarrow\infty$ limit with $N$ fixed, where the size of the bulk internal geometry is much larger than the AdS curvature scale. We also test the RDC in the moduli space of Class S theories without punctures in the large $N$ limit, showing that it amounts to a precise upper bound on the Weil-Petersson diameter of the moduli space of Riemann surfaces of genus $g$. This bound is consistent with all the mathematical literature up to date, but so far remains unproven.

classification.title_zh: 用 Class S 理论压力测试 Swampland 界限
classification.abstract_zh: 我们使用 CFT 对偶在 AdS5 引力时空中检验了 CFT 的 Sharpened 距离猜想（SharpDC）和精炼距离猜想（RDC）。前者给出了在共形流形无穷远处变轻的态塔指数质量衰减率的下界，后者限制了在塔的指数行为开始前可穿越的体场范围。我们证明了对于任意具有有限个 M 个规范因子且单圈 beta 函数为零的大 N 拉格朗日超对称规范理论，SharpDC 成立。我们还研究了它在大中心荷极限下是否普遍成立，发现并非如此：在 Class S 理论中，M→∞ 且 N 固定时，体内部几何尺度远大于 AdS 曲率尺度，SharpDC 被违反。我们还在大 N 极限下检验了无 punctures 的 Class S 理论模空间中的 RDC，表明它等价于亏格 g 黎曼曲面模空间 Weil-Petersson 直径的一个精确上界，该上界与已知数学结果一致但尚未证明。
classification.one_liner: 利用 Class S 理论在 AdS/CFT 下检验 Swampland 距离猜想：证明有限规范因子情况，发现大中心荷极限反例，并将 RDC 联系到模空间 Weil-Petersson 直径。
classification.relevance_reason: 该论文属于 Swampland 量子引力与 AdS/CFT 模空间问题，虽使用全息对偶，但与给定重点标签（全息超流超导、畴壁/涡旋/非均匀、相变/气泡、QNM、冷原子、探针膜、经典引力等）无明显交集。

papers.title: Positivity constraints on the dynamics of cusped impurities in CFTs
papers.abstract: The cusp anomalous dimension is the universal logarithmic contribution to the free energy of a line defect with a cusp, and provides a useful observable characterizing defect dynamics. We generalize this notion to cusped line defects in the presence of a planar conformal boundary or interface. The geometry is characterized by three angles, and the distance of the cusp from the boundary or interface which separates short-distance and long-distance regimes. The resulting free energy contains two large logarithmic terms: a short-distance contribution governed by the usual vacuum cusp anomalous dimension, and a new long-distance contribution sensitive to the boundary or interface. Using reflection positivity for transverse deformations of the defect rays, we derive several constraints on the coefficients of these logarithmic terms, which can be packaged into negative semi-definiteness of their angular Hessians. We also derive constraints on the continuation of these coefficients to Lorentzian kinematics. We compute these coefficients and verify the constraints explicitly in free scalar and Maxwell theories and in planar $\mathcal N=4$ super-Yang-Mills theory at weak coupling for various choices of boundary conditions. At strong coupling, we compute the logarithmic coefficients in the holographic D3-D5 defect CFT and find a Gross-Ooguri-like phase transition between competing string worldsheets driven by the geometry of the cusp relative to the interface. We also observe a close connection of the cusp free energy in this setup with holographic corner entanglement entropy.

secondary_topics: 非均匀态/孤子/涡旋/畴壁
classification.title_zh: CFT 中尖点杂质动力学的正定性约束
classification.abstract_zh: 尖点反常量纲是带尖点线缺陷自由能中普适的对数贡献，是刻画缺陷动力学的重要可观测量。我们将该概念推广到存在平面共形边界或界面时的尖点线缺陷。该几何由三个角度以及尖点到边界/界面的距离刻画，该距离区分短程和长程区域。所得自由能包含两个大的对数项：由通常真空尖点反常量纲主导的短程贡献，以及对边界/界面敏感的新长程贡献。利用缺陷射线横向形变的反射正定性，我们导出这些对数项系数的若干约束，这些约束可归结为它们角 Hessian 的半负定性。我们还导出这些系数延拓到洛伦兹运动学时的约束。我们在自由标量场、麦克斯韦理论以及弱耦合平面 N=4 超杨-米尔斯理论中，针对各种边界条件计算了这些系数并验证了约束。在强耦合下，我们在全息 D3-D5 缺陷 CFT 中计算了对数系数，并发现由尖点相对于界面的几何驱动的竞争弦世界面之间存在类 Gross-Ooguri 相变。我们还观察到该装置中尖点自由能与全息角纠缠熵之间的密切联系。
classification.one_liner: 将尖点反常量纲推广到含边界/界面的缺陷 CFT，用反射正定性给出新约束，并在全息 D3-D5 缺陷 CFT 中发现类 Gross-Ooguri 相变。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究全息 D3-D5 缺陷 CFT 中的尖点反常量纲与 Gross-Ooguri 相变，直接匹配 D3-D7/D3-D5 探针膜支线。

papers.title: Dynamical friction on black holes in scalar field environment
papers.abstract: Astrophysical black holes exist within non-vacuum environments, and their motion through these environments generically result in a force on these black holes through processes such as dynamical friction and Bondi accretion. We explore these forces numerically for black holes moving through a complex scalar field of mass $m$ with constant acceleration $a$, while also revisiting the constant velocity case considered in the existing literature. The former is modeled by the C-metric, while we use Painlev\'e-Gullstrand metric with an additional divergence and vorticity free velocity field to mimic the constant velocity motion. Our simulations reveal several novel and interesting aspects of the drag force in both cases. For the constant velocity case, the force saturates at late times, with a value that depends on velocity in a manner distinct from known dependence. For the constant acceleration case, the force increases to a maximum value $F_\star$ and then reduces drastically, with $F_\star \approx 0.3~ m a$. Moreover, the density wake in this case shows revivals separated by decreasing time intervals.

classification.title_zh: 标量场环境中黑洞的动力学摩擦
classification.abstract_zh: 天体物理黑洞存在于非真空环境中，它们在这些环境中的运动会通过动力学摩擦和Bondi吸积等过程在这些黑洞上产生力。我们数值研究了质量m的复标量场中以恒定加速度a运动的黑洞所受的这些力，同时也重新审视了文献中已有的恒定速度情形。前者用C-度量建模，而后者我们使用带有附加无散无旋速度场的Painlevé-Gullstrand度量来模拟恒定速度运动。我们的模拟揭示了两种情形下阻力力的若干新颖有趣的方面。对于恒定速度情形，阻力在后期饱和，其值对速度的依赖与已知依赖不同。对于恒定加速度情形，阻力增加到最大值F⋆然后急剧减小，其中F⋆≈0.3 m a。此外，该情形下的密度尾迹显示出以递减时间间隔分隔的复兴。
classification.one_liner: 数值研究黑洞在标量场环境中的动力学摩擦，涵盖恒定速度和恒定加速度情形，发现阻力力的新行为。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究经典引力框架下黑洞与标量场环境的相互作用，属于广义相对论和经典引力领域。

papers.title: Guide for the Hubble Tension: Mid-Time Solutions and Generalized PAge Parameterizations
papers.abstract: In cosmology, the Hubble tension has become one of the most serious challenges in the last decade. Assuming that all the observational data are right, one of the ways out is to modify the standard $\Lambda$CDM cosmology. In the literature, the theoretical modifications are mainly made in the early and the late/local universes. But on both sides, some no-go arguments have been proposed recently. In particular, the general no-go arguments for the late-time modifications are mainly based on the PAge parameterization. In the present work, we note that there are some flaws in the (original) PAge parameterization, and then propose various generalized PAge (GPAge) parameterizations, which can be extended to $z>z_{\rm CMB}$ and hence the cosmic microwave background (CMB) can be taken into account, while they are also more accurate at low redshifts. With these GPAge parameterizations, we revisit the Hubble tension by using not only the late-time observations but also the observational data of CMB. We find that the Hubble tension could be alleviated (or even resolved) in GPAges significantly different from the standard $\Lambda$CDM cosmology, while they are overwhelmingly preferred over $\Lambda$CDM by the observational data in terms of all the information criteria. Surprisingly, we find that the new physics in the mid-time might be the key to resolve the Hubble tension.

classification.title_zh: 哈勃张力指南：中期解与广义PAge参数化
classification.abstract_zh: 在宇宙学中，哈勃张力已成为过去十年最严峻的挑战之一。假设所有观测数据都是正确的，一条出路是修改标准ΛCDM宇宙学模型。文献中的理论修改主要针对早期和晚期/局域宇宙。但最近在两边都提出了一些不可行论证。特别是，针对晚期修改的一般不可行论证主要基于PAge参数化。在本文中，我们注意到（原始）PAge参数化存在一些缺陷，因此提出多种广义PAge（GPAge）参数化，它们可以扩展到z>z_CMB，从而能够纳入宇宙微波背景（CMB）数据，同时在低红移处也更为精确。利用这些GPAge参数化，我们不仅使用晚期观测数据，还使用CMB观测数据重新审视哈勃张力。我们发现，在显著偏离标准ΛCDM的GPAge模型中，哈勃张力可以得到缓解（甚至解决），并且按照所有信息判据，观测数据对这些模型的支持远超ΛCDM。令人惊讶的是，我们发现中期的新物理可能是解决哈勃张力的关键。
classification.one_liner: 提出广义PAge参数化并利用CMB与晚期数据重新审视哈勃张力，发现中期新物理可能缓解甚至解决哈勃张力。
classification.relevance_reason: 文章属于宇宙学参数化研究，与用户重点关注的全息、凝聚态、量子信息等支线无直接重合；虽涉及广义相对论宇宙学，但与经典引力现象（黑洞、引力波等）相关度有限。

papers.title: Explicit gauge-invariant variables in multifield inflation beyond linear order and Hamiltonian dynamics
papers.abstract: General relativity coupled to multiple scalar fields is a diffeomorphism-invariant constrained system. Consequently, a naive counting of the perturbative degrees of freedom unavoidably overestimates the true number of physical modes propagating in the theory, as gauge redundancies and constraint equations remove non-dynamical ones. While this problem has been solved for linear fluctuations, this work presents the first explicit calculation of all large-scale gauge-invariant phase-space variables in multifield inflation and at second order in perturbation theory, in a Hamiltonian language. Building upon the well-known Sasaki-Mukhanov variables, we show how to construct a finite-dimensional basis of quadratic corrections which are invariant under gauge transformations. Although our procedure is generic to any number of fields and at any scale, we restrict to super-Hubble scales for their explicit solution, which we deliver. Henceforth, we prove that it is possible to recover the usual flat-gauge and comoving-gauge fluctuations as large-scale gauge-invariant combinations, making for a robust consistency check of the gauge-fixed procedure to connect theoretical predictions above the horizon to observations. We derive the quadratic and cubic Hamiltonian of multifield inflation in a gauge independent manner, then we gauge fix our theory by going into the flat gauge, and we show perfect agreement with the literature on this topic, usually based on a Lagrangian approach. After these concrete steps, we propose a more formal proof of the existence of gauge-invariant variables at quadratic order, and we provide a sketch of the procedure that should allow to go to higher orders in perturbation theory.

classification.title_zh: 多场暴胀中超越线性阶的显式规范不变变量与哈密顿动力学
classification.abstract_zh: 广义相对论与多个标量场耦合是一个微分同胚不变的约束系统。因此，对微扰自由度的朴素计数不可避免地高估了理论中实际传播的物理模式数量，因为规范冗余和约束方程会移除非动力学模式。虽然这一问题已在线性涨落层面解决，但本文首次在哈密顿语言下、在二阶微扰论中显式计算了多场暴胀的所有大尺度规范不变相空间变量。在著名的Sasaki-Mukhanov变量的基础上，我们展示了如何构造一个在规范变换下不变的有限维二次修正基。虽然我们的方法适用于任意场数和任意尺度，但我们将显式解限制在超哈勃尺度并给出结果。由此，我们证明通常的平规范与共动规范涨落可以作为大尺度规范不变组合被恢复，这为规范固定程序提供了稳健的一致性检验，以连接地平线上方的理论预言与观测。我们以规范无关的方式推导了多场暴胀的二次和三次哈密顿量，随后通过进入平规范进行规范固定，并表明与通常基于拉格朗日方法的文献完全一致。在这些具体步骤之后，我们给出了二阶规范不变变量存在性的更形式化证明，并概述了允许推广到更高阶微扰论的程序。
classification.one_liner: 该工作首次在哈密顿框架下显式构造多场暴胀超哈勃尺度二阶规范不变相空间变量，并以规范无关方式推导二次及三次哈密顿量。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究多场暴胀中的规范不变变量与哈密顿动力学，直接匹配用户重点标签中的“经典引力/广义相对论”支线；但不涉及全息对偶、量子引力或强关联体系，因此 relevance 为中等。

papers.title: Time-dependent black hole lensing from ringdown quasinormal mode
papers.abstract: Is it possible to find imprints of a black hole ringdown through gravitational lensing? To address this question, we formulate an analytic description of weak-field and strong-deflection lensing of light in a time-dependent, perturbed Schwarzschild spacetime. The spacetime dynamics are modeled by a single, axisymmetric, even-parity quasinormal mode with \(\ell=2\), \(m=0\) and complex frequency \(\omega\). Working to first order in a small perturbation amplitude while keeping background null geodesics exact, we derive a time-dependent line-of-sight (Born) expression for the screen-plane deflection measured by a static observer at large radius. From the same integral, an asymptotic expansion yields the familiar weak-field \(1/b\) law with a ringdown-frequency correction that drives a harmonic centroid wobble, whereas a near-photon-sphere expansion produces a time-dependent generalization of the logarithmic strong-deflection limit with modulated coefficients, including a small oscillation of the critical impact parameter. An observer tetrad built from the background static frame ensures that all screen-plane quantities, such as centroid motion, multi-image hierarchy, and time delays, as well as photon-ring morphology, are gauge-safe at first order. We provide explicit matching across regimes, showing that the near-critical coefficients governing spacing and ring-radius modulations are encoded in the same Born kernel that controls the weak-field correction. This provides an analytic account of how ringdown-scale perturbations enter imaging observables, without resorting to numerical integration of null geodesics.

classification.title_zh: 来自铃宕准正规模式的含时黑洞透镜效应
classification.abstract_zh: 是否可能通过引力透镜发现黑洞铃宕的印记？为解决这个问题，我们建立了在含时微扰史瓦西时空中光的弱场与强偏折透镜的解析描述。时空动力学由单个轴对称偶宇称、\(\ell=2\)、\(m=0\)、复频率为 \(\omega\) 的准正规模式建模。在小微扰幅度下按一阶处理，同时保持背景零测地线精确，我们导出了由大半径处静态观测者测得的屏幕平面偏折的含时视线（Born）表达式。由同一积分，渐近展开给出熟悉的弱场 \(1/b\) 定律，并带有驱动谐波质心摆动的铃宕频率修正；而在近光子球展开则产生含时的对数强偏折极限的推广，其系数受到调制，包括临界碰撞参数的微小振荡。基于背景静态参考系构造的观测者四标架确保所有屏幕平面量，如质心运动、多重像层级和时间延迟以及光子环球形态，在一阶下都是规范安全的。我们给出了跨区域的显式匹配，表明控制间距和光环半径调制的近临界系数由控制弱场修正的同一个 Born 核编码。这提供了铃宕尺度微扰如何进入成像观测量的解析描述，而无需对零测地线进行数值积分。
classification.one_liner: 用解析 Born 方法研究史瓦西黑洞铃宕 QNM 对弱场和强偏折引力透镜的含时修正，包括质心摆动和临界参数振荡。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究经典广义相对论中黑洞铃宕 QNM 对引力透镜的含时修正，匹配用户重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”和“QNM与非线性演化”；但非全息或量子引力，且聚焦于引力透镜观测效应，因此相关性中等。

papers.title: Null fluid/gravity correspondence
papers.abstract: We construct a new class of perturbative asymptotically Anti-de Sitter pp-wave spacetimes by performing a long-wavelength expansion of Kaigorodov metrics in arbitrary spacetime dimensions. Holographically, these spacetimes are described by a null fluid hydrodynamic expansion around null states in the conformal field theory, which can be obtained as zero temperature and infinite momentum limits of finite temperature states. Building on this, we explicitly show that special cases of this null fluid/gravity correspondence can be obtained as an ultra-relativistic limit of the usual fluid/gravity correspondence in which the temperature tends to zero while the flow approaches the speed of light. We also extend these results to the context of the blackfold approach in which the corresponding pp-wave spacetimes are asymptotically flat and can be obtained as infinite temperature limits of boosted black branes.

classification.title_zh: 零流体/引力对应
classification.abstract_zh: 我们通过对任意时空维数下的 Kaigorodov 度规进行长波展开，构造了一类新的微扰渐近反德西特 pp 波时空。在全息上，这些时空由共形场论中零态附近的零流体流体力学展开描述，这种零态可作为有限温度态的零温度与无穷动量极限得到。在此基础上，我们明确表明这种零流体/引力对应的特殊情形可由通常流体/引力对应的超相对论极限得到，其中温度趋于零而流速趋近光速。我们还将这些结果推广到 blackfold 方法，相应的 pp 波时空是渐近平直的，可由 boost 黑膜的无穷温度极限得到。
classification.one_liner: 构造 Kaigorodov 度规长波展开的 pp 波时空，并提出零流体/引力对应，联系超相对论流体/引力及 blackfold 极限。
classification.relevance_reason: 涉及经典引力时空解（pp-wave/blackfold）和全息流体/引力对应，但与用户重点的凝聚态/超流/QNM 等支线重叠较少。

papers.title: Bouncing geodesics, black hole singularities, and singularities of thermal correlators
papers.abstract: Bouncing geodesics have been used as valuable probes of black hole singularities. In the dual boundary theory, the presence of bouncing geodesics is encoded in the analytic structure of correlation functions. Thus, when their existence is related to the presence of a black hole singularity, this presents a practical holographic framework to analyse, diagnose, and classify spacetimes with curvature singularities. To make this intuition precise, we use the Hadamard theory of hyperbolic differential equations to prove that both bulk and boundary retarded propagators diverge whenever two points can be connected by a null geodesic. We clarify why this statement remains valid beyond the geodesic regime (for operators of any dimension) and examine how holographic renormalisation modifies the structure of the dual propagator. We also present a general characterisation of bouncing geodesics and the associated singularities in correlation functions for arbitrary spacetimes. Furthermore, we compare the analytic structure of the correlators in position and momentum space and discuss explicit examples. Finally, we demonstrate the validity and concrete limitations of the bouncing geodesic approach to the study of black hole singularities. In particular, we show an explicit example of a black hole in the self-dual linear axion model, which has a curvature singularity despite the absence of bouncing geodesics.

classification.title_zh: 弹跳测地线、黑洞奇点与热关联函数的奇点
classification.abstract_zh: 弹跳测地线已被用作探测黑洞奇点的重要工具。在对偶边界理论中，弹跳测地线的存在编码在关联函数的解析结构中。因此，当它们的存在与黑洞奇点的存在相关时，这为分析、诊断和分类具有曲率奇点的时空提供了一个实用的全息框架。为了使这一直觉精确化，我们使用双曲微分方程的哈达玛理论证明，只要两点可以通过零测地线连接，体和边界推迟传播子都会发散。我们阐明了为什么这一结论在测地线区域之外仍然成立（对于任意维度的算子），并检查了全息重整化如何修改对偶传播子的结构。我们还对任意时空中弹跳测地线以及关联函数中相关奇点给出了一个一般性描述。此外，我们比较了位置空间和动量空间中关联函数的解析结构，并讨论了显式例子。最后，我们证明了弹跳测地线方法研究黑洞奇点的有效性和具体局限性。特别是，我们展示了一个自对偶线性轴子模型中的黑洞，尽管没有弹跳测地线，但仍存在曲率奇点。
classification.one_liner: 利用哈达玛理论证明零测地线连接的点对应传播子发散，并将弹跳测地线与黑洞奇点的关联推广到一般时空，同时指出这一方法的局限性。
classification.relevance_reason: 该论文聚焦于全息框架下弹跳测地线与黑洞奇点及边界关联函数解析结构的关系，属于AdS/CFT字典和量子引力中的基础问题，与用户偏好的全息超导、QNM、相变等具体研究支线关联较弱。

papers.title: Planar AdS multi-NUT spacetimes and Kaluza-Klein multi-monopoles
papers.abstract: In higher-dimensional Einstein-AdS gravity, it is well known that planar and static anti-de Sitter black holes can be endowed with multiple rotation parameters via a large-gauge transformation. However, a similar prescription fails when multiple NUT parameters are added, thereby obstructing the study of holographic properties with more than one NUT charge. To pave the way towards this direction, we construct explicit planar AdS spacetimes having multiple NUT parameters in two simple ways that allow one to circumvent the strong restrictions imposed by the vacuum field equations. First, motivated by momentum relaxation holographic models, we construct multi-NUT spaces in AdS with flat horizons by adding free scalar fields possessing an axionic profile. In our second approach, we build similar configurations in Einstein gravity with quadratic-curvature corrections. We end by presenting planar versions of the Kaluza-Klein monopole in AdS with different magnetic charges. As a byproduct, our strategy yields a simple way to generalize the Gross-Perry-Sorkin monopole to include the cosmological constant.

classification.title_zh: 平面AdS多NUT时空与Kaluza-Klein多磁单极子
classification.abstract_zh: 在更高维爱因斯坦-AdS引力中，众所周知，平面静态反德西特黑洞可以通过大规范变换被赋予多个旋转参数。然而，类似的方法在加入多个NUT参数时会失效，从而阻碍了研究具有多个NUT电荷的全息性质。为了向这个方向铺平道路，我们以两种简单的方式构造了具有多个NUT参数的显式平面AdS时空，以规避真空场方程施加的严格限制。首先，受动量弛豫全息模型的启发，我们通过添加具有轴子型轮廓的自由标量场构造了具有平坦视界的AdS多NUT空间。在我们的第二种方法中，我们在具有二次曲率修正的爱因斯坦引力中构建了类似构型。最后，我们给出了AdS中具有不同磁荷的Kaluza-Klein单极子的平面版本。作为副产品，我们的策略提供了一种将Gross-Perry-Sorkin单极子推广到包含宇宙学常数的简单方法。
classification.one_liner: 构造了具有多个NUT参数的平面AdS时空，并给出了Kaluza-Klein磁单极子的平面版本。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文构造平面AdS多NUT时空和KK磁单极子，属于经典引力和全息模型中的时空解构造，与经典引力/广义相对论标签相关，但不属于用户其他重点支线。

papers.title: Modular Self-Duality, Symmetrized Relative Entropy, and Bogoliubov--Kubo--Mori Susceptibility in Quantum Field Theory
papers.abstract: We develop an operator-algebraic framework for modular self-duality, symmetrized relative entropy, and Bogoliubov--Kubo--Mori (BKM) susceptibility of local states in quantum field theory. In finite dimensions, modular self-duality singles out fixed points at which a state coincides with its modularly reflected partner. At such points, the natural comparison functional is the symmetrized Umegaki relative entropy. It vanishes at coincidence, and its Hessian is governed by the BKM quantum Fisher information along the reflected tangent direction. We then extend this fixed-point construction to the local type~III von Neumann algebras that arise in quantum field theory. Here, a local state is compared with the modular pullback of its commutant restriction, and the intrinsic comparison functional is the symmetrized Araki relative entropy. For sufficiently regular state deformations, the fixed-localization Hessian at the self-dual point defines a type~III BKM susceptibility. This coefficient is obtained by evaluating the BKM bilinear form on the tangent selected by the modular pairing. Exact coherent-state realizations are obtained for the free scalar field on wedge algebras and for the chiral $U(1)$ current on half-line algebras. In both examples, the comparison functional is exactly quadratic in the deformation parameter, and the susceptibility coefficients admit explicit boost-energy, stress-tensor, or half-line integral representations. We also apply the construction to a ball-shaped boundary region in the vacuum state of a conformal field theory with a semiclassical anti-de Sitter (AdS) gravitational dual. For linear bulk coherent excitations in an exact complementary-recovery model of this sector, bulk--boundary modular intertwining identifies the modular partner with the AdS--Rindler-reflected coherent state, and the symmetrized relative entropy is exactly quadratic.

classification.title_zh: 量子场论中的模自对偶、对称化相对熵与Bogoliubov–Kubo–Mori磁化率
classification.abstract_zh: 我们发展了一个算子代数框架，用于处理量子场论中局域态的模自对偶、对称化相对熵以及Bogoliubov–Kubo–Mori（BKM）磁化率。在有限维情形下，模自对偶挑选出固定点，使得该态与其模反射伙伴重合。在这些点上，自然的比较泛函是对称化的Umegaki相对熵。它在重合处为零，其Hessian由沿反射切向方向的BKM量子Fisher信息控制。随后，我们将这一固定点构造推广到量子场论中出现的局域III型von Neumann代数。这里，局域态与其交换子限制的模拉回进行比较，内蕴的比较泛函是对称化的Araki相对熵。对于足够正则的态形变，自对偶点处的固定局域化Hessian定义了III型BKM磁化率。该系数通过将BKM双线性型作用于由模配对所选取的切方向来获得。对于楔形代数上的自由标量场和半直线代数上的手征U(1)流，我们得到了精确的相干态实现。在这两个例子中，比较泛函关于形变参数恰好是二次的，并且磁化率系数具有显式的boost能、应力张量或半直线积分表示。我们还将该构造应用于具有半经典反德西特（AdS）引力对偶的共形场论真空态中的一个球状边界区域。对于该扇区的一个精确互补恢复模型中的线性体态相干激发，体–边界模交织将模伙伴识别为AdS–Rindler反射的相干态，且对称化相对熵恰好是二次的。
classification.one_liner: 建立量子场论中模自对偶与对称化相对熵的算子代数框架，并在AdS/CFT等例子中得到精确二次型结果。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要聚焦量子场论中的模理论、相对熵与BKM磁化率，虽包含AdS/CFT应用，但未涉及用户指定的重点研究支线（如全息超流超导、相变、QNM、探针膜等），因此相关性较低。

papers.title: Five-dimensional Geometry from Spinning Amplitudes
papers.abstract: Massive spinor-helicity variables in four dimensions are a useful tool for studying amplitudes between higher-spin fields and gravitons. Among them a special, simple set of amplitudes reproduces the linearized stress-energy tensor of a Kerr black hole in the classical limit. In this work we initiate the study of the classical limit of three-point spinor-helicity amplitudes in five dimensions. We introduce the map between the spinor invariants and the expectation values of spin operators and match the amplitude building blocks with those of the multipole expansion. Interestingly, in order to take the classical limit of a general amplitude, we need to augment the multipole structures with the Hodge dual of the classical spin tensor. We study the classical limit of alternative spinning states not described by fully-symmetric products of polarisations and conclude that they can describe the same spacetimes. Finally, by relaxing the orthogonality condition of the spin tensor we are able to model spacetimes with a single rotational isometry and match these to the classical limit of amplitudes allowing for an internal spin shift. Along the way we also identify the class of amplitudes describing the Myers-Perry black hole and comment on its generalization to arbitrary dimensions.

classification.title_zh: 自旋振幅与五维几何
classification.abstract_zh: 四维大质量旋量-螺旋度变量是研究高自旋场与引力子之间振幅的有用工具。其中一组特殊而简单的振幅在经典极限下再现了Kerr黑洞的线性化应力-能量张量。本文开创了五维三点旋量-螺旋度振幅经典极限的研究。我们引入了旋量不变量与自旋算符期望值之间的映射，并将振幅构建块与多极展开的构建块进行匹配。有趣的是，为了取一般振幅的经典极限，我们需要用经典自旋张量的霍奇对偶来扩充多极结构。我们研究了非完全对称极化乘积所描述的替代自旋态的经典极限，并得出结论：它们可以描述相同的时空。最后，通过放宽自旋张量的正交性条件，我们能够模拟具有单一旋转等距的时空，并将其与允许内部自移位的振幅的经典极限相匹配。在此过程中，我们还确定了描述Myers-Perry黑洞的一类振幅，并评论了其向任意维度的推广。
classification.one_liner: 利用旋量螺旋度振幅的经典极限构造五维旋转黑洞（如Myers-Perry）的几何，并讨论自旋张量的多重极展开。
classification.relevance_reason: 该论文研究经典引力中的自旋振幅与黑洞几何，与用户重点关注标签'经典引力/广义相对论'相关，但与全息等具体方向无关。

papers.title: The giant graviton expansion in AdS$_5\times$SE$_5$
papers.abstract: We study giant graviton-like D3-branes as probe configurations in type IIB supergravity backgrounds AdS$_5\times$SE$_5$, with emphasis on the structure of the five-dimensional Sasaki-Einstein manifolds SE$_5$. These configurations wrap supersymmetric three-cycles in SE$_5$ and rotate at the speed of light along the Reeb direction. We formulate the general problem in terms of the transverse K\"ahler potential and show that configurations carrying maximal angular momentum can be described by loci where the transverse K\"ahler potential diverges in suitably chosen coordinates. We quantize a particular set of excitations, similar to those considered in the AdS$_5\times S^5$ case, and show that they are governed by a Fock-Darwin problem with a conical deficit, which generalizes the Landau problem obtained for $S^5$. Succinctly, the information about the geometry of SE$_5$ is encoded in the form of the external potential and the conical deficit. We compute a protected contribution to the superconformal index arising from quantized fluctuations of supersymmetric giant graviton configurations. For the explicit case of AdS$_5\times T^{1,1}$, we recover the finite-$N$ protected index of the dual quiver ${\cal N}=1$ superconformal field theory in the sector captured by a non-Abelian generalization of the quantized degrees of freedom.

classification.title_zh: AdS$_5\times$SE$_5$ 中的巨引力子展开
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究 IIB 型超引力背景 AdS$_5\times$SE$_5$ 中作为探针构型的类巨引力子 D3-膜，重点关注五维 Sasaki-Einstein 流形 SE$_5$ 的结构。这些构型包裹 SE$_5$ 中的超对称三维闭链，并沿 Reeb 方向以光速旋转。我们用横向 Kähler 势表述一般问题，并证明携带最大角动量的构型可由横向 Kähler 势在适当坐标下发散的位置描述。我们量子化了一组与 AdS$_5\times S^5$ 情形中考虑的激发类似的激发，并表明它们由具有锥形赤字的 Fock-Darwin 问题控制，这是对 $S^5$ 上得到的 Landau 问题的推广。简言之，SE$_5$ 的几何信息被编码在外部势和锥形赤字的形状中。我们计算了由超对称巨引力子构型的量子化涨落产生的超共形指标的受保护贡献。对于 AdS$_5\times T^{1,1}$ 的显式情形，我们在由这些量子化自由度的非阿贝尔推广所捕获的扇区中恢复了其对偶 quiver ${\cal N}=1$ 超共形场论的有限 $N$ 受保护指标。
classification.one_liner: 将巨引力子展开推广到一般 Sasaki-Einstein 流形，并通过量子化涨落计算超共形指标的受保护贡献。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究全息/弦论中的巨引力子与超对称指标，属于 AdS/CFT 基础，但不直接属于用户重点标签中的超流、探针膜、畴壁、QNM、经典引力等支线。

papers.title: Line operator indices of S-fold theories
papers.abstract: We study superconformal indices in the presence of line operators in S-fold theories. We consider two types of lines, realized by fundamental strings and fivebranes, respectively, in AdS$_5 \times S^5/\mathbb{Z}_k$. For fundamental lines, we analyze the corresponding indices including finite-$N$ corrections arising from giant graviton configurations. For $k=2$, we compare the holographic results with line operator indices in $\mathcal{N}=4$ super Yang-Mills theories with orthogonal gauge groups. For $k=3,4$ and $6$, we focus on the rank $2$ case, in which the supersymmetry is enhanced to ${\cal N}=4$, and compare them with the corresponding Wilson-'t Hooft line operator indices. In both cases, we find improved agreement once giant graviton contributions are included. For line operators realized by fivebranes, after confirming agreement for $k=2$, we construct BPS configurations for $k\geq 3$ explicitly using fivebrane junctions and derive the indices in the large $N$ limit by the mode analysis on the fivebrane junctions.

classification.title_zh: S-fold 理论的线算符指标
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究 S-fold 理论中在存在线算符情况下的超共形指标。考虑两类线，分别在 AdS_5 × S^5/Z_k 中由基本弦和五膜实现。对于基本弦线，我们分析相应指标，包括来自巨引力子构型的有限 N 修正。对于 k=2，我们将全息结果与具有正交规范群的 N=4 超杨-米尔斯理论中的线算符指标进行比较。对于 k=3,4 和 6，我们关注秩 2 情形，此时超对称增强为 N=4，并将其与相应的 Wilson-'t Hooft 线算符指标比较。在这两种情况下，我们发现一旦包含巨引力子贡献，吻合度就提高了。对于由五膜实现的线算符，在确认 k=2 一致后，我们利用五膜结显式构造了 k≥3 的 BPS 构型，并通过五膜结上的模式分析在大 N 极限下推导出指标。
classification.one_liner: 研究 S-fold 理论中线算符的超共形指标，包含巨引力子修正，并与正交规范群 N=4 SYM 的 Wilson-'t Hooft 线算符指标对比。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT 指标与线算符研究，与用户指定的全息凝聚态、探针膜、经典引力等支线关联较弱。

papers.title: Interior evolution of regular Schwarzschild black holes
papers.abstract: We present an exact, purely geometric account of the interior dynamics of Schwarzschild black holes, formulated without invoking any specific gravitational theory and free of additional charges beyond the total mass ${\cal M}$. We show that dynamical evolution generically produces new singularities, absent in the static case, whose resolution imposes highly restrictive conditions on gravitational collapse.

classification.title_zh: 正则史瓦西黑洞的内部演化
classification.abstract_zh: 我们给出了史瓦西黑洞内部动力学的严格纯几何描述，该描述不依赖任何具体引力理论，且除总质量 M 外无额外荷。我们证明，动力学演化一般会产生静态情形中不存在的新的奇点，其消除对引力坍缩施加了高度限制性条件。
classification.one_liner: 纯几何研究了史瓦西黑洞内部演化，表明动力学普遍产生新奇点，从而对引力坍缩施加极强约束。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究经典引力/广义相对论中的黑洞内部动力学与奇点，属于用户明确关注的经典引力支线。

papers.title: Renormalization group corrections to $\Lambda$CDM model and observational consequences for $H_0$ tension
papers.abstract:
We explore the renormalization group-based extension of the $\Lambda$CDM model as a potential solution to the current cosmological tensions. In this approach, both the cosmological constant density and Newton's constant are allowed to vary with the energy scale, as a consequence of the remnant effects of massive quantum fields in the low-energy regime. The corresponding cosmological model is consistent with the principles of quantum field theory, based on the covariance of the vacuum effective action, and is characterized by an unique extra parameter $
u$. Our analysis yields a best-fit value of $
u = - (2.5 \pm 1.3)	imes 10^{-4}$, placing the $\Lambda$CDM limit at the $2\sigma$ region of the $
u$ posterior. This narrow range is consistent with data from CMB (Planck), BAO (DESI), and SN Ia (DES Y5). Our result also alleviates the $H_0$ tension and is consistent with the previously established constraints from large-scale structure. In these kind of models, there is a link between cosmology and particle physics. Our results point to possibility of a new physics, characterized by a mass spectrum lying below the Planck scale but above the values typically associated with Grand Unified Theories (GUTs).

classification.title_zh: ΛCDM 模型的重整化群修正及其对 H0 张力的观测后果
classification.abstract_zh: 我们探索基于重整化群的 ΛCDM 模型扩展，作为当前宇宙学张力的潜在解决方案。在该方法中，宇宙学常数密度和牛顿常数都被允许随能标变化，这是大质量量子场在低能区残余效应的结果。相应的宇宙学模型符合量子场论原理，基于真空有效作用的协变性，并以唯一的额外参数 ν 表征。我们的分析给出 ν 的最佳拟合值为 -(2.5±1.3)×10⁻⁴，使 ΛCDM 极限位于 ν 后验分布的 2σ 区域。这一狭窄范围与 CMB（Planck）、BAO（DESI）和 SN Ia（DES Y5）数据一致。结果也缓解了 H0 张力，并与先前来自大尺度结构的约束一致。在这类模型中，宇宙学与粒子物理之间存在联系。我们的结果指出可能存在新物理，其特征质量谱低于普朗克尺度但高于通常与大统一理论（GUT）相关的值。
classification.one_liner: 通过重整化群让宇宙学常数和牛顿常数随能标跑动，可缓解 H0 张力并暗示低于普朗克尺度但高于 GUT 的新物理。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文属于宇宙学模型与粒子物理交叉，主要处理 H0 张力，与全息、量子引力核心主题相关性较弱；仅在宇宙学背景上可归入广义相对论应用。

papers.title: Spherically symmetric charged (anti-)de Sitter black hole in $f(R,T)$ gravity coupled with nonlinear electrodynamics
papers.abstract: We investigate black hole solutions in quadratic $f(R,T)=R+kT^2$ gravity coupled with nonlinear electrodynamics $\mathcal{L}(F)=\alpha - F/(4\pi) + \gamma F^2$. Solving the field equations yields an exact magnetically charged (anti-)de Sitter black hole metric featuring novel $r^{-6}$ and $r^{-14}$ correction terms. The horizon structure can exhibit up to four horizons depending on the parameters. Thermodynamic analysis reveals that the heat capacity exhibits critical phase transitions, with the critical point significantly shifted by the coupled corrections. Using the effective metric formalism, we study the photon sphere and black hole shadow, finding that the magnetic charge $Q$ shrinks the shadow while the nonlinear parameter $\gamma$ enlarges it. Constraints from Event Horizon Telescope observations of M87* and Sgr A* place the parameter $\gamma$ at the order of $10^3$ at $1\sigma$ and $2\sigma$ confidence levels. Our results demonstrate that quadratic $f(R,T)$ gravity combined with nonlinear electrodynamics provides a consistent framework for strong-field gravity phenomenology.

classification.title_zh: f(R,T) 引力耦合非线性电动力学中的球对称带电（反）德西特黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了二次 f(R,T)=R+kT^2 引力耦合非线性电动力学 L(F)=α - F/(4π) + γ F^2 中的黑洞解。求解场方程得到一个精确的磁荷（反）德西特黑洞度规，具有新颖的 r^{-6} 和 r^{-14} 修正项。视界结构根据参数可呈现最多四个视界。热力学分析表明热容出现临界相变，临界点因耦合修正显著移动。利用有效度规形式，我们研究了光子球和黑洞阴影，发现磁荷 Q 会使阴影缩小，而非线性参数 γ 会使阴影增大。事件视界望远镜对 M87* 和 Sgr A* 的观测约束在 1σ 和 2σ 置信水平下将参数 γ 限制在 10^3 量级。我们的结果表明二次 f(R,T) 引力结合非线性电动力学为强场引力现象学提供了一致框架。
classification.one_liner: 研究二次 f(R,T) 引力耦合非线性电动力学中的带电 (A)dS 黑洞解、热力学相变与黑洞阴影观测约束。

papers.title: Implications of Matter--Curvature Coupled Gravity on Chandrasekhar Mass Limit of White Dwarfs
papers.abstract: We investigate white dwarfs in the framework of f(R,Lm) and f(R,Lm,T) gravity to explore the Chandrasekhar limit. We have considered two functional forms of f(R,Lm) and one functional form of f(R,Lm,T) gravity. Considering the matter Lagrangian Lm=p , we calculate modified TOV equations for each of the forms. By employing the fully degenerate electron gas equation of state in the modified ToV equations, we derive the mass-radius relation for each functional form of both f(R,Lm) and f(R,Lm,T) gravity. Our models imply modifications in the Chandrasekhar mass limit that deviate significantly from the GR and the Newtonian cases. In the f(R,Lm,T) gravity, the new mass limit of the white dwarf can reach up to 1.537M while in f(R,Lm,T) with the quadratic extension can reach up to 1.52M and with square-root exponential model extension up to 2.08M. Further, we analyze the static stability criterion, the gravitational redshift, and the adiabatic indices. For the power-law form of f(R,Lm) and the nonlinear form of f(R,Lm,T) gravity, significant variations are observed at higher densities rho_c>1010gcm^-3, while substantial changes are noted at much lower central densities in the case of square-root exponential model form of f(R,Lm) gravity. The higher-density configurations should be regarded as formal equilibrium solutions within the adopted Chandrasekhar EoS and not as fully realistic stable C-O WDs, since additional high-density microphysics has not been included. We also calculate compactness and gravitational redshift, which are much lower than those of NS and BH. The configuration satisfies the adiabatic stability criterion, which shows that all considered models yield Gamma > 4/3 throughout the interiors of WDs. Overall, our models provide a viable framework for the existence of superChandrasekhar mass limit, extending beyond the classical predictions in the Newtonian and/or GR cases.

classification.title_zh: 物质-曲率耦合引力对白矮星钱德拉塞卡质量极限的影响
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在 f(R,Lm) 和 f(R,Lm,T) 引力框架下研究白矮星，以探索钱德拉塞卡极限。我们考虑了 f(R,Lm) 的两种函数形式和 f(R,Lm,T) 的一种函数形式。采用物质拉格朗日量 Lm=p，我们为每种形式计算了修正的 TOV 方程。利用完全简并电子气体状态方程，我们推导了 f(R,Lm) 和 f(R,Lm,T) 各函数形式的质量-半径关系。我们的模型表明，钱德拉塞卡质量极限出现明显修正，显著偏离广义相对论和牛顿情形。在 f(R,Lm,T) 引力中，白矮星新的质量极限可达 1.537M；二次扩展模型可达 1.52M；平方根指数模型扩展可达 2.08M。此外，我们分析了静态稳定性判据、引力红移和绝热指数。对于 f(R,Lm) 的幂律形式和 f(R,Lm,T) 的非线性形式，在较高中心密度 ρc>10^10 g cm^-3 处出现显著变化；而在 f(R,Lm) 的平方根指数模型形式下，在低得多的中心密度处就观察到明显改变。高密度构型应视为在所用 Chandrasekhar 状态方程内的形式平衡解，而不是完全现实且稳定的 C-O 白矮星，因为尚未包含额外的高密度微观物理。我们还计算了致密度和引力红移，它们远低于中子星和黑洞的值。构型满足绝热稳定性判据，所有模型在 WD 内部均给出 Γ>4/3。总体而言，我们的模型为超钱德拉塞卡质量极限的存在提供了可行框架，超越了牛顿和/或广义相对论中的经典预言。
classification.one_liner: 在修改引力框架下研究白矮星，发现钱德拉塞卡质量极限可被显著修正，支持超钱德拉塞卡质量白矮星的存在。

papers.title: Phase transition for a black hole with matter fields and the relation with the Lyapunov exponent
papers.abstract: We construct static black hole solutions coexisting with anisotropic matter in asymptotically (anti-)de Sitter spacetime and investigate how the matter field modifies their thermodynamic and dynamical properties. The anisotropic matter generates an exponentially decaying charge-like contribution to the metric, causing the geometry to interpolate between the Schwarzschild black hole in anti-de Sitter spacetime and the Reissner-Nordstr\"om black hole in anti-de Sitter spacetime. In anti-de Sitter black hole spacetime, we derive the complete thermodynamic description, including the Hawking temperature, heat capacity, Smarr relation, generalized first law, and Helmholtz free energy. The system exhibits a van der Waals-type small/large black hole phase transition with a critical point determined by the matter field parameters. Local thermodynamic stability is characterized by the heat capacity, whereas global stability is determined through the free energy. We further investigate unstable homoclinic orbits by evaluating the Lyapunov exponent associated with null geodesics. Our analysis reveals that different thermodynamic branches possess distinct dynamical instabilities, and that the thermodynamically preferred phase is accompanied by a smaller Lyapunov exponent. These results demonstrate that thermodynamic stability and geodesic instability are correlated because both originate from the same underlying spacetime geometry.

classification.primary_topic: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 含物质场的黑洞相变及其与Lyapunov指数的关系
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在渐近(反)德西特时空中构造了与各向异性物质共存的静态黑洞解，并研究了物质场如何修改其热力学和动力学性质。各向异性物质在度规中产生了一个指数衰减的类电荷贡献，使得几何在反德西特时空中的史瓦西黑洞和反德西特时空中的Reissner-Nordström黑洞之间插值。在反德西特黑洞时空中，我们推导了完整的热力学描述，包括霍金温度、热容、Smarr关系、广义第一定律和亥姆霍兹自由能。系统表现出范德瓦尔斯型的小/大黑洞相变，其临界点由物质场参数决定。局部热力学稳定性由热容表征，而全局稳定性由自由能决定。我们进一步通过评估零测地线相关的Lyapunov指数来研究不稳定的同宿轨道。我们的分析表明，不同的热力学分支具有不同的动力学不稳定性，并且热力学上优选的相伴随较小的Lyapunov指数。这些结果表明热力学稳定性和测地线不稳定性是相关的，因为两者都源于相同的底层时空几何。
classification.one_liner: 研究了含各向异性物质场的AdS黑洞的范德瓦尔斯型相变，并揭示了热力学稳定性与零测地线Lyapunov指数之间的关联。

papers.title: Noether charges and the first law of thermodynamics for multifractional Schwarzschild black hole in the q-derivative theory
papers.abstract: In this paper, we investigate black-hole thermodynamics in the multi-fractional theory with $q$-derivatives, focusing on static, spherically symmetric vacuum solutions in the spherical-coordinate approximation. In the geometric frame the solution is exactly Schwarzschild in the areal radius $q$, so that canonical charges can be defined using standard covariant methods. The conserved mass depends only on the Schwarzschild integration constant, and the Iyer--Wald entropy satisfies the usual area law in terms of the geometric horizon radius. When the Hawking temperature is defined in the fractional radial coordinate $r$, however, it acquires an explicit dependence on the multi-fractional profile through the local factor $q'(r_{\rm h})$ at the horizon. As a result, variations of the non-dynamical profile parameters generically obstruct integrability of a naive Clausius relation expressed solely in terms of mass and entropy. We show that this obstruction is resolved by enlarging the thermodynamic state space to include the profile parameters and by constructing an integrable entropy functional obtained from a radial integral of the geometric radius. The corresponding extended first law contains additional work terms conjugate to the multi-fractional couplings. We analyze both binomial and log-oscillating profiles, clarify the role of presentation dependence, and delineate the consistency conditions required for a well-defined exterior branch with a single horizon. Our results make explicit the separation between profile-insensitive canonical charges and profile-sensitive thermal quantities in multi-fractional black-hole thermodynamics.

classification.title_zh: q导数理论中多分数Schwarzschild黑洞的Noether荷与热力学第一定律
classification.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们研究了具有q导数的多分数理论中的黑洞热力学，重点是在球坐标近似下静态、球对称真空解。在几何框架中，解在面积半径q下恰好是Schwarzschild解，因此可以使用标准的协变方法定义规范荷。守恒质量仅取决于Schwarzschild积分常数，并且Iyer-Wald熵在几何视界半径方面满足通常的面积律。然而，当Hawking温度在分数径向坐标r中定义时，它通过视界处的局部因子q'(r_h)获得了对多分数轮廓的显式依赖。结果，非动力学轮廓参数的变化通常阻碍了仅用质量和熵表示的朴素Clausius关系的可积性。我们表明，这种阻碍可以通过扩展热力学状态空间以包含轮廓参数，并构造从几何半径的径向积分获得的可积熵泛函来解决。相应的扩展第一定律包含与多分数耦合共轭的额外功项。我们分析了二项式和对数振荡轮廓，阐明了表示依赖性的作用，并描述了具有单个视界的良定义外部分支所需的一致性条件。我们的结果明确区分了轮廓不敏感的规范荷和轮廓敏感的热量在多分数黑洞热力学中的分离。
classification.one_liner: 本文研究多分数q导数理论中Schwarzschild黑洞的热力学，发现温度依赖于分数轮廓，通过扩展状态空间得到含额外功项的积分型第一定律。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究多分数修改引力中的黑洞热力学，与经典引力/广义相对论方向相关，但不涉及全息或凝聚态，因此关联度中等。

papers.title: Devoured by a Hairy Gargantua: Probing Massive Scalar Charges with Non-minimal Curvature Coupling with Extreme-Mass-Ratio Inspirals
papers.abstract: Ultralight scalar fields nonminimally coupled to curvature can endow rotating black holes with stationary hair and alter nearby orbits. Using recently constructed hairy black-hole spacetimes, we model the transition to plunge of an extreme-mass-ratio inspiral. For scalar masses $\mu M=0.01$ and $0.1$ and dimensionless curvature coupling $\zeta=10^{-3},10^{-4}$, we find $\mathcal{O}(10)$ rad of gravitational-wave dephasing relative to general relativity over $\mathcal{O}(10^3)$ orbits. A multimode Fisher forecast at $\mu M=0.2$, where neighbouring hair solutions permit a numerical $\mu$-derivative, suggests that $\zeta$ and $\mu$ could be measured to precisions of $\simeq0.2\%$ and $0.6$--$1.1\%$, respectively, for a source with signal-to-noise ratio of about 80 in LISA.

classification.title_zh: 被毛茸茸的 Gargantua 吞噬：利用极端质量比旋近探测非最小曲率耦合的大质量标量荷
classification.abstract_zh: 极轻标量场通过与曲率的非最小耦合可以赋予旋转黑洞稳态毛并改变邻近轨道。利用最近构造的带毛黑洞时空，我们模拟了极端质量比旋近向坠入阶段的过渡。对于标量质量 μM = 0.01 和 0.1 以及无量纲曲率耦合 ζ = 10^{-3}, 10^{-4}，我们发现与广义相对论相比，在约 10^3 个轨道上产生约 10 弧度的引力波退相位。在 μM = 0.2，相邻毛解允许数值 μ 导数，多模 Fisher 预测表明对于 LISA 中信噪比约为 80 的源，ζ 和 μ 可分别达到约 0.2% 和 0.6–1.1% 的测量精度。
classification.one_liner: 利用带毛黑洞中的极端质量比旋近，计算引力波退相位并通过 Fisher 矩阵预测 LISA 对标量质量和耦合常数的测量精度。

papers.title: A first-principles binary neutron star merger model of GW170817, GRB170817A, and AT2017gfo
papers.abstract: The multimessenger observation of the binary neutron star merger event GW170817, associated with its electromagnetic counterparts GRB170817A and AT2017gfo, marked a milestone in astrophysics, yet its unified physical explanation remains elusive. We conduct an end-to-end simulation based on a first-principles general-relativistic magnetohydrodynamics neutrino-radiation transfer merger simulation, followed by nucleosynthesis calculations and photon radiative transfer to generate kilonova light curves. We show that the large-scale dynamo simultaneously produces a relativistic jet with an isotropic-equivalent luminosity of $\sim 10^{51}~{\rm erg~s^{-1}}$ and $\approx 0.08M_\odot$ of neutron-rich ejecta, reproducing the GRB170817A afterglow and the AT2017gfo kilonova light curves. Our results establish a unified first-principles framework for interpreting binary neutron star mergers across gravitational wave, gamma-ray burst, and kilonova observations.

classification.title_zh: 双中子星并合GW170817、GRB170817A和AT2017gfo的第一性原理模型
classification.abstract_zh: 双中子星并合事件GW170817及其电磁对应体GRB170817A和AT2017gfo的多信使观测标志着天体物理学的里程碑，但其统一物理解释仍然难以捉摸。我们基于第一性原理的广义相对论磁流体动力学中微子辐射转移并合模拟，随后进行核合成计算和光子辐射转移以生成千新星光变曲线，进行端到端模拟。我们表明，大尺度发电机同时产生各向同性等效光度约为10^51 erg/s的相对论性喷流和约0.08个太阳质量的中子富集抛射物，重现了GRB170817A余辉和AT2017gfo千新星光变曲线。我们的结果为解释跨引力波、伽马射线暴和千新星观测的双中子星并合建立了一个统一的第一性原理框架。
classification.one_liner: 通过第一性原理GRMHD模拟统一解释GW170817、GRB170817A和AT2017gfo的多信使观测。

papers.title: Toward a realistic test of black-hole movie correlations as a probe of extreme lensing
papers.abstract: In an optically thin setting, gravitational lensing around a black hole creates multiple delayed images of any localized source, appearing at different positions on the observer's screen. Even if particular sources cannot be singled out, this effect may be revealed in a black-hole movie (time-dependent image) by examining the two-point spatiotemporal correlation function of intensity fluctuations in the movie. Recently, the correlation function derived from a movie obtained by ray tracing of a general-relativistic magnetohydrodynamic simulation demonstrated the plausibility of this idea, even when the movie was blurred to angular resolutions corresponding to next-generation terrestrial very-long-baseline interferometric arrays. In this work, we further develop this method and study how some possible corruptions of the movie, motivated by real observational limitations, affect the ability to identify the extreme-lensing signatures by correlations. The effects are compared for both the original and blurred movies. We discuss the implications of our analysis for upcoming observations of M87* and Sgr A*, the two main targets of the Event Horizon Telescope and its future extensions. Our case study suggests that the types of data corruption we have explored, in themselves, do not preclude an identification of extreme-lensing effects in correlation measurements. We use our results to roughly estimate that, most importantly, for a successful correlation measurement, M87* may need to be continuously monitored for $\gtrsim 2$ years, while Sgr A* may need to be measured at a cadence $\gtrsim 1$ frame per minute. Finally, we outline a new analysis method that reduces the data in the complete correlation function---a large dataset defined on a five-dimensional configuration space---to a two-dimensional histogram that could be useful for black-hole parameter inference.

classification.title_zh: 迈向黑洞电影相关性作为极端透镜探针的现实检验
classification.abstract_zh: 在光学薄情形下，黑洞周围的引力透镜效应会使任何局域源产生多个延时像，出现在观测者屏幕上的不同位置。即使无法分辨出特定源，这种效应也可能通过研究黑洞电影（随时间变化的图像）中强度涨落的两点时空关联函数来揭示。最近，由广义相对论磁流体动力学模拟的光线追踪得到的电影所导出的关联函数，证明了这一想法的可行性，即使在将电影模糊到与下一代地基甚长基线干涉阵列相应的角分辨率时也是如此。在本工作中，我们进一步发展了这一方法，并研究了受真实观测限制启发的一些可能的数据损坏如何影响通过关联识别极端透镜特征的能力。我们比较了这些效应对原始电影和模糊电影的影响。我们讨论了分析对即将到来的M87*和Sgr A*观测的意义，它们是事件视界望远镜及其未来扩展的两个主要目标。我们的案例研究表明，我们所探索的数据损坏类型本身并不妨碍在关联测量中识别极端透镜效应。我们利用结果粗略估计，最重要的是，为了成功进行关联测量，M87*可能需要连续监测≳2年，而Sgr A*可能需要以≳每分钟1帧的节奏进行测量。最后，我们概述了一种新的分析方法，将完整关联函数（定义在五维构型空间上的大数据集）约化为二维直方图，这可能对黑洞参数推断有用。
classification.one_liner: 通过研究黑洞电影中强度涨落的两点关联函数，评估真实观测数据损坏对探测黑洞极端引力透镜效应的影响，并给出M87*和Sgr A*观测需求。

papers.title: Hyperon bulk viscosity effects in neutron-star inspirals
papers.abstract: The paper revisits the role of hyperon bulk viscosity during neutron-star inspiral. We find that hyperon bulk viscosity exerts only a minor influence on the gravitational-wave phase, causing a phase shift of $\sim 10^{-3}\,\rm rad$. This shift is too small to be detected by existing gravitational-wave observatories, and it seems unlikely that next-generation detectors will be able to isolate this effect from other factors. However, our analysis indicates that hyperon bulk viscosity can significantly heat the hyperon core of a neutron star, raising its temperature to approximately $5 \times 10^8\,\rm K$.

classification.title_zh: 超子体粘滞对中子星并合的影响
classification.abstract_zh: 本文重新审视了中子星并合过程中超子体粘滞的作用。我们发现超子体粘滞对引力波相位影响很小，引起的相移约为10^{-3}弧度。这个相移太小，现有引力波观测站无法探测，下一代探测器似乎也不太可能将这一效应与其他因素区分开来。然而，我们的分析表明，超子体粘滞可以显著加热中子星的超子核心，将其温度提高到约5×10^8 K。
classification.one_liner: 研究表明超子体粘滞对中子星并合引力波相位影响可忽略，但能显著加热超子核心至约5×10^8 K。

papers.title: Assessing astrophysical foreground subtraction in DECIGO using compact binary populations inferred from the first part of the LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA's fourth observation run
papers.abstract: Detecting the stochastic gravitational wave background (SGWB) from our Universe under the inflationary era is one of the primary scientific objectives of DECi-hertz Interferometer Gravitational wave Observatory (DECIGO), a space-borne gravitational wave detector sensitive in the 0.1Hz frequency band. This frequency band is dominated by the gravitational waves from inspiraling compact object binaries. Subtracting these signals is necessary to search for the primordial SGWB. In this paper, we assess the feasibility of the subtraction of such binary signals by employing the population model inferred from the latest gravitational wave event catalogue of the LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA Collaboration. We find that the projection scheme, which was originally proposed by Cutler & Harms (2005), is necessary to reduce the binary signals to the level where DECIGO can detect the primordial background.

classification.title_zh: 评估使用LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA第四次观测运行第一部分推断的致密双星种群对DECIGO的天体物理前景减除
classification.abstract_zh: 探测宇宙暴胀时期产生的随机引力波背景（SGWB）是DECI赫兹干涉引力波天文台（DECIGO）的主要科学目标之一，该天基引力波探测器对0.1Hz频段敏感。这一频段主要由旋进致密天体双星的引力波主导。为了搜索原初SGWB，必须减除这些信号。本文利用从LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA合作组织最新引力波事件目录推断的种群模型，评估了减除这类双星信号的可行性。我们发现，最初由Cutler & Harms (2005)提出的投影方案对于将双星信号降至DECIGO可探测原初背景的水平是必要的。
classification.one_liner: 评估DECIGO中利用致密双星种群模型减除天体物理引力波前景的可行性，发现需要投影方案。

papers.title: Can UV meet IR in the Swiss cheese?
papers.abstract: We consider the embedding of regular black holes in an expanding universe and study how the ultraviolet modifications to the Schwarzschild geometry that regularize the black hole singularity affect the exterior universe's expansion rate. We consider several proposals for the regular black hole geometry and obtain the corresponding Friedmann equations for a universe filled only with dust and black holes. We show that different proposals have different implications which may be distinguished. We then test the hypothesis that the UV corrections to the black hole geometry may be responsible for the current phase of accelerated expansion. To this aim we constrain the value of the regular black hole UV cutoff parameter from observations. Interestingly we find that the best fit is obtained by values of the parameter corresponding to regular horizonless compact objects.

classification.title_zh: 紫外与红外能在瑞士奶酪宇宙中相遇吗？
classification.abstract_zh: 我们考虑将规则黑洞嵌入膨胀宇宙中，研究使黑洞奇点正则化的 Schwarzschild 几何紫外修正如何影响外部宇宙的膨胀速率。我们考虑了若干规则黑洞几何的提议，并得到了仅由尘埃和黑洞组成的宇宙对应的 Friedmann 方程。我们表明，不同提议会产生不同且可区分的后果。然后我们检验了黑洞几何的紫外修正可能导致当前加速膨胀阶段的假说。为此，我们利用观测约束规则黑洞的紫外截断参数。有趣的是，我们发现最佳拟合对应的参数值是无视界紧致天体。
classification.one_liner: 研究规则黑洞嵌入膨胀宇宙后其紫外修正如何影响外部宇宙膨胀，并用观测约束参数，发现最佳拟合对应无视界紧致天体。

papers.title: Ringdown analysis of GW250114 with orthonormal modes
papers.abstract: GW250114 is the loudest gravitational wave event to date observed by LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA Collaboration. Owing to its high signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), previous analyses based on quasinormal mode (QNM) superpositions have suggested evidence of the fundamental and the first overtone of the $\ell=m=2$ mode in this event. However, QNMs are not orthogonal and the inclusion of multiple QNMs induces correlations among them, which can hinder the robust identification of subdominant QNMs. To address this challenge, we apply an analysis based on orthonormalized QNMs [S. Morisaki $\textit{et al.}$, Phys. Rev. D $\textbf{112}$, 124083 (2025)] to GW250114. We find that, in the model including three $\ell=m=2$ QNMs up to the second overtone, the first overtone of the $\ell=m=2$ mode is more strongly supported than in previous nonorthogonal analyses, with the inferred significance increasing from $82.5\%$ to $99.9\%$. Furthermore, we estimate deviations from the Kerr prediction using the orthonormal QNM framework and find no significant deviation, consistent with previous analyses. These results demonstrate that the orthonormal QNM framework provides a more robust way to identify subdominant modes in high-SNR ringdown signals, highlighting its potential for future gravitational wave observations.

classification.title_zh: GW250114 的正交模态振铃分析
classification.abstract_zh: GW250114 是迄今 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 合作组观测到的最响亮的引力波事件。由于其高信噪比（SNR），先前基于准正则模（QNM）叠加的分析表明该事件存在 l=m=2 模的基模和第一泛音的证据。然而，QNM 并非正交的，包含多个 QNM 会引入它们之间的相关性，这可能妨碍对次级 QNM 的稳健识别。为了应对这一挑战，我们将基于正交化 QNM 的分析 [S. Morisaki et al., Phys. Rev. D 112, 124083 (2025)] 应用于 GW250114。我们发现，在包含直到第二泛音的三个 l=m=2 QNM 的模型中，l=m=2 模的第一泛音比之前的非正交分析得到更强支持，推断显著性从 82.5% 增加到 99.9%。此外，我们使用正交 QNM 框架估计了与 Kerr 预言的偏差，发现没有显著偏差，与先前分析一致。这些结果表明，正交 QNM 框架为在高 SNR ringdown 信号中识别次级模提供了更稳健的方法，凸显了其未来引力波观测的潜力。
classification.one_liner: 利用正交化准正则模方法分析引力波事件 GW250114，显著提升了 l=m=2 第一泛音的检测置信度并确认与 Kerr 预言一致。

papers.title: Determination of the metric of a Schwarzschild black hole surrounded by a halo of dark matter
papers.abstract: Following the landmark acquisition of the first image of a black hole, systems comprising a black hole enveloped by a dark matter halo have attracted considerable attention. This work implements a novel method to analyze the structure of a system composed of a Schwarzschild black hole and a dark matter halo modeled as an anisotropic fluid, while ensuring that the proposed metric constitutes an exact solution of the Einstein field equations. Numerical results show that the connection between the temporal and radial metric functions preserves an inverse relationship, namely $A(r) \approx 1/B(r)$. Furthermore, we analytically demonstrate that the resulting functions satisfy $A(r)B(r) = 1 + \mathcal{O}(10^{-6})$, in excellent agreement with the numerical findings. In addition, the Einstein equations imply that the variation of the product $A(r)B(r)$ is governed by the factor $\varepsilon_h=\frac{8\pi G\rho_0r_0^2}{c^2}$. Finally, we show that the interior Schwarzschild region and the exterior dark matter halo can be joined smoothly via a regular Darmois Israel junction, without generating any thin shell curvature steps. To assess the observational implications of the model, we compare its theoretical predictions for the pericenter precession of the S2 star and the angular size of the shadow of Sgr A*. In both cases, the predicted deviations remain within the observational uncertainties reported by the GRAVITY Collaboration and the Event Horizon Telescope (EHT), respectively. These results demonstrate that the proposed black hole dark matter halo configuration is not only mathematically consistent, but also compatible with current observational constraints.

classification.title_zh: 确定被暗物质晕包围的Schwarzschild黑洞的度规
classification.abstract_zh: 继具有里程碑意义的首张黑洞图像获取之后，由黑洞被暗物质晕包围所构成的系统引起了广泛关注。本工作采用一种新方法来分析由Schwarzschild黑洞和建模为各向异性流体的暗物质晕组成的系统的结构，同时确保所提出的度规构成爱因斯坦场方程的精确解。数值结果表明，时间和径向度规函数之间的联系保持逆关系，即$A(r) \approx 1/B(r)$。此外，我们解析地证明了所得函数满足$A(r)B(r) = 1 + \mathcal{O}(10^{-6})$，与数值结果高度一致。另外，爱因斯坦方程暗示乘积$A(r)B(r)$的变化由因子$\varepsilon_h=\frac{8\pi G\rho_0r_0^2}{c^2}$控制。最后，我们展示了内部Schwarzschild区域和外部暗物质晕可以通过规则的Darmois-Israel连接平滑拼接，而不会产生任何薄壳曲率台阶。为了评估模型的观测意义，我们将其对S2恒星近心点进动和Sgr A*阴影角大小的理论预言进行了比较。在两种情况下，预测偏差都保持在GRAVITY合作组和事件视界望远镜（EHT）报告的观测不确定度范围内。这些结果表明，所提出的黑洞-暗物质晕构型不仅在数学上一致，而且与当前的观测约束相容。
classification.one_liner: 构造了一个由Schwarzschild黑洞和暗物质晕组成的精确Einstein方程解，并验证其与S2星进动和Sgr A*阴影观测一致。

papers.title: Gravitational Waves from Green's Function Decomposition for a Kerr black hole: I. Equatorial ISCO Plunge
papers.abstract: We present a decomposition of the Kerr Green's function in the time domain, motivated by the frequency-domain split previously studied in the Schwarzschild limit. We show that the identification of a quasinormal-mode contribution, a direct part, and a late-time tail is still available, where the split times are determined by the black hole spin and positions of the emitter and receiver. We have checked this Green's function with time-domain Teukolsky numerical simulations and find excellent agreement. We also apply this decomposed Green's function in the time domain to a model problem with a test particle plunging into a Kerr black hole. The dynamically excited direct wave and quasinormal modes are obtained by convoluting the Green's function with the particle's source term, which may be viewed as the first order in mass ratio of a spinning black hole ringdown.

classification.title_zh: Kerr黑洞Green函数分解的引力波：I. 赤道ISCO plunge
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出了Kerr Green函数在时域中的分解，其动机是先前在Schwarzschild极限中研究的频域分裂。我们表明，准正则模贡献、直接部分和晚期尾巴的识别仍然可行，其中分裂时间由黑洞自旋以及发射器和接收器的位置决定。我们用时域Teukolsky数值模拟检验了该Green函数，发现一致性极好。我们还将该分解的时域Green函数应用于一个测试粒子plunge进入Kerr黑洞的模型问题。通过将Green函数与粒子的源项卷积，得到动态激发的直接波和准正则模，这可视为旋转黑洞ringdown的质量比一阶结果。
classification.one_liner: 基于Kerr Green函数时域分解，将 plunge 源的直接波与QNM分离，并与Teukolsky模拟吻合。

papers.title: A Practical Study of Lightweight Neural Gravitational-Wave Detection in Real LIGO Noise: Models, Ablations, and Open Software
papers.abstract: Machine-learning methods offer a computationally efficient complement to conventional gravitational-wave searches, but their performance depends strongly on training data, preprocessing, inference design, and robustness to nonstationary detector noise. We present a framework for developing and evaluating lightweight neural detectors using real LIGO data. The pipeline includes strain acquisition, waveform injection, training, inference, and trigger construction. Using O3a data, we compare twelve architectures and perform ablations of normalization, whitening, label width, glitch handling, SNR curricula, and inference triggers. We find that simple temporal convolutional networks match or outperform more complex architectures, including attention-based and graph models, within our implementation. We then train four independently initialized 116k-parameter TCNs on O3b noise and evaluate them on 22.7 days of coincident data containing 13 confident GWTC-3 events. At a threshold fixed using O3a data, the four models recover 8, 9, 9, and 9 events while producing 0, 0, 1, and 0 false-positive triggers, respectively, without post hoc vetoes or inter-model coincidence filtering. In injection studies, the models achieve a median sensitive volume of $5.4\,\mathrm{Gpc}^3$ at the preselected threshold, corresponding to a median false-alarm rate of $20.5\,\mathrm{yr}^{-1}$. At a stricter threshold, the median sensitive volume remains $4.6\,\mathrm{Gpc}^3$, with three models returning 0 false alarms and one model yielding 1 false alarm, observed across one year of background per model. These results show that, within the tested implementations and training setup, careful pipeline design can matter more than architectural complexity and provide a lightweight pipeline for future studies on real interferometer data.

classification.title_zh: 轻量级神经引力波探测在真实LIGO噪声中的实践研究：模型、消融实验和开源软件
classification.abstract_zh: 机器学习方法为传统引力波搜索提供了一种计算高效的补充，但其性能强烈依赖于训练数据、预处理、推理设计和对抗非平稳探测器噪声的鲁棒性。我们提出了一个使用真实LIGO数据开发和评估轻量级神经探测器的框架。该流程包括应变获取、波形注入、训练、推理和触发构建。使用O3a数据，我们比较了十二种架构，并对归一化、白化、标签宽度、毛刺处理、信噪比课程和推理触发进行了消融实验。我们发现，在我们的实现中，简单的时间卷积网络（TCN）与更复杂的架构（包括注意力机制和图模型）相比，性能相当或更好。然后，我们在O3b噪声上训练了四个独立初始化的116k参数TCN，并对包含13个置信的GWTC-3事件的22.7天重合数据进行了评估。在使用O3a数据固定的阈值下，四个模型分别恢复了8、9、9和9个事件，同时产生0、0、1和0个误报触发，无需事后剔除或模型间重合过滤。在注入研究中，模型在预设阈值下实现了中位灵敏体积$5.4\,\mathrm{Gpc}^3$，对应中位误报率$20.5\,\mathrm{yr}^{-1}$。在更严格的阈值下，中位灵敏体积保持$4.6\,\mathrm{Gpc}^3$，三个模型返回0误报，一个模型在每模型一年的背景观测中产生1次误报。这些结果表明，在所测试的实现和训练设置中，精心的流程设计可能比架构复杂性更重要，并为未来在真实干涉仪数据上的研究提供了一个轻量级流程。
classification.one_liner: 一项利用真实LIGO数据比较轻量级神经网络架构的实证研究，表明简单的时间卷积网络在引力波检测中可媲美复杂模型。

papers.title: Irreducible Gravitational Wave Background as a Particle Detector
papers.abstract: Beyond the standard model particles can imprint a temporary early matter-dominated epoch on a stochastic gravitational-wave background. For a freely propagating background whose production has ceased, we show that the resulting feature contains two characteristic frequencies that determine the particle decay rate $\Gamma$ and the abundance-weighted mass $Y_iM$, independently of the microphysical origin of the gravitational-wave source. Using numerical scans, we derive semi-analytic relations between these characteristic frequencies and the BSM particle parameters, and quantify the parameter ranges over which these relations remain valid. For backgrounds that remain actively sourced, the end of early matter domination continues to define a source-independent cosmological frequency scale controlled by $\Gamma$, although the second feature, and hence the inference of $Y_iM$, is source dependent. Once a particle model and production mechanism are specified, the measured combinations can be translated into masses and microscopic couplings. Remarkably, decay lengths targeted by upcoming long-lived-particle searches map directly onto the nanohertz range in which NANOGrav has reported evidence for a stochastic gravitational-wave background.

classification.title_zh: 不可约引力波背景作为粒子探测器
classification.abstract_zh: 超越标准模型的粒子可以在随机引力波背景上留下一个临时的早期物质主导时期。对于产生已经停止的自由传播背景，我们表明所产生的特征包含两个特征频率，它们独立于引力波源的微观物理起源，决定了粒子衰变率Γ和丰度加权质量YiM。通过数值扫描，我们推导出这些特征频率与BSM粒子参数之间的半解析关系，并量化这些关系保持有效的参数范围。对于仍在积极产生的背景，早期物质主导的结束继续定义一个由Γ控制的与源无关的宇宙学频率尺度，尽管第二个特征以及因此对YiM的推断是依赖源的。一旦指定了粒子模型和产生机制，测得的组合可以转化为质量和微观耦合。值得注意的是，即将进行的长期粒子搜索所针对的衰变长度直接映射到纳赫兹范围，而NANOGrav已报告在该范围内有随机引力波背景的证据。
classification.one_liner: 提出随机引力波背景中的特征频率可独立于源机制地探测超标准模型粒子的衰变率和质量，并与NANOGrav纳赫兹信号相联系。

papers.title: Squeezed state degradations due to mode mismatch and thermal aberrations in gravitational wave detectors
papers.abstract: To date, frequency-dependent squeezed light has been used to reduce quantum noise in interferometric gravitational-wave detectors by 6.1 dB (a factor of two). Future upgrades and detectors aim to both reduce quantum noise by 10 dB (a factor of three) and to increase the circulating power in the interferometer arm cavities. Achieving these goals will be extremely challenging due, in part, to the degradations to the squeezed state caused by mode mismatch between the internal interferometer optical cavities and between the auxiliary external cavities. It is therefore imperative to gain a detailed understanding of all sources of mismatch and to obtain experience in mitigating their effects in the current detectors in order to improve astrophysical sensitivity now and in the future. Two types of internal mismatch are identified which are due to the thermal aberrations generated when the test mass optics absorb a small fraction of the circulating arm power. It is found that the dynamics responsible for the degradations caused by the mismatch between the quadratic part of the wavefront of two modes has a characteristic low-pass frequency dependence while the dynamics of the mismatch due to all higher order thermal aberrations has a high-pass behavior. As a consequence, the two types of mismatch are predominantly responsible for different squeezing degradations---some of which are significant for the current detectors and some of which will only be important for future detectors with longer arms. The behavior of these two types of internal mismatch are described, and the implications for detector design, operation, and characterization are discussed.

classification.title_zh: 引力波探测器中由模式失配和热像差引起的压缩态退化
classification.abstract_zh: 迄今为止，频率相关的压缩光已被用于将干涉式引力波探测器的量子噪声降低6.1 dB（两倍）。未来的升级和探测器旨在将量子噪声降低10 dB（三倍），并增加干涉仪臂腔内循环功率。实现这些目标将极具挑战性，部分原因是由于干涉仪内部光腔之间以及辅助外部光腔之间的模式失配所导致的压缩态退化。因此，必须详细了解所有失配来源，并在当前探测器中积累缓解其影响的经验，以提高当前和未来的天体物理灵敏度。识别出两种内部失配，它们源于测试质量光学元件吸收少量循环臂功率时产生的热像差。研究发现，导致两种模式波前二次部分失配的动力学具有特征性的低频依赖，而由所有高阶热像差引起的失配动力学则具有高通行为。因此，这两种类型的失配主要导致不同的压缩退化——其中一些对当前探测器很重要，而另一些只对未来具有更长臂的探测器重要。描述这两种内部失配的行为，并讨论对探测器设计、运行和表征的影响。
classification.one_liner: 研究引力波探测器中因模式失配和热像差导致的压缩态退化机制，区分了低频和高频两种失配类型。

papers.title: The facts on quantum self-dual Einstein gravity and self-dual Yang-Mills theory
papers.abstract: Self-dual Einstein gravity is a one-loop exact, UV and IR finite, diffeomorphism invariant, non-unitary theory of quantum gravity in four dimensions. The only non-trivial amplitudes are the one-loop-all-plus amplitudes, and they are equal to those of pure Einstein gravity. In these notes we review SDG and SDYM pedagogically. We walk the reader through key calculations, fill in some gaps in the literature, and point out directions for future research. Topics include: derivation of the self-dual actions from the full Einstein gravity/YM actions in lightcone gauge, decoupling of ghosts, Berends-Giele currents, vanishing of tree-level-one-minus amplitudes, celestial $Lw_{1+\infty}$ symmetry, perturbiners, double-off-shell current calculation of one-loop-all-plus SDYM and SDG amplitudes, dimension shifting, unitarity cuts, the BDPR gravity formula, one-loop color ordering, and the covariant formulations of the self-dual theories as well as their their gauge fixing. We also review some selected results from the celestial holography program, and briefly comment on an all-n expression for the one-loop-one-minus gravity amplitudes.

classification.title_zh: 量子自对偶爱因斯坦引力与自对偶杨-米尔斯理论的事实
classification.abstract_zh: 自对偶爱因斯坦引力是四维中一圈精确、紫外与红外有限、微分同胚不变且非幺正的量子引力理论。其仅有的非平凡振幅是一圈全正螺旋度振幅，并与纯爱因斯坦引力相同。本文以教学方式回顾自对偶引力与自对偶杨-米尔斯理论：给出光锥规范下从完整作用量出发的推导、鬼场解耦、Berends-Giele流、树级单负螺旋度振幅消失、天球 Lw_{1+∞} 对称性、perturbiner、双离壳流对一圈全正振幅的计算、维数平移、幺正切割、BDPR 引力公式、一圈颜色排序及协变表述与规范固定。文中还回顾了天球全息项目的部分结果，并简要评论一圈单负螺旋度引力振幅的 all-n 表达式。
classification.one_liner: 教学性综述自对偶爱因斯坦引力与自对偶杨-米尔斯理论：一圈精确、有限、非幺正，唯一非平凡的一圈全正振幅及其天球全息联系。

papers.title: Why Cooper pairs live in AdS2: a spectral analysis of the Yukawa-SYK model
papers.abstract: We establish the spectral foundation of the geometric formulation of Cooper pairing in the Yukawa--Sachdev--Ye--Kitaev model. Starting from the large-$N$ bilocal effective action, we derive the Gaussian fluctuation kernel in the even-frequency spin-singlet Cooper channel. Following the construction of Maldacena and Stanford, we determine the kernel eigenvalue $k\left(h\right)$ analytically for arbitrary conformal weight $h$ and resolve the pairing fluctuations into the continuous and discrete sectors of the associated de-Sitter space Laplacian. We show that the superconducting instability and the universal low-energy fluctuations near it reside entirely in the continuous scattering sector, while the discrete modes remain non-critical. Expanding the kernel about the lowest continuum mode yields a Klein--Gordon action on ${\rm dS}_2$, restricted to the continuous spectral subspace. This is precisely the subspace on which the inverse Radon transform to ${\rm AdS}_2$ is well defined. The projected bilocal Cooper-pair field can therefore be mapped onto a scalar matter field propagating in ${\rm AdS}_2$, without requiring any further spectral restriction on the bulk theory. Our results provide the missing microscopic justification for the projection implicit in earlier holographic formulations and clarify how a local bulk field emerges from the bilocal pairing theory.
