papers.title: Topology sums, sectorwise holography, and horizon normalcy
papers.abstract: The ``holography of information'' (HoI) principle argues that gravity can encode information redundantly in asymptotic observables. Although HoI is ultimately a nonperturbative claim, its standard motivation uses semiclassical gravitational constraints, the boundary nature of the Hamiltonian, and vacuum-sector cyclicity. We ask what happens when the same semiclassical path-integral reasoning allows topology sums that generate baby-universe or $\alpha$-sector data. Our analysis is conditional: such sectors need not survive in every unitary completion, and the Baby Universe Hypothesis of McNamara and Vafa instead suggests $\dim\mathcal H_{\rm BU}=1$ in consistent $d>3$ quantum gravity. If $\mathcal H_{\rm BU}$ is nontrivial, as in the Marolf--Maxfield formulation and in ensemble-like examples such as JT gravity, then HoI is naturally refined to an $\alpha$-sectorwise statement, $\overline{\mathcal A_\infty^{(\alpha)}|0_\alpha\rangle}=\mathcal H_\alpha$, rather than completeness on the full topology-summed Hilbert space. In a fixed $\alpha$-sector, HoI may obstruct AMPS factorization and allow a smooth horizon; in an unconditioned topology-summed state, the sector-independent obstruction is not automatic. A Bell-pair diagnostic shows that a sector-independent smooth interior requires aligned interior reconstructions, or access to the sector label. Thus the HoI-based absence of firewalls becomes conditional on global sector data, in tension with the generally covariant expectation emphasized by Bousso that horizon normalcy should be determined by local semiclassical geometry. If the exact theory collapses $\mathcal H_{\rm BU}$ to one dimension, the obstruction discussed here is absent.

classification.title_zh: 拓扑求和、扇区化全息与视界正常性
classification.abstract_zh: “信息全息性”（HoI）原理认为引力可以在渐近观测量中冗余编码信息。尽管 HoI 最终是非微扰主张，其标准动机使用半经典引力约束、哈密顿量的边界性质以及真空扇区的循环性。我们考虑当相同的半经典路径积分论证允许产生婴宇宙或 α-扇区数据的拓扑求和时会发生什么。我们的分析是有条件的：这些扇区不一定在每个幺正完备化中都存在，而 McNamara 和 Vafa 的婴宇宙假设反而表明在一致的 d>3 量子引力中 dim H_BU=1。如果 H_BU 非平凡，如 Marolf–Maxfield 构造和 JT 引力等系综示例，那么 HoI 自然被精炼为 α-扇区级陈述，\overline{\mathcal A_\infty^{(\alpha)}|0_\alpha\rangle}=\mathcal H_\alpha，而不是整个拓扑求和希尔伯特空间上的完备性。在固定 α-扇区中，HoI 可能阻碍 AMPS 分解并允许光滑视界；在无条件拓扑求和态中，扇区无关的阻碍并非自动成立。Bell 对诊断表明，扇区无关的光滑内部需要内部重构对齐，或获得扇区标签。因此，基于 HoI 的无火墙论点变得依赖于全局扇区数据，这与 Bousso 强调的一般协变期望（视界正常性应由局域半经典几何决定）存在张力。如果精确理论将 H_BU 坍缩为一维，这里讨论的阻碍不存在。
classification.one_liner: 探讨信息全息原理在拓扑求和和婴宇宙 α-扇区下的修正，指出光滑视界依赖于全局扇区数据，与局域半经典协变期望存在张力。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文关注信息全息性、拓扑求和、婴宇宙、α-扇区与视界火墙等量子引力基础问题，不涉及全息超流超导、p波序、非均匀态、multi-trace、相变成核、QNM、冷原子或探针膜 Floquet 驱动等用户重点研究支线。

papers.title: Massless Islands in Wedge Holography
papers.abstract: Entanglement islands are most easily realized in doubly holographic models with massive gravitons or non-gravitating baths. In wedge holography, however, Neumann boundary conditions on both branes give a normalizable massless graviton, while the island saddle of the purely geometric Ryu--Takayanagi (RT) problem collapses to the horizon. Negative Dvali--Gabadadze--Porrati (DGP) terms can restore nontrivial islands by modifying the endpoint condition, but this branch contains a massive ghost. We propose a different semiclassical mechanism. We keep the wedge gravitational action free of DGP terms and couple the healthy Neumann wedge sector to a unitary defect CFT localized at the codimension-two corner. This sector is distinct from the standard corner CFT dual to the undeformed wedge, so its entropy enters as the ordinary matter-entropy term in the quantum extremal surface (QES) prescription without double counting the wedge RT area. If the defect theory is holographic, this entropy can be evaluated by an auxiliary RT surface. We show that when the wedge endpoint determines the defect entangling region, the auxiliary area can vary in the opposite way to the wedge area while all couplings and central charges remain positive. A local endpoint model gives an isolated stable saddle that dominates over the Hartman--Maldacena (HM) surface at late times. The QES condition then replaces the pure orthogonality condition and permits a non-horizon island saddle in a long-range, massless, ghost-free gravitational theory. Thus, the obstruction to massless islands in minimal wedge holography is not masslessness itself, but the absence of a healthy matter-entropy contribution capable of balancing the horizon-minimizing area variation.

classification.title_zh: 楔形全息中的无质量岛
classification.abstract_zh: 纠缠岛最容易在具有有质量引力子或非引力化浴槽的双重全息模型中实现。然而在楔形全息中，两个膜上的 Neumann 边界条件给出一个可归一化的无质量引力子，而纯几何 Ryu–Takayanagi (RT) 问题的岛鞍点塌缩到视界。负 Dvali–Gabadadze–Porrati (DGP) 项可以通过修改端点条件恢复非平凡岛，但该分支包含一个有质量鬼场。我们提出一种不同的半经典机制。我们保持楔形引力作用量不含 DGP 项，并将健康的 Neumann 楔形扇区与位于余二维角落处的幺正缺陷 CFT 耦合。该扇区不同于未变形楔形对应的标准角 CFT，因此其熵作为量子极值面 (QES) 处方中的普通物质熵项进入，而不会与楔形 RT 面积重复计算。如果缺陷理论是全息的，则这个熵可以由一个辅助 RT 面来评估。我们证明，当楔形端点决定缺陷纠缠区域时，辅助面积可以与楔形面积相反的方式变化，同时所有耦合和中心荷保持为正。一个局域端点模型给出一个孤立的稳定鞍点，在晚期超过哈特曼–马尔达塞纳 (HM) 面。QES 条件从而取代纯正交条件，并允许在一个长程、无质量、无鬼场的引力理论中出现非视界岛鞍点。因此，最小楔形全息中无质量岛的障碍并不是无质量本身，而是缺少能够平衡视界最小化面积变化的健康物质熵贡献。
classification.one_liner: 提出在楔形全息中通过余二维角落缺陷 CFT 恢复无质量、无鬼场的非平凡纠缠岛，指出障碍在于缺少可平衡面积变化的物质熵贡献。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究楔形全息中的纠缠岛、量子极值面与无质量引力子的关系，属于全息量子引力与纠缠信息交叉的核心方向，与用户关注的全息理论基本结构高度相关。

papers.title: Holographic Krylov Complexity with Lifshitz Scaling and Hyperscaling Violation
papers.abstract: Following the holographic proposal that identifies the growth rate of Krylov complexity with the proper radial momentum of an infalling massive probe, we study Krylov complexity in Lifshitz and hyperscaling-violating backgrounds. For pure Lifshitz geometries, we find quadratic complexity growth for all values of the dynamical exponent. For hyperscaling-violating backgrounds, we show that the hyperscaling-violating exponent directly controls the late-time growth exponent, with a special limiting case exhibiting oscillatory behavior with a logarithmic envelope. We also extend our analysis to top-down string constructions, confirming the robustness of the scaling behaviors obtained in the bottom-up approach. Our analysis establishes that the momentum-Krylov correspondence extends naturally to non-relativistic holographic settings and remains well-defined despite the causal pathologies of Lifshitz spacetimes.

classification.title_zh: 具有Lifshitz标度和超尺度破坏的全息Krylov复杂度
classification.abstract_zh: 遵循将Krylov复杂度的增长率与下落的巨大探针的径向动量等同的全息提议，我们在Lifshitz和超尺度破坏背景下研究Krylov复杂度。对于纯Lifshitz几何，我们发现所有动力学指数值下复杂度均呈二次增长。对于超尺度破坏背景，我们证明超尺度破坏指数直接控制晚期时间增长指数，其中一种特殊极限情形表现出带对数包络的振荡行为。我们还将分析扩展到自上而下的弦论构造，证实了自下而上方法中获得的标度行为的稳健性。我们的分析表明，动量-克雷洛夫对应关系自然地推广到非相对论全息环境，并且尽管Lifshitz时空具有因果病态，该对应关系仍然定义良好。
classification.one_liner: 研究Lifshitz和超尺度破坏背景下的全息Krylov复杂度，发现纯Lifshitz情形二次增长，超尺度破坏指数控制晚期增长。
classification.relevance_reason: 摘要涉及全息Krylov复杂度与非相对论标度背景，不直接涉及用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子/双组分BEC、或D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜与Floquet驱动等方向。

papers.title: A Horizon-to-Boundary Dictionary Linking Smooth Horizon Continuation, Pole-Skipping, and \(SL(2,\mathbb R)\) Lowest-Weight Structure
papers.abstract: We study pole-skipping for a scalar field in the JT/AdS$_2$ black-hole background. Previous work established the local mechanism: at a pole-skipping point, a near-horizon recurrence relation becomes degenerate and an additional regular expansion coefficient is left undetermined. We take this local degeneracy as the starting point and track two independent solutions normalized at the AdS boundary, denoted by $R_1$ and $R_2$ for the source and response branches, respectively. Let $\widehat A$ and $\widehat B$ denote the source and response coefficients after their common singular factor is removed, and let $\chi_\mu$ denote the universal ingoing horizon factor. We find \[ \widehat A=0 \Longleftrightarrow \frac{R_2}{\chi_\mu}\in C^\infty, \qquad \widehat B=0 \Longleftrightarrow \frac{R_1}{\chi_\mu}\in C^\infty . \] Thus the source and response zeros correspond separately to horizon smoothness of the two boundary-normalized solutions after the ingoing factor is removed. At integer resonance the local regular solution contains an additional coefficient $a_N$. In the JT/AdS$_2$ model, continuation of the nonresonant ingoing solution fixes $a_N=0$ and thereby selects a unique retarded value at resonance, although unrestricted approaches in parameter space remain path dependent. At the endpoint of the pole-skipping lattice, the response branch is a lowest-weight state of the background $SL(2,\mathbb R)$ symmetry. A static holographic-superconductor example further shows that simultaneous horizon smoothness is insufficient if the two boundary branches are linearly dependent. A two-branch pole-zero intersection therefore requires \[ W[R_1,R_2]\neq0. \] These results distinguish the known local horizon degeneracy from the global relation between boundary branches and the resonant horizon solution space.

secondary_topics: 全息凝聚态/超流超导/强关联
classification.title_zh: 连接光滑视界延拓、极点跳跃与SL(2,R)最低权结构的视界-边界字典
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究JT/AdS2黑洞背景中标量场的pole-skipping。此前工作确立了局域机制：在pole-skipping点，近视界递推关系变得退化，留下一个额外的正则展开系数未定。我们以这一局域退化作为出发点，追踪在AdS边界归一化的两个独立解，分别记为源分支与响应分支的R1和R2。令\widehat A和\widehat B表示去除共同奇异因子后的源与响应系数，\chi_\mu表示普适的内行视界因子。我们发现：\widehat A=0当且仅当R2/\chi_\mu属于C^\infty；\widehat B=0当且仅当R1/\chi_\mu属于C^\infty。因此源与响应零点分别对应两个边界归一化解在去除内行因子后的视界光滑性。在整数共振处，局域正则解包含额外系数a_N。在JT/AdS2模型中，非共振内行解的延拓固定a_N=0，从而在共振处选出唯一的滞后值，尽管参数空间中的无限制途径仍存在路径依赖。在pole-skipping格点端点，响应分支是背景SL(2,R)对称性的最低权态。一个静态全息超导例子进一步表明，若两个边界分支线性相关，则同时视界光滑并不充分。因此双分支极点-零点相交要求W[R1,R2]不等于0。这些结果区分了已知的局域视界退化与边界分支和共振视界解空间之间的全局关系。
classification.one_liner: 在JT/AdS2背景下建立视界光滑延拓与极点跳跃源/响应零点的等价字典，并用全息超导例子说明双分支线性独立性的必要。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究AdS/CFT框架下JT/AdS2黑洞背景中的pole-skipping、边界条件与视界光滑性的关系，并以全息超导为例验证判据，与全息QNM和全息凝聚态强相关。

papers.title: D4-branes wrapped on topological disks from matter-coupled F(4) gauged supergravity
papers.abstract: We study a number of supersymmetric $AdS_4\times \Sigma$ solutions with $\Sigma$ being a topological disk with non-trivial $U(1)$ holonomy on the boundary or a ``half-spindle'' from matter-coupled $F(4)$ gauged supergravity. The gauged supergravity is coupled to three vector multiplets with $SO(3)\times SO(3)$ gauge group. The resulting solutions preserve eight supercharges and $SO(2)\times SO(2)$ or $SO(2)_{\text{diag}}$ symmetries and are expected to be dual to $N=2$ SCFTs in three dimensions arising from compactifications of five-dimensional $N=2$ SCFT on a half-spindle. All of the solutions lie within the $U(1)\times U(1)$ subsector of the matter-coupled $F(4)$ gauged supergravity that can be embedded in massive type IIA theory. After uplifted to ten dimensions, the solutions can be interpreted as a system of D4-D8-branes wrapped on $\Sigma$. Some of the solutions are asymptotic to a locally $AdS_6$ geometry and can be identified as codimension-2 conformal defects within the $N=2$ SCFT in five dimensions. For these solutions, the circle inside $\Sigma$ decompactifies in the $AdS_6$ limit rendering the holographic free energy infinite. There also exist solutions with finite free energy in the dual three-dimensional SCFTs. In addition, we show that the results both extend the previously known solutions and provide a novel class of solutions.

classification.title_zh: 物质耦合 F(4) 规范超引力中缠绕在拓扑圆盘上的 D4-膜
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了物质耦合 F(4) 规范超引力中的若干超对称 AdS4×Sigma 解，其中 Sigma 是边界上具有非平凡 U(1) 和乐（holonomy）的拓扑圆盘或“半纺锤体”（half-spindle）。该规范超引力耦合了三个矢量多重态，规范群为 SO(3)×SO(3)。所得解保持八个超荷，并具有 SO(2)×SO(2) 或 SO(2)_diag 对称性，预期对偶于由五维 N=2 SCFT 在半纺锤体上紧致化得到的三维 N=2 SCFT。所有这些解都位于物质耦合 F(4) 规范超引力的 U(1)×U(1) 子扇区中，并可嵌入 massive type IIA 超引力。提升到十维后，这些解可解释为 D4-D8 膜系统缠绕在 Sigma 上。其中一些解渐近于局部 AdS6 几何，可视为五维 N=2 SCFT 内的余维-2 共形缺陷。对这些解，Sigma 内的圆在 AdS6 极限下退紧致化，导致全息自由能发散。也存在在三维 SCFT 中具有有限自由能的解。此外，我们表明这些结果既推广了先前已知的解，也提供了一类新解。
classification.one_liner: 构造了 F(4) 规范超引力中 AdS4×拓扑圆盘/半纺锤体的超对称解，对应 D4-D8 膜缠绕系统，并论证其全息对偶为三维 N=2 SCFT 或五维 SCFT 中的共形缺陷。
classification.relevance_reason: 文章聚焦于 F(4) 规范超引力中的 AdS4×Sigma 超对称解与 D4-D8 膜缠绕构造，属于 AdS/CFT 基础，但未涉及用户列出的全息超流、p波、多分量序参量、QNM、冷原子或 D3-D7/D3-D5 Floquet 等具体支线，因此相关性较低。

papers.title: A geodesic distance interpretation of Lanczos coefficients
papers.abstract: We study the spread complexity of the infinite-temperature thermofield double state in large-$N$ random matrix theory and investigate the physical meaning of its Lanczos coefficients $b_n$. The leading density of states defines a family of orthogonal polynomials whose recursion coefficients coincide with the Lanczos coefficients of the associated Krylov dynamics. Starting from the Coulomb-gas equation, we derive a pair of nonlinear relations for these coefficients, which we call the Lanczos equations. Since the Lanczos coefficients approach constants at large Krylov index, the spread complexity grows linearly at late times. We further show that the Lanczos coefficients can be interpreted as generating functions for planar maps. For an even potential, the difference $b_{n+1}^2-b_n^2$ generates maps with two legs whose marked legs are separated by the exact geodesic distance $n$. Consequently, the spread complexity acceleration operator equals twice the geodesic generating operator. We illustrate these results in the quartic matrix model, where the expansion in the quartic coupling counts tetravalent planar maps, and in the double-scaled Sachdev--Ye--Kitaev model, where the auxiliary Hilbert space can be identified with the physical chord Hilbert space.

classification.title_zh: Lanczos 系数的测地线距离诠释
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究大 N 随机矩阵理论中无限温度热场双态（TFD）的展开复杂度，并探讨其 Lanczos 系数 b_n 的物理意义。态密度的领头阶定义了一族正交多项式，其递推系数与相应 Krylov 动力学的 Lanczos 系数一致。从库仑气体方程出发，我们导出一组关于这些系数的非线性关系，称为 Lanczos 方程。由于 Lanczos 系数在大 Krylov 指标处趋于常数，展开复杂度在晚期线性增长。进一步表明，Lanczos 系数可解释为平面地图的生成函数。对偶势，差值 b_{n+1}^2 - b_n^2 生成带有两条腿的地图，标记腿之间相隔精确的测地距离 n。因此，展开复杂度加速算符等于测地生成算符的两倍。我们在四次矩阵模型中说明了这些结果，其中按四次耦合展开计数四价平面地图；在双标度 Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev 模型中，辅助希尔伯特空间可与物理弦希尔伯特空间等同。
classification.one_liner: 将 Lanczos 系数解释为平面地图的生成函数，揭示展开复杂度与随机矩阵/SYK 中测地距离的联系。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于随机矩阵/SYK 与量子信息中的 Krylov 复杂度，不涉及用户重点的全息超流、相变、探针膜、Floquet 驱动或 QNM 等具体支线；与用户部分全息引力兴趣相邻但直接关联较低。

papers.title: Dissipation-enhanced scrambling in the SYK model coupled to a lossy cavity
papers.abstract: We study the Yukawa-Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev model, a disordered model of $N$ Majorana fermions and $R=\gamma N$ bosons in which the bosons are linearly coupled to independent realizations of SYK $p$-body interactions, in the presence of dissipation, modeled by a Lindblad master equation. Motivated by recent proposals for implementing SYK models in quantum simulators, we focus on bosonic leakage at rate $\kappa$. Initializing the system in the steady state, we analyze the late-time fermionic relaxation rate and the Lyapunov exponent, solving the large-$N$ theory both numerically and for $p$ large, finding a rich landscape of dynamical behaviors. Most notably, the Lyapunov exponent remains positive for every value of $\kappa$ and, for $p>2$, can even grow as $\kappa$ increases. The QED case $p=2$, which lies between the fully chaotic regime $p>2$ and the integrable case $p=1$, exhibits special features. We also identify a critical value of the boson-to-fermion ratio $\gamma_c \approx 2/p^2$ separating distinct dynamical regimes.

classification.title_zh: 耦合到耗散腔的SYK模型中的耗散增强量子置乱
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究 Yukawa-Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev 模型，这是一个包含 $N$ 个马约拉纳费米子和 $R=\gamma N$ 个玻色子的无序模型，其中玻色子线性耦合到 SYK $p$ 体相互作用的独立实现，并存在由 Lindblad 主方程描述的耗散。受近期在量子模拟器中实现 SYK 模型的提案启发，我们关注玻色子泄漏（速率 $\kappa$）。将系统初始化在稳态，我们分析晚时间费米子弛豫率和 Lyapunov 指数，通过数值和大 $p$ 近似求解大-$N$ 理论，发现丰富的动力学行为景观。最值得注意的是，Lyapunov 指数对每个 $\kappa$ 值保持为正，并且对于 $p>2$，甚至可随 $\kappa$ 增大而增长。QED 情形 $p=2$ 位于完全混沌区域 $p>2$ 与可积情形 $p=1$ 之间，表现出特殊性质。我们还确定了玻色子-费米子比的一个临界值 $\gamma_c \approx 2/p^2$，它区分了不同的动力学区域。
classification.one_liner: 该文在带耗散腔的 Yukawa-SYK 模型中发现耗散可增强 Lyapunov 指数，并揭示出关键的玻色子-费米子比。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文基于SYK模型，属于全息AdS2/JT引力模型的范畴，但摘要未直接涉及AdS/CFT字典或具体引力构造，而是聚焦于开放量子系统的混沌与耗散行为。
